42Caleb, Jerahmeel's brother, had the following descendants: Mesha, Ziph, Mareshah, Hebron, 43and Hebron's four sons, Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema. 44Shema was the father of Raham and the grandfather of Jorkeam. Rekem was the father of Shammai, 45the grandfather of Maon, and the great-grandfather of Bethzur.
46Ephah was one of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran named his son after his brother Gazez. 47Ephah was the daughter of Jahdai, who was also the father of Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, and Shaaph.
48Maacah was another of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Sheber and Tirhanah. 49Later, they had two more sons: Shaaph the father of Madmannah, and Sheva the father of Machbenah and Gibea. Caleb's daughter was Achsah. 50-51All of these were Caleb's descendants.
Hur, the oldest son of Caleb and Ephrath, had three sons: Shobal, Salma, and Hareph, who settled the town of Beth-Gader. 52Shobal, who settled the town of Kiriath-Jearim, was the ancestor of Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth clan, 53and the clans that lived near Kiriath-Jearim; they were the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites. The Zorathites and the Eshtaolites were descendants of the Mishraites.
54Salma settled the town of Bethlehem and was the ancestor of the Netophathites, the people of Atroth-Bethjoab, half of the Manahathite clan, and the Zorites. 55Salma was also the ancestor of the clans in Jabez that kept the court and government records; they were the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These clans were the descendants of Hammath the Kenite, who was also the ancestor of the Rechabites.
translation_text:
Israel biis yʋda nwa'
1Israel biribis da anɛ Reuben nɛ Simeon nɛ Levi nɛ Juda nɛ Isaka nɛ Zebulun 2nɛ Dan nɛ Josef nɛ Benjamin nɛ Naftali nɛ Gad nɛ Aser.
Juda yaas yʋda nwa'
3Juda pu'a kanɛ yʋ'ʋri da buon Bafisua la da du'a biribis atan' ka ba yʋda an Er nɛ Onan nɛ Sela, o da anɛ Keenan nid, ka o saam yʋ'ʋr buon Sua. Er onɛ aan o bikpɛɛm la da tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd Zugsɔb la tuon ka Zugsɔb la kɛ ka o kpi. 4Juda da dii o biig Onan pʋkɔɔnr la, ka on mɛ du'a Perez nɛ Zera. Juda biribis wʋsa da anɛ anu. 5Perez biribis da anɛ: Heziron nɛ Hamul. 6Zera biribis da anɛ: Zimiri nɛ Etan nɛ Heman nɛ Kalkol nɛ Daada. Ba wʋsa da la'as nɛ biribis anu. 7Akar da anɛ Karmi biig. Onɛ da zaŋ Zugsɔb la la'asieba ka li lieb o mɛŋ din ka li mɔr yɛla kɛn Israel dimin na la. 8Azaria da anɛ Etan biig. 9Heziron biribis da anɛ: Jerameel nɛ Ram nɛ Kaleb.
Ram yaas yʋda nwa'
10Ram da du'a Aminadab ka Aminadab du'a Nason, on da anɛ Juda dim tuongat. 11Nason da du'a Salmon ka Salmon du'a Boaz, 12Boaz da du'a Obɛd ka Obɛd du'a Jese.
13Jese bikpɛɛm da anɛ Eliab ka Abinadab tia'al ayi' ka Simea tia'al atan', 14ka Netanɛl da tia'al anaasi ka Aradaae tia'al anu ka 15Ozem da tia'al ayuobʋ ka David tia'al ayɔpɔi. 16Ba tanp yʋda da anɛ: Zeruyia nɛ Abigel. Zeruyia biribis da anɛ atan', ba yʋda da anɛ: Abisai nɛ Joab nɛ Asahel. 17Abigel biigi da an Amasa, ka o saam da an Jeta. O da anɛ Isimael nid.
Heziron yaas yʋda nwa'
18Heziron biigi da an Kaleb. Kaleb nɛ o pu'a Azuba da du'a bipuŋ Jeriof. Ba biribis da anɛ: Jeser nɛ Sobab nɛ Aridon. 19Azuba da kpi la, Kaleb da di Efirata du'a Hur. 20Hur da du'a Uri, ka Uri du'a Bezalel.
21Heziron da anɛ yʋma pisyuobʋ ka di Makir pu'ayua du'a Segub. Makir saam da anɛ Gilead. 22Segub da du'a Jair ka o sʋ'oe tɛɛns pisi nɛ atan' Gilead teŋgbauŋʋn. 23(Amaa lin nya'aŋ Gesur dim nɛ Aram dim da zabi faaɛn Jair Teŋkpɛmis la, nɛ Kenaf tempʋʋg nɛ li teŋkpɛmis, tɛɛns pisyuobʋ.) Bama wʋsa da anɛ Makir onɛ an Gilead la yaas. 24Heziron da kpi Efirata teŋin, linɛ an Kaleb sʋ'ʋlim la. On da kpii naae la, o pu'a Abija da du'a Asur ka Asur mɛ du'a Tekoa.
Jerameel yaas yʋda nwa'
25Heziron bikpɛɛm da anɛ Jerameel, ka Jerameel bikpɛɛm an Ram, ka banɛ tia'al an Buuna nɛ Orem nɛ Ozem nɛ Ahija. 26Ka o pu'abil Atara biig mɛ an Onam. 27Jerameel bikpɛɛm Ram biribis da anɛ Maaz nɛ Jamin nɛ Eker. 28Ka Onam biribis da an Seamaae nɛ Jada. Ka Seamaae biribis da an Nadab nɛ Abisuor.
29Abisuor pu'a yʋ'ʋri da buon Abihel, ka o biribis da anɛ Aban nɛ Moolid. 30Nadab biribis da anɛ Seled nɛ Apayim. Seled da kpiya ka pʋ du'a biisɛ. 31Apayim biig da anɛ Isi, ka on biig mɛ an Siesan, ka Siesan biig an Alai.
32Jada onɛ an Seamaae pitʋ la biribis da anɛ Jeta nɛ Jonatan. Jeta da kpiya ka pʋ du'a biisɛ. 33Jonatan biribis da anɛ Pelef nɛ Zaza. Bama wʋsa da anɛ Jerameel yaas.
34Siesan da ka' biribisɛ, ba da anɛ bipumis ma'aa. O da mɔr o yammʋg ka o an Egipt nid ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Jaha. 35O da nɔk o bipuŋi tis Jaha ka o kul o, du'a Atai tis o.
36Atai da du'a Natan, ka Natan du'a Zabad 37ka Zabad da du'a Efilal ka Efilal du'a Obɛd 38ka Obɛd da du'a Jehu ka Jehu du'a Azaria, 39ka Azaria da du'a Helez, ka Helez du'a Eleasa, 40ka Eleasa da du'a Sismaae, ka Sismaae du'a Sallum, 41Ka Sallum da du'a Jekamiya, ka Jekamiya du'a Elisama.
Kaleb dɔɔg dimi nwa'
42Jerameel pitʋ Kaleb biribis da anɛ Mesea onɛ da aan o bikpɛɛm. Ka Mesea du'a Zif; ka o biig yinne an Maresa ka on du'a Hebron. 43Hebron biribis da anɛ Kora nɛ Tapua nɛ Rekem nɛ Sema. 44Sema da du'a Raham ka Raham du'a Jokiam. Ka Rekem mɛ du'a Seamaae 45ka Seamaae da du'a Maon ka Maon du'a Bet Zur.
46Kaleb pu'abil Efa da du'a Haran nɛ Mooza nɛ Gaziis. Haran mɛ da mɔr biig ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Gaziis.
47Jadaae biribis da anɛ Regem nɛ Jotam nɛ Gesean nɛ Pelet nɛ Efa nɛ Saaf. 48Kaleb pu'abil Maaka da du'a Siebɛr nɛ Tirana. 49O da lɛn du'a biribis ayi', ka banɛ an Saaf nɛ Siiva. Saaf da sʋ'oe Madmana teŋ ka Siiva sʋ'oe Makbina nɛ Gibea tɛɛns. Kaleb pu'ayua da an Akisa.
50Bama da an Kaleb yaas. Hur da an Efirata bikpɛɛm, ka o biribis an Soobal onɛ da an Kiriaf Jiarim saam la. 51Betilehem saam da anɛ Sanlima ka Bet Gader saam an Haref.
52Soobal onɛ da an Kiriaf Jiarim saam la yaas da anɛ Haroi nɛ Manahaf dim la pʋsʋk, 53nɛ Kiriaf Jiarim dɔɔd la wʋsa; banɛ da an Yitir nɛ Puf nɛ Seuma nɛ Misira dim. Ka ba yaas da an Zora nɛ Esitaol dim.
54Sanlima yaas da anɛ Betilehem nɛ Netofa nɛ Atirof Bet Joab dim, nɛ Manahaf dim la pʋsʋk ya'as nɛ Zoor dim, 55nɛ gbauŋmi'idib dɔɔd banɛ bɛ Jabes teŋin la. Banɛ da an Tiira nɛ Simeaf nɛ Sueka dim.
Bama da anɛ Ken dim ka ba yaab an Hammaf onɛ biisi da an Rekab yidim la.

english_text:
The Descendants of King David
1-4 King David ruled from Hebron for seven years and six months, and during that time he had six sons, who were born in the following order: Amnon, Daniel, Absalom, Adonijah, Shephatiah, and Ithream. Ahinoam from Jezreel was the mother of Amnon; Abigail from Carmel was the mother of Daniel; Maacah daughter of King Talmai of Geshur was the mother of Absalom; Haggith was the mother of Adonijah; Abital was the mother of Shephatiah; and Eglah was the mother of Ithream.
David then ruled from Jerusalem for 33 years, 5 and during that time, he had 13 more sons. His wife Bathsheba daughter of Ammiel gave birth to Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon. 6-8David's other sons included Ibhar, Elishua, Eliphelet, Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia, Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet. 9David's other wives also gave birth to sons. Tamar was his daughter.
The Descendants of King Solomon
10-15Solomon's descendants included the following kings: Rehoboam, Abijah, Asa, Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, Ahaziah, Joash, Amaziah, Azariah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, Manasseh, Amon, and Josiah and his four sons, Johanan, Jehoiakim, Zedekiah, and Jehoahaz. 16Jehoiakim was the father of Jehoiachin and Zedekiah.
17Jehoiachin, who was taken to Babylon as a prisoner, had seven sons: Shealtiel, 18Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah. 19Pedaiah had two sons: Zerubbabel and Shimei. Zerubbabel was the father of Meshullam, Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister. 20He also had five other sons: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushabhesed. 21Hananiah's descendants were Pelatiah, Jeshaiah, Rephaiah, Arnan, Obadiah, and Shecaniah, 22the father of Shemaiah and the grandfather of Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat. 23Neariah was the father of Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam. 24Elioenai was the father of Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani.
translation_text:
Na'ab David yaas yʋda nwa'
1David n da du'a biribis sieba Hebron teŋin la yʋda nwa': O bikpɛɛm la yʋ'ʋri da buon Amnon ka o ma da an Abinoam ka yi Jezireel na. O bikanɛ da paas ayi' la yʋ'ʋri da buon Daniel ka o ma an Abigel onɛ da an Nabal pʋkɔɔnr ka yi Kaamel na la. 2O bikanɛ paas atan' la da anɛ Absalom ka o ma yʋ'ʋr buon Maaka ka an Talimai onɛ an Gesur na'ab pu'ayua la. Onɛ paas anaasi la yʋ'ʋri da buon Adonija ka o ma yʋ'ʋr buon Haggif. 3 O bikanɛ da paas anu la yʋ'ʋri da buon Sefatia ka o ma yʋ'ʋr buon Abital. Ka onɛ paas ayuobʋ la yʋ'ʋr da buon Itiram ka o ma an David pu'a kanɛ ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Egla la.
4Biis ayuobʋ ka David da du'a Hebron teŋin. O da zin'in na'am gbauŋ la zug anina yʋma ayɔpɔi nɛ nwadis ayuobʋ.
David da an na'ab Jerusalem teŋin nɛ yʋma atan'. 5 Bibanɛ ka o da du'a anina yʋda nwa':
Sammua nɛ Sobab nɛ Natan nɛ Solomon; biis anaasi nwa' ma yʋ'ʋri da buon Batsieba, o saam da anɛ Ammiel.
6Biis awai banɛ paas la yʋda nwa': Ibiha nɛ Elisua nɛ Elpelet nɛ 7Noga nɛ Nefeg nɛ Jafia nɛ 8Elisama nɛ Eliada nɛ Elifelet. 9Bama wʋsa da anɛ Na'ab David biribis, ka o pu'abibis la biribis pʋ paasɛ. Ka Tamar aan ba taʋn.
Juda sʋ'ʋlim na'anam yʋda nwa'
10Rehoboam da anɛ Na'ab Solomon biig ka on biig mɛ an Na'ab Abija, ka on biig mɛ an Na'ab Asa, ka on biig mɛ an Na'ab Jehosafat, 11ka on biig mɛ an Na'ab Jehoram, ka on biig mɛ an Na'ab Ahazaya, ka on biig mɛ an Na'ab Joas, 12ka on biig mɛ an Na'ab Amazaya, ka on biig mɛ an Na'ab Azaria, ka on biig mɛ an Na'ab Jotam, 13ka on biig mɛ an Na'ab Ahaz, ka on biig mɛ an Na'ab Hezekia, ka on biig mɛ an Na'ab Manase, 14ka on biig mɛ an Na'ab Ammon, ka on biig mɛ an Na'ab Josia,
15Na'ab Josia biribisi da an Johanan, onɛ aan o bikpɛɛm la, ka onɛ tia'al ayi' an Na'ab Jehoyakim, ka onɛ tia'al atan' an Na'ab Zedekaya, ka onɛ tia'al anaasi an Sallum.
16Banɛ da di'e na'am Na'ab Jehoyakim nya'aŋ da anɛ o mɛŋ biig Na'ab Jehoyakin. Ka on nya'aŋ ka o pitʋ Zedekaya di na'am.
Jehoyakim yaas yʋda nwa'
17Na'ab Jehoyakim yaas banɛ ka ba da gban'e keŋ Babilon la anɛ o biig Sealtiel, 18nɛ Malikiram nɛ Pedaya nɛ Sienaza nɛ Jekamiya nɛ Hosiama nɛ Nedabaya.
19Pedaya biribis da anɛ Zerubabɛl nɛ Simie. Zerubabɛl biribis da anɛ Mesulam nɛ Hanania, ka ba taʋn da an Sielomif. 20O mɛ da lɛn mɔr biribis anu, ka banɛ an Hasuba nɛ Ohel nɛ Berekaya nɛ Hasadaya nɛ Jusab-Hesed.
21Hanania yaas yʋda da anɛ Pelataya nɛ Jesaya, nɛ Refaya nɛ o biribis nɛ Anan nɛ o biribis nɛ Obadia nɛ o biribis nɛ Siekania nɛ o biribis. 22Siekania yaas yʋda anɛ Semaya nɛ o biribis Hatus nɛ Igal nɛ Baraya nɛ Nearaya nɛ Safat; ba wʋsa anɛ nidib ayuobʋ. 23Nearaya biribis yʋda anɛ Eloanai nɛ Hizikaya nɛ Azirikam; ba wʋsa anɛ nidib atan'. 24Eloanai biribis yʋda anɛ Hodavia nɛ Eliyaasib nɛ Pelaya nɛ Akub nɛ Johanan nɛ Delaya nɛ Anani; ba wʋsa anɛ nidib ayɔpɔi.

english_text:
The Descendants of Judah
1Judah was the father of five sons: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal. 2Shobal was the father of Reaiah, the grandfather of Jahath, and the great-grandfather of Ahumai and Lahad. These men all belonged to the Zorathite clan.
3-4Hur was the oldest son of Caleb and Ephrath. Some of his descendants settled the town of Bethlehem. Hur's other descendants included Etam, Penuel, and Ezer. Etam's sons were Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash, and his daughter was Hazzelelponi. Penuel settled the town of Gedor, and Ezer settled the town of Hushah.
5Ashhur, who settled the town of Tekoa, had two wives: Helah and Naarah. 6Ashhur and Naarah were the parents of Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. 7Ashhur and Helah were the parents of Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
8Koz, the father of Anub and Zobebah, was also the ancestor of the clans of Aharhel, the son of Harum.
9Jabez was a man who got his name because of the pain he caused his mother during birth. But he was still the most respected son in his family. 10One day he prayed to Israel's God, “Please bless me and give me a lot of land. Be with me so I will be safe from harm.” And God did just what Jabez had asked.
11Chelub was the brother of Shuhah and the father of Mehir. Later, Mehir had a son, Eshton, 12whose three sons were Bethrapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah. It was Tehinnah who settled the town of Nahash. These men and their families lived in the town of Recah.
13Kenaz was the father of Othniel and Seraiah. Othniel had two sons: Hathath and Meonothai, 14who was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab, who settled a place called “Valley of Crafts” because the people who lived there were experts in making things.
15Caleb son of Jephunneh had three sons: Iru, Elah, and Naam. Elah was the father of Kenaz.
16Jehallelel was the father of Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
17-18Ezrah was the father of Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon. Mered was married to Bithiah the daughter of the king of Egypt. They had a daughter named Miriam and two sons: Shammai and Ishbah. It was Ishbah who settled the town of Eshtemoa. Mered was also married to a woman from the tribe of Judah, and their sons were Jered, Heber, and Jekuthiel. Jered settled the town of Gedor; Heber settled the town of Soco; and Jekuthiel settled the town of Zanoah.
19A man named Hodiah was married to the sister of Naham. Hodiah's descendants included Keilah of the Garmite clan and Eshtemoa of the Maacathite clan.
20Shimon was the father of Amnon, Rinnah, Benhanan, and Tilon.
Ishi was the father of Zoheth and Benzoheth.
21-22Judah also had a son named Shelah, whose descendants included Jokim and the people of the town of Cozeba, as well as Er who settled the town of Lecah and Laadah who settled the town of Mareshah. The people who lived in Beth-Ashbea were also descendants of Shelah, and they were experts in weaving cloth. Shelah was the ancestor of Joash and Saraph, two men who married Moabite women and then settled near Bethlehem—but these family records are very old. 23The members of these clans were the potters who lived in the towns of Netaim and Gederah and worked for the king.
The Descendants of Simeon
24Simeon had five sons: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul. 25The descendants of Shaul included his son Shallum, his grandson Mibsam, and his great-grandson Mishma. 26The descendants of Mishma included his son Hammuel, his grandson Zaccur, and his great-grandson Shimei. 27Shimei had 16 sons and 6 daughters. But his brothers did not have as many children, so the Simeon tribe was smaller than the Judah tribe.
28-31 Before David became king, the people of the Simeon tribe lived in the following towns: Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar-Shual, Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad, Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag, Beth-Marcaboth, Hazarsusim, Bethbiri, and Shaaraim. 32They also lived in the five villages of Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, 33as well as in the nearby villages as far as the town of Baal. These are the places where Simeon's descendants had settled, according to their own family records.
34-38As their families and clans became larger, the people of Simeon had the following leaders: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah, Joel, Jehu, Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah, and Ziza. 39When the people needed more pastureland for their flocks and herds, they looked as far as the eastern side of the valley where the town of Gerar is located, 40and they found a lot of good pastureland that was quiet and undisturbed. This had once belonged to the Hamites, 41but when Hezekiah was king of Judah, the descendants of Simeon attacked and forced the Hamites and Meunites off the land, then settled there.
42Some time later, 500 men from the Simeon tribe went into Edom under the command of Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel the sons of Ishi. 43They killed the last of the Amalekites and lived there from then on.
translation_text:
Juda dim banɛ ka' na'am tuŋ dim la yʋda nwa'
1Juda yaas da anɛ Perez nɛ Heziron nɛ Karmi nɛ Hur nɛ Soobal. 2Ka Soobal biig Riaya da du'a Jahaf, ka Jahaf du'a Ahumai nɛ Lahad. Zora dɔɔg dimi la. 3Etam biribis da anɛ Jezireel nɛ Isima nɛ Idibasi. Ka ba taʋn an Hazelelpooni. 4Penuel da anɛ Geduor saam, ka Eza mɛ an Husea saam. Ba da anɛ Hur onɛ da an Efirata bikpɛɛm la yaas. Hur da an Betilehem dim wʋsa yaab. 5Asur biigi da an Tekoa. Asur pu'ab da anɛ ayi', ka ba yʋda an Hela nɛ Naara. 6Naara biribis da anɛ Ahuzam nɛ Hifa nɛ Temeni nɛ Hahasitari. 7Hela biribis da anɛ Zeref nɛ Zohar nɛ Efinan 8nɛ Kos. Ka Kos biis mɛ da an Anub nɛ Hazobeba nɛ Harum nɛ o biig Ahahel yaas.
9Jabes yʋ'ʋr da dʋʋ gaad o mabiis la wʋsa. O ma da pʋd o yʋ'ʋr ye, Jabes, ka yɛl ye, “M da du'a o nɛ ka li zabid hali!” 10Jabes da kaasi buol Israel Wina'am ka sɔs o ye, “Niŋimi m zug bareka ka kɛ ka m sʋ'ʋlim yalig! Sʋŋimim ka gɔsim ka m da nyɛ tɔɔgɔ!” Ka Wina'am wʋm o sɔsʋg la.
11Kɛlub da anɛ Suha mabiig, ka o biig da an Mehir, ka Mehir biig da an Esiton. 12Ka Esiton biis an Bet Rafa nɛ Pasia nɛ Tehina. Ka Tehina biig an Yir-Nahas. Ban da anɛ Reka dap.
13Kenas biribis da anɛ Ofniel nɛ Seraya. Ka Ofniel biribis an Hataf nɛ Meonotai. 14Ka Meonotai biig an Ofra. Seraya biig da anɛ Joab. Ka Joab biig an Ge-Haharasim. Linɛ kɛ ka ba da buonnɛ ba anwa la anɛ ye, nimbanɛ da bɛɛ anina la nu'ug tʋʋm da anɛ la'ad maalʋg.
15Jefune biig Kaleb biribis da anɛ Iru nɛ Ela nɛ Na'am. Ela biig da anɛ Kenas. 16Jehalelel biribis da anɛ Zif nɛ Zifa nɛ Tiriya nɛ Asarel.
17-18Ezira biribis da anɛ Jeta nɛ Mered nɛ Efer nɛ Jalon. Mered da di Na'ab Faaro biig ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Bitiya. O bipuŋ yʋ'ʋri da an Miriam ka o biribis an Seamaae nɛ Isiba. Ka Isiba biig an Estemoa. Mered pu'a kanɛ da an Juda nid la biribis da anɛ Jered nɛ Heber nɛ Jekutiel. Jered biig yʋ'ʋri da buon Geduor. Heber biigi da an Soko. Jekutiel biigi da an Zanoak.
19Hodaya da di Naham taʋn, ka ba yaasi an Kiela nɛ Estemoa. Kiela da anɛ Gerem nid, ka Estemoa mɛ an Maaka nid.
20Siimon biribis da anɛ Amnon nɛ Arina nɛ Ben-Hanan nɛ Tiiloon. Isi yaas da anɛ Zohef nɛ Ben-Zohef.
21Juda biig Sela yaas da anɛ Er onɛ an Leka saam nɛ Laada onɛ an Maresa saam ka an banɛ da zin' Beth Asibia ʋgʋd piena 22nɛ Jokim nɛ Kosiba dim nɛ Joas nɛ Seraf banɛ da sʋ'oe Moab dim ka zin' Betilehem la. (Yɛlbama da sɔbnɛ Kʋdimin sa n digil.) 23Nimbama da anɛ banɛ ya'abid ka zin' Netayin nɛ Gedera tɛɛnsin ka tʋmmi tisid Na'ab la.
Simeon yaas yʋda nwa'
24-25Simeon biribis da anɛ Nemuel nɛ Jamin nɛ Jarib nɛ Zera nɛ Sauul. Sauul da du'a Sallum, ka Sallum du'a Mibsam, ka Mibsam mɛ du'a Misima. 26Misima da du'a Hamuel, ka Hamuel du'a Zakur, ka Zakur mɛ du'a Simie.
27Simie biribis da anɛ biribis pii nɛ ayuobʋ nɛ bipumis ayuobʋ, amaa o pitib da pʋ du'a biribis bɛdegʋʋ, linɛ kɛ ka Simeon dɔɔg dim la da pʋ zu'oe wʋʋ Juda dimi da zu'oe si'em laa.
28Ba da zin'inɛ Beerseba nɛ Molada nɛ Hazasual, 29nɛ Biliha nɛ Ezem nɛ Tolad 30nɛ Betuel nɛ Horma nɛ Ziklag 31nɛ Bet Maakabof nɛ Hazasusim nɛ Befibiri nɛ Siaaram tɛɛnsin.
Tembama da aan ba tɛɛns hali ti paae Na'ab David na'am saŋa. 32Ba teŋkpɛmis la anɛ: Etam nɛ Ɛɛn nɛ Rimmon nɛ Token nɛ Asean. Ba da anɛ tɛɛns anu.
33Nɛ tembibis banɛ giligi ba la wʋsa, hali ti paae Baalaf.
Ban da zin' teŋ sieba la. Ba da sɔbi ba dɔɔg la nidib yʋda digil.
34Ba tuongatib yʋda nwa': Mesɔbab nɛ Jamlek nɛ Amazaya biig Josaya 35nɛ Joel nɛ Jehu onɛ da an Josibaya biig ka Josibaya an Seraya biig ka Seraya an Asiel biig, 36nɛ Eloanai nɛ Jaakoba nɛ Jesohaya nɛ Asaya nɛ Adiel nɛ Jesimiel nɛ Benaya, 37nɛ Siefi biig Ziza nɛ Allon biig nɛ Simir biig Jedaya onɛ yaabi da an Semaya la.
38Bama wʋsa da anɛ ba dɔɔg la tuongatib. Ba nidib da zu'oya hali, 39ba da yii yadig teŋ la ieed yaama ye ba tisi ba bʋnkɔnbid, hali ti paae Geduor teŋ bɛn, linɛ bɛ ya-nya'aŋ bɔn'ɔfaligin la. 40Ba da nyɛ mɔsʋma ani, ka paalʋ la yalim bɛdegʋ, ka teŋ la wʋsa dig baanlimm. Ham buudi la sieba da dɛŋi zin'inɛ ani kʋdimin sa ka duoe tɔɔm.
41Juda Na'ab Hezekia da di na'am saŋa si'a la ka nimbanɛ ka ba sɔbi ba yʋda nwa' keŋi zab nɛ Ham dim la ka mɛ zab nɛ Meun dim la ka nyaŋi ba n kʋʋ ba wʋsa. Hali nɛ zina, nidib mi' li yɛla. Ba da di'e teŋ la zin'in, bɔzugɔ yaama da bɛɛ ani bɛdegʋ. 42Saŋkan la ka Simeon dim la nidib kɔbisnu da keŋ Seir sʋ'ʋlim kʋkʋna la ni na nwɛ' tanp. Ba tuongatib da anɛ Pelataya, Nearaya, Refaya, nɛ Isi biig Uziel. 43Ba da kʋ Amalek dim banɛ da nyaŋi zɔɔ pɔns Seir teŋin la ka zin'in teŋin la hali ti paae zina.

english_text:
The Descendants of Reuben
1 Reuben was the oldest son of Jacob, but he lost his rights as the first-born son because he slept with one of his father's wives. The honor of the first-born son was then given to Joseph, 2 even though it was the Judah tribe that became the most powerful and produced a leader.
3Reuben had four sons: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
4-6 The descendants of Joel included Shemaiah, Gog, Shimei, Micah, Reaiah, Baal, and Beerah, a leader of the Reuben tribe. Later, King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria took Beerah away as prisoner.
7-8The family records also include Jeiel, who was a clan leader, Zechariah, and Bela son of Azaz and grandson of Shema of the Joel clan. They lived in the territory around the town of Aroer, as far north as Nebo and Baal-Meon, 9and as far east as the desert just west of the Euphrates River. They needed this much land because they owned too many cattle to keep them all in Gilead.
10When Saul was king, the Reuben tribe attacked and defeated the Hagrites, then took over their land east of Gilead.
The Descendants of Gad
11The tribe of Gad lived in the region of Bashan, north of the Reuben tribe. Gad's territory extended all the way to the town of Salecah. 12Some of the clan leaders were Joel, Shapham, Janai, and Shaphat. 13Their relatives included Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber.
14They were all descendants of Abihail, whose family line went back through Huri, Jaroah, Gilead, Michael, Jeshishai, Jahdo, and Buz. 15Ahi, the son of Abdiel and the grandson of Guni, was the leader of their clan.
16The people of Gad lived in the towns in the regions of Bashan and Gilead, as well as in the pastureland of Sharon. 17Their family records were written when Jotham was king of Judah and Jeroboam was king of Israel.
18The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh had 44,760 soldiers trained to fight in battle with shields, swords, bows, and arrows. 19They fought against the Hagrites and the tribes of Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab. 20Whenever these soldiers went to war against their enemies, they prayed to God and trusted him to help. That's why the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh defeated the Hagrites and their allies. 21These Israelite tribes captured 50,000 camels, 250,000 sheep, 2,000 donkeys, and 100,000 people. 22Many of the Hagrites died in battle, because God was fighting this battle against them. The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh lived in that territory until they were taken as prisoners to Assyria.
The Tribe of East Manasseh
23East Manasseh was a large tribe, so its people settled in the northern region of Bashan, as far north as Baal-Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon. 24Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel were their clan leaders; they were well-known leaders and brave soldiers.
The Tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh Are Defeated
25The people of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh were unfaithful to the God their ancestors had worshiped, and they started worshiping the gods of the nations that God had forced out of Canaan. 26 So God sent King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria to attack these Israelite tribes. The king led them away as prisoners to Assyria, and from then on, he forced them to live in Halah, Habor, Hara, and near the Gozan River.
translation_text:
Reuben yaas yʋda nwa'
1Reuben da anɛ Israel bikpɛɛm, amaa on da digin nɛ o saam pu'a la zug, ba da faaɛn dinɛ an bikpɛɛm faar la tis Josef onɛ mɛ da an Israel biribiŋ la. Alazug, ba da pʋ sɔb Reuben yʋ'ʋri pɛ'ɛs banɛ nar ye ba di Israel faar la nii. 2 La'an nɛ Juda da an kpi'em o ba'abiis la wʋsa sʋʋgin ka tuongat yii o tuŋʋn na la, Josef n da sʋ'ʋg bikpɛɛm faar la.
3Reuben onɛ da an Israel bikpɛɛm la biribis da anɛ Hanok nɛ Pallu nɛ Heziron nɛ Karmi. 4Joel yaas da anɛ Semaya, ka on du'a Gog, ka Gog du'a Simie, 5ka Simie du'a Maika, ka Maika du'a Riaya, ka Riaya du'a Baal, 6 ka Baal du'a Beera onɛ ka Asiria Na'ab Tigilaf-Pilesa da gban'e o keŋ ka o lieb yammʋg la. Beera da anɛ Reuben dɔɔg la tuongat.
7Ba da sɔbi ba dɔɔd la yʋda dɔlisi ba tuŋ-tuŋ wʋʋ ban kpin taaba si'em la. Jieel n da an zugdaan la nɛ Zakaria, 8ka Azas da du'a Bela, ka Azas saam an Sema ka on saam mɛ an Joel. Joel nɛ o nidib la da zin'inɛ Aroa hali ti paae Nebo nɛ Baal Meon tɛɛnsin. 9Ba mɛ da zin'in ya-nya'aŋ baba yadig hali paae sian'anr la nɔɔrin nɛ Efiritis kɔldaug la, bɔzugɔ ba bʋnkɔnbid la da wiak bɛdegʋ Gilead teŋin. 10Saŋkanɛ ka Saul da zin' na'am gbauŋ zug la, ba da zab nɛ Haga buudi la nyaŋi ba ka di'e ba teŋ la zin'inɛ tiig Gilead teŋ la zin'ikanɛ lɛbid ya-nya'aŋ la wʋsa.
Gad yaas yʋda nwa'
11Gad dɔɔg la da tʋgisnɛ Reuben dɔɔg la tuonnɛ zin'in Basan teŋin hali ti paae Saleka. 12Joel n da an zugdaan Basan teŋin la ka Safam tia'al ayi', ka banɛ paas an Janai nɛ Safat. 13Ba tuŋ la nɛ ba du'am da dɔl si'em nwa': Maikel nɛ Mesulam nɛ Seeba nɛ Joraae nɛ Jakan nɛ Zia nɛ Eba. Ba wʋsa da la'as nɛ nidib ayɔpɔi. 14Bama da an Abihel biribis, ka Abihel mɛ an Huri biig, ka Huri an Jaroa biig, ka Jaroa an Gilead biig, ka Gilead mɛ an Maikel biig, ka Maikel an Jesisae biig, ka Jesisae an Jahidau biig, ka Jahidau mɛ an Buz biig.
15Abdiel biig Ahi onɛ yaabi da an Guni la da aan ba tuŋ la tuongat.
16Gad dɔɔg la da zin'inɛ Gilead linɛ bɛ Basan teŋgbauŋʋn nɛ li teŋkpɛmis la, nɛ Saron mɔma'asa zin'is la nɛ li yalʋŋ la bɛn wʋsa.
17Ba da sɔb nɛ' wʋsa niŋi ba tuŋ gbana la ni, Juda Na'ab Jotam na'am saŋa la, nɛ Na'ab Jeroboam da an Israel na'ab saŋa si'a la.
Zaba yɛla
18Reuben nɛ Gad nɛ Manase dɔɔg la pʋsʋk da mɔr dap tusa pisnaasi nɛ anaasi nɛ kɔbisyɔpɔi nɛ pisyuobʋ (44,760) banɛ da siak tanp nwɛ'ɛb. Ba da pa'ali ba zaba zabid si'em, ka ba na nyaŋi zanl gbanti'edʋg nɛ zaba sʋ'ʋs nɛ ban na nwɛ' kpana si'em. 19Ba da zab nɛ Haga buudi la, nɛ Jetur dim, nɛ Nafis dim, nɛ Nodab dim la wʋsa. 20Ba da sɔs Wina'am zaba la saŋa, ka o sʋŋi ba ka ba zabi nyaŋ Haga dim nɛ banɛ zi'e ba nya'aŋ la wʋsa. Wina'am da wʋm tisi ba, ban da niŋ o yadda la zug. 21Ba da nyaŋi faaɛn Haga dim la yʋgʋma tusa pisnu (50,000), pɛ'ɛs tusa kɔbisyi' nɛ pisnu (250,000), nɛ bʋmis tusa ayi' (2,000). Ba mɛ da gban'e nidib tusa kɔbiga (100,000) keŋ ka ba lieb yammis, 22ka kʋ nidib la bɛdegʋ bɔzugɔ Wina'am mɛŋi da sʋ'oe zaba la. Ka ba zin'in teŋ la ni hali nɛ Asiria dimi ti gban'e ba keŋ ka ba lieb yammis.
Manase dɔɔg pʋsʋk dim la yʋda nwa'
23Manase dɔɔg pʋsʋk la da zu'onɛ. Ba da zin'inɛ Basan keŋ paae Baal Hemon nɛ Senir (Hemon Zuorin). 24Ba dɔɔg la tuŋ-tuŋ tuongatib da anɛ Efer nɛ Isi nɛ Eliel nɛ Aziriel nɛ Jeremia nɛ Hodavia nɛ Jadiel.
Ba da anɛ banɛ sʋnfʋ kpi'em zaba ni, ka an yʋ'ʋr dim ka aan ba tuŋ la tuongatib. 25Amaa ba da pʋ dɔl Wina'am onɛ aan ba yaanam Wina'am la nɛ pʋʋg yinnee, ka tʋm nwɛnɛ pu'agɔɔnda nɛ, ka dɔl teŋ kanɛ ka ba bɛ la nidibi dɔl ba'asieba la, ba'abanɛ yɛla ka Wina'am da san'am nidib la ka ba nyaan kpɛn' teŋin la. 26 Alazug Israel Wina'am la da kɛ ka Pul onɛ an Asiria Na'ab ka o yʋ'ʋr da lɛm buon Tigilaf-Pilesa la gban'e Reuben nɛ Gad nɛ Manase dɔɔg pʋsʋk la kɛ ka ba lieb yammis. O da mɔri ba keŋ Hala, nɛ Haabo nɛ Hara tɛɛnsin, nɛ Gozan kɔldaug la baba. Zin'ikan la ka ba bɛ, hali ti paae zina.

english_text:
The Descendants of Levi
1Levi was the father of Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
2Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel. 3Amram was the father of Aaron, Moses, and Miriam.
Aaron had four sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
4-14Eleazar's descendants included Phinehas, Abishua, Bukki, Uzzi, Zerahiah, Meraioth, Amariah, Ahitub, Zadok, Ahimaaz, Azariah, Johanan, Azariah the priest who served in the temple built by King Solomon, Amariah, Ahitub, Zadok, Shallum, Hilkiah, Azariah, Seraiah, and Jehozadak. 15King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia took Jehozadak to Babylon as prisoner when the Lord let the people of Judah and Jerusalem be dragged from their land.
16 Levi's three sons had sons of their own. 17Gershon was the father of Libni and Shimei. 18Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel. 19Merari was the father of Mahli and Mushi. These descendants of Levi each became leaders of their own clans.
20-21Gershon's descendants included Libni, Jahath, Zimmah, Joah, Iddo, Zerah, and Jeatherai.
22-24Kohath's descendants included Amminadab, Korah, Assir, Elkanah, Ebiasaph, Assir, Tahath, Uriel, Uzziah, and Shaul.
25Elkanah was the father of Amasai and Ahimoth. 26-27Ahimoth's descendants included Elkanah, Zophai, Nahath, Eliab, Jeroham, and Elkanah.
28Samuel was the father of Joel and Abijah, born in that order.
29-30Merari's descendants included Mahli, Libni, Shimei, Uzzah, Shimea, Haggiah, and Asaiah.
The Temple Musicians
31After King David had the sacred chest moved to Jerusalem, he appointed musicians from the Levi tribe to be in charge of the music at the place of worship. 32These musicians served at the sacred tent and later at the Lord's temple that King Solomon built.
33-38Here is a list of these musicians and their family lines:
Heman from the Kohathite clan was the director. His ancestors went all the way back to Jacob and included Joel, Samuel, Elkanah, Jeroham, Eliel, Toah, Zuph, Elkanah, Mahath, Amasai, Elkanah, Joel, Azariah, Zephaniah, Tahath, Assir, Ebiasaph, Korah, Izhar, Kohath, Levi.
39-43Asaph was Heman's relative and served as his assistant. Asaph's ancestors included Berechiah, Shimea, Michael, Baaseiah, Malchijah, Ethni, Zerah, Adaiah, Ethan, Zimmah, Shimei, Jahath, Gershon, and Levi.
44-47Ethan was also Heman's relative and served as his assistant. Ethan belonged to the Merari clan, and his ancestors included Kishi, Abdi, Malluch, Hashabiah, Amaziah, Hilkiah, Amzi, Bani, Shemer, Mahli, Mushi, Merari, and Levi.
48The rest of the Levites were appointed to work at the sacred tent.
The Descendants of Aaron
49Only Aaron and his descendants were allowed to offer sacrifices and incense on the two altars at the sacred tent. They were in charge of the most holy place and the ceremonies to forgive sins, just as God's servant Moses had commanded.
50-53Aaron's descendants included his son Eleazar, Phinehas, Abishua, Bukki, Uzzi, Zerahiah, Meraioth, Amariah, Ahitub, Zadok, and Ahimaaz.
The Towns for the Levites
(Joshua 21.1-42)
54Aaron's descendants belonged to the Levite clan of Kohath, and they were the first group chosen to receive towns to live in. 55They received the town of Hebron in the territory of Judah and the pastureland around it. 56But the farmland and villages around Hebron were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh. 57-59So Aaron's descendants received the following Safe Towns and the pastureland around them: Hebron, Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa, Hilen, Debir, Ashan, and Beth-Shemesh. 60From the Benjamin tribe they were given the towns of Geba, Alemeth, and Anathoth and the pastureland around them. Thirteen towns were given to Aaron's descendants.
61The rest of the Levite clan of Kohath received ten towns from West Manasseh.
62The Levite clan of Gershon received thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and East Manasseh in Bashan.
63The Levite clan of Merari received twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
64So the people of Israel gave the Levites towns to live in and the pastureland around them. 65All the towns were chosen with the Lord's help, including those towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.
66Some of the families of the Kohath clan received their towns from the tribe of Ephraim. 67-69These families received the following Safe Towns and the pastureland around them: Shechem in the hill country, Gezer, Jokmeam, Beth-Horon, Aijalon, and Gath-Rimmon. 70And from West Manasseh they received Aner and Bileam, together with their pastureland.
71The Gershonite clan received two towns from the tribe of East Manasseh: Golan in Bashan and Ashtaroth, including the pastureland around them. 72-73The Gershonites also received four towns from the tribe of Issachar: Kedesh, Daberath, Ramoth, and Anem, including the pastureland around them. 74-75The Gershonites received four towns from the tribe of Asher: Mashal, Abdon, Hukok, and Rehob, including the pastureland around them. 76Finally, the Gershonites received three towns from the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon, and Kiriathaim, including the pastureland around them.
77The rest of the Merari clan received the towns of Rimmono and Tabor and their pastureland from the tribe of Zebulun. 78-79They also received four towns east of the Jordan River from the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the flatlands, Jahzah, Kedemoth, and Mephaath, including the pastures around them. 80-81And from the tribe of Gad the Merarites received the towns of Ramoth in Gilead, Mahanaim, Heshbon, and Jazer, including the pastureland around them.
translation_text:
Levi yaas yʋda nwa'
1Levi biribis da anɛ Gerson nɛ Kohat nɛ Merari.
2Kohat biribis da anɛ Amram nɛ Izar nɛ Hebron nɛ Uziel. 3Amram biis da anɛ Aaron nɛ Moses nɛ Miriam. Aaron biribis da anɛ Nadab nɛ Abihu nɛ Eleazar nɛ Itamar.
4Eleazar da du'a Finehas ka Finehas du'a Abisua 5ka Abisua du'a Buki ka Buki du'a Uzi, 6ka Uzi du'a Zerahaya, ka Zerahaya du'a Merayof, 7ka Merayof da du'a Amaraya ka Amaraya du'a Ahitub, 8ka Ahitub da du'a Zadok ka Zadok du'a Ahimaaz, 9ka Ahimaaz da du'a Azaria, ka Azaria da du'a Johanan 10ka Johanan da du'a Azaria (onɛ da an maanmaan Pʋ'ʋsim Yikanɛ ka Solomon da mɛ' Jerusalem tempʋʋgin la). 11Azaria da du'a Amaraya, ka Amaraya du'a Ahitub, 12ka Ahitub du'a Zadok, ka Zadok du'a Sallum, 13ka Sallum du'a Hilkia, ka Hilkia du'a Azaria, 14ka Azaria du'a Seraya ka Seraya du'a Jehozadak. 15Ba da gban'e Jehozadak n keŋ teŋ zʋŋ, saŋkanɛ ka Zugsɔb la da kɛ ka Nebukadnɛza gban'e Juda nɛ Jerusalem dimi keŋ la.
16 Levi biribis da anɛ Gerson nɛ Kohat nɛ Merari. 17Gerson biribis da anɛ Libni nɛ Simie. 18Kohat biribis da anɛ Amram nɛ Izar nɛ Hebron, nɛ Uziel. 19Merari biribis da anɛ Mahili nɛ Musi. Ba da sɔb Levi dɔɔg la yʋda nɛ dɔlis ba' gbin ba' gbin.
Gerson yaas yʋda nwa'
20Gerson yaas da anɛ Gerson biig Libni onɛ da du'a Jehaf, ka Jehaf du'a Zimma 21ka Zimma du'a Joa, ka Joa du'a Iddo, ka Iddo du'a Zera, ka Zera mɛ du'a Jeterai.
Kohat yaas yʋda nwa'
22Kohat yaasi nwa': Kohat biigi da an Aminadab ka Aminadab du'a Kora, ka Kora du'a Asir, 23ka Asir du'a Elkana, ka Elkana du'a Ebiyasaf, ka Ebiyasaf du'a Asir, 24ka Asir du'a Tahaf, ka Tahaf du'a Uriel, ka Uriel du'a Uzia, ka Uzia du'a Sauul.
25Elkana biribis da anɛ Amasai nɛ Ahimof. 26Ka Ahimof du'a Elkana, ka Elkana du'a Zofai, ka Zofai du'a Nahaf, 27ka Nahaf du'a Eliab, ka Eliab du'a Jeroham, ka Jeroham du'a Elkana, ka Elkana mɛ du'a Samuel.
28Samuel biribis da anɛ Joel onɛ da aan o bikpɛɛm ka Abija tia'al.
29Merari yaas yʋda nwa': o biig yʋ'ʋri da buon Mali. Ka Mali da du'a Libni, ka Libni du'a Simie, ka Simie mɛ du'a Uzaa, 30ka Uzaa du'a Simea, ka Simea du'a Hagiya, ka Hagiya du'a Asaya.
Pʋ'ʋsim yin yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib la yɛla
31Ban da mɔr nɔnaar Daka la kena digil la nya'aŋ, nimbama ka David da kɛ ka ba sʋ'oe yʋʋma yɛla Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la. 32Ba tʋʋma da anɛ yʋʋma: ba da zi'e La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr la tuonnɛ yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma zun'od Zugsɔb la, hali ka Solomon nyaan ti mɛ' Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la Jerusalem tempʋʋgin. Ba da tʋmmi ba tʋʋma wʋʋ wada la zi'el ye ba tʋm si'em la.
33Banɛ ka ban nɛ ba biribis da la'an tʋm la yʋda nwa': Kohat buudi la ni, Heman da anɛ yʋʋmyʋ'ʋm ka an Joel biig, ka Joel mɛ an Samuel biig 34ka Samuel an Elkana biig, ka Elkana an Jeroham biig, ka Jeroham an Eliel biig, ka Eliel an Toak biig, 35Toak da anɛ Zuf biig, ka Zuf an Elkana biig, ka Elkana an Mahaf biig, ka Mahaf an Amasai biig, 36ka Amasai da an Elkana biig, ka Elkana an Joel biig, ka Joel an Azaria biig, ka Azaria an Zefanaya biig, 37ka Zefanaya da an Tahaf biig, ka Tahaf an Asir biig, ka Asir an Ebiyasaf biig, ka Ebiyasaf an Kora biig, 38Kora da an Izar biig, ka Izar an Kohat biig, ka Kohat da an Levi biig, ka Levi mɛ an Israel biig.
39Heman tʋmtʋm tiraan Asaf da zi'enɛ o datiuŋʋ tʋm: Asaf da anɛ Berekaya biig, ka Berekaya an Simea biig, 40ka Simea da an Maikel biig, ka Maikel an Baaseya biig, ka Baaseya an Malkija biig, 41ka Malkija da an Efni biig ka Efni an Zera biig, ka Zera mɛ an Adaya biig, 42ka Adaya da an Etan biig, ka Etan an Zimma biig, ka Zimma an Simie biig, 43ka Simie da an Jahaf biig, ka Jahaf an Gerson biig, ka Gerson mɛ an Levi biig.
44Heman tʋmtʋm taaba banɛ da zi'e o dagɔbʋgʋ sʋŋid o la da anɛ Merari dim. Banɛ da an Etan onɛ da an Kisi biig la, ka Kisi an Abidi biig, ka Abidi an Maluk biig, 45ka Mauk an Hasiabiya biig, ka Hasiabiya an Amazaya biig, ka Amazaya mɛ an Hilkia biig, 46ka Hilkia an Amzi biig, ka Amzi an Bani biig, ka Bani an Semer biig, 47ka Semer an Mahli biig, ka Mahli an Musi biig ka Musi an Merari biig, ka Merari mɛ an Levi biig.
48Levi dim banɛ da kpɛlim la da tʋmnɛ tʋʋm banɛ bɛ Fuug Sʋgʋr linɛ an Wina'am Yir la ni.
Aaron yaas yʋda nwa'
49Amaa Aaron nɛ o yaas la da an banɛ maan maana linɛ nyu'od maan daka la nɛ bimbim kanɛ ka ba nyu'od bʋnnyubisa la zug. Ka li dɔl wʋʋ ban maan Kasi wʋsa Kasi zin'igin si'em la, ka ba maannɛ sɔsid suguru tisid Israel dim tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yɛla, nwɛnɛ Wina'am tʋmtʋm Moses n da zi'el nɔɔr si'em tisi ba la wʋsa. 50Aaron yaas da anɛ Eleazar ka Eleazar da du'a Finehas, ka Finehas da du'a Abisua, 51ka Abisua da du'a Buki, ka Buki da du'a Uzi, ka Uzi da du'a Zerahaya, 52Zerahaya da du'a Merayof, ka Merayof du'a Amaraya, ka Amaraya da du'a Ahitub, 53ka Ahita du'a Zadok, ka Zadok mɛ du'a Ahimaaz,
Levi dim tɛɛns yʋda nwa'
54Ban da tis Aaron yaas teŋ sieba nwa' ye ba zin'in (ba da tis o yaas banɛ yi Kohat tuŋʋn la yiiga wʋʋ din nar si'em): 55Ba da tisi ba Hebron linɛ bɛ Juda sʋ'ʋlimin la, la'an nɛ ban kemmi ba kɔnbid zin'isi'a la wʋsa. 56Amaa pɔɔd nɛ tembibis linɛ gilig teŋ la, ba da nɔki li tis nɛ Kaleb onɛ an Jefune biig la. 57Alazug Aaron yaas la da sʋ'oe Hebron (teŋ kanɛ an suak zin'ig la), nɛ Libna nɛ Jatir nɛ Estemoa, 58nɛ Hilen nɛ Debir, 59nɛ Asan, nɛ Jueta nɛ Bet Semes, la'an nɛ ban kemmi ba kɔnbid zin'isi'a la wʋsa. 60Benjamin dɔɔg la sʋ'ʋlimin ba da tisi ba nɛ Gibeon nɛ Geba nɛ Alemef nɛ Anatof la'an nɛ ban na kemmi ba kɔnbid zin'isi'a wʋsa.
Tembanɛ ka ba da nɔki pʋdig Kohat tuŋ la da la'as nɛ pii nɛ atan'.
61Kohat yaas banɛ kpɛlim la da di'enɛ tɛɛns piiga Manase dɔɔg pʋsʋk la sʋ'ʋlimin la.
62Ba da tis Gerson yaas la tɛɛns pii nɛ atan' yit Isaka nɛ Asa nɛ Naftali dɔɔd la sʋ'ʋlimin nɛ Manase dɔɔg la sieba banɛ bɛ Basan teŋgbauŋ sʋ'ʋlimin la. 63Ba mɛ da tis Merari yaas la tɛɛns pii nɛ ayi' ka li yit Reuben nɛ Gad nɛ Zebulun dɔɔd sʋ'ʋlimin la. 64Israel buudi la da pʋdig tɛɛns la'an nɛ ban na kemmi ba kɔnbid zin'isi'a tis Levi dim la lin nar si'em. 65Juda dɔɔg nɛ Simeon nɛ Benjamin dɔɔd la ba da tisi ba nɛ tɛɛns banɛ ka ti pʋn buoli ba yʋda la.
66Kohat dim banɛ kpɛlim an Levi dim la, ba da pʋdig Efiram dim sʋ'ʋlim la tɛɛnsi tisi ba: 67Efiram kʋkʋna teŋ la ba da tisi ba Sekɛm (teŋ kanɛ an suak zin'igi tis onɛ wʋsa kʋ nid la), nɛ Giza, 68Jokimem, Befihoron, 69Aijalon, nɛ Gaf Rimmon, la'an nɛ ban kemmi ba kɔnbid zin'isi'a la wʋsa. 70Manase dɔɔg pʋsʋk la ni ka Israel dim da di'e Anɛr nɛ Bileam, la'an nɛ ban kemmi ba kɔnbid zin'isi'a la, tis Kohat dim banɛ kpɛlim la.
71Gerson dim la da di'e si'el Manase dɔɔg pʋsʋk sʋ'ʋlimin la da anɛ Golan linɛ bɛ Basan la, nɛ Asitarof, la'an nɛ ban kemmi ba kɔnbid zin'isi'a la wʋsa.
72Isaka dɔɔg sʋ'ʋlimin la ba da di'enɛ Kades nɛ Dabɛraf 73nɛ Ramot nɛ Anem, la'an nɛ ban kemmi ba kɔnbid zin'isi'a la wʋsa. 74Asa dɔɔg sʋ'ʋlim la da di'enɛ Misial nɛ Abidon, 75nɛ Hukkok nɛ Rehob, la'an nɛ ban kemmi ba kɔnbid zin'isi'a la wʋsa.
76Naftali dɔɔg sʋ'ʋlim la mɛ da di'enɛ Kedes linɛ bɛ Galile nɛ Hamon nɛ Kiriafaim, la'an nɛ ban kemmi ba kɔnbid zin'isi'a la wʋsa.
77Merari dim banɛ kpɛlim Levi dɔɔg la ni la da di'e si'eli nwa': Zebulun dɔɔg la ni ba da di'enɛ Jokneam nɛ Kata nɛ Rimono nɛ Tabo, la'an nɛ ba kɔnbid kemmʋg zin'ig wʋsa. 78Reuben dɔɔg la ni da di'enɛ Beza linɛ bɛ pipirisin la, nɛ Jaaza, 79nɛ Kedemof nɛ Mɛfaaf nɛ ba bʋnkɔnbid kemmʋg zin'is. 80Gad dɔɔg la da di'enɛ Ramot linɛ bɛ Gilead la nɛ Mahanam, 81nɛ Hesbon nɛ Jaza, la'an nɛ ban na kemmi ba kɔnbid zin'isi'a wʋsa.

english_text:
The Descendants of Issachar
1Issachar was the father of four sons: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron.
2Tola was the father of Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, who were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their clan. There were 22,600 people in Tola's family by the time David became king.
3Uzzi was the father of Izrahiah and the grandfather of Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, who were also family leaders. 4Their families were so large that they had 36,000 soldiers in their clans. 5In fact, according to family records, the tribe of Issachar had a total of 87,000 warriors.
The Descendants of Benjamin and Dan
6Benjamin was the father of three sons: Bela, Becher, and Jediael.
7Bela was the father of Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri. They were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their father's clan. The number of soldiers in their clan was 22,034.
8Becher was the father of Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. 9The official family records listed 20,200 soldiers in the families of this clan, as well as their family leaders.
10Jediael was the father of Bilhan and the grandfather of Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar. 11They were family leaders in their clan, which had 17,200 soldiers prepared to fight in battle. 12Ir was the father of Shuppim and Huppim, who also belonged to this clan.
Dan was the father of Hushim.
The Descendants of Naphtali
13Naphtali's mother was Bilhah, and he was the father of Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum.
The Descendants of Manasseh
14Manasseh and his Syrian wife were the parents of Asriel and Machir the father of Gilead. 15Machir found a wife for Huppim and one for Shuppim. Machir had a sister named Maacah.
Zelophehad was also a descendant of Manasseh, and he had five daughters.
16Machir and his wife Maacah were the parents of Peresh and Sheresh. Peresh was the father of Ulam and Rekem. 17Ulam was the father of Bedan. These were all descendants of Gilead, the son of Machir and the grandson of Manasseh.
18Gilead's sister Hammolecheth was the mother of Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
19Shemida, another descendant of Manasseh, was the father of Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.
The Descendants of Ephraim
20Ephraim was the father of Shuthelah and the ancestor of Bered, Tahath, Eleadah, Tahath, 21Zabad, and Shuthelah.
Ephraim had two other sons, Ezer and Elead. But they were killed when they tried to steal livestock from the people who lived in the territory of Gath. 22Ephraim mourned for his sons a long time, and his relatives came to comfort him. 23Some time later his wife gave birth to another son, and Ephraim named him Beriah, because he was born during a time of misery.
24Ephraim's daughter was Sheerah. She built the towns of Lower Beth-Horon, Upper Beth-Horon, and Uzzen-Sheerah.
25Ephraim also had a son named Rephah, and his descendants included Resheph, Telah, Tahan, 26Ladan, Ammihud, Elishama, 27Nun, and Joshua.
28The descendants of Ephraim took over the territory as far south as Bethel, as far east as Naaran, and as far west as Gezer. Their territory included all the villages around these towns, as well as Shechem, Ayyah, and the nearby villages.
29The descendants of Manasseh settled in the territory that included Beth-Shan, Taanach, Megiddo, Dor, and the nearby villages.
The descendants of Joseph lived in these towns and villages.
The Descendants of Asher
30Asher had four sons, Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah, and one daughter, Serah.
31Beriah was the father of Heber and Malchiel the father of Birzaith. 32Heber was the father of three sons, Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham, and one daughter, Shua. 33Japhlet was the father of Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. 34Shomer was the father of Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram. 35And Japhlet's brother Hotham was the father of Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal. 36Zophah was the father of Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah, 37Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera. 38Jether was the father of Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
39Ulla was the father of Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
40These were the descendants of Asher, and they were all respected family leaders and brave soldiers. The tribe of Asher had a total of 26,000 soldiers.
translation_text:
Isaka yaas yʋda nwa'
1Isaka biribis da anɛ Tola nɛ Pua nɛ Jasub nɛ Simiron. Ba wʋsa da la'as nɛ nidib anaasi.
2Tola da mɔri biribis ayuobʋ ka ba yʋda an Uzi nɛ Rafaya nɛ Jeriel nɛ Jamaae nɛ Ibisam nɛ Samuel.
Banɛ da aan ba dɔɔg la tuongatib. Na'ab David na'am saŋa la, Tola yaas la da mɔr zabzabidibi ba tuŋʋn la, ka ba kal an wʋʋ tusa pisi nɛ ayi' nɛ kɔbis yuobʋ (22,600).
3Uzi biig da anɛ Izirahaya ka Izirahaya biribis da an Maikel nɛ Obadia nɛ Joel nɛ Isaaya. Ba babanu la wʋsa da anɛ zugdaannam.
4Ba tuŋ la pʋʋgin, ba da sɔb dap tusa pistan' nɛ ayuobʋ yʋda (36,000) banɛ siak zaba ken, bɔzugɔ ba da mɔr pu'ab nɛ biribis bɛdegʋ. 5Isaka dɔɔg la ni dap banɛ da siak zaba ken la kal da anɛ tusa pisnii nɛ yɔpɔi (87,000).
Benjamin yaas yʋda nwa'
6Benjamin biribis da anɛ Bela nɛ Beka nɛ Jediael.
7Bela biribis da anɛ Ezibon nɛ Uzi nɛ Uziel nɛ Jerimof nɛ Iri, tuŋ la tuongatib.
Ba tuŋ la ni ba da mɔr zabzabidib tusa pisi nɛ ayi' nɛ pistan' nɛ anaasi (22,034).
8Beka biribis da anɛ Zemira nɛ Joas nɛ Elieza nɛ Eloanai nɛ Omir nɛ Jerimof nɛ Abija nɛ Anatof nɛ Alemef. Bama wʋsa da anɛ Beka biribis.
9Ba tuŋʋn la, ba da sɔb yidaannam yʋda, nɛ zabzabidib kal ka li anɛ nidib tusa pisi nɛ kɔbisyi' (20,200).
10Jediael biig da anɛ Bilhan. Ka Bilhan biribis an Jeus nɛ Benjamin nɛ Ehud nɛ Kenaana nɛ Zetan nɛ Tarsis nɛ Ahisiaha.
11Jediael biribis nwa' wʋsa da anɛ yidaannam. Ba da mɔr zabzabidib tusa pii nɛ ayɔpɔi nɛ kɔbisyi' (17,200) banɛ siak zaba ken. 12Sup dim nɛ Hup dim la da anɛ Ir yaas ka Husi dim an Aher yaas.
Naftali yaas yʋda nwa'
13Naftali biribis da anɛ Jaziel nɛ Guni nɛ Jezer nɛ Sillem. Banɛ da an Biliha yaas.
Manase yaas yʋda nwa'
14Manase da mɔr pu'abil ka o an Aram sʋ'ʋlim nid. O da du'a biis ayi' ka ba yʋda buon Asiriel nɛ Makir ka Gilead saam da an Makir. 15Makir da di pu'a ka o an Hup nɛ Sup dim buudi ka o taʋn yʋ'ʋr da buon Maaka. O yaaŋ yinne da bɛɛ buon Zelofehad, o da du'anɛ bipumis ma'aa.
16Makir pu'a Maaka da du'a biribiŋ ka pʋd o yʋ'ʋr ye Periis, ka o mabiig yʋ'ʋr buon Sieriis ka on biribis mɛ an Ulam nɛ Rakɛm. 17Ulam biig yʋ'ʋri da buon Bedan. Bama da an Gilead onɛ an Makir biig ka Makir mɛ an Manase biig la.
18O taʋn Hamolekef da du'a Isod nɛ Abieza nɛ Mahla. 19Siamida biribis da anɛ Ahiyaan nɛ Sekɛm nɛ Likihi nɛ Aniam.
Efiram yaas yʋda nwa'
20Ephiram biig yʋ'ʋri da buon Seufila, ka Seufila da du'a Bered, ka Bered du'a Tahaf, ka Tahaf du'a Eli'ada, ka Eli'ada du'a Tahaf, 21ka Tahaf da du'a Zabad, ka Zabad du'a Seufila.
Eza nɛ Eliad da keŋ Gaf teŋin ye ba faaɛn ba bʋnkɔnbid, ka teŋ la dim kʋʋ ba. 22Ba saam Efiram da kumi ba yɛla dabisa bɛdegʋ ka o nidib kena bɛlis o. 23O da lɛn digin nɛ o pu'a ya'as ka o gban'e pʋʋgʋ du'a biribiŋ. Ka o pʋd o yʋ'ʋr ye Beria, bɔzugɔ yɛla pamm da kɛɛn o yin la na. 24O bipuŋ yʋ'ʋri da buon Seera, onɛ da mɛ' Bet Horon linɛ bɛ Zugin, nɛ Bet Horon linɛ bɛ Teŋir la, la'an nɛ Uzen Seera tɛɛns la. 25Seufila da du'a Refa, ka Refa du'a Resief, ka Resief du'a Tela, ka Tela du'a Tahan, 26ka Tahan du'a Ladan, ka Ladan du'a Ammihud, ka Ammihud du'a Elisama, 27ka Elisama du'a Nun, ka Nun mɛ du'a Josua.
28Ba teŋ la nɛ ban da zin' zin'isi'a la da kpanbi Betel nɛ teŋkpɛmis banɛ giligi li la, lin yi Naaran teŋin lɛbid ya-nya'aŋ baba, nɛ Giza nɛ li teŋkpɛmis la lɛbid ya-tuona baba, nɛ Sekɛm nɛ tembanɛ giligi li la, hali ti paae Aya teŋ nɛ tembanɛ giligi li la wʋsa. 29Manase titɔndigi da an Betsean teŋ la, Taanak nɛ Megido nɛ Dor nɛ tembanɛ gilig la wʋsa. Josef onɛ an Israel biig la yaas la da bɛnɛ teŋ bama ni.
Aser yaas yʋda nwa'
30Aser biribis da anɛ Imnah nɛ Isiva nɛ Isivi nɛ Beria. Ba taʋn yʋ'ʋri da buon Sera.
31Beria biribis da anɛ Heber nɛ Malkiel. Ka Malkiel biig an Birzef.
32Heber biribis da anɛ Jafilet nɛ Seoma nɛ Hotam. Ba taʋn da an Sua. 33Jafilet mɛ da mɔr biribis atan', ka ba yʋda an Pasak nɛ Bimihal nɛ Asivaf. 34Seoma biribis da anɛ Ahi nɛ Roga nɛ Huba nɛ Aram. 35O pitʋ Helem biribis da anɛ Zofa nɛ Imna nɛ Sielis nɛ Amal.
36Zofa biribis da anɛ Sua nɛ Haanɛfa nɛ Sual nɛ Beri nɛ Imra nɛ 37Bezer nɛ Hod nɛ Seamma nɛ Silisia nɛ Itiran nɛ Beera.
38Jeta biribis da anɛ Jefune nɛ Pisipa nɛ Ara. 39Ulla biribis da anɛ Arah nɛ Haniel nɛ Ariziya.
40Bama wʋsa da anɛ Aser yaas ka an tuŋ la tuongatib, ba da anɛ zabzabidib banɛ sʋnfʋ kpi'em nɛ tuongatib banɛ ka sɔ' wʋsa mi' ba yɛla. Dap banɛ da siak zaba ken ka ba kaali ba la da anɛ tusa pisi nɛ ayuobʋ (26,000).

english_text:
More Descendants of Benjamin
1Benjamin had five sons, who were born in the following order: Bela, Ashbel, Aharah, 2Nohah, and Rapha. 3Bela was the father of Addar, Gera, Abihud, 4Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah, 5Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.
6-7Ehud was the father of Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera. They were clan leaders in the town of Geba, but were later forced to move to the town of Manahath, and Gera led the way. He had two sons: Uzza and Ahihud.
8-11Shaharaim and his wife Hushim had two sons: Abitub and Elpaal. But Shaharaim later divorced her and his other wife, Baara. Then he moved to the country of Moab and married Hodesh, and they had seven sons: Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam, Jeuz, Sachia, and Mirmah. They were all family leaders in his clan. 12Elpaal was the father of Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who settled the towns of Ono and Lod, as well as the nearby villages.
13Beriah and Shema were family leaders in the clan that lived in the town of Aijalon and that forced out the people of Gath. 14-16Beriah's descendants included Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth, Zebadiah, Arad, Eder, Michael, Ishpah, and Joha. 17-18Elpaal's descendants included Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber, Ishmerai, Izliah, and Jobab. 19-21Shimei's descendants included Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi, Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel, Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath. 22-25Shashak's descendants included Ishpan, Eber, Eliel, Abdon, Zichri, Hanan, Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah, Iphdeiah, and Penuel. 26-27Jeroham's descendants included Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah, Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri. 28These were the family leaders in their ancestor's clan, and they and their descendants lived in Jerusalem.
29Jeiel settled the town of Gibeon. He and his wife Maacah lived there 30along with their sons, who were born in the following order: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab, 31Gedor, Ahio, Zecher, 32and Mikloth the father of Shimeah. Some of them went to live in Jerusalem near their relatives.
The Descendants of King Saul
33Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul.
Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal. 34Jonathan was the father of Meribbaal, the grandfather of Micah, 35and the great-grandfather of Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz. 36Saul's other descendants were Jehoaddah, Alemeth, Azmaveth, Zimri, Moza, 37Binea, Raphah, Eleasah, Azel, 38as well as Azel's six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. 39Azel's brother Eshek was the father of Ulam, Jeush, and Eliphelet. 40Ulam's sons were brave soldiers who were experts at using a bow and arrows. They had a total of 150 children and grandchildren.
All of these belonged to the tribe of Benjamin.
translation_text:
Saul yaas yʋda nwa'
1Bela da anɛ Benjamin bikpɛɛm, ka Asbɛl tia'al, ka Ahara paas atan', 2ka Noha paas anaasi ka Rafa paas anu.
3Bela biribis da anɛ Addar nɛ Gera nɛ Abihud 4nɛ Abisua nɛ Naaman nɛ Ahoohi 5nɛ Gera nɛ Sefuhan nɛ Huram.
6Bama da anɛ Ehud yaas, banɛ da an yidaannam ka bɛ Geba teŋin, amaa ba da yisi ba ani kɛ ka ba keŋ Manahaf teŋin. Ba yʋda nwa': 7Naaman nɛ Ahija nɛ Gera, onɛ da gaadi ba tuon ka ba keŋ Manahaf la. Gera biribisi da an Uza nɛ Ahihud.
8Siaharam da du'a biribis Moab teŋin on da lɛbis o pu'a banɛ yʋda an Husim nɛ Baara la nya'aŋ. 9O da di pu'a ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Hodes ka o du'a Jobab nɛ Zibia nɛ Mesea nɛ Malikam 10nɛ Jeus nɛ Sakia nɛ Mirima.
Bama da aan o biribis ka lɛn an yidaannam. 11Siaharam pu'a Husim biribis anɛ Abitub nɛ Elipaal. 12Elipaal biribis anɛ Eba nɛ Misam nɛ Semed (onɛ da mɛ' Ono nɛ Lod nɛ tembibis banɛ gilig la), 13nɛ Beria nɛ Sema.
Bama an banɛ da bɛ Aijalon teŋin la tuŋ la tuongatib, banɛ da kad Gaf teŋ nidib la yis.
14Beria biribis da anɛ Ahio nɛ Siasiak nɛ Jerimof 15nɛ Zebadaya nɛ Arad nɛ Eda 16Maikel nɛ Ispa nɛ Joha.
17Elipaal biribis da anɛ Zebadaya nɛ Mesulam nɛ Hiziki nɛ Heber 18nɛ Isimeraae nɛ Izilia, nɛ Jobab.
19Simie biribis da anɛ Jakim nɛ Zikir nɛ Zabdi 20nɛ Elienai nɛ Zilataae nɛ Eliel 21nɛ Adaya nɛ Beraaya nɛ Simiraf.
22Siasiak biribis da anɛ Isipan nɛ Eba nɛ Eliel 23nɛ Abidon nɛ Zikir nɛ Hanan 24nɛ Hanania, Elam nɛ Antotija 25nɛ Ifideya nɛ Penuel.
26Jeroham biribis da anɛ Samisirai nɛ Sieharaya nɛ Atalia 27nɛ Jaaresia nɛ Elaja nɛ Zikir.
28Bama wʋsa da anɛ ba tuongatib nɛ zugdaannam banɛ ka ba sɔbi ba yʋda dɔlis tuŋ-tuŋ. Ba da zin'inɛ Jerusalem tempʋʋgin.
29Jeyel onɛ da an Gibeon saam la da zin'inɛ Gibeon teŋin. O pu'a yʋ'ʋri da buon Maaka. 30O bikpɛɛm yʋ'ʋri da buon Abidon, ka banɛ tia'al la an Zur nɛ Kis nɛ Baal nɛ Nier nɛ Nadab 31nɛ Geduor nɛ Ahio nɛ Zeka 32nɛ Mikilof onɛ biigi da an Simea la.
Ba mɛ da zin' kpi'enɛ ba nidib, Jerusalem teŋin.
33Kis saam da anɛ Nier, ka Saul saam an Kis, ka Jonatan nɛ Abinadab nɛ Malikisua nɛ Esibaal saam an Saul.
34Jonatan da du'a Meribaal, ka Meribaal du'a Maika.
35Maika biribis da anɛ Piton nɛ Melek nɛ Tarea nɛ Ahaz. 36Ahaz biig yʋ'ʋri da buon Jehoada, ka Jehoada biribis da an Alemef nɛ Asmavef nɛ Zimiri. Ka Zimiri da du'a Mooza, 37ka Mooza du'a Binɛa, ka Binɛa mɛ du'a Rafa ka Rafa du'a Eleasa ka Eleasa du'a Azel.
38Azel da mɔri biribis ayuobʋ ka ba yʋda an: Azirikam nɛ Bokɛru nɛ Isimael nɛ Seraya nɛ Obadia, nɛ Hanan. Bama wʋsa da anɛ Azel biribis. 39O ba'abiig Esek bikpɛɛm da anɛ Ulam, ka Jeus tia'al ayi', ka Elifelet tia'al atan'.
40Ulam biribis la da anɛ zabzabidib banɛ mɔr sʋnkpi'euŋ ka mi' kpan nwɛ'ɛb. Ba da mɔr biribis nɛ yaas bɛdegʋ ka ba wʋsa kal da duoe kɔbiga nɛ pisnu (150).
Bama wʋsa da anɛ Benjamin yaas.

english_text:
The People Who Returned from Babylonia and Settled in Jerusalem
1Everyone in Israel was listed in the official family records that were included in the history of Israel's kings.
The people of Judah were taken to Babylonia as prisoners because they sinned against the Lord. 2 And the first people to return to their towns included priests, Levites, temple workers, and other Israelites. 3People from the tribes of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh settled in Jerusalem.
4-6There were 690 people from the Judah tribe who settled in Jerusalem. They were all descendants of Judah's three sons: Perez, Shelah, and Zerah. Their leaders were Uthai, Asaiah, and Jeuel. Uthai was the son of Ammihud and a descendant of Omri, Imri, Bani, and Perez. Asaiah was a descendant of Shelah; Jeuel was a descendant of Zerah.
7-9There were also 956 family leaders from the Benjamin tribe who settled in Jerusalem. They included: Sallu son of Meshullam, grandson of Hodaviah, and great-grandson of Hassenuah; Ibneiah son of Jeroham; Elah son of Uzzi and grandson of Michri; Meshullam son of Shephatiah, grandson of Reuel, and great-grandson of Ibnijah.
The Priests Who Settled in Jerusalem
10-12Here is a list of priests who settled in Jerusalem: Jedaiah; Jehoiarib; Jachin; Azariah, who was a temple official, and whose ancestors included Hilkiah, Meshullam, Zadok, Meraioth, and Ahitub; Adaiah son of Jeroham, whose ancestors included Pashhur and Malchijah; Maasai son of Adiel, whose ancestors included Jahzerah, Meshullam, Meshillemith, and Immer.
13There was a total of 1,760 priests, all of them family leaders in their clan and trained in the work at the temple.
The Levites Who Settled in Jerusalem
14-16Here is a list of Levites who settled in Jerusalem: Shemaiah from the Merari clan, whose ancestors included Hasshub, Azrikam, and Hashabiah; Bakbakkar; Heresh; Galal; Mattaniah son of Mica, whose ancestors included Zichri and Asaph; Obadiah son of Shemaiah, whose ancestors included Galal and Jeduthun; Berechiah son of Asa and grandson of Elkanah, who had lived in the villages near the town of Netophah.
The Temple Guards Who Settled in Jerusalem
17Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their relatives were the guards at the temple gates. Shallum was the leader of this clan, 18and for a long time they had been the guards at the King's Gate on the east side of the city. Before that, their ancestors guarded the entrance to the Levite camp.
19Shallum son of Kore, as well as the other men in the Korahite clan, guarded the entrance to the temple, just as their ancestors had guarded the entrance to the sacred tent. 20Phinehas son of Eleazar had supervised their work because the Lord was with him.
21Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was also one of the guards at the temple.
22There was a total of 212 guards, all of them listed in the family records in their towns. Their ancestors had been chosen by King David and by Samuel the prophet to be responsible for this work, 23and now they guarded the temple gates.
24There was one full-time guard appointed to each of the four sides of the temple. 25Their assistants lived in the villages outside the city, and every seven days a group of them would come into the city and take their turn at guard duty. 26The four full-time guards were Levites, and they supervised the other guards and were responsible for the rooms in the temple and the supplies kept there. 27They guarded the temple day and night and opened its doors every morning.
The Duties of the Levites
28Some of the Levites were responsible for the equipment used in worship at the temple, and they had to count everything before and after it was used. 29Others were responsible for the temple furnishings and its sacred objects, as well as the flour, wine, olive oil, incense, and spices. 30But only the priests could mix the spices. 31Mattithiah, Shallum's oldest son, was a member of the Levite clan of Korah, and he was in charge of baking the bread used for offerings. 32The Levites from the Kohath clan were in charge of baking the sacred loaves of bread for each Sabbath.
33The Levite family leaders who were the musicians also lived at the temple. They had no other responsibilities, because they were on duty day and night.
34All of these men were family leaders in the Levi tribe and were listed that way in their family records. They lived in Jerusalem.
King Saul's Family
(1 Chronicles 8.29-38)
35Jeiel had settled the town of Gibeon, where he and his wife Maacah lived. 36They had ten sons, who were born in the following order: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab, 37Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth 38the father of Shimeam. Some of them went to live in Jerusalem near their relatives.
39Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul.
Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal. 40-41Jonathan was the father of Meribbaal, the grandfather of Micah, and the great-grandfather of Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz. 42-44The descendants of Ahaz included Jarah, Alemeth, Azmaveth, Zimri, Moza, Binea, Rephaiah, Eleasah, and Azel and his six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.
translation_text:
Nimbanɛ da naan teŋ zʋŋʋ lɛb Jerusalem na la yɛla
1Ba da sɔb Israel tuŋ wʋsa nidib yʋda niŋ Israel na'anam gbana la ni.
Ba da gban'e Juda dimi mɔri keŋ Babilon ban da ka' sida dim la zug. 2 Banɛ da dɛŋi lɛbi zin'inɛ ba mɛŋ paalʋ nii ba teŋin la da anɛ Israel buudbanɛ an maanmaannib nɛ Levi dɔɔg dim nɛ banɛ tʋm Pʋ'ʋsim Yir tʋʋma la.
3Banɛ da yi Juda nɛ Benjamin nɛ Efiram nɛ Manase dɔɔg la ni ka zin' Jerusalem teŋin la da anɛ: 4Utaae onɛ saamme an Ammihud ka Ammihud mɛ an Omir biig, ka Omir an Imir biig, ka Imir mɛ an Bani biig, ka an Perez yaaŋ la, Perez mɛ da anɛ Juda biig.
5Siilo tuŋʋn la, da anɛ Asaya onɛ aan o bikpɛɛm la nɛ o biribis. 6Zera tuŋʋn la da anɛ Jewel.
Nimbanɛ da yi Juda tuŋʋn la kal da duoe nɛ kɔbisyuobʋ nɛ piswai (690).
7Benjamin dɔɔg la ni: Salu da anɛ Mesulam biig, ka Mesulam an Hodavia biig, ka Hodavia mɛ an Hasenua biig; 8Ibneya da anɛ Jeroham biig; ka Ela an Uzi biig, ka Uzi an Mikir biig, ka Mesulam da an Sefatia biig ka Sefatia da an Reuel biig, ka Reuel mɛ an Ibneya biig.
9Nimbanɛ da yi Benjamin dɔɔgin la da duoe nɛ kɔbiswai nɛ pisnu nɛ ayuobʋ (956). Dap bama wʋsa da anɛ ba dɔɔg tuongatib.
Maanmaannib banɛ da bɛ Jerusalem
10Maanmaannib la ni da anɛ: Jedaya nɛ Jehoyarib nɛ Jakin 11nɛ Azariya onɛ da an Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la kpɛɛm. O da anɛ Hilkia biig, ka Hilkia an Mesulam biig, ka Mesulam an Zadok biig, ka Zadok an Merayof biig, ka Merayof mɛ an Ahitub biig.
12Adaya da anɛ Jeroham biig, ka Jeroham an Pasur biig, ka Pasur an Malkija biig. Maasaae da anɛ Adiel biig, ka Adiel an Jazera biig, ka Jazera an Mesulam biig, ka Mesulam an Mesielemif biig, ka Mesielemif mɛ an Imer biig.
13Maanmaannib banɛ da an dɔɔd la tuongatib la da anɛ tusir nɛ kɔbisyɔpɔi nɛ pisyuobʋ (1,760). Ba da anɛ dap banɛ siaki ba mɛŋ, ka ba tʋʋma da an ye ba maan maana Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la.
14Levi dɔɔg la ni, Semaya da anɛ Hasueb biig ka Hasueb an Azirikam biig ka Azirikam an Hasiabiya biig ka an Merari tuŋ nid la.
15Bakbakar nɛ Heres nɛ Galal nɛ Matanaya onɛ da an Maika biig ka Maika da an Zikir biig ka Zikir mɛ an Asaf biig. 16Obadia da anɛ Semaya biig ka Semaya mɛ an Galal biig ka Galal an Jedutun biig; ka Berekaya an Asa biig ka Asa an Elkana biig; o da zin'inɛ Netofa dim teŋkpɛmisin.
Za'anɔgu'udib
17Banɛ da gur za'anɔɔr la da anɛ: Sallum nɛ Akub nɛ Talimon nɛ Ahiman nɛ ba ba'abiis. Sallum da aan ba tuongat 18ba da nɔki ba Na'ab Za'anɔɔr kanɛ lɛbid ya-nya'aŋ baba la gu'uli ba ti paae saŋa kaŋa. Bama an Levi dɔɔg dim banɛ da gur za'anɔɔr la.
19Sallum da anɛ Kore biig, ka an Ebiyasaf yaaŋ. On nɛ o taaba banɛ yi Kohat buudi ni la tʋʋm da anɛ ye ba gur Fuug Sʋgʋr za'anɔɔr la wʋʋ ba yaanamɛ da gur si'em la. 20Pin'ilʋgʋn la Finehas onɛ an Eleazar biig la da gur za'anɔɔr la, ka Zugsɔb la da bɛ nɛ o. 21Zakaria onɛ an Meselemaya biig la mɛ da anɛ onɛ gur Zugsɔb La'asʋg Fuug Sʋgʋr la za'anɔɔr.
22Banɛ ka ba da gaŋ ye ba gur za'anɔɔr la kal da duoe nɛ kɔbisyi' nɛ pii nɛ ayi' (212). Ba da sɔbi ba yʋda dɔlis tuŋ-tuŋ nɛ ban yi teŋkpɛŋ sieba na. David nɛ Samuel onɛ an Zugsɔb nɔdi'es la da nɔk nidib la niŋ tʋʋm kan ni. 23Ban nɛ ba yaasi da gur Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la za'anɔya saŋa wʋsa; linɛ ka ba da buon ye Sʋgʋr la. 24Za'anɔgu'udib la da bɛ nɛ lʋga anaasi la wʋsa, tuon nɛ nya'aŋ, nɛ datiuŋ nɛ dagɔbʋg. 25Ba ba'abiis banɛ bɛ teŋkpɛmisin la da ɛɛn bɛ nɛ saŋa si'a kena tʋm sʋŋi ba wʋʋ daba ayɔpɔi. 26Amaa banɛ da gur za'anɔya anaasi la kpɛɛmnam la da anɛ Levi dɔɔg dim, ba tʋʋm da anɛ ba gur dɔɔd la nɛ la'abanɛ bɛ Wina'am yin la. 27Yʋ'ʋŋ wʋsa ba da giligid nɛ Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la, bɔzugɔ li da anɛ ba guri li, ka mɔr saafibiis banɛ ka ba mɔri yɔ'ɔgidi kpɛn'ɛd bɛkɛung wʋsa la.
Levi dim tʋʋm sieba yɛla
28Levi dim banɛ da kpɛlim la tʋʋm da anɛ ye ba gur la'abanɛ ka ba mɔri tʋm Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la. Ba ya'a mɔri ba kpɛn'ɛd na, ba na kaali ba, ka lɛn kaali ba, ba ya'a mɔri ba yit. 29Sieba tʋʋm mɛ da anɛ ba gɔsid kʋgis nɛ la'abanɛ wʋsaa bɛ Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔgin la, la'an nɛ zɔ'ɔm nɛ daam nɛ kpaam linɛ nyu'od la nɛ bʋnnyubisa. 30Amaa li anɛ maanmaannib la sieba da maan bʋnnyubisa la. 31Levi nid sɔ' da bɛ ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Matitia, o da anɛ Sallum bikpɛɛm ka an Kora nid, o tʋʋm da anɛ bodobodo maalʋg. 32Ba ba'abiis sieba banɛ an Kohat tuŋ dim la da sʋ'oe bodobodo linɛ ka ba pa'an teebul zug Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar wʋsa la gɔsig.
33Levi dim la sieba da anɛ yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la ni. Ba yir kpɛɛmnam la da bɛ nɛ Pʋ'ʋsim Yir dɔɔdin la, ba da pʋ kɛ ka ba tʋm tʋʋm si'a ya'asɛ bɔzugɔ ba da anɛ banɛ sʋ'oe yʋ'ʋŋ nɛ nintaŋ tʋʋma.
34Banɛ yʋda sɔb zugin la da anɛ Levi dim yir kpɛɛmnam. Ba yʋda la da sɔb nɛ dɔlis tuŋ-tuŋ, ba da zin'inɛ Jerusalem.
Saul tuŋ la yɛla
35Jeyel onɛ da an Gibeon saam la, da zin'inɛ Gibeon teŋin. O pu'a yʋ'ʋri da buon Maaka. 36O bikpɛɛm yʋ'ʋri da buon Abidon, ka banɛ tia'al an Zur nɛ Kis nɛ Baal nɛ Nier nɛ Nadab 37nɛ Geduor nɛ Ahio nɛ Zakaria nɛ Mikilof. 38Miklof biigi da an Simeam. Ba mɛ da zin'ini kpi'e nɛ ba nidib Jerusalem teŋin.
39Nier da anɛ Kis saam, ka Kis an Saul saam, ka Saul an Jonatan nɛ Malikisua nɛ Abinadab nɛ Esibaal saam. 40Jonatan biig yʋ'ʋri da an Meribaal: ka Meribaal du'a Maika. 41Maika biribis yʋda nwa': Piton nɛ Melek nɛ Tarea, nɛ Ahaz. 42Ka Ahaz an Jara saam ka Jara an Alemef nɛ Asmavef nɛ Zimiri saam ka Zimiri an Mooza saam. 43Ka Mooza an Binɛa saam ka Binɛa an Rafa saam ka Rafa an Eleasa saam ka Eleasa an Azel saam. 44Azel da mɔri biribis ayuobʋ, ka ba yʋda an: Azirikam nɛ Bokɛru nɛ Isimael nɛ Seraya nɛ Obadia nɛ Hanan. Bama wʋsa da anɛ Azel biribis.

english_text:
King Saul and His Sons Die
(1 Samuel 31.1-13)
1The Philistines fought against Israel in a battle at Mount Gilboa. Israel's soldiers ran from the Philistines, and many of them were killed. 2The Philistines closed in on Saul and his sons and killed three of them: Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua. 3The fighting was fierce around Saul, and he was badly wounded by enemy arrows.
4Saul told the soldier who carried his weapons, “Kill me with your sword! I don't want those godless Philistines to torture and make fun of me.”
But the soldier was afraid to kill him. Then Saul stuck himself in the stomach with his own sword and fell on the blade. 5When the soldier realized that Saul was dead, he killed himself in the same way.
6Saul, three of his sons, and all his male relatives were dead. 7The Israelites who lived in Jezreel Valley learned that their army had run away and that Saul and his sons were dead. They ran away too, and the Philistines moved into the towns the Israelites left behind.
8The next day the Philistines came back to the battlefield to carry away the weapons of the dead Israelite soldiers. When they found the bodies of Saul and his sons on Mount Gilboa, 9they took Saul's weapons, pulled off his armor, and cut off his head. Then they sent messengers everywhere in Philistia to spread the news among their people and to thank the idols of their gods. 10They put Saul's armor in the temple of their gods and hung his head in the temple of their god Dagon.
11When the people who lived in Jabesh in Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul, 12some brave men went to get his body and the bodies of his three sons. The men brought the bodies back to Jabesh, where they buried them under an oak tree. Then for seven days, they went without eating to show their sorrow.
13 Saul died because he was unfaithful and disobeyed the Lord. He even asked advice from a woman who talked to spirits of the dead, 14instead of asking the Lord. So the Lord had Saul killed and gave his kingdom to David, the son of Jesse.
translation_text:
Saul n kʋʋ o mɛŋ la yɛla
(1Sa 31:1-13)
1Filistia dim da zab nɛ Israel dim Giliboa zuorin la ka nyaŋ Israel dim la kʋʋ ba pamm, ka banɛ kpɛlim la zɔ. 2Filistia dim la nini da mu'oe Saul nɛ o biribis la yɛla hali; ba da kʋʋ o biribis Jonatan nɛ Abinadab nɛ Malikisua. 3Zaba la da ɔnsig nɛ hali gɛɛl Saul, ka tiratɔɔndib la nyaŋi tɔn Saul n pu'alim o bɛ'ɛd bɛ'ɛdi.
4Saul da yɛl onɛ ziid o zaba la'ad la ye, “Fuomi fʋ sʋ'ʋg la kunsimi kʋ, ya'a ka' ala nimbanɛ pʋ kpɛn' baŋʋ nwa' na kena kunsimi kʋ ka li lieb nyannɛ tisim.” Amaa o zaba la'aziid la da zɔ dabiem ka pʋ siaki niŋ ala. Ka Saul fuoe o mɛŋ sʋ'ʋgʋ ba'a teŋin ka bas o mɛŋi lii li zugʋ kpi. 5Zaba la'aziid la da nyɛ ka Saul kpi la, ka on mɛ fuoe o sʋ'ʋgʋ ba', ka mɛ bas o mɛŋi lii li zug, ka ba wʋsa la'am kpi. 6Saul nɛ o biribis atan' la nɛ onɛ ziid o zaba la'ad, nɛ o yidim la wʋsa da la'am kpinɛ daar yinne. 7Israel dim banɛ bɛ bɔn'ɔfaligin la da nyɛ soogianam la zɔt, ka Saul nɛ o biribis la wʋsa kpi la, ba da duoe zɔ ka basi ba tɛɛns la. Ka Filistia dim la keŋ di'e lii zin'in.
8Bɛogʋ da nie ka Filistia dim la kena ye ba yɛɛs banɛ kpi la fuud la, ba da nyɛ Saul nɛ o biribis la dig Giliboa zuor la zug. 9Ka ba yɛɛs o zaba la'ad la, ka fi'ig o zug, ka tʋm nidib ye ba keŋ mɔɔli gilig Filistia dim teŋ la wʋsa, ka yɛl labaar la tisi ba bada la nɛ ba nidib la wʋsa. 10Ba da nɔk o zaba la'ad la niŋi ba bada la dɔɔgin ka nɔk o zug la ya'al ba'ar kanɛ buon Dagon la dɔɔgin. 11Jabis Gilead nidib la wʋsa da wʋm Filistia dim la maal Saul niŋgbiŋ la si'em la, 12ba nimbanɛ sʋnfʋ kpi'em ka ba pʋ lɛbid nya'aŋ zaba ni la, da duoe keŋ Betsean yʋ'ʋŋ kanɛ yak Saul nɛ o biribis la niŋgbina lɛb Jabis ka nɔki ba kɔnba la pin' titita'ar gbinnin Jabis teŋin, ka lɔ nɔɔr daba ayɔpɔi.
13 Saul n da dɔl Zugsɔb la nɛ pʋʋs ayi' la zug ka o da kpi. O da ki'is Zugsɔb la nɔɔr hali ka keŋ ba'akɔlʋg sɔb san'an ye o bugi baŋ dinɛ na niŋ, 14ka pʋ bu'os Zugsɔb la baŋ linɛ bɛɛ. Alazug Zugsɔb la da kʋʋ o ka nɔk na'am la tis Na'ab David onɛ an Jese biig la.

english_text:
David Becomes King of Israel
(2 Samuel 5.1-3)
1Israel's leaders met with David at Hebron and said, “We are your relatives, 2and we know that you have led our army into battle, even when Saul was still our king. The Lord God has promised that you would rule our country and take care of us like a shepherd. 3So we have come to crown you king of Israel.”
David made an agreement with the leaders and asked the Lord to be their witness. Then the leaders poured olive oil on David's head to show that he was now king of Israel. This happened just as the Lord's prophet Samuel had said.
David Captures Jerusalem
(2 Samuel 5.6-10)
4 Jerusalem was called Jebus at the time, and David led Israel's army to attack the town. 5The Jebusites said, “You won't be able to get in here!” But David captured the fortress of Mount Zion, which is now called the City of David.
6David had told his troops, “The first soldier to kill a Jebusite will become my army commander.” And since Joab son of Zeruiah attacked first, he became commander.
7Later, David moved to the fortress—that's why it's called the City of David. 8He had the city rebuilt, starting at the landfill on the east side. Meanwhile, Joab supervised the repairs to the rest of the city.
9David became a great and strong ruler, because the Lord All-Powerful was on his side.
The Three Warriors
(2 Samuel 23.8-17)
10The Lord had promised that David would become king, and so everyone in Israel gave David their support. Certain warriors also helped keep his kingdom strong.
11The first of these warriors was Jashobeam the son of Hachmoni, the leader of the Three Warriors. In one battle he killed 300 men with his spear.
12Another one of the Three Warriors was Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite. 13During a battle against the Philistines at Pas-Dammim, all the Israelite soldiers ran away, 14except Eleazar, who stayed with David. They took their positions in a nearby barley field and defeated the Philistines! The Lord gave Israel a great victory that day.
15One time the Three Warriors went to meet David among the rocks at Adullam Cave. The Philistine army had set up camp in Rephaim Valley 16and had taken over Bethlehem. David was in a fortress, 17and he said, “I'm very thirsty. I wish I had a drink of water from the well by the gate to Bethlehem.”
18The Three Warriors sneaked through the Philistine camp and got some water from the well near Bethlehem's gate. They took it back to David, but he refused to drink it. Instead, he poured out the water as a sacrifice to the Lord 19and said, “Drinking this water would be like drinking the blood of these men who risked their lives to get it for me.”
The Three Warriors did these brave deeds.
The Thirty Warriors
(2 Samuel 23.18-39)
20Joab's brother Abishai was the leader of the Thirty Warriors, and in one battle he killed 300 men with his spear. He was just as famous as the Three Warriors 21and was more famous than the rest of the Thirty Warriors. He was their commander, but he never became one of the Three Warriors.
22Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was a brave man from Kabzeel who did some amazing things. One time he killed two of Moab's best fighters, and one snowy day he went into a pit and killed a lion. 23Another time he killed an Egyptian who was over two meters tall and was armed with a spear. Benaiah only had a club, so he grabbed the spear from the Egyptian and killed him with it. 24Benaiah did things like that; he was just as brave as the Three Warriors, 25even though he never became one of them. And he was certainly as famous as the rest of the Thirty Warriors. So David made him the leader of his own bodyguard.
26-47Here is a list of the other famous warriors:
Asahel the brother of Joab; Elhanan the son of Dodo from Bethlehem; Shammoth from Haror; Helez from Pelon; Ira the son of Ikkesh from Tekoa; Abiezer from Anathoth; Sibbecai the Hushathite; Ilai the Ahohite; Maharai from Netophah; Heled the son of Baanah from Netophah; Ithai the son of Ribai from Gibeah in Benjamin; Benaiah from Pirathon; Hurai from near the streams on Mount Gaash; Abiel from Arbah; Azmaveth from Baharum; Eliahba from Shaalbon; Hashem the Gizonite; Jonathan the son of Shagee from Harar; Ahiam the son of Sachar the Hararite; Eliphal the son of Ur; Hepher from Mecherah; Ahijah from Pelon; Hezro from Carmel; Naarai the son of Ezbai; Joel the brother of Nathan; Mibhar the son of Hagri; Zelek from Ammon; Naharai from Beeroth who carried Joab's weapons; Ira the Ithrite; Gareb the Ithrite; Uriah the Hittite; Zabad the son of Ahlai; Adina the son of Shiza, a leader in the Reuben tribe, and 30 of his soldiers; Hanan the son of Maacah; Joshaphat from Mithan; Uzzia from Ashterah; Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham from Aroer; Jediael and Joha the sons of Shimri from Tiz; Eliel from Mahavah; Jeribai and Joshaviah the sons of Elnaam; Ithmah from Moab; Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel from Mezobah.
translation_text:
David n lieb Israel wʋsa Na'ab la yɛla
(2Sa 5:1-10)
1Israel nidib la wʋsa da la'as taaba keŋ David san'an Hebron teŋin yɛl o ye, “Tinam nɛ fʋ anɛ du'am, 2saŋa kanɛ daa gaad ka Saul aan ti na'ab la, fʋnɛ an onɛ daa ɛɛnti gaad Israel nidib tuon zaba pʋʋgin, ka Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, ‘Fʋnɛ na an onɛ na guri m nidib Israel dim la wʋʋ kɔnbkem nɛ, ka na liebi ba tuongat.’” 3Israel kpɛɛmnam la wʋsa da la'as na'ab la san'an na Hebron teŋin. Na'ab David da maal nɔnaar nɛ ba Hebron teŋin Zugsɔb la tuon. Ka ba diis o na'am ka o sʋ'oe Israel wʋsa, wʋʋ Zugsɔb la da kaanb si'em tis Samuel ka o yɛl o la.
David n nyaŋ Jerusalem la yɛla
4 David nɛ o nidib la wʋsa da duoe keŋ Jerusalem tempʋʋgin ye ba zab nɛ Jebus dim banɛ bɛ anina la. 5Jebus dim la da yɛl David ye, “Fʋ kʋ nyaŋi kpɛn' kpɛla naa.” La'an nɛ wala, David da nyaŋi ba kpi'euŋ zin'ig dinɛ bɛ Zion, ka ba yʋ'ʋn buonnɛ li ye, David Teŋ la. 6David da yɛl ye, “Onɛ nyaŋi gaad tuon ka ba zabi nyaŋ Jebus buudi la na lieb zabzabidib la kpɛɛm.” Ka Joab onɛ an Zeruyia biig la da gaad tuon yiiga, dinzug o da liebi ba kpɛɛm. 7David da keŋ zin'in teŋ la kpi'euŋ zin'ikanɛ ka o zabi nyaŋ la ni, linzug ka ba da buonnɛ li ye, David Tempʋʋg la. 8O da mɛ' zaŋguom kanɛ mɔr paŋi giligi li ka yʋ'ʋn mɛ' ya' bɛdegʋ ka li kilim tempʋʋg, ka Joab mɛ' linɛ kpɛlim la naae. 9Ka David kpi'euŋ la yʋ'ʋn maligim zu'oe hali, bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la da bɛ nɛ o.
David zabzabidib banɛ kpi'em la yɛla
(2Sa 23:8-39)
10Bama da an David ninkpi'ema la tuongatib, ban nɛ Israel dim la wʋsa da la'as taaba kɛ ka David na'am la paam paŋi yaligi paae teŋ la bɛn wʋsa, wʋʋ Zugsɔb la da kaanb si'em la. 11Banɛ da an David ninkpi'ema la yʋda nwana: onɛ da an Takɛmon nid la da an nidiba atan' la kpɛɛm. O da nɔk kpan nɛ kʋ nidib kɔbisnii zabir yinne ma'aa ni.
12Onɛ tia'al da anɛ Eleazar onɛ an Dodo biig ka an Ahoohi nid la. On anɛ onɛ da paas nimbɛda atan' la ni. 13O da la'am bɛ nɛ David Pas-Damim teŋin ka Filistia dim la la'as taaba ye ba zab nɛ ba. Israel zabzabidib la da zɔ ka bas Filistia dim la zin'ikanɛ ka mui bɔn'ɔg da bɛ la. 14Amaa Eleazar nɛ David n da paae pɔɔg la teŋsʋk la, ba da zi'enɛ zab nɛ Filistia dim la. Ka Zugsɔb la kɛ ka ba nyaŋ nyaŋtita'ar.
15Nidib atan' banɛ da an nidib pistan' la kpɛɛmnam la da kɛn David san'an na, tampinyɔk dinɛ bɛ Adullam la. Ka Filistia dim la mɛ la'as Refa Dim Bɔn'ɔgin la zi'e ye ba zab. 16Saŋkan la ka David da bɛ nɛ o zin'ikpi'euŋin la, ka Filistia zabzabidib la sieba pʋdigi keŋ bɛ Betilehem. 17Ku'onuud da mɔr David ka o yɛl ye, “O! M bɔɔdi sɔ' naan gbin'e ku'om bulig kanɛ kpi'e Betilehem za'anɔɔrin la tisim!” 18Ka o nimbɛda atan' la bʋŋ Filistia dim la teŋsʋkʋ gaadi keŋ paae bulig kanɛ kpi'e Betilehem za'anɔɔrin la gbin'e ku'om zii lɛb na tis David. Amaa o da zan'as ya ka pʋ nu ku'om la, ka kpa'ae li bas Zugsɔb la tuon, 19ka yɛl ye, “Win da kɛ ka m tʋm nɛ'ɛŋaa! Li na nwɛnɛ banɛ kuosi ba nyɔvʋri keŋ la ziim ka m nu.” Alazug ka o zan'as ka pʋ nuu. Tʋʋm kpi'euŋ kanɛ ka dap atan' banɛ an sʋnkpi'euŋ dim la da tʋmm la.
20Abisai onɛ an Joab pitʋ ka an Zeruyia biig la da an nidib pistan' la kpɛɛm. O da nɔk o kpan nɛ kʋ nidib kɔbistan' ka o yʋ'ʋr mɛ da yii nwɛnɛ nidiba atan' la nɛ. 21Bi'esʋg kae nɛ on da di'e na'asi gaad nidib pistan' la, hali ka liebi ba tuongat, la'an nɛ ban da pʋ kaal o paas nidib atan' la sʋʋgin la.
22Benaya, onɛ an Jehoyada biig la, da anɛ zabzabid hali, ka yi Kabziel teŋin na. O da mɔya hali. O da kʋ Moab ninkpi'ema ayi'. O da lɛn sig bʋmbɔkin kʋ gbigim, daar kanɛ ka sisalig da bɛ ka ku'om ga'aŋi nwɛnɛ sakuga la. 23O mɛ da kʋ Egipt dau tita'ar onɛ wa'alim da gat ninsaal wa'alim, la'an nɛ on da zanl kpan o nu'ugin ka li wa'am hali la. Benaya da keŋ o san'an nɛ balaar ka zɛ kpan la Egipt dau la nu'ugin faaɛn ka nɔk o mɛŋ kpan nɛ kʋʋ o. 24Jehoyada biig Benaya da tʋm si'em la. O mɛ da mɔr yʋ'ʋr wʋʋ nimbɛda atan' la nɛ. 25O da di'e na'asi gaad nidib pistan' la, amaa o da pʋ paas nimbɛda atan' la nii. Ka David da kɛ ka o an banɛ gur la kpɛɛm.
26Ninkpi'ema bama da anɛ: Asahel onɛ an Joab pitʋ la, nɛ Elhanan onɛ an Dodo biig ka yi Betilehem na la, 27nɛ Seamma onɛ an Harod nid la, nɛ Helez onɛ an Palet nid la, 28nɛ Ira onɛ an Ikes biig ka yi Tekoa na la nɛ Abieza onɛ yi Anatof teŋin na la, 29nɛ Sibɛkai onɛ an Husea nid la, nɛ Yila onɛ an Ahoohi nid la, 30nɛ Meharai onɛ an Netofa nid la, nɛ Heled onɛ an Baana biig ka an Netofa nid la, 31nɛ Itai onɛ an Ribai biig ka yi Gibea Benjamin teŋin la, nɛ Benaya onɛ an Piraton nid la, 32nɛ Hurai onɛ yi Gaas Bʋmbu'adin la na, nɛ Abiel onɛ an Aba teŋ nid la, 33nɛ Asmavef onɛ an Baahum nid la, nɛ Eliyahaba onɛ an Saalbon nid la, nɛ 34Hasem onɛ an Gizo nid la, nɛ Jonatan onɛ an Siage biig ka yi Harar na la, 35nɛ Saka biig Ahiam onɛ an Harar nid la, nɛ Elifal onɛ an Ur biig la, nɛ 36Hifa onɛ an Mekɛra nid la, nɛ Ahija onɛ an Pilon nid la, 37nɛ Hesro onɛ an Kaamel nid la, nɛ Naarai onɛ an Eziba biig la, nɛ 38Joel onɛ ba'abiigi an Natan la, nɛ Mibiha onɛ an Hagir biig la, 39nɛ Zelek onɛ an Ammon nid la, nɛ Naharai onɛ an Beerot nid ka an onɛ ziid Joab onɛ an Zeruyia biig zaba la'ad la, 40nɛ Ira nɛ Gareb banɛ an Yitir nidib la, 41nɛ Uria onɛ an Hitti nid la, nɛ Zabad onɛ saamme an Alai la, 42nɛ Adina onɛ saamme an Siiza onɛ yi Reuben dɔɔgin ka da sʋ'oe nidib pistan' banɛ bɛ nɛ o la, 43nɛ Hanan onɛ an Maaka biig la, nɛ Joseafat onɛ an Mitan nid la 44nɛ Uzia onɛ an Asitarof nid la, nɛ Seama nɛ Jeiel banɛ saamme da an Hotam onɛ an Aroa nid la, 45nɛ Jediael onɛ an Simri biig la, nɛ o ba'abiig Joha onɛ an Tizi nid la, 46nɛ Eliel onɛ an Mahavi nid la, nɛ Jeribaae nɛ Joseavia banɛ an Elinaam biribis la, nɛ Yitma onɛ an Moab buudi nid la, 47nɛ Eliel nɛ Obɛd nɛ Jaasiel onɛ an Mezoba nid la.

english_text:
David's Men at Ziklag
1Some time earlier, David had gone to live in the town of Ziklag to escape from King Saul. While David was there, several brave warriors joined him to help fight his battles.
