Ka ba yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib banɛ an dap nɛ pu'ab an kɔbisyi' nɛ pisnaasi nɛ anu (245). 68Ba widi da anɛ kɔbisyɔpɔi nɛ pistan' nɛ ayuobʋ (736) nɛ wiedbanɛ nwɛnɛ bʋmis kɔbisyi' nɛ pisnaasi nɛ anu (245). 69Ba yʋgʋma da anɛ kɔbisnaasi nɛ pistan' nɛ anu (435) nɛ bʋmis tusa ayuobʋ nɛ kɔbisyɔpɔi nɛ pisi (6,720).
70Yidaannam la sieba da la'as nɛ ligidi sʋŋ tʋʋma la. Gɔmena la da tis anzurifa ligidi tusir (1,000) nɛ sanlima laas pisnu (50) nɛ maanmaannib fuud kɔbisnu nɛ pistan' (530). 71Yidaannam la sieba da tis sanlima ligidi tusa pisi (20,000) nɛ anzurifa ligidi bɔtnam tusa ayi' nɛ kɔbisyi' (2,200). 72Nidib banɛ kpɛlim la da tis nɛ sanlima ligidi tusa pisi (20,000) nɛ anzurifa ligidi tusa ayi' (2,000) nɛ maanmaannib fuud pisyuobʋ nɛ ayɔpɔi (67).
73Maanmaannib la nɛ Levi dim nɛ yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib nɛ za'anɔgu'udib la nɛ Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir tʋmtʋmnib nɛ nidib la sieba nɛ Israel dim la wʋsa yʋ'ʋn da lɛbi zin'in sɔ' wʋsa nɛ o mɛŋ teŋin nɛ o tempʋʋgin.
Ezra karim Zugsɔb zi'elʋg la
Nwadis ayɔpɔi la da paae la, Israel dim wʋsa da keŋ zin'in nɛ ba tempʋʋsin la.

english_text:
Ezra Reads God's Law to the People
1-2On the first day of the seventh month, the people came together in the open area in front of the Water Gate. Then they asked Ezra, who was a teacher of the Law of Moses, to read to them from this Law that the Lord had given his people. Ezra the priest came with the Law and stood before the crowd of men, women, and the children who were old enough to understand. 3From early morning till noon, he read the Law of Moses to them, and they listened carefully. 4Ezra stood on a high wooden platform that had been built for this occasion. Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah were standing to his right, while Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hash Baddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam were standing to his left.
5Ezra was up on the high platform, where he could be seen by everyone, and when he opened the book, all the people stood up. 6Ezra praised the great Lord God, and they lifted their hands, shouting “Amen! Amen!” Then they bowed with their faces to the ground and worshiped the Lord.
7-8After this, the Levites Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, and Pelaiah went among the people, explaining the meaning of what Ezra had read.
9The people started crying when God's Law was read to them. Then Nehemiah the governor, Ezra the priest and teacher, and the Levites who had been teaching the people all said, “This is a special day for the Lord your God. So don't be sad and don't cry!”
10Nehemiah told the people, “Enjoy your good food and wine and share some with those who didn't have anything to bring. Don't be sad! This is a special day for the Lord, and he will make you happy and strong.”
11The Levites encouraged the people by saying, “This is a sacred day, so don't worry or mourn!” 12When the people returned to their homes, they celebrated by eating and drinking and by sharing their food with those in need, because they had understood what had been read to them.
Celebrating the Festival of Shelters
13On the second day of the seventh month, the leaders of all the family groups came together with the priests and the Levites, so Ezra could teach them the Law 14 that the Lord had given to Moses. They learned from the Law that the people of Israel were to live in shelters when they celebrated the festival in the seventh month of the year. 15They also learned that they were to go into the woods and gather branches of leafy trees such as olives, myrtles, and palms for making these shelters.
16So the people gathered branches and made shelters on the flat roofs of their houses, in their yards, in the courtyard of the temple, and in the open areas around the Water Gate and Ephraim Gate. 17Everyone who had returned from Babylonia built shelters. They lived in them and joyfully celebrated the Festival of Shelters for the first time since the days of Joshua son of Nun. 18On each of the first seven days of the festival, Ezra read to the people from God's Law. Then on the eighth day, everyone gathered for worship, just as the Law had said they must.
translation_text:
1Nidib la wʋsa da la'as nɛ Ku'om Za'anɔɔr la tuon, ka yɛl Ezra onɛ pa'an wada la ye o nɔkim Moses wada gbauŋ kanɛ ka Zugsɔb da zi'el nɔɔri tis Israel dim la na.
2Li da anɛ nwadis ayɔpɔi la dabisir yinne daar ka Ezra onɛ an maanmaan la mɔr wada la nidib la tuon na. Banɛ da bɛɛ ani da anɛ dap nɛ pu'ab nɛ banɛ wʋsa na nyaŋi gban'e pian'ad gbin. 3O da zi'enɛ ka o nindaa kpa' Ku'om Za'anɔɔr paalʋ zin'ig la, ka o karim gbauŋ la nidib la wʋsa tuon, lin pin'il bɛkɛung asuba hali ti paae nintaŋ. Ka nidib la kɛlisid wada gbauŋ la ka o karim la sʋ'ʋŋa.
4Ba da maalnɛ daadi kpa' ka li dʋ ka Ezra dʋʋ zi'enɛ li zug, ba da maali li nɛ dabiskan la yɛla. Matitia nɛ Sema nɛ Anaya nɛ Uria nɛ Hilkia nɛ Maaseya da zi'enɛ o datiuŋ, ka banɛ da zi'e o dagɔbʋg la da anɛ Pedaya nɛ Misael nɛ Malkija nɛ Hasuem nɛ Hasiabadana nɛ Zakaria nɛ Mesulam.
5Ezra da lak gbauŋ la ka nidib la wʋsa nyɛt o bɔzugɔ, on da zi'e si'el la ba da maali li ka li dʋʋ gaad nidib la zi'e si'el la. 6Ezra da zun'e Zugsɔb onɛ an Wina'am tita'ar la ka nidib la wʋsa ʋki ba nu'us ka siak ye, “Ami! Ami!” Ka igin teŋinɛ zun'e Zugsɔb la ka ba nindaas kpa' teŋin.
7Ka Levi dim la da tu'asid nidib la wada la gbin ka nidib la wʋsa zi'e. Levi dim la yʋda da anɛ Jesua nɛ Bani nɛ Sieribaya nɛ Akub nɛ Siabetaae nɛ Hodaya nɛ Maaseya nɛ Kɛlita nɛ Azaria nɛ Jozabad nɛ Pelaya. 8Ba da karim Wina'am wada gbauŋ la, nie li pa'al nyain ka pa'ali li gbin ye nidib la gban'e ban karim si'el la gbin.
9Nehemaya onɛ an gɔmena la nɛ Ezra onɛ an maanmaan ka an onɛ pa'an wada la nɛ Levi dim banɛ da pa'annɛ ba ka ba gban'adi li gbin la, yʋ'ʋn daa yɛli ba ye, “Dabiskaŋa anɛ ti Zugsɔb Wina'am la mɛŋ dabisir linɛ an kasi, dinzug, da kummi bɛɛ kaasida.” Bɔzugɔ nidib la wʋsaa da wʋm ka ba karim wada la, ba da kaasidnɛ.
10Nehemaya da yɛl ye, “Kem maali sumalisim, dimi disʋma ka nuue bʋmmalisa ka tis banɛ pʋ mɔr la. Dabiskaŋa anɛ Zugsɔb la din, da maannɛ sʋnsa'aŋa bɔzugɔ, Zugsɔb la sumalisim aan ya paŋ.”
11Levi dim la da giligidi bɛlisid nidib la ka yɛti ba ye, “Aaɛn baanlimm ka zina anɛ kasi dabisiri tis Zugsɔb la, da maannɛ sʋnsa'aŋa.”
12Ka nidib la keŋ di ka nu, ka tisid banɛ pʋ mɔr diibi na di la, ka maal sumalisim bɔzugɔ ba yʋ'ʋn da gban'e pian'ad linɛ ka ba pa'ali ba la gbin.
13Dabiskanɛ paas ayi' la, yir kpɛɛmnam nɛ maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim da la'as Ezra onɛ pa'an wada la san'an na ye ba kɛlis wada la.
14 Ba da nyɛ wada gbauŋ la pʋʋgin ka Wina'am zi'el wada tis Moses ye Israel dim la anɛ ba bɛ sʋga ni nwadis ayɔpɔi malʋŋ la saŋa. 15Ka li lɛm pa'al ye, ba mɔɔlim labakaŋa ba tempʋʋs la wʋsa nɛ Jerusalem tempʋʋgin, ka ye, “Yim keŋ kʋkʋna teŋin nwaae olif tiis banɛ bɛ pɔɔdin nɛ mɔɔgin la wila mɔri kena, ka bɔ tutuud nɛ kpʋkparis nɛ tiis banɛ mɔr ma'asim wila mɔri kena maal sʋga wʋʋ lin sɔb si'em la.”
16Alazug ka nidib la da yii keŋ mɔr wila la lɛb na maal sʋga ba mɛŋ dɔɔd zugin nɛ ba za'asin nɛ Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir zakin la nɛ paalʋ zin'is linɛ bɛ Ku'om Za'anɔɔrin nɛ Efiram Za'anɔɔrin la. 17Banɛ da yi Babilon n lɛb na la wʋsa da maali ba mɛŋ sʋga bɛɛ ani. Din yi Nun biig Josua saŋa ti paae daakan la, Israel dim nan zi' maal di'ema wʋʋ daakan la. Ba sumalisim la da zu'oe nɛ hali.
18Dabisir wʋsa lin yi malʋŋ la pin'ilʋg daare ti paae li naar daar la, Ezra da karim Wina'am gbauŋ la. Ba da maal malʋŋ tiɛnr di'ema la nɛ daba ayɔpɔi, ka daba anii la daar ka ba wʋsa la'as zin'ig yinne nwɛnɛ wada la da zi'el si'em la.

english_text:
The People Confess Their Sins
1On the twenty-fourth day of the seventh month, the people of Israel went without eating, and they dressed in sackcloth and threw dirt on their heads to show their sorrow. 2They refused to let foreigners join them, as they met to confess their sins and the sins of their ancestors. 3For three hours they stood and listened to the Law of the Lord their God, and then for the next three hours they confessed their sins and worshiped the Lord.
4Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani stood on the special platform for the Levites and prayed aloud to the Lord their God. 5Then the Levites Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah said:
“Stand and shout praises
to your Lord,
the eternal God!
Praise his wonderful name,
though he is greater
than words can express.”
The People Pray
6You alone are the Lord,
Creator of the heavens
and all the stars,
Creator of the earth
and those who live on it,
Creator of the ocean
and all its creatures.
You are the source of life,
praised by the stars
that fill the heavens.
7 You are the Lord our God,
the one who chose Abram—
you brought him from Ur
in Babylonia
and named him Abraham.
8 Because he was faithful,
you made an agreement
to give his descendants
the land of the Canaanites
and Hittites,
of the Amorites and Perizzites,
and of the Jebusites
and Girgashites.
Now you have kept your promise,
just as you always do.
9 When our ancestors
were in Egypt,
you saw their suffering;
when they were at the Red Sea,
you heard their cry for help.
10 You knew that the King of Egypt
and his officials and his nation
had mistreated your people.
So you worked fearsome miracles
against the Egyptians
and earned a reputation
that still remains.
11 You divided the deep sea,
and your people walked through
on dry land.
But you tossed their enemies in,
and they sank down
like a heavy stone.
12 Each day you led your people
with a thick cloud,
and at night you showed the way
with a flaming fire.
13 At Sinai you came down
from heaven,
and you gave your people
good laws and teachings
that are fair and honest.
14You commanded them to respect
your holy Sabbath,
and you instructed
your servant Moses
to teach them your laws.
15 When they were hungry,
you sent bread from heaven,
and when they were thirsty,
you let water flow
from a rock.
Then you commanded them
to capture the land
that you had solemnly promised.
* 16 Our stubborn ancestors
refused to obey—
they forgot about the miracles
you had worked for them,
and they were determined
to return to Egypt
and become slaves again.
17 But, our God, you are merciful
and quick to forgive;
you are loving, kind,
and very patient.
So you never turned away
from them—
18 not even when they made
an idol shaped like a calf
and insulted you by claiming,
“This is the god who rescued us
from Egypt.”
19 Because of your great mercy,
you never abandoned them
in the desert.
And you always guided them
with a cloud by day
and a fire at night.
20Your gentle Spirit
instructed them,
and you gave them manna to eat
and water to drink.
21You took good care of them,
and for forty years
they never lacked a thing.
Their clothes didn't wear out,
and their feet were never swollen.
22 You let them conquer kings
and take their land,
including King Sihon of Heshbon
and King Og of Bashan.
23 You brought them into the land
that you had promised
their ancestors,
and you blessed their nation
with people that outnumbered
the stars in the sky.
24 Then their descendants
conquered the land.
You helped them defeat
the kings and nations
and treat their enemies
however they wished.
25 They captured strong cities
and rich farmland;
they took furnished houses,
as well as cisterns,
vineyards, olive orchards,
and numerous fruit trees.
They ate till they were satisfied,
and they celebrated
your abundant blessings.
26 In spite of this, they rebelled
and disobeyed your laws.
They killed your prophets,
who warned them
to turn back to you,
and they cursed your name.
27So you handed them over
to their enemies,
who treated them terribly.
But in their sufferings,
they begged you to help.
From heaven you listened
to their prayers
and because of your great mercy,
you sent leaders to rescue them.
28 But when they were at peace,
they would turn against you,
and you would hand them over
to their enemies.
Then they would beg for help,
and because you are merciful,
you rescued them
over and over again.
29 You warned them to turn back
and discover true life
by obeying your laws.
But they stubbornly refused
and continued to sin.
30 For years, you were patient,
and your Spirit warned them
with messages spoken
by your prophets.
Still they refused to listen,
and you handed them over
to their enemies.
31But you are merciful and kind,
and so you never forgot them
or let them be destroyed.
32 Our God, you are powerful,
fearsome, and faithful,
always true to your word.
So please keep in mind
the terrible sufferings
of our people, kings, leaders,
priests, and prophets,
from the time Assyria ruled
until this very day.
33You have always been fair
when you punished us
for our sins.
34Our kings and leaders,
our priests and ancestors
have never obeyed your commands
or heeded your warnings.
35You blessed them with a kingdom
and with an abundance
of rich, fertile land,
but they refused to worship you
or turn from their evil.
36Now we are slaves
in this fruitful land
you gave to our ancestors.
37Its plentiful harvest is taken
by kings you placed over us
because of our sins.
Our suffering is unbearable,
because they do as they wish
to us and our livestock.
The People Make an Agreement
38And so, a firm agreement was made that had the official approval of the leaders, the Levites, and priests.
translation_text:
Israel dim viigi ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi yɛl Wina'am
1Nwadkan la dabpisi nɛ anaasi daar Israel dim da la'asi lɔ nɔɔr ka yɛ bɔto fuud ka bugi ba zut nɛ titan ka li anɛ sʋnsa'aŋ malʋŋ. 2Israel dim banɛ da an Israel dim amɛŋa la da baki ba mɛŋ nɛ buudzʋna la. Ba da zi'enɛ ba zi'esa ni ka viigi ba mɛŋ nɛ ba yaanam tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi yɛl Wina'am. 3Ba da zi'en ban bɛ zin'isi'a la ka karimi ba Zugsɔb Wina'am wada gbauŋ la dabisir la pʋʋgin, ka viigi ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka wɔ'ɔgi ba Zugsɔb Wina'am la. 4Levi dim banɛ da zi'e ba zin'igin bimbim la zug la da anɛ Jesua nɛ Bani nɛ Kadmiel nɛ Siebanaya nɛ Buni nɛ Sieribaya nɛ Bani nɛ Kenani, ka ba da buoli ba Zugsɔb Wina'am la yʋ'ʋr nɛ kʋkɔtita'ar. 5Ka Jesua nɛ Kadmiel nɛ Bani nɛ Hasiabineya nɛ Sieribaya nɛ Hodaya nɛ Siebanaya nɛ Petahaya banɛ an Levi dim la da yɛl ye,
“Zi'enimi ka wɔ'ɔgi Zugsɔb onɛ aan ya Wina'am
ka vʋe saŋa linɛ ka' bɛn la.”
Ka nidib la wʋsa da yʋʋm yɛt ye,
“Albareka bɛ nɛ fʋ yʋ'ʋtita'ar linɛ nar girima,
ka gaad zʋn'or nɛ na'asi linɛ bɛ wʋsa la!
6Fʋn ma'aa an Zugsɔb,
fʋnɛ maal agɔl nɛ saŋgbauŋ nɛ nwadbibis banɛ bɛɛ li ni la,
ka maal teŋgbauŋ nɛ linɛ bɛɛ li ni wʋsa,
ka maal atɛuk nɛ linɛ bɛɛ li pʋʋgin wʋsa.
Fʋnɛ tisid si'el wʋsa nyɔvʋr,
ka bʋn linɛ bɛɛ agɔl la wʋsa zun'odif.
7 Fʋnɛ an Zugsɔb Wina'am kanɛ da gaŋ Abram
mɔr o yi Ur linɛ bɛ Kaldea teŋgbauŋʋn la na
ka pʋd o yʋ'ʋr ye Abraham.
8 On da pa'al ye o anɛ sida sɔb la,
fʋ da maal nɔnaar nɛ o.
Fʋ zi'el nɔɔr ye fʋ na nɔk Keenan dim teŋ la tis o yaas,
ka li anɛ Hitti dim nɛ Amor dim la din,
nɛ Perizi dim nɛ Jebus dim nɛ Girgas dim din la.
Fʋ pʋ tami fʋ kaanbʋg la, fʋ pʋpielim la zug.
9 Fʋn da nyɛɛ ti yaanam namisʋg Egipt teŋin la;
fʋ da wʋmi ba kaasig Atɛuk Zɛn'ugʋn la.
10Fʋ da maal zanbina nɛ nyalima nɛ kilima pa'al Faaro
nɛ o na'ayikpɛm nɛ teŋ la nidib wʋsa,
bɔzugɔ fʋ mi' Egipt dim la da dʋ'ʋsi ba mɛŋ
ka namisidi fʋ nidib la si'em.
Fʋ maal yʋ'ʋri tisi fʋ mɛŋ
ka li kpɛm bɛ hali nɛ zina.
11 Fʋ buak atɛuk ku'om, ka ba dɔl teŋ kpi'emisi lɔ'ɔŋ,
amaa ka fʋ lɛbis ku'om la pil banɛ kati ba la,
ka ba sim wʋʋ kugir nɛ.
12 Fʋ gaadi ba tuonnɛ an saŋgbauŋ nintaŋ
ka lɛn an nɛɛsim yʋ'ʋŋʋ nie tisi ba
pa'annɛ ba ban na dɔl suosi'a la.
13 Fʋ sig Sinai Zuor zug na.
Fʋ naam arezana ni ka pian' tisi ba.
Fʋ tisi ba zi'ela nɛ wada ka li an sʋm tisi ba
ka li an linɛ nar ka dɔl suor.
14Fʋ kɛya ka ba baŋi fʋ Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar la yɛla,
ka tis Moses zi'ela nɛ wada nɛ fʋ gban'ar wʋsa ye o tisi ba.
15 Kɔ'ɔm da mɔri ba ka fʋ kɛ ka diib yi arezana ni na ka ba di.
Ku'onuud da mɔri ba ka fʋ kɛ ka ku'om yi tampiingin na ka ba nu.
Fʋ yɛli ba ye ba kem sʋ'ʋg
teŋ kanɛ ka fʋ da pɔɔ zi'el ye fʋ na tisi ba la.
16 Amaa ti yaanam la da mɔr nyɛɛsim ka maal zukpi'euŋ
ka pʋ siaki fʋ nɔɔr zi'elʋgɔ.
17 Ba da zan'as ya ka pʋ kɛlisɛ,
ka tam tʋʋmnyalima banɛ ka fʋ da maali ba san'an la.
Ba da maal zukpi'euŋʋ zan'as ka gaŋ tuongat
bɔɔd ye ba lɛbi an yammis Egipt teŋin.
Amaa fʋ anɛ Wina'am kanɛ kɛt taali basid,
fʋ mɔr nimbaanlzɔɔr ka zɔti fʋ nidib nyɔɔg,
fʋ sʋnf pʋ duod tɔ'ɔtɔɔ ka fʋ nɔŋilim zu'oe,
dinzug ka fʋ pʋ basi baa,
18 hali baa ban da maal na'abil ba'ari tisi ba mɛŋ
ka yɛl ye, ‘Ya teŋgban onɛ mɔri ya yi Egipt na la nwa' la,’
bɛɛ ban da tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi san'ami fʋ yʋ'ʋr la.
19 Fʋ nimbaanlzɔɔri zu'oe la zug, fʋ da pʋ basi ba sian'arin la.
Nintaŋ wʋsa saŋgbauŋ la pʋ bɔdigid ka basidi baa,
bɛɛ nɛɛsim kanɛ pa'annɛ ba suor yʋ'ʋŋ la bɔdig ka kɛɛ baa.
20Fʋ da tisi fʋ Siig onɛ an sʋm la na ka o pa'annɛ ba ban na niŋ si'em.
Fʋ da pʋ mɔŋi ba fʋ diib linɛ yʋ'ʋri buon manna la,
ka ku'onuud ya'a mɔri ba saŋsi'a fʋ tisidi ba ku'om.
21Yʋma pisnaasi ka fʋ guri ba mɔɔgin,
si'el da pʋ pɔ'ɔgi ba,
ba fuud pʋ kpii ka ba nɔba mɛ pʋ mɔdɛ.
22 Fʋ kɛya ka ba nyaŋ na'anam nɛ buudi bɛdegʋ,
fʋ tisi ba teŋ la bɛn wʋsa.
Ba da faaɛn Hesbon na'ab Sihon teŋ
nɛ Basan na'ab Og teŋgbauŋ.
23 Fʋ kɛya ka ba biribis zu'oe nwɛnɛ nwadbibis banɛ bɛ saŋgbauŋin la,
ka mɔri ba keŋ kpɛn' teŋ la ni,
teŋ kanɛ ka fʋ da pɔɔ zi'eli ba yaanam ye ba sʋ'oe la ni.
24 Ba biis la da kpɛn' sʋ'ʋg teŋ la.
Fʋ da nyaŋ Keenan dim banɛ da dɛŋi bɛ teŋin la,
ka nɔk Keenan dim nɛ ba na'anam wʋsa niŋi ba nu'usin
nɛ nimbanɛ bɛ teŋin la ka ba da maali ba ban bɔɔd si'em.
25 Ba da faaɛn tɛɛns banɛ mɔr kpi'euŋ
nɛ zin'ibanɛ ka teŋ la mɔr kʋ'ʋlʋm la.
Ba da faaɛn ya' banɛ ka la'asʋma pɛ'ɛl la sʋ'ʋgi li,
nɛ bulis banɛ dɛŋi bɛɛ ani la,
nɛ vain tiis pɔɔd nɛ olif tiis,
ka tiis banɛ da wan la da ka' bɛnnɛ.
Ba da dii tig ka maal sumalisim
ka li anɛ yɛlsʋm kanɛ ka fʋ maali tisi ba la zug.
26 Amaa ba da pʋ siakɛ, ka zan'asi fʋ nɔɔr.
Ba da zan'asi fʋ wada la,
ka kʋʋ fʋ nɔdi'esidib banɛ da san'anɛ ba
ye ba lɛmmi fʋ san'an na la,
ka san'ami fʋ yʋ'ʋr hali.
27Ka fʋ nɔki ba niŋi ba bi'emnam nu'usin ka ba namisi ba.
Amaa ban da nyɛ namisʋg ka kaasi tisif la,
fʋ naam arezana ni wʋm.
Fʋ nimbaanlzɔɔri zu'oe hali la zug
fʋ da tʋm tuongatibi tisi ba na
ka ba faaɛn ba, ba bi'emnam la nu'usin.
28Amaa ban da nyɛ yɔlisim la ba da lɛn tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi fʋ tuon,
fʋ da basi ba tisi ba bi'emnam ka ba sʋ'oe ba.
Ban da lɛn kaasi tisif la ka fʋ bɛ arezana ni ka wʋm,
ka fʋn an nimbaanlzɔt la zug ka fʋ faandi ba saŋa wʋsa.
29 Fʋ sa'ali ba ye ba dɔlli fʋ wada la,
ka ba maal nyɛɛsim ka zan'asi fʋ nɔzi'ela.
Ba tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka zan'asi fʋ wada la
linɛ ka sɔ' ya'a siak ka li an vʋm tis o sɔb la.
Ba maal zukpi'euŋ ka bidif kʋdig,
ka pʋ kɛlisidif hali baa bi'elaa.
30 Yʋma bɛdegʋ ka fʋ mɔr sumbʋgʋsʋm nɛ ba.
Fʋ siig la ka fʋ nɔki dɔlisi fʋ nɔdi'esidib la ni sa'ali ba.
La'an nɛ wala ba pʋ kɛlisɛ,
ka fʋ nɔki ba niŋi ba kpi'es nu'usin.
31Amaa fʋ nimbaanlzɔɔri zu'oe la zug
ka fʋ pʋ basi ba ka li naae
bɛɛ fʋ tami ba yɛla,
fʋn an pʋpiel nɛ nimbaanlzɔɔr Wina'am la zug.
32 Oo ti Wina'am, fʋ anɛ Wina'am tita'ar
ka mɔr kpi'euŋ ka an onɛ ka ba zɔt!
Fʋ dɔlli fʋ nɔŋilim nɔnaar la.
Da kɛ ka namisʋg linɛ kɛɛn ti zugin na la an zaalim tisi fɔ;
namisʋg linɛ paae tinam nɛ ti na'anam nɛ tuongatib,
nɛ ti maanmaannib nɛ nɔdi'esidib la wʋsa,
namisʋg kanɛ da paae ti yaanam nɛ fʋ nidib la,
lin yi Asiria na'anam saŋa ti paae zina.
33Bʋn linɛ maali ti la wʋsa, fʋn nan kpɛn anɛ sida sɔb.
Fʋn tʋm si'em la da anɛ sida
ka tinam din lɛɛ pʋ dɔl suorɛ.
34Ti na'anam nɛ ti tuongatib nɛ ti maanmaannib la
nɛ ti yaanam la wʋsa pʋ dɔlli fʋ wada la,
ba pʋ kɛlisi fʋ nɔzi'ela
bɛɛ nimmua sa'al kanɛ ka fʋ sa'ali ba la.
35Hali la'an nɛ ban da sʋ'oe ba na'am la
ka dit yɛlsʋm kanɛ ka fʋ tisi ba la
ka bɛ teŋ kanɛ yalim ka mɔr kʋ'ʋlʋm la,
ba pʋ na'asif bɛɛ fɛndig ka basi ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la.
36Amaa gɔsima, ti anɛ yammis nannanna
bɛ teŋ kanɛ ka fʋ tisi ti yaanam
ye ba di teŋ la nyɔɔd nɛ bʋnsʋŋ kanɛ bɛ teŋin la wʋsa.
37Ti tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la zug ka fʋ kɛ ka Na'abama sʋ'oe tinam
nɛ ti bʋnkɔnbid,
ka maannɛ ti ban bɔɔd si'em,
ka ti yʋ'ʋn bɛ namisʋg pʋʋgin la.”
Nidib la maal nɔnaar ka sɔbi digil
38Ka Israel dim la da lɛn yɛl ye, “Nɛ'ɛnam wʋsa zug, ti na maal nɔnaar, ka sɔbi li ka ti tuongatib nɛ Levi dim nɛ maanmaannib la tiki ba nu'us.”

english_text:
1As governor, I signed the agreement together with Zedekiah and the following priests: 2-8Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah, Pashhur, Amariah, Malchijah, Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch, Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah, Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch, Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin, Maaziah, Bilgai, and Shemaiah.
9The Levites who signed were: Jeshua son of Azaniah, Binnui from the clan of Henadad, Kadmiel, 10Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan, 11Mica, Rehob, Hashabiah, 12Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah, 13Hodiah, Bani, and Beninu.
14The leaders who signed were: Parosh, Pahath Moab, Elam, Zattu, Bani, 15Bunni, Azgad, Bebai, 16Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin, 17Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur, 18Hodiah, Hashum, Bezai, 19Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai, 20Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir, 21Meshezabel, Zadok, Jaddua, 22Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah, 23Hoshea, Hananiah, Hasshub, 24Hallohesh, Pilha, Shobek, 25Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah, 26Ahiah, Hanan, Anan, 27Malluch, Harim, and Baanah.
The Agreement
28-29All of us, including priests, Levites, temple guards, singers, temple workers and leaders, together with our wives and children, have separated ourselves from the foreigners in this land and now enter into an agreement with a complete understanding of what we are doing. And so, we now place ourselves under the curse of the Lord our God, if we fail to obey his laws and teachings that were given to us by his servant Moses.
30 We won't let our sons and daughters marry foreigners.
31 We won't buy goods or grain on the Sabbath or on any other sacred day, not even from foreigners.
Every seven years we will let our fields rest, and we will cancel all debts.
32 Once a year we will each donate a small amount of silver to the temple of our God. 33This is to pay for the sacred bread, as well as for the daily sacrifices and special sacrifices such as those offered on the Sabbath and during the New Moon Festival and the other festivals. It will also pay for the sacrifices to forgive our sins and for all expenses connected with the worship of God in the temple.
34We have decided that the families of priests, Levites, and ordinary people will supply firewood for the temple each year, so that sacrifices can be offered on the altar, just as the Lord our God has commanded.
35 Each year we will bring to the temple the first part of our harvest of grain and fruit.
36 We will bring our first-born sons and the first-born males of our herds and flocks and offer them to the priests who serve in the temple, because this is what is written in God's Law.
37 To the priests in the temple of our God, we will bring the bread dough from the first harvest, together with our best fruit, and an offering of new wine and olive oil.
We will bring ten percent of our grain harvest to those Levites who are responsible for collecting it in our towns. 38 A priest from the family of Aaron must be there when we give this to the Levites. Then the Levites will put one tenth of this part in the temple storeroom, 39which is also the place for the sacred objects used by the priests, the temple guards, and the singers.
Levites and everyone else must bring their gifts of grain, wine, and olive oil to this room.
We will not neglect the temple of our God.

28-29Tinam nimbanɛ kpɛlim an maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim nɛ banɛ gur Pʋ'ʋsim Yir za'anɔɔr nɛ yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib nɛ Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yir tʋmtʋmnib nɛ banɛ baki ba mɛŋ nɛ nimbanɛ aan ba kpi'es Wina'am wada la zug la, ban nɛ ba pu'ab nɛ biribis nɛ ba bipumis banɛ na nyaŋi gban'e pian'ad gbin la. Ti wʋsa la'as taaba gban'e nɔɔr yinne pɔ nɔɔri zi'el ye,
Ti na dɔl Wina'am wada linɛ ka o tʋmtʋm Moses da tisi ti la, ye ti siak ka gu'usid ka dɔl Zugsɔb gban'ar nɛ o zi'ela la wʋsa.
30 Ti kaanbi zi'el ye ti kʋ nɔki ti bipumisi tis buudbanɛ kpi'e nɛ ti la ka ba dii ba bɛɛ li'a ba bipumisi tisi ti biribis ka ba dii ba.
31 Nidib banɛ kpi'e nɛ ti la ya'a mɔr la'ad bɛɛ diibi kena ye ba kuosi tisi ti Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar bɛɛ dabisa banɛ an kasi la ni, ti kʋ da'.
Yʋʋm kanɛ paas ayɔpɔi wʋsa ti kʋ kuaa ti pɔɔd la, ka onɛ dii ti sam wʋsa ti kʋ lɛn di'e.
32-33Ti gban'e ye yʋʋm wʋsa ti na tis anzurifa bi'ela ka li sʋŋ Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir tʋʋma, linɛ an: Bodobodo kanɛ ka ba pa'an teebul zugʋ tisid Zugsɔb la, nɛ daar wʋsa zʋʋd maan la nɛ daar wʋsa maan kanɛ nyu'od nɛ bugum la nɛ Vʋ'ʋsʋm Dabisa malima maan la nɛ Nwadpaalig di'ema tiɛnr maan nɛ malima banɛ ka ba gban'e li yɛla zi'el la nɛ kasi malima la nɛ Israel tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd suguru sɔsʋg maan nɛ tʋʋma linɛ kpɛlim tis Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la wʋsa.
34Tinam banɛ an maanmaannib la nɛ Levi dim nɛ nidib la maal bʋgʋlʋm-bʋgʋlʋm ye ti baŋ saŋa kanɛ ka yir wʋsa na la'asid daad saŋa kanɛ nar yʋʋm wʋsa pʋʋgin linɛ ka ba na nyu'od maan daka la zug, ti Zugsɔb Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la nwɛnɛ lin sɔb wada gbauŋʋn si'em la.
35 Ti mɛ lɛm gban'e ye yʋʋm wʋsa ti na mɔr zʋʋd linɛ an bʋndɛɛŋ wʋsa nɛ tiis wala kɛn Zugsɔb Yin la na.
36 Nwɛnɛ lin sɔb wada la ni si'em la, ti na mɔri ti bikpɛŋ wʋsa, nɛ niigi nɛ kɔnbdɛɛna kɛn Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin na tis maanmaan kanɛ tʋm Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir tʋʋma la.
37 Linɛ lɛm paas, ti na mɔr ki linɛ ka ti bʋn yiiga la zɔ'ɔm kɛn Pʋ'ʋsim Yin na tis maanmaan la, nɛ ti zʋʋd piini, nɛ tiis wala nɛ daam nɛ kpaam linɛ an yiiga la. Ti mɛ na mɔri ti zʋʋd la pʋʋr piiga wʋsa kena tis Levi dim la, bɔzugɔ, li anɛ Levi dim la di'esidi ti pʋʋr piiga la'ad tinamɛ tʋm teŋ si'a ni wʋsa, 38 ka ba ya'a ti ye ba di'e la'ad la, Aaron yaaŋ kanɛ an maanmaan la na dɔlli ba keŋ. Levi dim la na di'e la'ad la yisi ba pʋʋr piiga mɔri keŋ Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yinnɛ kpɛn'ɛsi li la'ad dɔɔdin la su'a. 39Israel nidib nɛ Levi dim la wʋsa na mɔri ba zʋʋd nɛ daam nɛ kpaam piini la na kpɛn'ɛs la'ad dɔɔdin la, zin'ikanɛ ka Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la'ad bɛ la, nɛ maanmaannib la nɛ banɛ gur za'anɔɔr la nɛ yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib la bɛ si'el la.
Ti kʋ bas bɛɛ tam Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la yɛla baa bi'elaa.

english_text:
People Who Settled in Jerusalem
1The nation's leaders and their families settled in Jerusalem. But there was room for only one out of every ten of the remaining families, and so they asked God to show them who would live there. 2Then everyone else asked God to bless those who were willing to live in Jerusalem.
3 Some of the people of Israel, the priests, the Levites, the temple workers, and the descendants of Solomon's servants lived on their own property in the towns of Judah. But the leaders of the province lived in Jerusalem with their families.
The Judah Tribe
4-6From the Judah tribe, two leaders settled in Jerusalem with their relatives. One of them was Athaiah son of Uzziah. His ancestors were Zechariah, Amariah, Shephatiah, Mahalalel, and Perez, the son of Judah. From the descendants of Perez, 468 of the best men lived in Jerusalem.
The other leader from Judah was Maaseiah the son of Baruch. His ancestors were Colhozeh, Hazaiah, Adaiah, Joiarib, Zechariah, and Shelah, the son of Judah.
The Benjamin Tribe
7-8From the Benjamin tribe, three leaders settled in Jerusalem. The first was Sallu son of Meshullam, and the others were Gabbai and Sallai. Sallu's ancestors were Joed, Pedaiah, Kolaiah, Maaseiah, Ithiel, and Jeshaiah. Altogether, there were 928 men of the Benjamin tribe living in Jerusalem. 9Joel son of Zichri was their leader, and Judah son of Hassenuah was second in command.
Priests
10Four priests settled in Jerusalem. The first was Jedaiah; he was the son of Joiarib and the uncle of Jachin.
11The second priest to settle there was Seraiah son of Hilkiah. His ancestors were Meshullam, Zadok, Meraioth, and Ahitub, who had been a high priest. 12Altogether, there were 822 from his clan who served in the temple.
The third priest to settle there was Adaiah son of Jeroham. His ancestors were Pelaliah, Amzi, Zechariah, Pashhur, and Malchijah. 13Altogether, there were 242 clan leaders among his relatives.
The fourth priest to settle there was Amashsai son of Azarel. His ancestors were Ahzai, Meshillemoth, and Immer. 14Altogether, there were 128 brave warriors from their clans, and their leader was Zabdiel son of Haggedolim.
Levites
15Several Levites settled in Jerusalem. First, there was Shemaiah son of Hasshub. His ancestors were Azrikam, Hashabiah, and Bunni.
16Next, there were Shabbethai and Jozabad, the Levite leaders in charge of the work outside the temple.
17Then there was Mattaniah son of Mica. His ancestors were Zabdi and Asaph. Mattaniah led the temple choir in the prayer of praise. Bakbukiah, who also settled in Jerusalem, was his assistant.
Finally, there was Abda son of Shammua; his grandfather was Galal, and his great-grandfather was Jeduthun.
18Altogether, 284 Levites settled in the holy city.
Temple Guards and Others
19One hundred seventy-two temple guards settled in Jerusalem; their leaders were Akkub and Talmon.
20The rest of the Israelites, including priests and Levites, lived on their own property in the other towns of Judah. 21But the temple workers lived in the section of Jerusalem known as Ophel, and the two men in charge of them were Ziha and Gishpa.
22Uzzi son of Bani was the leader of the Levites in Jerusalem. His grandfather was Hashabiah, his great-grandfather was Mattaniah, and his great-great-grandfather was Mica. He belonged to the Asaph clan that was in charge of the music for the temple services, 23though the daily choice of music and musicians was decided by royal decree of the Persian king.
24The people of Israel were represented at the Persian court by Pethahiah son of Meshezabel from the Zerah clan of the Judah tribe.
The People in the Other Towns and Villages
25Some of the people of Judah lived in the following towns near their farms: Kiriath-Arba, Dibon, Jekabzeel, 26Jeshua, Moladah, Beth-Pelet, 27Hazar-Shual, Beersheba, 28Ziklag, Meconah, 29Enrimmon, Zorah, Jarmuth, 30Zanoah, Adullam, Lachish, and Azekah. In fact, they settled the towns from Beersheba in the south to Hinnom Valley in the north.
31The people of Benjamin lived in the towns of Geba, Michmash, Aija, Bethel with its nearby villages, 32Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah, 33Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim, 34Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat, 35Lod, and Ono, as well as in Craft Valley. 36Several groups of Levites from the territory of Judah were sent to live among the people of Benjamin.
translation_text:
Nidib banɛ zin'in Jerusalem la yɛla
1Nidib la tuongatib da zin'in Jerusalem, ka banɛ kpɛlim la mɛ da bʋgʋlʋm gaŋ nid yinne nidib piiga wʋsa pʋʋgin, ye o kem zin'in Jerusalem tempʋkanɛ an Zugsɔb la din ka an kasi la ni, ka banɛ kpɛlim la zin'ini ba mɛŋ tɛɛnsin. 2Nidib la da faas banɛ wʋsa siak ye ba na lɛbi zin'in Jerusalem la. 3 Banɛ da an sʋ'ʋlimnam la tuongatib sieba da lɛbi zin'in Jerusalem teŋin la. Israel dim la sieba mɛ da lɛbi zin'in Juda tɛɛnsin, sɔ' wʋsa nɛ o mɛŋ paalʋ, tɛɛns la ni. Ba da anɛ maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim nɛ Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir tʋmtʋmnib nɛ Solomon yammis yaas la. 4Ka ninsieba banɛ an Juda nɛ Benjamin sʋ'ʋlimin la yaas da zin'in Jerusalem tempʋʋgin.
Juda yaas la da anɛ:
Uzia biig Ataya onɛ yaanamɛ da an Zakaria nɛ Amaraya nɛ Sefatia nɛ Mahalaleel onɛ da an Perez yaaŋ la,
5Baruk biig Maaseya onɛ yaanamɛ da an Kol-Hose nɛ Hazaya nɛ Adaya nɛ Joirarib nɛ Zakaria onɛ da an Sela yaaŋ la.
6Perez yaas banɛ da bɛ Jerusalem ka an nintitada la wʋsa da anɛ nidib kɔbisnaasi nɛ pisyuobʋ nɛ anii (468).
7Benjamin yaas la da anɛ:
Mesulam biig Salu onɛ yaanamɛ da an Joed nɛ Pedaya nɛ Kolaya nɛ Maaseya nɛ Itiel nɛ Jesaya 8nɛ o nya'andɔlib Gabbai nɛ Sallai, ba dap da anɛ kɔbiswai nɛ pisi nɛ anii (928). 9Zikir biig Joel da anɛ ba tuongat ka Hasenua biig Juda da sʋ'oe tempʋʋg sʋ'ʋlim kanɛ tia'al ayi' la.
10Maanmaannib la da anɛ:
Jedaya onɛ an Joyaarib biig la nɛ Jakin. 11Banɛ paas anɛ Hilkia biig Seraya onɛ yaanamɛ da an Mesulam nɛ Zadok nɛ Merayof nɛ Ahitub onɛ da gɔsid Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la 12nɛ ba taaba banɛ da tʋm Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir tʋʋma la. Ba da anɛ dap kɔbisnii nɛ pisi nɛ ayi' (822).
Ba sieba anɛ Jeroham biig Adaya onɛ yaanamɛ da an Pelalaya nɛ Amzi nɛ Zakaria nɛ Pasur nɛ Malkija, 13nɛ ba taaba banɛ da an yisɔbnam la, ba da anɛ dap kɔbisyi' nɛ pisnaasi nɛ ayi' (242);
Azarel biig Amasisai onɛ yaanamɛ da an Ahizai nɛ Mesielemof nɛ Imer, 14nɛ ba taaba banɛ da an nintitada la da anɛ kɔbiga nɛ pisi nɛ anii (128).
Ba kpɛɛm da anɛ Zabdiel onɛ an Hagedolim biig la.
15Levi dim la da anɛ:
Hasueb biig Semaya onɛ yaanamɛ da an Azirikam nɛ Hasiabiya nɛ Buni;
16Siabetaae nɛ Jozabad banɛ da an Levi dɔɔg kpɛɛmnam la da gɔsid Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la yiŋ tʋʋma;
17Matanaya onɛ saamme an Maika ka on Saam mɛ an Zabdi ka on saam mɛ an Asaf la da an kpɛɛm onɛ gat tuon winsɔsʋg nɛ bareka pʋ'ʋsim saŋa la,
Bakbukia da dɔl o nya'aŋ nɛ Sammua biig Abida onɛ yaanamɛ da an Galal nɛ Jedutun.
18Levi dim banɛ da bɛ tempʋkanɛ an Zugsɔb din la da la'asi anɛ kɔbisyi' nɛ pisnii nɛ anaasi (284).
19Za'anɔgu'udib la da anɛ:
Akub nɛ Talimon nɛ ba taaba.
Banɛ da zin' gɔsid za'anɔɔr la da anɛ dap kɔbiga nɛ pisyɔpɔi nɛ ayi' (172).
20Israel dim banɛ kpɛlim la, nɛ maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim la, da bɛ nɛ Juda tempʋʋs la wʋsa ni, sɔ' wʋsa da zin'inɛ o yaab paalʋ ni. 21Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir tʋmtʋmnib la da bɛ nɛ Ofel zuorin: Ziha nɛ Gisipa da aan ba tuongatib.
22Levi dim banɛ da bɛ Jerusalem tempʋʋgin la tuongat da anɛ Bani biig Uzi onɛ yaanamɛ da an Hasiabiya nɛ Matanaya nɛ Maika. Uzi da anɛ Asaf tuŋ nid, banɛ da an yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib la ka da gɔsid Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir tʋʋma la. 23Na'ab la da tis nɔɔr ban na tʋm si'em dabisir wʋsa pʋʋgin.
24Mesiezabɛl biig Petahaya, onɛ yaabi da an Zera onɛ da an Juda mɛŋ biig la da bɛ Na'ab la tuon nidib la wʋsa sʋʋgin.
25Ya'a kpɛlim nɛ teŋkpɛmis nɛ li paalʋ la, Juda nidib la da zin'inɛ Kiriaf Ariba nɛ zin'ibanɛ giligi li la, Dibon nɛ zin'ibanɛ giligi li la, nɛ Jekabzeel nɛ li tembibis. 26Ka ba da lɛn zin'inɛ Jesua nɛ Molada nɛ Befipelet 27nɛ Hazar Sual nɛ Beerseba nɛ li tembibis, 28nɛ Ziklag nɛ Mekona nɛ li tembibis. 29Ba sieba mɛ da bɛ Ɛɛn Rimmon nɛ Zora nɛ Jarimuf, 30Zanoak nɛ Adullam nɛ ba teŋkpɛmis nɛ Lakis nɛ li paalʋ la wʋsa nɛ Azeka nɛ li tembibis.
Ala ka ba da zin'in lin yi Beerseba mɔri paae Ben Hinnom Bɔn'ɔgin la.
31Benjamin yaas la da zin'inɛ ba mɛŋ tɛɛnsin Geba nɛ Mikmas nɛ Aija nɛ Betel nɛ tɛɛns banɛ gilig la, 32nɛ Anatof nɛ Nob nɛ Ananaya 33nɛ Hazo nɛ Rama nɛ Gitam 34nɛ Hadid nɛ Zeboim nɛ Neballat 35nɛ Lod nɛ Ono nɛ Ge-Haharasim. 36Levi dim banɛ bɛ Juda la sieba mɛ da zin'inɛ Benjamin teŋin.

english_text:
A List of Priests and Levites
1Many priests and Levites had returned from Babylonia with Zerubbabel and Joshua as their leaders. Those priests were Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra, 2Amariah, Malluch, Hattush, 3Shecaniah, Rehum, Meremoth, 4Iddo, Ginnethoi, Abijah, 5Mijamin, Maadiah, Bilgah, 6Shemaiah, Joiarib, Jedaiah, 7Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, and another Jedaiah. These were the leading priests and their assistants during the time of Joshua.
8The Levites who returned were Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah. They and their assistants were responsible for the songs of praise, 9while Bakbukiah and Unno, together with their assistants, were responsible for the choral responses.
Descendants of Joshua the High Priest
10Joshua was the father of Joiakim, the grandfather of Eliashib, and the great-grandfather of Joiada. 11Joiada was the father of Jonathan and the grandfather of Jaddua.
Leaders of the Priestly Clans
12When Joiakim was high priest, the following priests were leaders of their clans: Meraiah of the Seraiah clan, Hananiah of Jeremiah, 13Meshullam of Ezra, Jehohanan of Amariah, 14Jonathan of Malluchi, Joseph of Shebaniah, 15Adna of Harim, Helkai of Meraioth, 16Zechariah of Iddo, Meshullam of Ginnethon, 17Zichri of Abijah, Piltai of Moadiah, 18Shammua of Bilgah, Jehonathan of Shemaiah, 19Mattenai of Joiarib, Uzzi of Jedaiah, 20Kallai of Sallai, Eber of Amok, 21Hashabiah of Hilkiah, and Nethanel of Jedaiah.
The Priestly and Levite Families
22During the time of the high priests Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, and Jaddua, and including the time that Darius was king of Persia, a record was kept of the heads of the Levite and priestly families. 23However, no official record was kept of the heads of the Levite clans after the death of Johanan, the grandson of Eliashib.
24Hashabiah, Sherebiah, Jeshua son of Kadmiel, and their assistants organized two choirs of Levites to offer praises to God, just as King David, the man of God, had commanded.
25Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, and Akkub were responsible for guarding the storerooms near the temple gates.
26All of these men lived during the time of Joiakim and during the time that I was governor and Ezra, a teacher of the Law of Moses, was priest.
Nehemiah Dedicates the City Wall
27When the city wall was dedicated, Levites from everywhere in Judah were invited to join in the celebration with songs of praise and with the music of cymbals, small harps, and other stringed instruments. 28-29The Levite singers lived in villages around Jerusalem, and so they came from there, as well as from the villages around Netophah, Beth-Gilgal, Geba, and Azmaveth. 30The priests and Levites held special ceremonies to make themselves holy, and then they did the same for the rest of the people and for the gates and walls of the city.
31I brought the leaders of Judah to the top of the city wall and put them in charge of the two groups that were to march around on top of the wall, singing praises to God. One group marched to the right in the direction of Garbage Gate. 32Hoshaiah and half of the leaders followed them. 33Then came the priests Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam, 34Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, and Jeremiah, 35all of them blowing trumpets. Next, there was Zechariah of the Asaph clan 36and his relatives, Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah, and Hanani. They played musical instruments like those that had been played by David, the man of God. And they marched behind Ezra, the teacher of the Law. 37When they reached Fountain Gate, they climbed the steps to David's City and went past his palace, before stopping at the Water Gate near the eastern wall of the city.
38The second group of singers marched along the wall in the opposite direction, and I followed them, together with the other half of the leaders of Judah. We went past Oven Tower, Broad Wall, 39Ephraim Gate, Old Gate, Fish Gate, Hananel Tower, Hundred Tower, and on to Sheep Gate. Finally, we stopped at Gate of the Guard, 40where we stood in front of the temple with the other group, praising God. In the group with me were half of the leaders, 41as well as the priests Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, who were blowing trumpets. 42Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malchijah, Elam, and Ezer also stood there, as Jezrahiah led the singers. 43God had made the people very happy, and so on that day they celebrated and offered many sacrifices. The women and children joined in the festivities, and joyful shouts could be heard far from the city of Jerusalem.
Preparation for Worship
44On that same day, some leaders were appointed to be responsible for the safekeeping of gifts for the temple and to be in charge of receiving the first part of the harvest and the ten percent of the crops and livestock that was offered to God. These same leaders also collected the part of crops that the Law of Moses taught was to be given to the Levites.
Everyone was pleased with the work of the priests and Levites, 45 when they performed the ceremonies to make people acceptable to worship God. And the singers and the temple guards did their jobs according to the instructions given by David and his son Solomon. 46In fact, ever since the days of David and Asaph, there had been song leaders and songs of praise and worship. 47During the time that Zerubbabel and I were in charge, everyone in Israel gave what they were supposed to give for the daily needs of the singers and temple guards from the Levi tribe. Then the Levites would give the priests their share from what they had received.
translation_text:
Maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim
1Bama an maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim banɛ da dɔl Sealtiel biig Zerubabɛl nɛ Jesua lɛb na la: Seraya nɛ Jeremia nɛ Ezra 2nɛ Amaraya nɛ Maluk nɛ Hatus 3nɛ Siekania nɛ Rehum nɛ Meremof nɛ 4Iddo nɛ Ginɛton nɛ Abija 5nɛ Mijamin nɛ Moadia nɛ Bilga 6nɛ Semaya nɛ Joyaarib nɛ Jedaya 7nɛ Salu nɛ Amok nɛ Hilkia nɛ Jedaya.
Bama da an maanmaannib la tuongatib nɛ ba taaba Jesua saŋa la.
8Levi dim la da anɛ: Jesua nɛ Binnu nɛ Kadmiel nɛ Sieribaya nɛ Juda nɛ Mattania, on nɛ o taaba da sʋ'oe bareka pʋ'ʋsim yʋʋma. 9Ka Bakbukia nɛ Uni nɛ ba taaba da zi'e kpa' ba pʋ'ʋsim zin'igin la.
10Josua tuŋ dimi nwa', Josua biig da anɛ Joyakim ka on biig da anɛ Eliyaasib; Eliyaasib mɛ biig da anɛ Joyada. 11Joyada biig da anɛ Jonatan ka on biig mɛ da an Jadua.
12Joyakim saŋa la, bama da an maanmaannib la yir kpɛɛmnam: Meraya da an Seraya yir kpɛɛm ka Hanania an Jeremia yir kpɛɛm 13ka Mesulam an Ezra yir kpɛɛm ka Jehohanan an Amaraya yir kpɛɛm 14ka Jonatan an Maluk yir kpɛɛm ka Josef an Siekania yir kpɛɛm 15ka Adina an Harim yir kpɛɛm ka Helika an Meremof yir kpɛɛm 16ka Zakaria an Iddo yir kpɛɛm ka Mesulam an Ginɛton yir kpɛɛm 17ka Zikir an Abija yir kpɛɛm ka Piltai an Miniamin nɛ Moadia ya kpɛɛmnam; 18ka Sammua da an Bilga yir kpɛɛm ka Semaya an Jehonatan yir kpɛɛm 19ka Matena an Joyaarib yir kpɛɛm ka Uzi an Jedaya yir kpɛɛm 20ka Kalla an Salu yir kpɛɛm ka Ebɛr an Amok yir kpɛɛm 21ka Hasiabiya an Hilkia yir kpɛɛm ka Netanɛl an Jedaya yir kpɛɛm.
22Pesia Na'ab Darius saŋa ka ba da sɔb Levi dim la kpɛɛmnam yʋda, banɛ da bɛ Eliyaasib nɛ Joyada nɛ Johanan nɛ Jadua saŋa la. 23Levi dim la kpɛɛmnam la, lin pin'ili ba yaanam la ti paae Eliyaasib biig Johanan saŋa la, ba sɔbi ba yʋda kpɛn'ɛs yaanam gbana la ni. 24Levi dim la tuongatib da anɛ Hasiabiya nɛ Sieribaya nɛ Kadmiel biig Jesua nɛ ba taaba banɛ zi'e kpa' ban dʋ'ʋsid Wina'am ka tisid o bareka di'esid taaba nwɛnɛ Na'ab David onɛ da an Wina'am nid la da zi'el si'em la.
25Mattania nɛ Bakbukia nɛ Obadia nɛ Mesulam nɛ Talimon nɛ Akub da anɛ banɛ gur za'anɔya; ba da gur la'ad dɔɔd banɛ bɛ Pʋ'ʋsim Yir za'anɔya ni la. 26Ba da tʋm nɛ saŋa kanɛ ka Joyakim onɛ saamme da an Jesua ka o yaab an Jozadak la, saŋkan ka Nehemaya onɛ an Gɔmena nɛ Ezra onɛ da an maanmaan nɛ gbauŋ sɔbid la da bɛ la.
Jerusalem zaŋguom pɛsigir
27Ban da ye ba pɛsig Jerusalem zaŋguom saŋsi'a la, ba da buol Levi dim la ban bɛ zin'isi'a wʋsa la'asi ba Jerusalem na ka ba maal sumalisim ka yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma tis Wina'am bareka pʋ'ʋsim, ka nwɛ'ɛd bʋnnwɛ'ɛda di'em zaŋguom la pɛsigir zug. 28Ba mɛ da mɔr yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib la yi tembibis banɛ kpi'e Jerusalem la, nɛ Netofa dim tɛɛnsin, 29nɛ Bet Gilgal nɛ zin'ibanɛ bɛ Geba nɛ Azmavef la. Yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib la da mɛɛ ba mɛŋ temkpɛmisi gilig Jerusalem. 30Maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim la maali ba mɛŋ kasi naae la, ba yʋ'ʋn maal nidib la nɛ za'anɔya nɛ tempʋʋg la zaŋguoma la kasi mɛn.
31Man Nehemaya da kɛ ka Juda tuongatib la dʋ zaŋguom la zugin, ka m da la'as yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib la bɛdegʋ zin'is ayi' ye ba yʋ'ʋm pʋ'ʋs Wina'am bareka.
Ka banɛ yʋ'ʋm la, zin'ig yinne dʋ zaŋguom la zugin ye ba dɔl ya-dagɔbʋgʋ kpa'ad Na'ambin Za'anɔɔr la baba. 32Banɛ da dɔlli ba da anɛ Hosaya nɛ Juda tuongatib la pʋsʋk, 33nɛ Azaria nɛ Ezra nɛ Mesulam 34nɛ Juda, Benjamin nɛ Semaya nɛ Jeremia, 35la'an nɛ maanmaannib sieba nɛ banɛ piebid na'atana; nɛ Zakaria onɛ saamme an Jonatan ka on saam an Semaya ka on saam an Matanaya ka on saam an Mikaya ka on saam an Zakur ka on saam an Asaf, 36nɛ o taaba Semaya nɛ Azarel nɛ Milala nɛ Gilala nɛ Maai nɛ Netanɛl nɛ Juda nɛ Hanani ka ba mɔr bʋnnwɛ'ɛda wʋʋ David onɛ an Wina'am nid la da pa'al si'em la. Ban da ken la Ezra onɛ an gbauŋmi'id la da anɛ ba tuongat. 37Ka ba yi Bulig Za'anɔɔrin la, ka dɔlisi dʋʋ kpa' David tempʋʋgin la dʋt David yir zaŋguom la zugin gaadi paad Ku'om Za'anɔɔr linɛ bɛ ya-nya'aŋ la.
38Yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib banɛ kpɛlim la mɛ da fɛndigi lɛbid ya-datiuŋ, ka mam mɛŋ mɔr nidib la pʋsʋkʋ dɔlli ba dʋ zaŋguom la zugin keŋ dɔl Seneb Girimbisa la ti paae Zaŋguom yalʋŋ la. 39Ka ti yii ani keŋ tʋʋg Efiram Za'anɔɔr zugin, linɛ ka ba buon Jesiana Za'anɔɔr bɛɛ Za'anɔkʋdʋg la, nɛ Zimi Za'anɔɔr la, nɛ Hananɛl Girimbisa, nɛ Kɔbiga Girimbisa la ni, mɔri ala keŋ paae Pɛ'ɛs Za'anɔɔrin la, hali ti paae Teŋgu'udib Za'anɔɔrini zi'e ani. 40Yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib zin'is ayi' banɛ yʋ'ʋm pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am bareka la yʋ'ʋn da paae Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la ka keŋ zi'e ba zi'esa ni, ka mam nɛ kpɛɛmnam la pʋsʋk mɛ zi'e ti zi'esa ni, 41tinam nɛ maanmaannib la Eliakim nɛ Maaseya nɛ Minyamin nɛ Mikaya nɛ Eloanai nɛ Zakaria nɛ Hanania nɛ ba na'atana. 42Banɛ paas da anɛ; Maaseya nɛ Semaya nɛ Eleazar nɛ Uzi, Jehohanan nɛ Malkija nɛ Elam nɛ Ezer. Jezrahaya da gaad yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib la tuonnɛ pa'annɛ ba ka ba yʋ'ʋm agɔla gɔla. 43Daakan la ka ba maal maana bɛdegʋ, ka maal sumalisim bɔzugɔ Wina'am tisi ba sumalistita'ar. Ka pu'ab nɛ biis mɛ maan sumalisim. Ka sumalisim tʋkpiidʋg kanɛ ka ba da maan Jerusalem tempʋʋgin la wʋm lallisa.
44Saŋkan la ka ba gaans nimbanɛ na gur la'ad dɔɔd la. La'ad la anɛ zʋʋd linɛ ka ba bʋn yiiga la nɛ ba pʋʋr piiga la'asʋg. Pɔɔd banɛ giligi ba tempʋʋs la wʋsa anɛ ba mɔri ba la'adi kena wʋʋ wada la zi'el si'em ye ba tis maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim la bɔzugɔ, maanmaannib la nɛ Levi dim tʋʋma da paae Juda dim ya'am hali. 45 Ba da tʋmmi ba Wina'am la tʋʋma ka maannɛ ba mɛŋ ka an kasi nyain, ka yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib la nɛ banɛ gur za'anɔɔr la mɛ tʋm ala nwɛnɛ Na'ab David nɛ o biig Na'ab Solomon n da zi'el si'em la. 46Yʋma banɛ da gaad la sa, Na'ab David nɛ Asaf saŋa la, ba da mɔr kpɛɛmnam banɛ sʋ'oe yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib la nɛ yʋʋma linɛ zun'od Wina'am, nɛ bareka pʋ'ʋsim. 47Alazugɔ Zerubabɛl saŋa nɛ Nehemaya saŋa la, Israel dim da la'asid nɛ diib daar wʋsa tisid yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib nɛ banɛ an za'anɔgu'udib la. Ba mɛ da bɛŋ Levi dim banɛ kpɛlim la dinnɛ tisi ba, ka mɛ tis Levi dim banɛ an Aaron yaas la ba din.

english_text:
Foreigners Are Sent Away
1 On that day when the Law of Moses was read aloud to everyone, it was discovered that Ammonites and Moabites were forbidden to belong to the people of God. 2 This was because they had refused to give food and water to Israel and had hired Balaam to call down a curse on them. However, our God turned the curse into a blessing. 3Following the reading of the Law of Moses, the people of Israel started sending away anyone who had any foreign ancestors.
Nehemiah Makes Other Changes
4The priest Eliashib was a relative of Tobiah and had earlier been put in charge of the temple storerooms. 5So he let Tobiah live in one of these rooms, where all kinds of things had been stored—the grain offerings, incense, utensils for the temple, as well as the tenth of the grain, wine, and olive oil that had been given for the use of the Levites, singers, and temple guards, and the gifts for the priests.
6This happened in the thirty-second year that Artaxerxes ruled Babylonia. I was away from Jerusalem at the time, because I was visiting him. Later I received permission from the king 7to return to Jerusalem. Only then did I find out that Eliashib had done this terrible thing of letting Tobiah have a room in the temple. 8It upset me so much that I threw out every bit of Tobiah's furniture. 9Then I ordered the room to be cleaned and the temple utensils, the grain offerings, and the incense to be brought back into the room.
10 I also found out that the temple singers and several other Levites had returned to work on their farms, because they had not been given their share of the harvest. 11I called the leaders together and angrily asked them, “Why is the temple neglected?” Then I told them to start doing their jobs. 12 After this, everyone in Judah brought a tenth of their grain, wine, and olive oil to the temple storeroom. 13Finally, I appointed three men with good reputations to be in charge of what was brought there and to distribute it to the others. They were Shelemiah the priest, Zadok the teacher of the Law, and Pedaiah the Levite. Their assistant was Hanan, the son of Zaccur and the grandson of Mattaniah.
14I pray that my God will remember these good things that I have done for his temple and for those who worship there.
The Sabbath
15 I also noticed what the people of Judah were doing on the Sabbath. Not only were they trampling grapes to make wine, but they were harvesting their grain, grapes, figs, and other crops, and then loading these on donkeys to sell in Jerusalem. So I warned them not to sell food on the Sabbath. 16People who had moved to Jerusalem from the city of Tyre were bringing in fish and other things to sell there on the Sabbath. 17I got angry and said to the leaders of Judah, “This evil you are doing is an insult to the Sabbath! 18Didn't God punish us and this city because our ancestors did these very same things? And here you are, about to make God furious again by disgracing the Sabbath!”
19I ordered the gates of Jerusalem to be closed on the eve of the Sabbath and not to be opened until after the Sabbath had ended. Then I put some of my own men in charge of the gates to make certain that nothing was brought in on the Sabbath. 20Once or twice some merchants spent the night outside Jerusalem with their goods. 21But I warned them, “If you do this again, I'll have you arrested.” From then on, they did not come on the Sabbath. 22I ordered the Levites to make themselves holy and to guard the gates on the Sabbath, so that it would be kept holy.
God is truly merciful, and I pray that he will treat me with kindness and bless me for doing this.
Mixed Marriages
23 I discovered that some Jewish men had married women from Ashdod, Ammon, and Moab. 24About half of their children could not speak Hebrew—they spoke only the language of Ashdod or some other foreign language. 25So in my anger, I called down curses on those men. I had them beaten and even pulled out the hair of some of them. Then I made them promise:
In the name of God we solemnly promise not to let our sons and daughters marry foreigners. 26 God dearly loved King Solomon of Israel and made him the greatest king on earth, but Solomon's foreign wives led him into sin. 27So we will obey you and not rebel against our God by marrying foreign women.
28 Jehoiada, the son of the high priest Eliashib, had a son who had married a daughter of Sanballat from Horon, and I forced his son to leave.
29I pray that God will punish them for breaking their priestly vows and disgracing the Levi tribe.
30Then I made sure that the people were free from every foreign influence, and I assigned duties for the priests and Levites. 31I also arranged for the people to bring firewood to the altar each day and for them to bring the first part of their harvest to the temple.
I pray that God will bless me for the good I have done.
translation_text:
Nehemaya yis teŋ zʋŋ nidib la
1 Daakan la ba da karim Moses wada gbauŋ la agɔla gɔla ka nidib la wʋsa wʋm. Ani ka ba nyɛ ka li sɔb ye, suor kae ka ba kɛ ka Ammon nid bɛɛ Moab nid kpɛn' Zugsɔb la nidib sʋʋginɛ, 2 bɔzugɔ ba da pʋ tʋ'ʋs Israel dim la tisi ba diib bɛɛ ku'om, amaa ka da' Balaam ka o kaanb kaanbbɛ'ɛdi tisi ba. (Nɛ wala wʋsa ti Wina'am la tiak kaanb bɛ'ɛd la ka li lieb albareka tisi ti.) 3Nidib la wʋsa wʋm wada la, ba pʋ gɛlig banɛ yaanamɛ ka' Israel dim la paas Israel dim la nii.
4Ba da pʋn gaŋ Eliyaasib onɛ an maanmaan la ye o gur Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la'ad dɔɔg la, saŋkan la ka on nɛ Tobaya pʋn an nɔɔr yinne sa, 5ka o nɔk dɔtita'are tis o, dɔkan la ka ba daa ɛɛnti su'ad zʋʋd nɛ bʋnnyubisa nɛ Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la'ad la, la'an nɛ zʋʋd linɛ an pʋdigir piiga pʋʋgin vaar yinne dinɛ an zʋʋd nɛ daam nɛ kpaam linɛ ka ba tisid Levi dim la nɛ yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib nɛ za'anɔgu'udib la, la'an nɛ la'abanɛ ka ba la'asidi tisid maanmaannib la. 6Amaa nɛ'ɛnamɛ da niŋid la ka mam ka' Jerusalem, saŋkan la da an Babilon Na'ab Atazeesis n da dii o na'am la li yʋma pistan' nɛ ayi' saŋa la, ka m lɛb Na'ab la san'an. Lin nya'aŋ ka m sɔs suor o san'an ka 7lɛb Jerusalem na. Ani ka m wʋm Eliyaasib n tʋm bɛ'ɛd si'em nɔk dɔɔg Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la tis Tobaya, 8ka m sʋnf da pɛlig hali ka m vaae Tobaya la'ad linɛ bɛ dɔɔgin la wʋsa lɔbi bas yiŋ. 9Ka tis nɔɔr ye ba maal malima pie dɔɔg la, ka kɛ ka m lɛbis Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la'ad la kpɛn'ɛs, la'an nɛ zʋʋd piini la nɛ bʋnnyubisa la.
10 M mɛ lɛn wʋm ye ba pʋ nɔk la'ad linɛ an Levi dim din la tisi baa, ka Levi dim wʋsa nɛ yʋʋmyʋ'ʋmnib la lɛbi ba pɔɔdin. 11Ka m sa'al kpɛɛmnam la ka bu'osi ba ye, “Bɔ ka ya tam Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la yɛllɛ?” Ani ka m buol Levi dim la kɛ ka ba lɛbi ba tʋʋma ni na. 12 Ka Juda dim wʋsa yʋ'ʋn pin'ili mɔri ba pʋdigir piiga vaar yinne linɛ an zʋʋd nɛ daam nɛ kpaam kenna kpɛn'ɛsid la'ad dɔɔgin la. 13Ka m kɛ ka Sielemaya onɛ an maanmaan la nɛ Zadok onɛ an gbauŋmi'id la nɛ Levi nid onɛ yʋ'ʋri buon Pedaya la gur la'ad dɔɔg la, ka kɛ ka Hanani onɛ an Zakur biig ka o yaab an Matanaya la sʋŋidi ba, bɔzugɔ, ba da yɛt nimbama yɛla ye ba anɛ sida dim. Ba da kɛ ka ban tʋʋm anɛ ba pʋdigid la'adi tisidi ba ba'abiis la.
14Oo m Wina'am, tɛnri m yɛla ka da kɛ ka man maal si'eli tisi fʋ Pʋ'ʋsim Yir nɛ li tʋʋma la keŋ zaalim!
15 Dabisban la ni ka m nyɛ ka Juda dim da nwiakid daam ba daam nwiasʋg zin'igin la Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar, ka mɔr zʋʋdi kenna lɔɔdi pa'annɛ ba bʋmis la'an nɛ daam nɛ tiis wala nɛ la'ad buudi wʋsa. Ka ba mɔri li wʋsa kenna ye ba kuosi li Vʋ'ʋsʋm daare tis Juda dim; hali nɛ Jerusalem tempʋʋgin mɛn! Dinzug ka m sa'ali ba ye ba da kuosid diib Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daarɛ. 16Ninsieba banɛ yi Taya ka bɛ Jerusalem la mɛ da mɔr zimi nɛ la'ad buudi wʋsa ken Jerusalem na kuosidi tisid Juda nidib Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar. 17Ka m sa'al Juda tuongatib la ka yɛli ba ye, “Bɔ ka ya tʋm bɛ'ɛdi san'amid Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar kisʋgɔ? 18Ya yaanam da pʋ niŋnɛ ala ka ti Wina'am la mɔr yɛltɔɔd bama kɛn tinam nɛ tempʋʋg la wʋsa zugin na? Lin pʋ siakɛ ka ya yʋ'ʋn maligim san'amid Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar la ye ya kɛ ka Wina'am sʋnpɛɛn lii ti zugɔɔ!”
19Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar ya'a na bɛ wʋʋ bɛog la, zaam ya'a ma'ae ka ma'asim tuligi paae Jerusalem za'anɔya la, m ɛɛn tis nɛ nɔɔr ka ba yɔ' za'anɔya la ka kʋ lɛn yɔ'ɔgɛ asɛɛ Vʋ'ʋsʋm dabisir daar la ya'a ti gaad. M ɛɛn zi'el nɛ m mɛŋ nidib za'anɔya la ni ka sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi mɔr la'adi kpɛn' tempʋʋgin la Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daarɛ. 20Nɔɔr yinne bɛɛ nɔɔra ayi' ka banɛ kpiisid la'ad nɛ li buudi la da gbɛn Jerusalem tempʋʋg la yiŋ. 21Amaa m sa'ali ba ka yɛli ba ye, “Bɔ ka ya gbɛɛnd zaŋguom la yiŋ yʋ'ʋŋɔ? Ya ya'a lɛn niŋ ala ya'as ya na baŋ!” Lin yi saŋkan la ba pʋ lɛn lɛb Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar na ya'asɛ. 22Ani ka m tis Levi dim la nɔɔr ye ba maali ba mɛŋ nyain ka keŋ gur za'anɔya la, ka li kɛ ka Vʋ'ʋsʋm Daar la an kasi.
O m Wina'am, tɛnri m yɛla lina wʋsa zug ka zɔɔ m nimbaanlig fʋ nɔŋilim tita'ar la zug.
23 Dabisban la ni ya'as ka m nyɛ Juda dim banɛ di pu'ab Asdod nɛ Ammon nɛ Moab dimin la. 24Ka ba biis la pʋsʋk pian'ad nɛ Asdod dim pian'ad bɛɛ buudbanɛ kpɛlim la pian'ad, ka kʋ nyaŋi pian' Juda dim pian'adɛ. 25Ka m tansi ba ka pɔ nɔɔri tisi ba. Ka bʋ' sieba ka vɔɔn ba zuobid. Ka m kɛ ka ba pɔ nɔɔr ye ba kʋ lɛn nɔki ba pu'ayuosi tis buudzʋŋ bɛɛ ba kɛ ka ba biribis bɛɛ ba mɛŋ di buudzʋŋ ya'asɛ. 26 M da sa'ali ba ka bu'osi ba ye, “Ka' pu'adiir bama zugʋ da kɛ ka Israel na'ab Solomon da tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd laa? Buudi wʋsa ni, na'ab da kae nwɛnɛ oo. O Wina'am da nɔŋ o nɛ hali, ka kɛ ka o an Israel wʋsa na'ab, amaa la'an nɛ wala teŋ zʋŋ pu'ab yɛla da kɛ ka o tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd. 27Li sʋm ye nannanna tinam wʋm ye yanam mɛ tʋm bɛ'ɛd kaŋa buudi ka pʋ dɔlli ti Wina'am la nɛ sidaa, ka dit teŋ zʋŋ pu'abaa?” 28 Joyada biig yinne onɛ yaabi an Eliyaasib onɛ an maanmaan kpɛɛm la diem dau da an Sambalat onɛ an Horon nid la, ka m da kad o yisi m san'an.
29Tɛnri ba yɛla, O m Wina'am, ban san'am maanmaannib tʋʋma ka kɛ ka dian'ad bɛ li ni la, nɛ nɔnaar linɛ an maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim din la.
30Ala ka m maal malima pie maanmaannib nɛ Levi dim la yis linɛ an teŋ zʋŋ la'ad wʋsa, ka lɛbisi ba, ba tʋʋma ni, ka kɛ ka sɔ' wʋsa mi' o tʋʋmmi an si'el. 31Ka m mɛ lɛn zi'el saŋa kanɛ nar ye nidib la la'as daad na nɛ zʋʋd linɛ ka ba bʋn yiiga la.
Tɛnri m yɛla, O m Wina'am, ka kɛ ka m paae fʋ ya'am.

english_text:
Queen Vashti Disobeys King Xerxes
1-2 King Xerxes of Persia lived in his capital city of Susa and ruled 127 provinces from India to Ethiopia. 3During the third year of his rule, Xerxes gave a big dinner for all his officials and officers. The governors and leaders of the provinces were also invited, and even the commanders of the Persian and Median armies came. 4For 180 days he showed off his wealth and spent a lot of money to impress his guests with the greatness of his kingdom.
5At the end of this time, King Xerxes gave another dinner and invited everyone in the city of Susa, no matter who they were. The eating and drinking lasted seven days in the beautiful palace gardens. 6The area was decorated with blue and white cotton curtains tied back with purple linen cords that ran through silver rings fastened to marble columns. Couches of gold and silver rested on pavement that had all kinds of designs made from costly bright-colored stones and marble and mother-of-pearl.
7The guests drank from gold cups, and each cup had a different design. The king was generous 8and said to them, “Drink all you want!” Then he told his servants, “Keep their cups full.”
9While the men were enjoying themselves, Queen Vashti gave the women a big dinner inside the royal palace.
10By the seventh day, King Xerxes was feeling happy because of so much wine. And he asked his seven personal servants, Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethar, and Carkas, 11to bring Queen Vashti to him. The king wanted her to wear her crown and let his people and his officials see how beautiful she was. 12The king's servants told Queen Vashti what he had said, but she refused to go to him, and this made him terribly angry.
13-14The king called in the seven highest officials of Persia and Media. They were Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, and Memucan. These men were very wise and understood all the laws and customs of the country, and the king always asked them what they thought about such matters.
15The king said to them, “Queen Vashti refused to come to me when I sent my servants for her. What does the law say I should do about that?”
16Then Memucan told the king and the officials:
Your Majesty, Queen Vashti has not only embarrassed you, but she has insulted your officials and everyone else in all the provinces.
17The women in the kingdom will hear about this, and they will refuse to respect their husbands. They will say, “If Queen Vashti doesn't obey her husband, why should we?” 18Before this day is over, the wives of the officials of Persia and Media will find out what Queen Vashti has done, and they will refuse to obey their husbands. They won't respect their husbands, and their husbands will be angry with them.
19Your Majesty, if you agree, you should write for the Medes and Persians a law that can never be changed. This law would keep Queen Vashti from ever seeing you again. Then you could let someone who respects you be queen in her place.
20When the women in your great kingdom hear about this new law, they will respect their husbands, no matter if they are rich or poor.
21King Xerxes and his officials liked what Memucan had said, 22and he sent letters to all of his provinces. Each letter was written in the language of the province to which it was sent, and it said that husbands should be in charge of their wives and children.
translation_text:
Ba yis na'apu'a Vasiti na'amin
1Nɛ'ɛŋa da maal nɛ Na'ab Zeesis onɛ da sʋ'oe tɛɛns kɔbiga nɛ pisi nɛ ayɔpɔi lin yi India paae Kus la. 2Saŋkan la Zeesis da bɛ nɛ Susa linɛ an o na'am zin'ig ka an teŋ kpi'euŋ ka soogianam bɛ ka gɔt teŋ la. 3On da di na'am la, li yʋma atan' saŋa ka o da la'as o ninkpi'ema nɛ kpɛɛmnam maal diibi tisi ba. Soogia kpɛɛmnam banɛ bɛ Pesia nɛ Media la wʋsa da bɛ, nɛ na'ayikpɛm nɛ banɛ sʋ'oe sʋ'ʋlim kɔn'ɔb-kɔn'ɔb wʋsa da bɛ. 4O da nɔk dabisa kɔbiga nɛ pisnii pa'al nidib la o mɔrim nɛ girima nɛ kpi'euŋ kanɛ ka o mɔr. 5Lina nya'aŋ ka Na'ab la da maal diibi buol nidib ka ba zin'in lɔmbɔn'ɔg kanɛ bɛ Na'ayin la, daba ayɔpɔi. O da buol biis nɛ ninkʋda wʋsa banɛ bɛ Susa na'am zin'igin la, ka ba kena.
6Ba da lɔ pien piela nɛ pien dɛn'ɛm bɛŋi ba diib zin'ig, ka da nɔk nwiis nɛ anzurifa baansi lɔɔ ga' zan'antɔlis banɛ ka ba kpi'e kugsʋma maal la. Ba da zin'in kʋgbanɛ ka ba nɔk sanlima nɛ anzurifa bulig la. Ka ba nɔk kuglamma banɛ an pʋpɔnra ka ba ligidi kpi'emi maal zak la teŋ. 7Ba da nɔknɛ sanlima la'ad banɛ gʋl kɔn'ɔb, kɔn'ɔbi kuob daam tis na'anam la. Na'ab la da tisi ba daam bɛdegʋ ka li pa'al o na'am paŋi zem si'em. 8Na'ab la da tis nɔɔr ye sɔ' wʋsa num o paŋ bɛn, ka mɛ yɛl banɛ pʋʋd la ye ba tisim sɔ' wʋsa on bɔɔd dansi'a buudi wʋsa.
9Na'ab la pu'a onɛ yʋ'ʋri da buon Vasiti la mɛ da maal diibi tis pu'a banɛ bɛ Na'ab Zeesis yin la.
10Li daba ayɔpɔi daar Na'ab la da nu daam kʋʋl ka buol o tʋmtʋmnib ayɔpɔi banɛ bɛɛ o san'an la. Ba yʋda da anɛ Mehuman nɛ Bizita nɛ Habona nɛ Bigita nɛ Abagita nɛ Zeta nɛ Kakas. Ban da kena la, ka o yɛli ba ye 11ba kem yɛl o pu'a Vasiti ka o pidi o na'am zupibig la kɛɛn o san'an na. Na'apu'a la da vɛnl nɛ hali ka Na'ab la bɔɔd ye o zaŋ o pa'al nidib la nɛ kpɛɛmnam la on vɛnl si'em. 12Amaa dap ayɔpɔi la da keŋ tis o Na'ab la labaar la, Na'apu'a Vasiti da zan'as ye o kʋ keŋɛ. Nɛ'ɛŋa da kɛ ka Na'ab la sʋnf duoe hali.
13Li da anɛ ba malʋŋ ye si'el ya'a ti an wada yɛla Na'ab la on bu'os banɛ mi' wada nɛ sariakatib la, dinzug Na'ab la da bu'os ya'am dim banɛ da mi' linɛ nar ye ba maal la. 14Banɛ da li'el Na'ab la da anɛ Kasena nɛ Sieta nɛ Adimata nɛ Tarsis nɛ Meres nɛ Masena nɛ Memukan, ya'am dima ayɔpɔi nwa' da an Pesia nɛ Media tɛɛns kpi'emnam la ka mɛ mɔr suori na tun'e kpɛn' Na'ab la san'an.
15O da bu'osi ba ye, “Wada pʋʋgin, li nar ye ba niŋ Na'apu'a Vasiti wala? O zan'as nɔɔr kanɛ ka man Na'ab Zeesis, tʋmi m tʋmtʋmnib ye ba keŋ yɛl o la.”
16Ani ka Memukan da yɛl Na'ab la nɛ ya'am dim la tuon ye, “Naa, li ka'anɛ Na'ab la ma'aa ka Na'apu'a Vasiti nɛ'ɛsɛ amaa o mɛ nɛ'ɛs nɛ ya'am dim nɛ nimbanɛ bɛɛ fʋ sʋ'ʋlimin la wʋsa. 17Bɔzugɔ Na'apu'a la tʋm si'el la, pu'ab la wʋsa na wʋm, ka lin na kɛ ka ba nɛ'ɛsi ba sidib mɛn ka yɛl, ye, ‘Na'ab Zeesis da tis nɔɔr ye ba mɔr Na'apu'a Vasiti na, amaa ka o pʋ siakɛ.’ 18Zina nɔɔ pu'ab banɛ an burikinnam ka bɛ Pesia nɛ Media sʋ'ʋlim la na wʋm Na'apu'a la maal si'el la, ka ba mɛ na niŋ ala tisi ba sidib banɛ an burikinnam la. Li na kɛ ka na'asi nɛ nɔɔr yinne naae teŋgbauŋ kaŋa ni.
19“Alazug, Na'aba, fʋ ya'a na siak, fʋn sɔm gbauŋ ka tik nu'ug ka kɛ ka li lieb wada Pesia nɛ Media teŋin ye, Vasiti kʋ lɛn kɛn Na'ab tuon naa, ka faaɛn o na'am la tis onɛ sɔn'ɔ o. 20Na'aba, fʋn ya'a niŋ ala ka li tiigi fʋ teŋgbauŋ la wʋsa, pu'ab la na tisi ba sidib girima lin pin'il tadimnamin ti keŋ paae kpi'emnamin la.”
21Na'ab la nɛ o kpɛɛmnam la sʋnf da ma'ae ya nɛ sa'al kaŋa, alazug Na'ab la da niŋ wʋʋ Memukan n yɛl si'em la. 22O da sɔb gbana tis o sʋ'ʋlim la bɛn wʋsa, ka tɛɛns wʋsa di'e li ka li sɔbi ba mɛŋ buudi pian'adin, yɛti ba ye dau wʋsa na sʋ'ʋg o mɛŋ yidim.

english_text:
Esther Becomes Queen
1After a while, King Xerxes got over being angry. But he kept thinking about what Vashti had done and the law that he had written because of her. 2Then the king's personal servants said:
Your Majesty, a search must be made to find you some beautiful young women. 3You can select officers in every province to bring them to the place where you keep your wives in the capital city of Susa. Put your servant Hegai in charge of them since that is his job. He can see to it that they are given the proper beauty treatments. 4Then let the young woman who pleases you most take Vashti's place as queen.
King Xerxes liked these suggestions, and he followed them.
5At this time a Jew named Mordecai was living in Susa. His father was Jair, and his grandfather Shimei was the son of Kish from the tribe of Benjamin. 6 Kish was one of the people that Nebuchadnezzar had taken from Jerusalem, when he took King Jeconiah of Judah to Babylonia.
7Mordecai had a very beautiful cousin named Esther, whose Hebrew name was Hadassah. He had raised her as his own daughter, after her father and mother died. 8When the king ordered the search for beautiful women, many were taken to the king's palace in Susa, and Esther was one of them.
Hegai was put in charge of all the women, 9and from the first day, Esther was his favorite. He began her beauty treatments at once. He also gave her plenty of food and seven special maids from the king's palace, and they had the best rooms.
10Mordecai had warned Esther not to tell anyone that she was a Jew, and she obeyed him. 11He was anxious to see how Esther was getting along and to learn what had happened to her. So each day he would walk back and forth in front of the court where the women lived.
12The young women were given beauty treatments for one whole year. The first six months their skin was rubbed with olive oil and myrrh, and the last six months it was treated with perfumes and cosmetics. Then each of them spent the night alone with King Xerxes. 13When a young woman went to the king, she could wear whatever clothes or jewelry she chose from the women's living quarters. 14In the evening she would go to the king, and the following morning she would go to the place where his wives stayed after being with him. There a man named Shaashgaz was in charge of the king's wives. Only the ones the king wanted and asked for by name could go back to the king.
15-16Xerxes had been king for seven years when Esther's turn came to go to him during Tebeth, the tenth month of the year. Everyone liked Esther. The king's personal servant Hegai was in charge of the women, and Esther trusted Hegai and asked him what she ought to take with her.
17Xerxes liked Esther more than he did any of the other young women. None of them pleased him as much as she did, and he immediately fell in love with her and crowned her queen in place of Vashti. 18In honor of Esther he gave a big dinner for his leaders and officials. Then he declared a holiday everywhere in his kingdom and gave expensive gifts.
Mordecai Saves the King's Life
19When the young women were brought together again, Esther's cousin Mordecai had become a palace official. 20He had told Esther never to tell anyone that she was a Jew, and she obeyed him, just as she had always done.
21Bigthana and Teresh were the two men who guarded King Xerxes' rooms, but they got angry with the king and decided to kill him. 22Mordecai found out about their plans and asked Queen Esther to tell the king what he had found out. 23King Xerxes learned that Mordecai's report was true, and he had the two men hanged. Then the king had all of this written down in his record book as he watched.
translation_text:
Esta lieb na'apu'a
1Lina nya'aŋ, Na'ab Zeesis sʋnfʋ yʋ'ʋn da ma'ae la, o da tiɛn Vasiti n da maal si'el nɛ on gban'e si'el o yɛla. 2O na'ayikpɛm banɛ da sa'an o la da yɛl ye, “Naa, kɛl ka ba iee paam pu'asadbanɛ zi' dau na tisif. 3Kɛl ka Na'ab gaans kpɛɛmnam zin'ig wʋsa ka ba zi'en o nɔba zugʋ gaans pu'asadvɛnla mɔri kɛn Susa teŋin na. Naa, kɛl ka fʋ tʋmtʋm onɛ ka ba fuo o ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Hegai ka o gur pu'ab la sʋ'oe ba ka gɔti ba vɛnlim yɛla. 4Ka kɛ ka pu'asadir kanɛ ka Na'ab ya'am kpɛn' la di'e Vasiti zin'igi lieb na'apu'a.” Sa'al kaŋa da malis Na'ab la ka o sid da niŋ ala.
5Saŋkan la ka Jew nid da bɛ Susa teŋin, ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Modekaya, ka o saam yʋ'ʋr buon Jair ka o yaanam an Simie nɛ Kis. O da anɛ Benjamin dɔɔg nid. 6 Babilon Na'ab Nebukadnɛza da gban'e Juda Na'ab Jehoyakim nɛ o nidibi yi Jerusalem kena maali ba yammis la, o da anɛ ba nid yinne. 7Modekaya saam pitʋ biig da bɛɛ o san'an, ka o da ugus o bɔzugɔ o da ka' saam bɛɛ maa. O da anɛ bipuŋ ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Hadasa bɛɛ Esta. O da anɛ onɛ vɛnl ka o zi'esim an sʋ'ʋŋa. O ma nɛ o saam da kpinɛ ka Modekaya nɔk o maal o mɛŋ biig.
8Ban da mɔɔl Na'ab la tɔlʋŋ zin'ig wʋsa la, ba da mɔr pu'asada bɛdegʋ kɛn Susa teŋin na ka Hegai guri ba. Ba mɛ da mɔr Esta n kɛn Na'ab la yin na mɛ gu'ul Hegai onɛ da gur zin'ikanɛ ka pu'ab la'asi bɛ la. 9O nini da tig Esta ka o bɔɔd o yɛla hali. Linzug o da bɔ duorim la'adi tis o, nɛ disʋma linɛ bɛɛ li kɔn'. O da gaans bipumis ayɔpɔi yi na'ayin la ye ba gɔsid o yɛla, ka nɔk on nɛ o tʋmtʋm bipumis la bɛ zin'isi'a la tɔɔm niŋ zin'isʋŋin.
10Esta da pʋ pa'al o buudi nɛ o tuŋʋ bɔzugɔ, Modekaya da pʋ siak ye o niŋ alaa. 11Daar wʋsa Modekaya da kaalim pu'ab la bɛ zin'isi'a la gɔsid Esta an si'em nɛ ban maan o si'em.
12Pu'asadir ya'a na kpɛn' Na'ab Zeesis san'an, asɛɛ ka ba dɛŋin nɔk nwadis pii nɛ ayi' maal o ka o vɛnl wʋʋ ban pa'al si'em la. Ba na zaŋ nwadis ayuobʋ suoɛn o kpaam nɛ tiim linɛ ka ba buon mir la, ka lɛn nɔk nwadis ayuobʋ kanɛ kpɛlim la niŋ o tudaari nɛ li buudi wʋsa. 13Pu'asadir ya'a da ye o yi pu'asada la bɛ zin'isi'a la kpɛn' Na'ab la san'an ka yɛl ye o bɔɔd si'el wʋsa, ba nɔkid nɛ tisid o ka o mɔri ken Na'ab la dɔɔgin. 14O ɛɛnti kpɛn' nɛ Na'ab la san'an zaam, ka lɛb bɛkɛung na tɔɔm zin'isi'a pu'ab la zin'igin la, ka kpɛm bɛ Saasgas onɛ ka ba fuo o ka o gɔt pu'abibis la nu'ugin. Pu'asadir la kʋ lɛn lɛb Na'ab la san'anɛ ya'a ka' o ya'am ti lɛb o san'an ka o buol o yʋ'ʋr ye ba mɔr o naa.
15Saŋa da paae ye Esta (pu'asadir kanɛ an Abihel biig ka lɛn an Modekaya taʋn bil onɛ ka o da nɔk o gɔt la) keŋ Na'ab la san'an, o da pʋ sɔs si'eli gaad linɛ ka Hegai onɛ da guri ba la da pa'al ye o mɔri keŋ la. Banɛ da nyɛ Esta la wʋsa ya'am da kpɛn' o nɛ. 16Ba da mɔr o kɛn Na'ab Zeesis san'an na, o na'am la yʋma ayɔpɔi saŋa li nwadis piiga linɛ ka ba buon Tebɛf la ni.
17Na'ab la ya'am da kpɛn' Esta gaad pu'ab la wʋsa, ka o zug di Na'ab la gat pu'asada banɛ kpɛlim la wʋsa. Ka o nɔk na'am zupibigi pid o zug ka faaɛn Vasiti na'am la diis o. 18Ka Na'ab la maal diib bɛdegʋ Esta na'am diib yɛla tis nidib la wʋsa, la'an nɛ o ya'am dim nɛ o kpɛɛmnam la wʋsa. O da mɔɔl vʋ'ʋsʋm dabisire tis o sʋ'ʋlim nidib la wʋsa ka tis nidib la piinsʋma bɛdegʋ.
Modekaya tilig na'ab la nyɔɔr
19Ban da lɛn la'as pu'asada la, Modekaya da zin'inɛ Na'ab la zɔŋŋin. 20Amaa Esta da pʋ pa'al o buudi nɛ o tuŋ yɛla wʋʋ Modekaya da sa'al o si'em la, bɔzugɔ o da nan kpɛm mɔr sa'al kanɛ ka Modekaya da sa'al o wʋʋ on da nan ugus o saŋsi'a la.
21Bigitana nɛ Teris da bɛɛ ani, ka an Na'ab la kpɛɛmnam banɛ gur za'anɔɔr linɛ kpɛn'ɛd la. Saŋa kanɛ ka Modekaya da zin' Na'ab la zɔŋŋin la, ba sʋnf da duoe hali ka ba gban'e ye ba kʋ Na'ab Zeesis. 22Modekaya da wʋm ban gban'e si'em la ka yɛl Esta, ka on mɛ nɔki yɛl Na'ab la, ka li kɛ ka Modekaya paam yʋ'ʋr. 23Ka ban da vɛɛnsi nyɛ ka li an sida la, ba da yul nidib ayi' la nɛ nwiisi kʋ. Nɛ'ɛŋa wʋsa da sɔbi niŋ Na'anam Labaya Gbana la ni Na'ab la nini ni.

english_text:
Haman Plans To Destroy the Jews
1Later, King Xerxes promoted Haman the son of Hammedatha to the highest position in his kingdom. Haman was a descendant of Agag, 2and the king had given orders for his officials at the royal gate to honor Haman by kneeling down to him. All of them obeyed except Mordecai. 3When the other officials asked Mordecai why he disobeyed the king's command, 4he said, “Because I am a Jew.” They spoke to him for several days about kneeling down, but he still refused to obey. Finally, they reported this to Haman, to find out if he would let Mordecai get away with it.
5Haman was furious to learn that Mordecai refused to kneel down and honor him. 6And when he found out that Mordecai was a Jew, he knew that killing only Mordecai was not enough. Every Jew in the whole kingdom had to be killed.
7It was now the twelfth year of the rule of King Xerxes. During Nisan, the first month of the year, Haman said, “Find out the best time for me to do this.” The time chosen was Adar, the twelfth month.
8 Then Haman went to the king and said:
Your Majesty, there are some people who live all over your kingdom and won't have a thing to do with anyone else. They have customs that are different from everyone else's, and they refuse to obey your laws. We would be better off to get rid of them! 9Why not give orders for all of them to be killed? I can promise that you will get tons of silver for your treasury.
10The king handed his official ring to Haman, who hated the Jews, and the king told him, 11“Do what you want with those people! You can keep their money.”
12On the thirteenth day of Nisan, Haman called in the king's secretaries and ordered them to write letters in every language used in the kingdom. The letters were written in the name of the king and sealed by using the king's own ring. At once they were sent to the king's highest officials, the governors of each province, and the leaders of the different nations in the kingdom of Xerxes.
13The letters were taken by messengers to every part of the kingdom, and this is what was said in the letters:
On the thirteenth day of Adar, the twelfth month, all Jewish men, women, and children are to be killed. And their property is to be taken.
14-15King Xerxes gave orders for these letters to be posted where they could be seen by everyone all over the kingdom. The king's command was obeyed, and one of the letters was read aloud to the people in the walled city of Susa. Then the king and Haman sat down to drink together, but no one in the city could figure out what was going on.
translation_text:
Haman gban'e ye o kʋ Jew dim la
1Nɛ' wʋsa nya'aŋ la Na'ab Zeesis da na'as Haman onɛ an Hamedata biig ka an Agag buudi la ka tis o kpɛŋ ka li gaad kpɛɛm banɛ bɛɛ ani la wʋsa. 2Na'ab la da tis nɔɔr ye banɛ bɛ zɔŋŋin la wʋsa iginim o tuon ka tis o girima. Ba wʋsa da niŋid ala, amaa Modekaya ma'aa da zan'as ka pʋ iginidi tisid o girimaa.
3Ka o taaba la da bu'os o ye, “Bɔzugʋ kɛ ka fʋ pʋ siak ye fʋ dɔl Na'ab la tis nɔsi'a la?” 4La'an nɛ ban da pian'adi tisid Modekaya li yɛla la daar wʋsa la, o da pʋ tiak o pʋtɛn'ɛrɛ. Alazug, ba da yɛl Haman li yɛla ye ba gɔs ye o na siaki bas Modekaya ka o kpɛm bɛ ala bɛɛ o kʋ siakɛ? Bɔzugɔ o da yɛli ba ye o anɛ Jew.
5Haman da baŋ ye Modekaya pʋ bɔɔd ye o igin o tuon bɛɛ tis o girima la, o sʋnf da duoe nɛ hali. 6On da baŋ Modekaya nidib la an ninsieba buudi la o da pʋ siak ye o kʋ Modekaya ma'aanɛ, amaa ka ieed suokanɛ na kʋ on nɛ o nimbanɛ an Jew dim la wʋsa, Na'ab Zeesis sʋ'ʋlimin la wʋsa.
7Zeesis na'am la yʋma pii nɛ ayi' saŋa, nwadig kanɛ an yiiga ka ba buonnɛ li Nisan la ni, ka ba da maal pur (linɛ ka ba buon bʋgʋlʋm-bʋgʋlʋm la) Haman tuon ye ba gaŋ dabisir nɛ nwadig kanɛ ka ba na kʋ Jew dim la, ka li keŋ lu nwadig pii nɛ ayi' linɛ ka ba buon Ada la zug, li dabpiiga nɛ atan' daar.
8Haman da yɛl Na'ab la ye, “Naa, ninsieba bɛ kpɛla ka ba malima bɛɛ li kɔn', ka ba gɛndig nɛ fʋ nidib sʋ'ʋlimin la wʋsa; ba anɛ banɛ pʋ siaki dɔlli fʋ wada laa. Na'aba, li pʋ sʋm ye fʋ kɛ ka nimbama bɛ teŋ kaŋa nii. 9Fʋ ya'a na siak, fʋn tisim nɔɔr ka ba kʋʋ ba, ka m na nɔk anzurifa ligidi bɛdegʋ niŋ na'am ligidi suak zin'igi tis banɛ yii kʋʋ ba la.”
10Na'ab la da fuoe o nu'ubil tikir baŋi yis o nu'ugin tis Haman onɛ da an Jew dim dataa la. O da anɛ Hamedata biig ka an Agag buudi. 11Na'ab la da yɛl Haman ye, o kɛl ligidi la, ka lɛɛ maal nidib la wʋʋ on gban'e ye o niŋi ba si'em la.
12Yiiga nwadig la ni, li dabpiiga nɛ atan' la daar, ba da la'as teŋ la gbansɔbidib la wʋsa. Ba da sɔb gbana tis o sʋ'ʋlim la wʋsa, nɛ Gɔmenanam nɛ tɛɛns la tuongatib nɛ kpɛɛmnam wʋsa, ka tɛɛns wʋsa di'e li ka li sɔbi ba mɛŋ sɔbirin, nɛ buudi la wʋsa mɛŋ pian'adin, ka li pa'al Haman n gban'e ye ba tʋm si'em. Ba da sɔb nɛ'ɛŋa wʋsa nɛ Na'ab Zeesis yʋ'ʋr ka nɔk o mɛŋ nu'ug baŋ la tiki li zug. 13Ba da tʋm nidib ka ba mɔri keŋ tis sʋ'ʋlim la wʋsa. Pian'akanɛ da bɛ gbauŋʋn la da yɛti ba ye nwadkanɛ paas pii nɛ ayi' la ni, li dabpiiga nɛ atan' daar, ba kʋʋm Jew dim la na'akim nɛ pu'asada nɛ ninkʋda, la'an nɛ pu'ab nɛ biis wʋsa ka faaɛn ba la'ad la wʋsa. 14Gbana la da anɛ ba nɔki li ka teŋ wʋsa di'e mɔɔl ka sɔ' wʋsa wʋm ka li mɛ lieb wada, ka buudi nɛ sɔ' wʋsa baŋ ka ti'ebi gur dabisir la.
15Labaya dim la da zi Na'ab la wada la keŋ mɔɔl Susa tempʋʋgin mɔɔli gilig. Din saŋa la, Na'ab la nɛ Haman da zin'inɛ nuud daam, amaa Susa teŋ la da pɛ'ɛl nɛ tʋkpiidʋg.

english_text:
Mordecai Asks for Esther's Help
1When Mordecai heard about the letter, he tore his clothes in sorrow and put on sackcloth. Then he covered his head with ashes and went through the city, crying and weeping. 2But he could go only as far as the palace gate, because no one wearing sackcloth was allowed inside the palace. 3 In every province where the king's orders were read, the Jews cried and mourned, and they went without eating. Many of them even put on sackcloth and sat in ashes.
4When Esther's servant girls and her other servants told her what Mordecai was doing, she became very upset and sent Mordecai some clothes to wear in place of the sackcloth. But he refused to take them.
5Esther had a servant named Hathach, who had been given to her by the king. So she called him in and said, “Find out what's wrong with Mordecai and why he's acting this way.”
6Hathach went to Mordecai in the city square in front of the palace gate, 7and Mordecai told him everything that had happened. He also told him how much money Haman had promised to add to the king's treasury, if all the Jews were killed.
8Mordecai gave Hathach a copy of the orders for the murder of the Jews and told him that these had been read in Susa. He said, “Show this to Esther and explain what it means. Ask her to go to the king and beg him to have pity on her people, the Jews!”
9Hathach went back to Esther and told her what Mordecai had said. 10She answered, “Tell Mordecai 11there is a law about going in to see the king, and all his officials and his people know about this law. Anyone who goes in to see the king without being invited by him will be put to death. The only way that anyone can be saved is for the king to hold out the gold scepter to that person. And it's been thirty days since he has asked for me.”
12When Mordecai was told what Esther had said, 13he sent back this reply, “Don't think that you will escape being killed with the rest of the Jews, just because you live in the king's palace. 14If you don't speak up now, we will somehow get help, but you and your family will be killed. It could be that you were made queen for a time like this!”
15Esther sent a message to Mordecai, saying, 16“Bring together all the Jews in Susa and tell them to go without eating for my sake! Don't eat or drink for three days and nights. My servant girls and I will do the same. Then I will go in to see the king, even if it means I must die.”
17Mordecai did everything Esther told him to do.
translation_text:
Modekaya yɛl Esta ye o sʋŋimi ba
1Modekaya wʋm ban gban'e si'em la, o sʋnf san'amnɛ hali ka o aans o fuud ka yɛ bɔtkɛɛnd ka nɔk tampɛligim bug, sʋnsa'aŋ la zug, ka kpɛn' teŋ la pʋʋgini kaasid agɔla gɔla nɛ nimmua. 2Amaa o da paae Na'ab la yaŋirini tir, bɔzugɔ sɔ' ya'a yɛ bɔtkɛɛnd fuud, ba pʋ siakid ka o kpɛn'ɛda. 3Zin'ikanɛ wʋsa ka Na'ab la tik gbauŋ si'a la paae, Jew dim la da kpɛn' nɛ kukuma ka lɔ nɔɔr ka kaasid ka ki'ed kuŋ. Ba bɛdegʋ da yɛnɛ bɔtkɛɛnd ka nɔk tampɛligim bugi ba mɛŋ.
4Esta zak biis la nɛ dap banɛ da gur o la da kena yɛl o Modekaya yɛla la ka o sʋnf da san'am hali. Ka o tis fuud ye ba keŋ tis Modekaya ka o yɛ ka bas bɔtkɛɛnd la, amaa o da zan'as nɛ ka pʋ di'e fuud laa. 5Esta da buol Hatak onɛ ka Na'ab la gaŋ ye o gur o la, ka tʋm o ye o kem bu'os Modekaya linɛ daamid o, nɛ linɛ niŋ.
6Hatak da yii keŋ Modekaya san'an Na'ab la yaŋir la tuon. 7Ka Modekaya yɛl o linɛ maal la wʋsa, la'an nɛ Haman n gban'e ye ba ya'a sid nyaŋi kʋ Jew dim la wʋsa o na yɔ ligidi niŋ ban su'ad Na'ab la ligidi zin'isi'a la. 8Modekaya mɛ da nɔk gbauŋ kanɛ ka ba sɔb Jew dim la yɛla ka ba karimi li Susa teŋin la tis Hatak ye o keŋ pa'al Esta, ka yɛl o ye o mɔɔm ka yɛl Esta ka o keŋ Na'ab la san'ani bɛllim o ye o zɔmi o nidib la nimbaanlig.
9Hatak da lɛbi yɛl Esta Modekaya yɛl si'el la. 10Ka o yɛl o ye o kem yɛl Modekaya ye, 11“Na'ayikpɛm la nɛ nimbanɛ wʋsa bɛ teŋ la sʋ'ʋlim wʋsa mi' ye dau bɛɛ pu'a pʋ kpɛn'ɛd Na'ab la zɔŋŋin ka li ya'a ka' ye o buol o nɛ.
