13If God All-Powerful refuses
to answer their empty prayers,
14he will surely deny
your impatient request
to face him in court.
15Job, you were wrong to say
God doesn't punish sin.
16Everything you have said
adds up to nonsense.
translation_text:
1Ka Elihu lɛn yɛl ye,
2“Fʋ tɛn'ɛs ka nɛ'ɛŋa dɔl suorɛɛ? Fʋ yɛt ye,
‘Wina'am na tisim bʋʋd.’
3La'an nɛ wala fʋ bu'os o ye,
‘M ya'a pʋn ye m kʋ tʋm bɛ'ɛdɛ,
di nyɔɔd an bɔ ka m na di'e?’
4Tɔ', m na gandig fʋn
nɛ fʋ zuanam nwa' wʋsa.
5Ʋkimi fʋ nindaa gɔs agɔl;
fʋ nyɛ saŋgbana la bɛ saazug si'em laa?
6 Fʋ ya'a tʋm bɛ'ɛdɛ li niŋid Wina'am bɔ?
Fʋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ya'a zu'oe galisɛ, li niŋid o bɔ?
7Ka fʋ ya'a tʋm pʋpielim, li paasid o bɔ,
bɛɛ bɔ ka Wina'am bɔɔdi fʋ san'anɛ?
8Fʋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la namisidnɛ fʋ saal taaba ma'aa,
ka fʋ pʋpielim tʋʋma mɛ sʋŋidi ninsaalib gʋllim.
9Ba ya'a mugus saalib, ba kaasidnɛ
ka sɔsid yɔlisim banɛ mɔr kpi'euŋ la ni.
10Amaa sɔ' pʋ bu'osid ye, ‘M Wina'am onɛ maalim la bɛ yaa?
Onɛ tisidim yʋʋma ye m yʋ'ʋm yʋ'ʋŋ la bɛ yaanɛ?
11Onɛ pa'annɛ ti baŋir ka li gat on pa'an
bʋnkɔnbid banɛ bɛ teŋgbauŋ zug la,
ka tisidi ti ya'am ka li gat niimis banɛ ian'ad agɔla la.’
12Saalib ya'a kaasidi bɔɔd sʋŋir, o pʋ gandigida,
ka li anɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim nyɛɛsim la zug.
13Wina'am pʋ kɛlisidi ba fabilyɛɛd la;
Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar sɔb la ba'a pʋn kae nɛ baa.
14Ka fʋn kanɛ ye fʋ pʋ nyɛt o la;
o na niŋ wala wʋm tisi fɔ?
La'an nɛ fʋn yɛt ye fʋ bɛɛ o tuon
ka gur ye o maali fʋ yɛla la.
15Fʋ tɛn'ɛs ye Wina'am sʋnf pʋ duodaa,
ka lɛn yɛl ye o ba'a kae nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dimi tʋm si'ela.
16Alazug ka Job ya'ae o nɔɔrɛ pian'ad pian'ayɛɛd,
ka pʋn zi' on yɛt si'ela.”

english_text:
Elihu Continues
Be Patient a While Longer
1Elihu said:
2Be patient a while longer;
I have something else to say
in God's defense.
3God always does right—
and this knowledge
comes straight from God.
4You can rest assured
that what I say is true.
5Although God is mighty,
he cares about everyone
and makes fair decisions.
6The wicked are cut down,
and those who are wronged
receive justice.
7God watches over good people
and places them in positions
of power and honor forever.
8But when people are prisoners
of suffering and pain,
* 9God points out their sin
and their pride,
10then he warns them
to turn back to him.
11And if they obey,
they will be successful
and happy from then on.
12But if they foolishly refuse,
they will be rewarded
with a violent death.
Godless People Are Too Angry
13Godless people are too angry
to ask God for help
when he punishes them.
14So they die young
in shameful disgrace.
15Hard times and trouble
are God's way
of getting our attention!
16And at this very moment,
God deeply desires
to lead you from trouble
and to spread your table
with your favorite food.
17Now that the judgment
for your sins
has fallen upon you,
18don't let your anger
and the pain you endured
make you sneer at God.
19Your reputation and riches
cannot protect you
from distress,
20nor can you find safety
in the dark world below.
21Be on guard! Don't turn to evil
as a way of escape.
22God's power is unlimited.
He needs no teachers
23to guide or correct him.
Others Have Praised God
24Others have praised God
for what he has done,
so join with them.
25From down here on earth,
everyone has looked up and seen
26how great God is—
God is more than we imagine;
no one can count the years
he has lived.
* 27God gathers moisture
into the clouds
28and supplies us with rain.
29Who can understand
how God scatters the clouds
and speaks from his home
in the thunderstorm?
30And when God sends lightning,
it can be seen
at the bottom of the sea.
31By producing such rainstorms,
God rules the world
and provides us with food.
32Each flash of lightning
is one of his arrows
striking its target,
33and the thunder tells
of his anger against sin.
translation_text:
1Ka Elihu nan kpɛn ken tuonnɛ yɛt ye,
2“Ma'ami fʋ mɛŋ bi'ela nwa'
ka m naae Wina'am mɔr si'el ye m yɛlif la.
3Man ya'am la zu'onɛ galis;
alazug m na kɛ ka fʋ baŋ Wina'am onɛ maalim la yɛla
ye o anɛ pʋpiel ka tʋm linɛ nar.
4Baŋim sʋ'ʋŋa ye man yɛtif si'el la, ziri ka' li nii;
man kanɛ zi'e fʋ tuon nwa' anɛ onɛ mɔr baŋir pamm.
5Wina'am anɛ paŋ sɔb, amaa o pʋ ziemid sɔ'ɔsɔ.
O mɔr paŋ tita'ar ka o ya'a gban'e si'el o na maali li ka bi'esʋg kae.
6O pʋ kɛt ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim nyɔvʋr wa'ama,
ka lɛɛ tisid banɛ namisid la bʋʋd.
7Wina'am pʋ yisid o nif pʋpielim dim nii;
o dʋ'ʋsidi ba ka ba zin' nɛ na'anam,
ka kɛt ka ba an girima dim saŋa linɛ ka' naarɛ.
8Amaa ba ya'a ti lɔ saalib nɛ bana,
ka ba bɛ namistita'ar pʋʋgin,
9o nied ban tʋm si'el la pa'annɛ ba,
ka kɛt ka ba baŋid ye li anɛ ban tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka mɔr nyɛɛsim la zug.
10O kɛt ka ba baŋid ban gbɛlig si'em,
ka yɛti ba nɛ nimmua ye ba tiakim ka sɔs suguru ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd zug.
11Ba ya'a siak ka lɛb na dɔl o,
o niŋidi ba zug yɛlsʋm ba nyɔvʋr bɛllim wʋsa,
ka ba bɛ nɛ sumalisim, hali nɛ ba kum dabisir.
12Amaa ba ya'a zan'as ka pʋ kɛlisɛ,
ba na kʋʋ ba nɛ zaba sʋ'ʋs,
ka ba kpi yɔri-yɔri.
13Banɛ pʋ niŋ Wina'am yadda la mɔri sʋnpɛɛn saŋa wʋsa,
hali o ya'a ba'a ba nɛ bana, ba kʋ sɔs o ka o sʋŋi baa.
14Ba kpiidnɛ ka ba daar nam pʋ paae,
ba naar wʋsa anɛ nyan nɛ zufa'asim.
15Wina'am dɔlisidnɛ namisʋg pʋʋgin faand banɛ bɛ namisʋgʋn la,
namisʋg saŋa ka o pa'annɛ ba ya'am.
16Wina'am mɔrif nɛ baanlimm yis yɛla ni na,
ka mɔri fʋ keŋ zin'ikanɛ ka yɛlpakir kae,
ka li anɛ diib nɛ nuub ma'aa.
17Amaa nannanna fʋ di'e sariakadib linɛ nar nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim la,
sariakadib linɛ an yɛlsida la na gban'af.
18Gu'usim ka da kɛ ka sɔ' pan'asif nɛ o mɔrimm;
da kɛ ka ba zaŋ kpan'am kpɛn'ɛsif mɔɔgɔ.
19Fʋ tɛn'ɛs ye fʋ mɔrim bɛɛ fʋ mɛŋ-mɛŋ paŋ
na nyaŋi yisif yɛla nii?
20Da mɔr ti'ir ye yʋ'ʋŋ sɔb
ka fʋ vɛ' nidibi yisi ba, ba yaanɛ.
21Mid ka fʋ lɛb tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdin;
fʋ namisʋg la anɛ li gu'uf ka fʋ da lɛb tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdinɛ.
22Gɔsima, Wina'am paŋ la ka' tiraana.
Anɔ'ɔnɛ an pa'annɛ nwɛnɛ on an si'em la?
23Anɔ'ɔnɛ na tun'e pa'al o linɛ nara
bɛɛ yɛl o ye, ‘Fʋ gbɛlig ya!’
24Tiɛnm ka zun'e o nu'ugʋ tʋm si'el la
linɛ ka saalib yʋ'ʋm ka pian'ad saŋa wʋsa la.
25Sɔ' wʋsa nyɛ Wina'am tʋʋma la;
amaa ba nyɛɛ li nɛ lalli sa.
26Ya'a an sida, Wina'am galis nɛ hali
ka ti kʋ nyaŋi baŋ on zem si'em!
O yʋma ka' bɛnnɛ.
27Onɛ kɛt ka ku'om yit teŋgbauŋ zugʋ
dʋt agɔla kilim saa niid.
28O kɛt ka saŋgbana la kpa'ad saa
ka li nii tiig teŋ wʋsa.
29Anɔ'ɔnɛ na tun'e baŋ on niŋ si'em yadigid saŋgbana la,
bɛɛ satansʋg la tansidi dammidi
yit agɔl zin'ikanɛ ka o bɛ la?
30Gɔsim on kɛ ka saa iank agɔl pililili si'em,
ka atɛuk pʋʋgin lɛɛ an lik biridi.
31On gur buudi wʋsa si'em nwa'.
O kɛt ka saa niid ka zʋʋd maan,
ka saalib nyɛt diib bɛdegʋ dit.
32Onɛ mɔr sa-ian'asʋg la paŋ
ka on bɔɔd ye li kpa' zin'isi'a la, ani ka li ken.
33Saa ya'a ti tans, li pa'an ye sisi'etita'ari na dɔl;
hali niigi mɛ mi' ye li kenna.

english_text:
Elihu Continues
I Am Frightened
1I am frightened
and tremble all over,
2when I hear the roaring voice
of God in the thunder,
3and when I see his lightning
flash across the sky.
4God's majestic voice
thunders his commands,
5creating miracles too marvelous
for us to understand.
6Snow and heavy rainstorms
7make us stop and think
about God's power,
8and they force animals
to seek shelter.
9The windstorms of winter strike,
10and the breath of God
freezes streams and rivers.
11Rain clouds filled with lightning
appear at God's command,
12traveling across the sky
13to release their cargo—
sometimes as punishment for sin,
sometimes as kindness.
Consider Carefully
14Job, consider carefully
the many wonders of God.
15Can you explain why lightning
flashes at the orders
16of God who knows all things?
Or how he hangs the clouds
in empty space?
17You almost melt in the heat
of fierce desert winds
when the sky is like brass.
18God can hammer out the clouds
in spite of the oppressive heat,
but can you?
19Tell us what to say to God!
Our minds are in the dark,
and we don't know how
to argue our case.
20Should I risk my life
by telling God
that I want to speak?
21No one can stare at the sun
after a breeze has blown
the clouds from the sky.
22Yet the glorious splendor
of God All-Powerful
is brighter by far.
23God cannot be seen—
but his power is great,
and he is always fair.
24And so we humans fear God,
because he shows no respect
for those who are proud
and think they know so much.
translation_text:
1“Elihu da tʋgisi yɛl ye
“Nɛ'ɛŋa kɛnɛ ka m ya'am iank
ka m pʋʋg wʋsa bɔŋim.
2Kɛlisimi, kɛlisim on tansid si'em
ka wʋm o nɔɔri pian'ad ka li dammid si'em.
3O kɛ ka saa iank agɔla
hali ti tiig zin'ig wʋsa.
4Lin nya'aŋ ka ti wʋm o tansʋg la;
o tansʋg la anɛ linɛ mɔr paŋ nɛ girima.
O tansʋg la nya'aŋ,
si'el kae na nyaŋi gu'oe paŋ tita'ar la.
5Wina'am tansʋg mɔr nyalima.
O tʋm tʋʋm titada ka ti kʋ nyaŋi gban'e li gbinnɛ.
6O yɛt sakuga ye, ‘Lummi teŋgbauŋ la zug,’
ka yɛt saa ye, ‘Niim sakʋdʋg ka li pʋbid teŋgbauŋʋn la.’
7O gu'od ninsaalib wʋsa ba tʋʋma ni,
ala ka nidib wʋsa na baŋ o tʋʋma an si'em.
8Ka bʋnkɔnbid mɛ bɔɔd su'asa zin'ig;
ba zɔtnɛ kpɛn'ɛd zin'ikanɛ ka saa kʋ bʋ' baa.
9Sisi'etita'ar la yitnɛ ya-dagɔbʋg na,
ka waad linɛ ma'ad sim-sim la yit ya-datiuŋ na.
10Wina'am vʋ'ʋsʋm kɛtnɛ ka ku'om ga'aŋ nwɛnɛ kugir nɛ
hali ka ku'otitada lieb wʋʋ tampiing nɛ.
11O kɛt ka saŋgbana pɛ'ɛl nɛ ku'om,
ka kɛt ka saa ian'asid pil-pil saŋgbana la ni.
12Onɛ kɛt ka saŋgbana yadigi gilig teŋgbauŋ la wʋsa
ka dɔlisid on zi'eli li si'em la.
Li sid maan on gban'e ye ba maal si'el wʋsa.
13O tun'e tʋm saa na
ka li namis saalibi ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd zug,
ka mɛ tun'e kɛ ka saa nii maal zʋʋd
ka li pa'al on an sʋ'ʋm si'em.
14Job, kɛlisim nɛ'ɛŋa sʋ'ʋŋa;
an baanlimm ka gɔs Wina'am tʋʋmnyalima an si'em.
15Fʋ mi' Wina'am niŋ si'em kɛt ka saŋgbana bɛi,
bɛɛ on kɛt ka saa ian'asidi li pʋʋgin si'em laa?
16Fʋ mi' lin niŋ si'em ka saŋgbana yul agɔlaa,
li ka'anɛ Wina'am tʋʋmnyalimaa?
17Fʋn kanɛ ka pɛbistʋʋlʋg ya'a ɛɛn naan ya-dagɔbʋg na
ka ɔnsir di'e fʋ fuug matti la
18na tun'e sʋŋ Wina'am yadig saŋgbauŋ,
ka kɛ ka li kpi'em ka ian'ad nwɛnɛ gɔtiŋɔɔ?
19Pa'alimi ti tinamɛ na yɛl Wina'am si'el;
bɔzugɔ ti nɔɔr kpari ka ti zi' tinamɛ na yɛl o si'ela,
ka li anɛ tinamɛ bɛ likin biridi la yɛla.
20Man kʋ siak ye m pian' tis Wina'am;
bɔ ka m kɛt ka o ti san'amidim yɔri-yɔri?
21Sɔ' kae na tun'e gɔs winnig
linɛ nie nyain saŋgbauŋin la.
Li kas-kas anɛ sisi'em ya'a ti da'ae
ka pɛbisim la pie uusʋg la ka li maligim nie nyain.
22O naan ya-datiuŋʋ kenna ka ian'asid pil-pil wʋʋ sanlim nɛ;
Wina'am la kenna nɛ o na'am pipilim.
23Wina'am Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar sɔb la bɛ lalli sa
ka sɔ' kae na tun'e paae o san'anɛ;
asida o paŋ la gat si'el wʋsa.
O anɛ sida nɛ pʋpielim sɔb,
ka pʋ mugusid sɔ'ɔsɔ.
24Alazug ka saalib woo na'asid o.
O mɛ pʋm pʋ gɔsi nyɛ banɛ ye ba anɛ ya'am dim laa.”

english_text:
The Lord Speaks
From Out of a Storm
1From out of a storm,
the Lord said to Job:
2Why do you talk so much
when you know so little?
3Now get ready to face me!
Can you answer
the questions I ask?
4How did I lay the foundation
for the earth?
Were you there?
5Doubtless you know who decided
its length and width.
6What supports the foundation?
Who placed the cornerstone,
7 while morning stars sang,
and angels rejoiced?
8 When the ocean was born,
I set its boundaries
9and wrapped it in blankets
of thickest fog.
10Then I built a wall around it,
locked the gates, 11and said,
“Your powerful waves stop here!
They can go no farther.”
Did You Ever Tell the Sun To Rise?
12Did you ever tell the sun to rise?
And did it obey?
13Did it take hold of the earth
and shake out the wicked
like dust from a rug?
14Early dawn outlines the hills
like stitches on clothing
or sketches on clay.
15But its light is too much
for those who are evil,
and their power is broken.
16Job, have you ever walked
on the ocean floor?
17Have you seen the gate
to the world of the dead?
18And how large is the earth?
Tell me, if you know!
19Where is the home of light,
and where does darkness live?
20Can you lead them home?
21I'm certain you must be able to,
since you were already born
when I created everything.
22Have you been to the places
where I keep snow and hail,
23until I use them to punish
and conquer nations?
24From where does lightning leap,
or the east wind blow?
25Who carves out a path
for thunderstorms?
Who sends torrents of rain
26on empty deserts
where no one lives?
27Rain that changes barren land
to meadows green with grass.
28Who is the father of the dew
and of the rain?
29Who gives birth to the sleet
and the frost
30that fall in winter,
when streams and lakes
freeze solid as a rock?
Can You Arrange Stars?
31 Can you arrange stars in groups
such as Orion
and the Pleiades?
32Do you control the stars
or set in place the Big Dipper
and the Little Dipper?
33Do you know the laws
that govern the heavens,
and can you make them rule
the earth?
34Can you order the clouds
to send a downpour,
35or will lightning flash
at your command?
36Did you teach birds to know
that rain or floods
are on their way?
37Can you count the clouds
or pour out their water
38on the dry, lumpy soil?
39When lions are hungry,
do you help them hunt?
40Do you send an animal
into their den?
41And when starving young ravens
cry out to me for food,
do you satisfy their hunger?
translation_text:
Zugsɔb la gandig Job
1Ka Zugsɔb la naan sisi'etita'arin la lɛbis Job ye,
2“Fʋ aan anɔ'ɔnɛ bi'esid ya'am pian'ad nɛ pian'ayɛɛd
ka mɛ an onɛ zi' si'ela?
3Gban'ami fʋ mɛŋ nwɛnɛ bʋraa nɛ
ka m bu'osif bu'osa,
ka fʋ gandigim.
4Man da ɛɛnb teŋgbauŋ la, fʋ da bɛ yaanɛ?
Fʋ ya'a gban'e li gbin fʋn lɛbisimim!
5Anɔ'ɔnɛ maki li yalʋŋʋ zem si'em? Mɛ fʋ pʋn mi'!
Anɔ'ɔnɛ zaŋ nwiigi maki li labisim zem si'em?
6Teŋgbauŋ la ɛɛnbir la sʋn'e bɔ zugɔ,
bɛɛ anɔ'ɔnɛ ba'a li ɛɛnbir kuga la,
7saŋkanɛ ka bɛogʋn nwadbibis yʋ'ʋm wʋʋ saalib
ka maliaknam tansid nɛ sumalisim la?
8 Atɛuk ku'om da tansi yi teŋgbauŋʋn na
nwɛnɛ biig ka ba du'ad si'em la,
anɔ'ɔnɛ da nyaŋi yɔɔ li
wʋʋ ban kparid dɔɔg si'em la?
9Manɛ da nɔk saŋgbana pil atɛuk la,
ka bɔbigi li nɛ lik linɛ an biridi la.
10Saŋkan la m da bia' bi'ena ka li gu' li,
ka maal kʋlis nɛ kʋnt gama kpɛn'ɛsi ba.
11Ka yʋ'ʋn yɛl ye, ‘Fʋ tun'e pʋbigi paae kpɛ', amaa da gaadɛ;
fʋ ku'opila banɛ dʋt agɔla la bɛnnɛ nwa'.’
Anɔ'ɔnɛ da kɛ ka li wʋsa niŋɛ?
Li ka'anɛ manɛɛ?
12Job, fʋ biilimin sa, fʋ nan mi' kɛ ka bɛog nie,
bɛɛ pa'al sɔɔnrim la li bɛllim zin'igaa?
13Fʋ nan mi' yɛl nɛɛsim ye li tansim tiig dunia la wʋsa
ka kɛ ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim yii ba suak zin'isin naa?
14Nɛɛsim ya'a tans, teŋgbauŋ niednɛ nyain
ka zuoya nɛ bɔn'ɔd wʋsa nie nwɛnɛ fuug nɛ.
15Li kɛtnɛ ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim kʋ mɔr nɛɛsim,
ka kɛt ka ba pʋ lɛn nyaŋidi zabida.
16Fʋ nan mi' keŋ zin'ikanɛ ka atɛuk ku'om yit naa,
bɛɛ vɛɛnsi baŋ dinɛ bɛɛ atɛuk pʋʋginɛ an lik biridi la?
17Ba nan mi' pa'alif kum za'anɔɔrɛɛ?
Fʋ nan mi' nyɛ kpi'im teŋ kʋlisɛɛ?
18Fʋ mi' teŋgbauŋ la yalʋŋʋ paae si'em?
Fʋ ya'a mi' nɛ'ɛnam wʋsa, fʋn yɛlimim!
19Fʋ mi' nɛɛsim la yit si'el naa,
bɛɛ fʋ baŋ liki naanid si'eli kenna?
20Fʋ na tun'e mɔri ba lɛbis ban yi zin'isi'a naa?
Fʋ mi' suokanɛ ka ba dɔlli kunnaa?
21Fʋ na yɛl ye fʋ mi' wae, mɛ saŋkan sa ka ba pʋn du'a fɔ!
Waii, fʋ yuug ya woo!
22Fʋ nan mi' kpɛn' sakuga dɔɔginɛɛ?
Bɛɛ fʋ mi' nyɛ ba suak zin'iga?
23Manɛ digil sakuga ani gur yɛltɔɔd saŋa,
nɛ dabisbanɛ ka zaba nɛ tanp na li la.
24Suobɔ ka saa ɛɛn dɔlli ianki widig zin'ig wʋsa?
Sisi'em ɛɛn niŋ wala yit ya-nya'aŋ na widigi tiig teŋgbauŋ la?
25Anɔ'ɔnɛ maal ku'osuor ka satitada dɔlisid ani niid,
ka maal suor ka sisi'etita'ar nɛ satansʋg yit na?
26Hali ka niid teŋ kanɛ ka saalib kae
ka mɛ niid pipirisin zin'ikanɛ ka sɔ'ɔsɔ kae.
27Ka anɔ'ɔnɛ dɔn'ɔsid teŋ kanɛ kʋdig bar-bar la
ka kɛt ka mɔma'asa yit na?
28Saa mɔr saammaa?
Ka mɛligim mɔr ba'a?
29Sakuga yinɛ pu'a pʋʋgin naa?
Anɔ'ɔnɛ du'a mɛligim linɛ yi agɔl na ka ma'ad sim-sim la?
30Ka kɛt ka ku'om ga'aŋi kpɛ'ɛŋ wʋʋ kugir nɛ
ka atɛuk zugin ga'aŋi lieb wʋʋ tampiinga?
31 Fʋ na nyaŋi la'as nwadbibis banɛ bɛ saŋgbana teŋsʋk la bɔbigɛɛ,
bɛɛ idig nwadbibis banɛ yʋ'ʋri buon Nɔnya'aŋ-nɛ-o-biis la basɛ?
32Fʋ na tun'e kɛ ka nwadbibis la yi saŋkanɛ ka fʋ bɔɔd,
bɛɛ pa'al nwadbibis banɛ yʋ'ʋri buonnɛ A-kidigim-bu'os la ban na keŋ zin'isi'aa?
33Fʋ mi' wada banɛ gɔsid saŋgbana laa,
ka fʋ na tun'e kɛ ka wada bama tʋm teŋgbauŋ nwa' zugɔɔ?
34Fʋ na tun'e tansi yɛl saŋgbana,
ka saa ni hali ka ku'om la gɛɛli fɔɔ?
35Fʋ na tun'e tʋm sa-ian'asʋg ka li tʋm fʋn bɔɔd si'el,
ka lɛb na yɛlif ye, ‘Tinamɛ nwana’?
36Anɔ'ɔnɛ nɔk ya'am tis saal
bɛɛ tis nidib pʋtɛn'ɛr ka ba bakid yɛla?
37Anɔ'ɔnɛ mɔr ya'am hali na tun'e kaal saŋgbana,
bɛɛ gbɛlig yʋya banɛ bɛ saazug la kpa'ae ku'om la bas na?
38Ka li kɛ ka uusʋg la'asi kpɛ'ɛŋ wʋʋ kugir,
ka titan la'asi an gammire?
39-40Gbigima ya'a su'a ba buuginɛ
gur ye bʋnkɔnbid gat ka ba gban'e,
fʋ na nyaŋi gban'e tisi ba
ka ba ɔnbi tigɛɛ?
41Agaung biis ya'a ɛɛnti kaasidi buon Wina'am
ka ginnɛ ieed diibɔ,
anɔ'ɔnɛ bɔɔd diibi tisidi ba?”

english_text:
The Lord Continues
When Do Mountain Goats Give Birth?
1When do mountain goats
and deer give birth?
Have you been there
when their young are born?
* 2How long are they pregnant
3before they deliver?
4Soon their young grow strong
and then leave
to be on their own.
5Who set wild donkeys free?
6I alone help them survive
in salty desert sand.
7They stay far from crowded cities
and refuse to be tamed.
8Instead, they roam the hills,
searching for pastureland.
9Would a wild ox agree
to live in your barn
and labor for you?
10Could you force him to plow
or to drag a heavy log
to smooth out the soil?
11Can you depend on him
to use his great strength
and do your heavy work?
12Can you trust him
to harvest your grain
or take it to your barn
from the threshing place?
An Ostrich Proudly Flaps Her Wings
13An ostrich proudly
flaps her wings,
but not because
she loves her young.
14She abandons her eggs
and lets the dusty ground
keep them warm.
15And she doesn't seem to worry
that the feet of an animal
could crush them all.
16She treats her eggs as though
they were not her own,
unconcerned that her work
might be for nothing.
17I myself made her foolish
and without common sense.
18But once she starts running,
she laughs at a rider
on the fastest horse.
Did You Give Horses Their Strength?
19Did you give horses their strength
and the flowing hair
along their necks?
20Did you make them able
to jump like grasshoppers
or to frighten people
with their snorting?
21Before horses are ridden
into battle,
they paw at the ground,
proud of their strength.
22Laughing at fear, they rush
toward the fighting,
23while the weapons of their riders
rattle and flash in the sun.
24Unable to stand still,
they gallop eagerly into battle
when trumpets blast.
25Stirred by the distant smells
and sounds of war, they snort
in reply to the trumpet.
26Did you teach hawks to fly south
for the winter?
* 27Did you train eagles to build
28their nests on rocky cliffs,
29where they can look down
to spot their next meal?
30 Then their young gather to feast
wherever the victim lies.
translation_text:
1Ka Wina'am lɛn yɛl Job ye,
“Fʋ mi' saŋkanɛ ka sian'arin bʋʋs du'adaa?
Fʋ nif nan mi' nyɛ ka walig du'ad o biisɛɛ?
2Fʋ mi' ban nɔkid pʋʋg nwadis si'em ka du'adaa?
Fʋ mi' saŋa kanɛ ka ba du'adi baa?
3Ba ɛɛnti iginɛ ka du'a ba biis
ka zabir la naae.
4Ba biis la nɔbigidnɛ ka kpɛ'ɛŋid tɔ'ɔtɔ;
ba ya'a kpɛ'ɛŋi naae, ba zɔtnɛ ka basidi ba ma.
5Anɔ'ɔnɛ kɛ ka mɔɔgin bʋmis gɔɔndi ba ya'aminɛ?
Anɔ'ɔnɛ idigi ba basɛ?
6Manɛ tisi ba teŋ kanɛ ka nidib kae ka li an pipirig la,
ka ye zin'ig kanɛ ka mɔɔd pʋ yit la na aan ba bɛllim zin'ig.
7Ba pʋ wʋm tempʋʋgin tʋkpiidʋg
bɛɛ kɛlis nidibi tansidi ba bʋmis ka mugusidi ba si'em laa.
8Ba gɔɔndnɛ zuoya zuti ieed yam,
ba ieednɛ yamma'asa zin'ig wʋsa.
9Wɛnaaf na siak ka fʋ lɔɔ o kuaa?
O pʋn na siaki kpɛn' fʋ gariki nii?
10Fʋ na nyaŋi niŋ o yu'asin ka o vɛ'ɛg kuunrɛɛ?
O na siaki nwɛ' fʋ bɔn'ɔgʋ tisi fɔɔ?
11Fʋ na yɛl ye on mɔr paŋ la zug,
fʋ na pɛsigi fʋ kuobu tis o ka o kuaa?
12Fʋ tɛn'ɛs ka o na siaki zii fʋ ki pɔɔgin
bɛɛ zi kibielim zieŋin naa?
13Niiŋtita'asi'a bɛ pipirigin sa;
o ya'a bɔɔd on nwɛ'ɛm o kpʋkpama si'em,
amaa o kʋ nyaŋi mak nɛ silʋg kpʋkpama linɛ ian'ad laa.
14O nyɛ'ɛd o gɛla digin teŋin
ka kɛ ka titanbin'isʋg tʋligidi ba.
15O ba'a kae ye sɔ' na tun'e nɔɔ ba
bɛɛ bʋnkɔnbid na tun'e nɔɔ ba nwa'ae.
16O maannɛ o biis nɛ yɔri-yɔri nwɛnɛ ba ka' o biisɛ,
o ba'a kae ye o tʋʋma la na an yɔrii.
17Linɛ kɛ la, Wina'am pʋ tis o ya'am,
bɛɛ kɛ ka o mi' linɛ an sʋ'ʋm.
18Amaa o ya'a lak o kpʋkpama ye o zɔ kpɛla,
wiedban'ad nɛ o wief wʋsa kʋ li'el oo.
19Fʋnɛ tis wief paŋaa?
Bɛɛ kɛ ka o niŋgɔɔnrin gbɛɛnd la sɔbig liŋ-liŋ laa?
20Fʋnɛ kɛ ka o ian'ad wʋʋ sisɔm
ka sin'im ka dabiem gban'ad nidib laa?
21O dɛɛdnɛ hali ka li mɔr dabiem, ka pa'annɛ o paŋ
saŋkanɛ ka o dammid ka ian'ad zaba bɔn'ɔgin la.
22O zi' dabiem an si'ela
ka mɛ pʋ zɔt zaba sʋ'ʋgɔ.
23Lɔk kanɛ ka ba suud piema la dammid o lʋga ni,
hali ka kpana ian'ad fiaʋn-fiaʋn.
24Zaba na'atan ya'a ti pieb, o pʋ lɛn tun'e gban'ad o mɛŋa,
o zɔtnɛ ki'ed teŋ la parigid-parigid ka uusʋg duod.
25Na'atan ya'a ti pieb, o sin'imnɛ,
ka pʋn wʋm zaba nyuug lalli sa,
hali nɛ zaba tuongatib la kuŋ.
26Silʋgʋ ɛɛnti iank ka yadig o kpʋkpama kpa'ad ya-dagɔbʋg la,
fʋ baŋiri ɛɛn tis o ya'am ka o ian'adaa?
27Fʋnɛ ɛɛn tis silʋg nɔɔr ka o ianki dʋʋ agɔla sa
ye o tɛɛ o tɛog laa?
28O tɛɛdi li nɛ zuorin tampinkanɛ wa'am la zug,
anina ka o gbɛɛnd ka si'el kʋ paae oo.
29Anina ka o ɛɛn gɔs kii
ka nyɛti o diib hali lalli sa.
30 O biis diib anɛ ziim ma'aa
dinzug, bʋnkpiilima bɛ si'el la, o bɛ nɛ anina.”

english_text:
The Lord Continues
I Am the Lord All-Powerful
* 1I am the Lord All-Powerful,
2but you have argued
that I am wrong.
Now you must answer me.
3Job said to the Lord:
4Who am I to answer you?
5I did speak once or twice,
but never again.
6Then out of the storm
the Lord said to Job:
7Face me and answer
the questions I ask!
8Are you trying to prove
that you are innocent
by accusing me of injustice?
9Do you have a powerful arm
and a thundering voice
that compare with mine?
10If so, then surround yourself
with glory and majesty.
* 11Show your furious anger!
Throw down and crush
12all who are proud and evil.
13Wrap them in grave clothes
and bury them together
in the dusty soil.
14Do this, and I will agree
that you have won
this argument.
I Created You
15I created both you
and the hippopotamus.
It eats only grass like an ox,
16but look at the mighty muscles
in its body 17and legs.
Its tail is like a cedar tree,
and its thighs are thick.
18The bones in its legs
are like bronze or iron.
19I made it more powerful
than any other creature,
yet I am stronger still.
20Undisturbed, it eats grass
while the other animals
play nearby.
* 21It rests in the shade of trees
along the riverbank
22or hides among reeds
in the swamp.
23It remains calm and unafraid
with the Jordan River rushing
and splashing in its face.
24There is no way to capture
a hippopotamus—
not even by hooking its nose
or blinding its eyes.
translation_text:
1Ka Zugsɔb la yɛl Job ya'as ye,
2“Fʋn kanɛ nwa'asid nɛ mam Wina'am Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar sɔb la
na nyaŋi pa'alim man gbɛlig lɔsi'a?
Fʋn kanɛ fiied Wina'am la, gandigim!”
3Ka Job lɛbis Zugsɔb la ye,
4“Man aan anɔ'ɔnɛ na tun'e gandisidi fɔ?
Mam nɔki m nu'usi pin' m nɔɔr baanlimm.
5M pʋn pian' nɔɔrin babiga m kʋ lɛm pian' ya'asɛ,
m pʋn kʋ lɛn yɛl si'ela.”
6Ka Zugsɔb naam sisi'etita'arin la na pian' tis Job ye,
7“Gban'ami fʋ mɛŋ kimm wʋʋ dau nɛ
ka m bu'osif bu'osa ka fʋ gandigim.
8Fʋ bɔɔdi pa'al ye man ka' sida sɔbaa?
Fʋ bɔɔd ye fʋ zɛrig man ka lɛɛ tisi fʋ mɛŋ bʋʋdɛɛ?
9Fʋ paŋ paae Wina'am paŋaa?
Ka fʋ na tun'e tans ka fʋ kʋkɔr vuud wʋʋ o kʋkɔrɛ?
10Alaa, duom zi'en ka pa'ali fʋ girima nɛ fʋ vɛnlim an si'em,
pa'alimi fʋ na'am pipilim nɛ fʋ gandaalim.
11Kɛl ka fʋ sʋnpɛɛn duoe nɛ nyɛɛsim dim,
ka sie ba, ka ba lieb zaalim.
12Gbɛɛnlim banɛ dʋ'ʋsidi ba mɛŋ la
ka kɛ ka ba lɛbi sig teŋ,
ka nwɛ' tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim la bas ban zi'e si'el la vuguri.
13La'asimi ba wʋsa pin' teŋin;
ka kpari ba bas kpi'im teŋ.
14Ala ka m na baŋ ka siak ye
fʋ sid na tun'e faaɛn fʋ mɛŋ.
15Gɔsim Bʋnkɔnbid Na'ab la zem si'em;
manɛ maal o ka mɛ maalif,
amaa ka o ɔnbid mɔɔd wʋʋ naaf nɛ.
16O paŋ bɛ nɛ o sien,
ka giinl kpi'ema bɛɛ o pʋʋrin.
17O zʋʋr yibisidnɛ nwɛnɛ na'aziinr nɛ,
ka o gbɛgiinla kpɛn' kiŋ-kiŋ.
18O kɔnba kpi'emnɛ wʋʋ kʋntzɛn'ug nɛ,
ka o gbɛya kpi'em wʋʋ kʋnt nɛ.
19Onɛ an bʋntita'ar kanɛ ka Wina'am da dɛŋi maal;
ka Wina'am ma'aa na tun'e li'el o nɛ zaba sʋ'ʋg.
20On ɔnbid yam sieba bɛ nɛ zuoya ni,
zin'ikanɛ ka mɔɔgin bʋnkɔnbid gɔɔndi giligid la.
21O dignɛ kɔldaugin tiis teŋir,
zin'ikanɛ ka kɔlkantima duoe an limm la.
22Kɔldaug nɔɔrin tiis la tisid o ma'asim
ka kɔlkantima la gilig o.
23Joodan kɔldaug ya'a bɔɔd lin pɛ'ɛlim si'em
ka ku'om la kpɛn'ɛd o nɔɔrin nɛ kpi'euŋ si'em,
la'an nɛ wala o pʋ zɔt dabiem.
24Anɔ'ɔnɛ na nyaŋi puns o nini ka gban'e o?
Anɔ'ɔnɛ na nyaŋi zaŋ gu'a kʋns o nyɔnya?”

english_text:
The Lord Continues
Can You Catch a Sea Monster?
1 Can you catch a sea monster
by using a fishhook?
Can you tie its mouth shut
with a rope?
2Can it be led around
by a ring in its nose
or a hook in its jaw?
3Will it beg for mercy?
4Will it surrender
as a slave for life?
5Can it be tied by the leg
like a pet bird
for little girls?
6Is it ever chopped up
and its pieces bargained for
in the fish-market?
7Can it be killed
with harpoons or spears?
8Wrestle it just once—
that will be the end.
9Merely a glimpse of this monster
makes all courage melt.
10And if it is too fierce
for anyone to attack,
who would dare oppose me?
11I am in command of the world
and in debt to no one.
12What powerful legs,
what a stout body
this monster possesses!
13Who could strip off its armor
or bring it under control
with a harness?
14Who would try to open its jaws,
full of fearsome teeth?
* 15Its back is covered
with shield after shield,
16firmly bound and closer together
17than breath to breath.
When This Monster Sneezes
18When this monster sneezes,
lightning flashes, and its eyes
glow like the dawn.
19Sparks and fiery flames
explode from its mouth.
20And smoke spews from its nose
like steam
from a boiling pot,
21while its blazing breath
scorches everything in sight.
22Its neck is so tremendous
that everyone trembles,
23the weakest parts of its body
are harder than iron,
24and its heart is stone.
25When this noisy monster appears,
even the most powerful
turn and run in fear.
26No sword or spear can harm it,
27and weapons of bronze or iron
are as useless as straw
or rotten wood.
28Rocks thrown from a sling
cause it no more harm
than husks of grain.
This monster fears no arrows,
29it simply smiles at spears,
and striking it with a stick
is like slapping it with straw.
30As it crawls through the mud,
its sharp and spiny hide
tears the ground apart.
31And when it swims down deep,
the sea starts churning
like boiling oil,
32and it leaves behind a trail
of shining white foam.
33No other creature on earth
is so fearless.
34It is king of all proud creatures,
and it looks upon the others
as nothing.
translation_text:
1Ka Zugsɔb la lɛm bu'os Job ye,
Fʋ na nyaŋi tɛɛg bandaug nɛ gu'a yis ku'omin
bɛɛ lɔɔ o nɔɔr nɛ nwiigaa?
2Fʋ na nyaŋi vʋdig o nyɔnya ka kpɛn'ɛs nwiig
bɛɛ zaŋ gu'a kʋns o yierɛɛ?
3Bandaug la na bɛlimif ye fʋ zɔɔ o nimbaanligaa?
O na fabil ka nwɛ'ɛf nu'ugɔɔ?
4O na siak ka fʋn nɛ on maal nɔnaar
ye o liebi fʋ yammʋg hali o nyɔvʋr bɛn wʋsaa?
5Fʋ na gban'e o mɔri wʋʋ niiŋe fʋ yin
bɛɛ maal o wʋʋ di'ema bʋn ka fʋ yampu'ab gɔsidaa?
6Ziiŋku'osidib na dii o da'aa?
Ba na pʋdig oo tis ziiŋda'adibaa?
7Fʋ na tun'e tɔɔn o nɛ kpana,
bɛɛ vʋdig o zug nɛ ziiŋtɔɔndib piema?
8Fʋ ya'a si'is o nɔɔr yinne,
fʋ kʋ lɛn paasɛ.
9Pʋn da tɛn'ɛs ye fʋ na tun'e niŋ o si'ela,
fʋ ya'a pʋn nyɛɛ o nɛ nif, fʋ giinla kɛnsidnɛ.
10Sɔ' kae mɔr sʋnkpi'euŋ hali na tun'e dam oo.
Li daan bɛ yaa na tun'e zi'en o tuonnɛ?
11Anɔ'ɔn lɛɛ na tun'e lud o ka tiligɛ?
Dunia nwa' wʋsa, sɔ' kae na mak oo.
12M pʋn pʋ lɛn yɛt o gbɛya nɛ o paŋi
galis si'em nɛ on vɛnl si'em.
13Anɔ'ɔn lɛɛ na tun'e tɛɛgi fulig o gbauŋɔ?
Bɛɛ pʋn nyaŋi li'el o nɛ salibir ye o li'a o?
14Anɔ'ɔnɛ na tun'e wɛ'ɛg o nɔɔri ya'ae
ka nyɛɛ o nyina banɛ kpɛn'ɛsid nidib dabiem la?
15O nya'aŋ gbana la anɛ muula-muula wʋʋ pien ka ba tɔ'ɔŋi sɛn' nɛ.
16Ba gban'e nɛ taaba kiŋ-kiŋ hali
ka pɛbisim gba kʋ nyaŋi kpɛn'.
17Ba tɔ'ɔŋ nɛ taaba kimm,
ka li tɔi pamm nɛ sɔ' na nyaŋi wɛligi ba.
18O ya'a tɛnsim li nwɛnɛ bugum nɛ ian'asidi yit na;
ka o nini mu'oe wʋʋ nintaŋi tansid bɛogʋn nɛ.
19Bugum pielim yit o nɔɔrin na;
li ian'adnɛ pidʋ-pidʋ.
20Ka nyɔ'ɔs yiti o nyɔnya ni us-us
wʋʋ dʋk ka ba dʋgʋl bugumin ka li kɔt ka walim yitnɛ.
21O ya'a vʋ'ʋs, bugumsaana la'aŋid nɛ bugum,
ka bugum yit o nɔɔrin na pidʋ-pidʋ.
22Paŋ ma'aa pɛ'ɛli o niŋgɔɔnr;
ka o zin'ig wʋsa mɔr dabiem.
23O niŋgbiŋ gban'anɛ kimm,
li kpi'emnɛ kaŋ-kaŋ ka sɔ' kʋ tun'e dammi li.
24O sʋnf kpi'emnɛ nwɛnɛ kugir nɛ,
li kpi'emnɛ wʋʋ nɛɛr nɛ.
25O ya'a duoe zi'en, paŋ dim kiridi nɛ dabiem;
ba zɔtnɛ lɛbid nya'aŋ hali ka o nam pʋ zab nɛ baa.
26Ba ya'a zaŋ zaba sʋ'ʋgʋ kʋns o, li kʋ niŋ o si'ela;
hali baa ba ya'a kʋns o nɛ piema bɛɛ kpanaa li kʋ niŋ o si'ela.
27Kʋnt nwɛnɛ kikan'a o san'an,
ka kʋntzɛn'ug nwɛnɛ dapɔn'ɔnsa tis o.
28Piema kʋ tun'e kad o ka o zɔɔ;
ka luobkugir mɛ nwɛnɛ udugu o san'an.
29Balaar nwɛnɛ kikan'ari tis o.
Ba ya'a nwɛ' o kpan ka li dammid, li kpɛn'ɛsidi o nɛ la'ad.
30O pʋʋr la anɛ pa'ad pa'adi,
ka o ya'a vuugi o mɛŋ bian'ar zug
li maannɛ bʋmbɔk wʋʋ na'avuk nɛ.
31O kɛt ka ku'ozulima la dammid
wʋʋ ku'om bɛ bugumini lɛ'ɛgid nɛ
ka kɛt ka mu'a ku'om nwɛnɛ dʋkʋn kpaam nɛ.
32O ya'a lugid, pumpuum fukid nɛ
pɛlig wʋʋ zuobpielim nɛ.
33O tiraan kae teŋgbauŋ zugɔ;
o anɛ bʋnkɔnbkanɛ pʋ zɔt si'ela.
34O pʋ gɔsi nyɛ bʋnkɔnbkanɛ zem nɛ oo;
onɛ an bʋnkɔnbid wʋsa na'ab.

english_text:
Job's Reply to the Lord
No One Can Oppose You
1Job said:
2No one can oppose you,
because you have the power
to do what you want.
3 You asked why I talk so much
when I know so little.
I have talked about things
that are far beyond
my understanding.
4 You told me to listen
and answer your questions.
5I heard about you from others;
now I have seen you
with my own eyes.
6That's why I hate myself
and sit here in dust and ashes
to show my sorrow.
The Lord Corrects Job's Friends
7The Lord said to Eliphaz:
What my servant Job has said about me is true, but I am angry with you and your two friends for not telling the truth. 8So I want you to go over to Job and offer seven bulls and seven goats on an altar as a sacrifice to please me. After this, Job will pray, and I will agree not to punish you for your foolishness.
9Eliphaz, Bildad, and Zophar obeyed the Lord, and he answered Job's prayer.
A Happy Ending
10 After Job had prayed for his three friends, the Lord made Job twice as rich as he had been before. 11Then Job gave a feast for his brothers and sisters and for his old friends. They expressed their sorrow for the suffering the Lord had brought on him, and they each gave Job some silver and a gold ring.
12The Lord now blessed Job more than ever; he gave him 14,000 sheep, 6,000 camels, 1,000 pair of oxen, and 1,000 donkeys.
13In addition to seven sons, Job had three daughters, 14whose names were Jemimah, Keziah, and Keren Happuch. 15They were the most beautiful women in that part of the world, and Job gave them shares of his property, along with their brothers.
16Job lived for another 140 years—long enough to see his great-grandchildren have children of their own— 17and when he finally died, he was very old.
translation_text:
Job lɛbisʋg
1Ka Job lɛbis Zugsɔb la ye;
2“M mi' ye fʋ na tun'e maal si'el wʋsa;
fʋn gban'e si'el wʋsa sɔ' kae na nyaŋi gu'oe li.
3 Fʋ bu'os ya ye, ‘Oŋa aan anɔ'ɔnɛ bi'esid ya'am pian'ad
ka mɛ an onɛ zi' si'ela?’
Ya'a an sida, m pian'adi bʋn linɛ ka m pʋ gban'e li gbinnɛ,
yɛl nyalima banɛ ka mam mɛŋ pʋn zi'.
4 Fʋ yɛl ye, ‘Kɛlisim ka m na pian';
m na bu'osif bu'osa,
ka fʋ gandigim.’
5M tʋba daa wʋmi fʋ yɛla
amaa nannanna m nini nyɛɛf.
6Alazug, m gɔs ka man niŋ si'el la kʋdim pʋ dɔl suorɛ
lin ka m sɔs suguru
ka bugi m mɛŋ nɛ titan nɛ tampɛligim.”
Wina'am lɛbis Job mɔrim tis o
7Zugsɔb la n yɛl Job nɛ'ɛnam wʋsa naae la, o yɛl Elifaz onɛ yi Teman na la ye, “M sʋnf duoe fʋn nɛ fʋ zuanama ayi' la, bɔzugɔ ya pʋ pian' m yɛla sida wʋʋ Job n pian' si'em laa. 8Alazug, zaŋimi na'araad ayɔpɔi nɛ pɛraad ayɔpɔi keŋ maal nyu'or malʋŋʋ ya mɛŋ zug. M tʋmtʋm Job na sɔsi tisi ya, ka m na siak o sɔsʋg ka kʋ niŋi ya wʋʋ ya zɔlim tʋʋma la narin si'em la. Ya pʋ pian' m yɛla sʋ'ʋm wʋʋ m tʋmtʋm Job n pian' si'em laa.” 9Ala ka Elifaz onɛ yi Teman la na, nɛ Bilidad onɛ yi Suh la na, nɛ Zofar onɛ yi Naama teŋin na la niŋ wʋʋ Zugsɔb la yɛli ba si'em la; ka Zugsɔb la di'e Job sɔsʋg.
10 Job da sɔsi tis o zuanam la, Zugsɔb la da lɛbis o mɔrim la tis o ka li gaad on da mɔr si'em la nɔɔr ayi'. 11O ba'abiis wʋsa da kennɛ o yin na ka ba la'am dit, nɛ banɛ wʋsa da mi' o ka yɛltɔɔd naan paae o la. Ba da bʋgʋl o sʋnf ka bɛlis o, Zugsɔb la da kɛ ka yɛla pamm paae o la zug. Ka ba yinne, yinne tis o anzurifa la'af nɛ sanlima baŋ.
12Wina'am da niŋ Job zug bareka hali gaad on da nyɛ si'em pin'ilʋgʋn la. O da mɔr kɔnbid tusa pii nɛ anaasi nɛ yʋgʋma tusa ayuobʋ nɛ lɔlkuoda tusa ayi', nɛ bʋnnya'as tusir. 13O mɛ da mɔr biribis ayɔpɔi nɛ bipumis atan'. 14O da pʋd bipuŋ kpɛɛm la yʋ'ʋr ye Jemaima ka pʋd onɛ tia'al la yʋ'ʋr ye Keeziya nɛ onɛ pa'a la ye Kerenhapok. 15Pu'a sɔ' da kae teŋgbauŋ la wʋsa zugʋ vɛnl wʋʋ Job pu'ayuos laa. Ba saam da kɛ ka ba la'as nɛ o biribis la ka o pʋdig o faari tisi ba wʋsa.
16Nɛ'ɛŋa wʋsa nya'aŋ, Job da kpɛm bɛ hali yʋma kɔbiga nɛ pisnaasi (140) ka nyɛɛ o yaas nɛ o yaayalinya'asi ti paae zʋmaana anaasi. 17O da kʋdignɛ hali paae o bɛn ka nyaan kpi.

english_text:
BOOK I
(Psalms 1–41)
The Way to Happiness
1God blesses those people
who refuse evil advice
and won't follow sinners
or join in sneering at God.
2Instead, they find happiness
in the Teaching of the Lord,
and they think about it
day and night.
3 They are like trees
growing beside a stream,
trees that produce
fruit in season
and always have leaves.
Those people succeed
in everything they do.
4That isn't true of those
who are evil—
they are like straw
blown by the wind.
5Sinners won't have an excuse
on the day of judgment,
and they won't have a place
with the people of God.
6The Lord protects everyone
who follows him,
but the wicked follow a road
that leads to ruin.
translation_text:
GBAUŊ KANƐ PIN'IL
(Yʋm 1–41)
Zugsɔb nidib nɛ nimbɛ'ɛdnam yɛla
1Yɛlsʋm bɛ nɛ onɛ pʋ di'ed nimbɛ'ɛdnam sa'alʋgɔ
bɛɛ dɔl tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dimi dɔl suosieba la,
bɛɛ nɔk o mɛŋi la'as nɛ nintʋ'ʋsnama.
2Amaa o sʋnf bɔɔdim anɛ ye o dɔl Zugsɔb wada la
ka zamisidi li yʋ'ʋŋ nɛ nintaŋ wʋsa.
3 O sɔb nwɛnɛ tikanɛ ka ba sɛ kɔlʋg nɔɔrin nɛ,
ka li wan saŋa kanɛ nar ye li wal
ka li vaand pʋ sʋʋgida.
O ya'a maal si'el wʋsa o nyɛti li nyɔɔd.
4Nimbɛ'ɛdnam la on ka' ala!
Ba nwɛnɛ udug
linɛ ka sisi'em da'adi ken.
5Alazug tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim na paam kʋʋsbɛ'ɛd,
ba na baki ba yis ka bas pʋpielim dim la.
6Bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb la gur pʋpielim dim la,
amaa nimbɛ'ɛdnam la kennɛ san'auŋʋn.

english_text:
The Lord's Chosen King
1 Why do the nations plot,
and why do their people
make useless plans?
2The kings of this earth
have all joined together
to turn against the Lord
and his chosen king.
3They say, “Let's cut the ropes
and set ourselves free!”
4In heaven the Lord laughs
as he sits on his throne,
making fun of the nations.
5The Lord becomes furious
and threatens them.
His anger terrifies them
as he says,
6“I've put my king on Zion,
my sacred hill.”
7 I will tell the promise
that the Lord made to me:
“You are my son, because today
I have become your father.
8Ask me for the nations,
and every nation on earth
will belong to you.
9 You will smash them
with an iron rod
and shatter them
like dishes of clay.”
10Be smart, all you rulers,
and pay close attention.
11Serve and honor the Lord;
be glad and tremble.
12Show respect to his son
because if you don't,
the Lord might become furious
and suddenly destroy you.
But he blesses and protects
everyone who runs to him.
translation_text:
Wina'am n gaŋ na'asɔ' la yɛla
1Bɔɔ niŋ ka dunia buudi wʋsa su'a gban'ad gban'abɛ'ɛdɛ?
Bɔ ka ba san'amid saŋa gban'ad gban'ayaalisɛ?
2Dunia kaŋa na'anam duoe zi'e,
ka banɛ sʋ'oe tɛɛns la la'as taaba
zan'as Zugsɔb la
nɛ Onɛ ka o Gaŋ la.
3Ba yɛt taaba ye, “Kɛlli ka ti faaɛn ti mɛŋ
ka ba da lɛn sʋ'oe ti ya'asɛ.”
4Onɛ zin' na'am gbauŋ zug arezana ni la la'adi banɛ:
Zugsɔb la maannɛ banɛ siaa.
5Ka o sʋnf duoe nɛ ba ka o tansi ba
ka vɔlisi ba o sʋnf duor la pʋʋgin ka ye,
6“M diisi m Na'ab
Zion zuokanɛ an kasi la zug.”
7M na yɛl Zugsɔb la zi'ela la yɛla:
O yɛlim ye, “Fʋ anɛ mam Biig;
zina ka m liebi fʋ Saam.
8Sɔsim, ka m na kɛ ka fʋ sʋ'ʋg tɛɛns la
ka dunia bɛn wʋsa aan fʋ din.
9 Fʋ na nyaŋi ba nɛ kʋnt dansaar,
ka nwa'asi ba bugus wʋʋ tandʋk nɛ.”
10Alazugɔ, na'anama, baŋimi ya'am!
Dunia tuongatiba, sa'alimi ya mɛŋ
11ka dɔlli Zugsɔb la nya'aŋ nɛ na'asi
ka maal sumalisim nɛ kikirʋg.
12Na'asimini o biig la, ya'a ka' ala o sʋnf na duoe
ka o san'ami ya, ya suobɛ'ɛd la pʋʋgin;
bɔzugɔ o sʋnf tun'e duoe vuguri.
Albareka bɛ nɛ banɛ wʋsa kɛɛn o san'an na su'a la.

english_text:
(Written by David when he was running from his son Absalom.)
An Early Morning Prayer
1 I have a lot of enemies, Lord.
Many fight against 2me and say,
“God won't rescue you!”
3But you are my shield,
and you give me victory
and great honor.
4I pray to you, and you answer
from your sacred hill.
5I sleep and wake up refreshed
because you, Lord,
protect me.
6Ten thousand enemies attack
from every side,
but I am not afraid.
7Come and save me, Lord God!
Break my enemies' jaws
and shatter their teeth,
8because you protect
and bless your people.
translation_text:
Zugsɔb la aan m gbanti'edʋg
1Zugsɔba, m dataas zu'onɛ!
Nidib bɛdegʋ zabid nɛ mam!
2Nidib bɛdegʋ yɛti m yɛla ye,
“Wina'am kʋ faaɛn oo!”
3Amaa Zugsɔba, fʋnɛ an gbanti'edʋgʋ giligim,
fʋnɛ tisim girima ka ʋki m zug agɔla.
4Zugsɔb la ka m kaasi buol,
ka o naanɛ o zuokanɛ an kasi la zug ka wʋm tisim.
5Man digini gbis; ka lɛn duoe nɛ nimma'asim
bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb la gurim.
6Nidib tusa-tusa giligim zin'ig wʋsa
amaa m kʋ zɔ ba dabiem baa bi'elaa.
7O Zugsɔba, duom zi'en!
O m Wina'am, faanmim!
Zam nɛ m dataas la wʋsa.
Lɔmmi ba tampian'as
ka kɔ' bugusim dim la nyina.
8M faangir yit nɛ Zugsɔb la san'an na.
Kɛl ka fʋ albareka la bɛɛ fʋ nidib la zugin.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader. Use stringed instruments.)
An Evening Prayer
1You are my God and protector.
Please answer my prayer.
I was in terrible distress,
but you set me free.
Now have pity and listen
as I pray.
2How long will you people
refuse to respect me?
You love foolish things,
and you run after
what is worthless.
3The Lord has chosen
everyone who is faithful
to be his very own,
and he answers my prayers.
4 But each of you
had better tremble
and turn from your sins.
Silently search your heart
as you lie in bed.
5Offer the proper sacrifices
and trust the Lord.
6There are some who ask,
“Who will be good to us?”
Let your kindness, Lord,
shine brightly on us.
7You brought me more happiness
than a rich harvest
of grain and grapes.
8I can lie down
and sleep soundly
because you, Lord,
will keep me safe.
translation_text:
Yʋ'ʋŋ winsɔsʋg
1M Wina'am onɛ an pʋpielim daana,
m ya'a sɔsif, fʋn wʋm tisim.
Man daa bɛ yɛla ni la fʋ daa tisim yɔlisim,
ka zɔɔm nimbaanlig ka wʋmi m sɔsʋg.
2Saaliba, bʋndaar ka ya na bas man yʋ'ʋr san'auŋɔ?
Bʋndaar ka ya na bas ziri bada la ka dɔl sida?
3Baŋimi ye Zugsɔb la gaans pʋpielim dim la ye ba aan o nidib.
M ya'a sɔs Zugsɔb la o na wʋm tisim.
4 Fʋ sʋnf ya'a duoe fʋn da tʋm bɛ'ɛdɛ;
fʋ ya'a digi fʋ dɔɔgin yʋ'ʋŋ
fʋn tɛn'ɛsim pian'ad nwa' yɛla ka an baanlimm.
5Nɔkim maan kanɛ an sʋ'ʋŋa la tis
ka niŋ Zugsɔb la yadda.
6Nidib bɛdegʋ bu'osid ye, “Anɔ'ɔnɛ na maal bʋnsʋŋʋ tisi ti?”
Zugsɔba, zɔmi ti nimbaanlig.
7Fʋ tisim sumalistita'ar
ka li gat ban na bʋn ki bɛdegʋ
ka nyɛt daam nɛ kpaam ka maan sumalisim si'em la.
8M na digini gbis nɛ laafi
bɔzugɔ, Zugsɔba, fʋn ma'aa kɛt ka m bɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm pʋʋgin.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader. Use flutes.)
A Prayer for Help
1Listen, Lord, as I pray!
Pay attention when I groan.
2You are my King and my God.
Answer my cry for help
because I pray to you.
3Each morning you listen
to my prayer,
as I bring my requests to you
and wait for your reply.
4You are not the kind of God
who is pleased with evil.
Sinners can't stay with you.
5No one who boasts can stand
in your presence, Lord,
and you hate evil people.
6You destroy every liar,
and you despise violence
and deceit.
7Because of your great mercy,
I come to your house, Lord,
and I am filled with wonder
as I bow down to worship
at your holy temple.
8You do what is right,
and I ask you to guide me.
Make your teaching clear
because of my enemies.
9 Nothing they say is true!
They just want to destroy.
Their words are deceitful
like a hidden pit,
and their tongues are good
only for telling lies.
10Punish them, God,
and let their own plans
bring their downfall.
Get rid of them!
They keep committing crimes
and turning against you.
11Let all who run to you
for protection
always sing joyful songs.
Provide shelter for those
who truly love you
and let them rejoice.
12Our Lord, you bless those
who live right,
and you shield them
with your kindness.
translation_text:
Wina'am nidib sɔsid Zugsɔb ye o guri ba
1Zugsɔba, wʋmmi m sɔsʋg,
kɛlisimi m fabʋlʋg ka zɔɔm nimbaanlig.
2Wʋm man kaasidi bɔɔd sʋŋir la,
m Na'ab nɛ m Wina'am,
bɔzugɔ li anɛ fʋn ka m sɔsid.
3Zugsɔba, fʋ wʋmmi m sɔsʋg bɛogʋn;
bɛogʋn ka m mɔri m winsɔsʋgʋ kɛɛn fʋ tuon na
ka gur nɛ ti'ir ye fʋ na maal.
4Fʋ anɛ Wina'am kanɛ pʋ bɔɔd bɛ'ɛdɛ;
tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim kʋ nyaŋi zin'ini fʋ san'anɛ.
5Tita'alnam kʋ nyaŋi kɛɛn fʋ san'an naa;
banɛ tʋm bɛ'ɛd wʋsa fʋ kisi ba nɛ.
6Banɛ faad la fʋ san'amidi ba nɛ;
nimbanɛ bɔɔd kʋʋb ka an ziri dim la
Zugsɔb la kisi ba nɛ.
7Amaa li ya'a an mam, fʋ nimbaanlzɔɔr la zug,
m tun'e kpɛn' fʋ Yin la
ka igini kpa' fʋ pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg linɛ an kasi la
ka tisif girima nɛ na'asi.
8Zugsɔba, gaadimi m tuon nɛ fʋ pʋpielim la,
sʋŋimim, m dataas la zug.
Kɛl ka fʋ suor la an tituaa tisim ka m dɔl.
9 Pian'ʋk wʋsa linɛ yiti ba nɔɔrin na ka' sidaa.
Ba sʋnf gban'e nɛ san'auŋ ma'aa.
Ba pʋʋg pʋ paada;
ba pian'adnɛ ziri pian'ad ma'aa.
10O Wina'am, kʋʋsimi ba bɛ'ɛd!
Kɛl ka ba mɛŋ gban'abɛ'ɛd la tuligi dii ba.
Kadimi ba yis, ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la zug,
bɔzugɔ ba zan'asi fʋ nɔɔr.
11Amaa kɛl ka banɛ wʋsa su'a fʋ san'an la paam sumalisim;
kɛl ka ba yʋ'ʋm nɛ sumalisim saŋa wʋsa.
Kɛl ka fʋ paŋ kanɛ guri ba la lusi ba,
ka banɛ nɔŋif la na mɔr sumalisim fʋ san'an.
12O Zugsɔba, li anɛ sida ye fʋ niŋid pʋpielnam la zug bareka;
fʋ lusi ba nɛ wʋʋ gbanti'edʋg nɛ.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader. Use stringed instruments.
)
A Prayer in Time of Trouble
1 Don't punish me, Lord,
or even correct me
when you are angry!
2Have pity on me and heal
my feeble body.
My bones tremble with fear,
3and I am in deep distress.
How long will it be?
4Turn and come to my rescue.
Show your wonderful love
and save me, Lord.
5If I die, I cannot praise you
or even remember you.
6My groaning has worn me out.
At night my bed and pillow
are soaked with tears.
7Sorrow has made my eyes dim,
and my sight has failed
because of my enemies.
8 You, Lord, heard my crying,
and those hateful people
had better leave me alone.
9You have answered my prayer
and my plea for mercy.
10My enemies will be ashamed
and terrified,
as they quickly run away
in complete disgrace.
translation_text:
Mugusʋg saŋa winsɔsʋg
1O Zugsɔba, da kɛ ka fʋ sʋnf duoe ka fʋ tansim,
bɛɛ namisimi fʋ sʋnf duor la pʋʋginɛ.
2Zugsɔba, zɔmim nimbaanlig, ka m gɛnnɛ;
Zugsɔba, tisimim laafi,
ka m niŋgbina wʋsa ka' paŋa.
3M giinla wʋsa kɛnsnɛ.
Zugsɔba, li na yuugi paae wala?
4O, Zugsɔba, lɛm na sʋŋim;
faanmim fʋ nɔŋilim la zug.
5Sɔ' kae na kpi ka lɛn tiɛn fʋ yɛlaa;
anɔ'ɔnɛ na bɛ kpi'im teŋ
ka lɛn nyaŋi zun'e fʋ yʋ'ʋrɛ?
6Sʋnsa'aŋ yʋ'ʋn kɛnɛ ka m gɛn,
yʋ'ʋŋ wʋsa m gadʋg ɛɛn anɛ ninta'am ma'aa
ka ninta'am kɛ ka m zukʋgʋr wʋ'ʋg matti.
7M dataas la kɛnɛ ka m kaas hali;
ka m nini mɔd ka pʋ lɛn nyɛta.
8Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim nwa', isigimini m san'an
bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb la wʋmi m kukuma.
9Zugsɔb la wʋm man kaasidi bɔɔd sʋŋir si'em;
Zugsɔb la gandigi m sɔsʋg.
10Li na lidigi m dataas la wʋsa ka nyan gban'e ba;
ba na zɔ tɔ'ɔtɔ lɛb nya'aŋ nɛ nyan.

english_text:
(Written by David.
He sang this to the Lord because of Cush from the tribe of Benjamin.)
The Lord Always Does Right
1You, Lord God,
are my protector.
Rescue me and keep me safe
from all who chase me.
2Or else they will rip me apart
like lions attacking a victim,
and no one will save me.
3I am innocent, Lord God!
4I have not betrayed a friend
or had pity on an enemy
who attacks for no reason.
5If I have done any of this,
then let my enemies
chase and capture me.
Let them trample me to death
and leave me in the dirt.
6Get angry, Lord God!
Do something!
Attack my furious enemies.
See that justice is done.
7Make the nations come to you,
as you sit on your throne
above them all.
8Our Lord, judge the nations!
Judge me and show that I
am honest and innocent.
9 You know every heart and mind,
and you always do right.
Now make violent people stop,
but protect all of us
who obey you.
10You, God, are my shield,
the protector of everyone
whose heart is right.
11You see that justice is done,
and each day
you take revenge.
12Whenever your enemies refuse
to change their ways,
you sharpen your sword
and string your bow.
13Your deadly arrows are ready
with flaming tips.
14An evil person is like a woman
about to give birth
to a hateful, deceitful,
and rebellious child.
15 Such people dig a deep hole,
then fall in it themselves.
16The trouble they cause
comes back on them,
and their heads are crushed
by their own evil deeds.
17I will praise you, Lord!
You always do right.
I will sing about you,
the Lord Most High.
translation_text:
Onɛ bɔɔd yɛlsida suor winsɔsʋg
1M Zugsɔb Wina'am, fʋ ni ka m su'ad,
faanmim ka yisim banɛ ieedim la nu'usin.
2Ya'a ka' ala ba na aansim zɔra-zɔra wʋʋ gbigimi aansid si'el si'em la,
bɛɛ vɛ'ɛgimi keŋ, ka sɔ' kae na faaɛn ma.
3M Zugsɔb Wina'am, m ya'a tʋm bɛ'ɛd
ka taal bɛ m zugin,
4m ya'a tʋm bɛ'ɛdi tis onɛ mɔr sumbʋgʋsʋm nɛ m,
bɛɛ faanm dataa si'el zaalim-zaalim,
5fʋn kɛl ka m dataas kadimi nyaŋim,
ka nwɛ'ɛmi digil teŋin,
ka yʋ'ʋn kʋʋmi pin' teŋin.
6M Zugsɔba, vaam duoe nɛ sʋʋnr,
ka san'am ban gban'e si'el ba sʋnpɛɛn zug la,
duom zi'en, m Wina'am, ka kɛ ka sida la tʋm.
7Kɛl ka dunia nidib kɛɛn fʋ san'an na;
zin'inimi fʋ na'am gbauŋ la zug agɔla ka sʋ'ʋgi ba.
8Kɛl ka Zugsɔb kad nidib la saria.
M Zugsɔba, kadimi m saria
ka li dɔlli m pʋpielim zem si'em,
ka dɔlli m bʋʋdi zem si'em,
fʋnɛ Gaad Si'el wʋsa.
9Wina'am Onɛ an Pʋpielim Sɔba,
fʋnɛ mi' ninsaal pʋtɛn'ɛr nɛ o sʋnfʋ gban'e si'em.
Kɛl ka nimbɛ'ɛdnam tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la gu'oe,
ka kɛ ka pʋpielim dim nyɛɛ ba mɛŋ.
10Wina'am Onɛ Gaad Si'el wʋsa la lusidim,
onɛ faand banɛ ka ba sʋnf an nyain la.
11Wina'am kad saria nɛ pʋpielim,
O pa'annɛ o sʋnpɛɛn daar wʋsa.
12Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb ya'a pʋ tiakɛ
Wina'am na maligim saas o sʋ'ʋg la
ka gʋd o tiraug la sʋ'ʋŋa.
13O maal o zaba la'abanɛ tun'e kʋʋd la
ka ti'eb nɛ o piema banɛ dit wʋʋ bugum la.
14Onɛ wʋsa gban'e tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nɛ
yɛla ma'aa pʋʋg, du'adnɛ dama'am.
15Onɛ tu bʋmbɔk
o sɔb lutnɛ bʋmbɔkanɛ ka o tu la pʋʋgin.
16Yɛlbanɛ ka o ieed la lɛbidnɛ o zugin na;
o daamʋg la wʋsa na lɛb o mɛŋ zugin.
17M na pʋ'ʋs Zugsɔb la bareka o pʋpielim la zug,
ka yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma zun'e o yʋ'ʋr,
Zugsɔb la Gaad Si'el wʋsa.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.
)
The Wonderful Name of the Lord
1Our Lord and Ruler,
your name is wonderful
everywhere on earth!
You let your glory be seen
in the heavens above.
2 With praises from children
and from tiny infants,
you have built a fortress.
It makes your enemies silent,
and all who turn against you
are left speechless.
3I often think of the heavens
your hands have made,
and of the moon and stars
you put in place.
4 Then I ask, “Why do you care
about us humans?
Why are you concerned
for us weaklings?”
5 You made us a little lower
than you yourself,
and you have crowned us
with glory and honor.
6 You let us rule everything
your hands have made.
And you put all of it
under our power—
7the sheep and the cattle,
and every wild animal,
8the birds in the sky,
the fish in the sea,
and all ocean creatures.
9Our Lord and Ruler,
your name is wonderful
everywhere on earth!
translation_text:
Wina'am girima nɛ ninsaal na'asi
1Naa, Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti Zugsɔba,
fʋ yʋ'ʋr la mɔri kpi'euŋ dunia wʋsa ni,
fʋ dʋ'ʋsi fʋ girima agɔl ka li gaad saŋgbana.
2 Fʋ kɛt ka bibibis nɛ bilies pian'adi fʋ yʋ'ʋr.
Fʋ dataas ya'a maan tʋkpiidʋg
fʋ na kɛ ka ba gigilim,
la'an nɛ banɛ bɔɔd sam yɔɔb la wʋsa.
3M ya'a gɔs agɔla nyɛ fʋ nu'usi maal si'el la,
nwadig nɛ nwadbibis banɛ ka fʋ niŋi ba, ba zin'isin si'em la,
4 m bu'osidi m mɛŋ ye,
“Ninsaal an bɔ, ka fʋ tɛnr o yɛla ala?
Bɛɛ ninsaal biig an bɔ, ka fʋ ba'a bɛɛ o ni?”
5Fʋ maal o ka maliaknam gaad o nɛ bi'ela
amaa fʋ tis o girima nɛ na'asi.
6 Fʋ kɛ ka o sʋ'oe linɛ ka fʋ maal la,
fʋ zaŋ si'el wʋsa niŋ o nu'usin,
7onɛ sʋ'oe kɔnbid nɛ niigi wʋsa,
nɛ mɔɔgin bʋnkɔnbid la wʋsa,
8nɛ niimis banɛ ian'ad saŋgbauŋin,
nɛ zimi banɛ bɛ atɛukʋn
nɛ linɛ wʋsa lugidi dɔlisid ku'osuoya atɛukʋn la.
9Naa, Zugsɔb onɛ aan ti Zugsɔba,
fʋ yʋ'ʋr la mɔri kpi'euŋ dunia wʋsa zug!

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader. To the tune “The Death of the Son.”)
Sing Praises to the Lord
1I will praise you, Lord,
with all my heart
and tell about the wonders
you have worked.
2God Most High, I will rejoice;
I will celebrate and sing
because of you.
3When my enemies face you,
they run away and stumble
and are destroyed.
4You take your seat as judge,
and your fair decisions prove
that I was in the right.
5You warn the nations
and destroy evil people;
you wipe out their names
forever and ever.
6Our enemies are destroyed
completely for all time.
Their cities are torn down,
and they will never
be remembered again.
7You rule forever, Lord,
and you are on your throne,
ready for judgment.
8You judge the world fairly
and treat all nations
with justice.
9The poor can run to you
because you are a fortress
in times of trouble.
10Everyone who honors your name
can trust you,
because you are faithful
to all who depend on you.
11You rule from Zion, Lord,
and we sing about you
to let the nations know
everything you have done.
12You did not forget
to punish the guilty
or listen to the cries
of those in need.
13 Please have mercy, Lord!
My enemies mistreat me.
Keep me from the gates
that lead to death,
14and I will sing about you
at the gate to Zion.
I will be happy there
because you rescued me.
15 Our Lord, the nations fell
into their own pits,
and their feet were caught
in their own traps.
16You showed what you are like,
and you made certain
that justice is done,
but evil people are trapped
by their own evil deeds.
17The wicked will go down
to the world of the dead
to be with those nations
that forgot about you.
18The poor and the homeless
won't always be forgotten
and without hope.
19Do something, Lord!
Don't let the nations win.
Make them stand trial
in your court of law.
20Make the nations afraid
and let them all discover
just how weak they are.
translation_text:
Pʋ'ʋsim Zugsɔb bareka o yɛlmɛŋir yɛla
1Zugsɔba, m na zun'e fʋ yʋ'ʋr nɛ m sʋnf wʋsa,
m na yɛl nidibi fʋ tʋʋmnyalima la yɛla.
2M sʋnf na ma'ae ka m maal sumalisim fʋ tuon,
ka yʋʋm yʋ'ʋma zun'e fʋ yʋ'ʋr,
fʋnɛ Gaad Si'el wʋsa!
3M dataasi zɔti lɛbid nya'aŋ la,
ba na tu'ugi luu kpii fʋ tuon.
4Bɔzugɔ fʋ mi' m bʋʋd yɛla ka kpɛn'ɛdi m zug;
fʋ zin'inɛ fʋ na'am gbauŋ zug ka kad saria nɛ sida.
5Fʋ sa'al tɛɛns la ka kʋ nimbɛ'ɛdnam:
fʋ kpiisi ba yʋda ka li kʋ lɛn maligim sɔbɛ.
6San'auŋ linɛ ka' bɛn paae dataas la;
fʋ nwa'a ba teŋ la,
hali ka sɔ' pʋ lɛn tɛnri ba yɛlaa.
7Zugsɔb la sʋ'oe na'am, saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ,
O zi'el o na'am ye o kad saria.
8O na kad dunia nwa' saria nɛ pʋpielim,
ka gur tɛɛns wʋsa nɛ sida.
9Zugsɔb la anɛ suak zin'igi tis banɛ ka ba namisidi ba,
yɛla ya'a ti bɛ, o anɛ kpi'euŋ zin'igi tisi ba.
10Banɛ mi' fʋ yʋ'ʋr la paŋi an si'em la na niŋif yadda
bɔzugɔ fʋn kanɛ an Zugsɔb la nan zi' kad banɛ ieedif la basɛ.
11Yʋ'ʋmmi yʋʋma wɔ'ɔg Zugsɔb onɛ an Zion Na'ab la,
yɛlimi tɛɛns la wʋsa on maal si'el!
12Bɔzugɔ o tɛnr banɛ namisid la yɛla.
O pʋ tammid banɛ kaasid la yɛlaa, ka yɔɔd banɛ namisidi ba la sam.
13Naa, m Zugsɔba, gɔsimi m dataas la namisidim si'em.
Zɔmim nimbaanlig ka yisim kum pʋʋgin.
14M na zun'e fʋ yʋ'ʋr Zion teŋ za'anɔɔrin
ka maal sumalisim fʋ faangir la yɛla.
15Tɛɛns la nidib pʋn lu bʋmbu'abanɛ ka ba tu la pʋʋgin,
baans banɛ ka ba su'a bɛnd la lɛm gban'e ba mɛŋ nɔba.
16Ba baŋid Zugsɔb la yɛla nɛ on an sida sɔb la zug;
nimbɛ'ɛdnam la tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi gban'adi ba.
17Nimbɛ'ɛdnam wʋsa lɛbidnɛ kpi'im teŋ,
nɛ buudbanɛ wʋsa tam Wina'am yɛla la.
18Amaa o kʋ tam tadimnam yɛlaa,
bɛɛ kɛ ka banɛ bɛ namisʋgʋn la ti'ir gaadɛ.
19Zugsɔba, duom zi'en ka da kɛ ka ninsaal di ya'annɛ;
kɛl ka ba kad buudi wʋsa saria fʋ tuon.
20Zugsɔba, kɛl ka dabiem gban'e ba,
kɛl ka buudi la baŋ ye ba anɛ ninsaalib ma'aa.

english_text:
A Prayer for Help
1Why are you far away, Lord?
Why do you hide yourself
when I am in trouble?
2Proud and brutal people
hunt down the poor.
But let them get caught
by their own evil plans!
3The wicked brag about
their deepest desires.
Those greedy people hate
and curse you, Lord.
4The wicked are too proud
to turn to you
or even think about you.
5They are always successful,
though they can't understand
your teachings,
and they keep sneering
at their enemies.
6In their hearts they say,
“Nothing can hurt us!
We'll always be happy
and free from trouble.”
7 They curse and tell lies,
and all they talk about
is how to be cruel
or how to do wrong.
8They hide outside villages,
waiting to strike and murder
some innocent victim.
9They are hungry lions
hiding in the bushes,
hoping to catch
some helpless passerby.
They trap the poor in nets
and drag them away.
10They crouch down and wait
to grab a victim.
11They say, “God can't see!
He's got on a blindfold.”
12Do something, Lord God,
and use your powerful arm
to help those in need.
13The wicked don't respect you.
In their hearts they say,
“God won't punish us!”
14But you see the trouble
and the distress,
and you will do something.
The poor can count on you,
and so can orphans.
15Now break the power
of all merciless people.
Punish them for doing wrong
and make them stop.
16Our Lord, you will always rule,
but every godless nation
will vanish from the earth.
17You listen to the longings
of those who suffer.
You offer them hope,
and you pay attention
to their cries for help.
18You defend orphans
and everyone else in need,
so that no one on earth
can terrify others again.
translation_text:
Onɛ bɔɔd yɛlsida suor winsɔsʋg
1Zugsɔba, bɔ ka fʋ zi'e lallisa?
Bɔ ka fʋ su'adi fʋ mɛŋ, yɛla saŋa?
2Bugusim sɔb la, tita'alim zug ka o namisid tadimnam;
o gban'e bɛ'ɛd la na tuligi gban'e o mɛŋ!
3Ninvʋbɛ'ɛd nwɛ'ɛdnɛ nyɔ'ɔg nɛ on tʋm linɛ aan o sʋʋnr bɔɔdim la;
o kaanbid kaanb sʋŋi tisid dasʋŋ sɔb ka ki'isid Zugsɔb la.
4Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb la tita'alim zug, o pʋ ieed Wina'am zin'iga;
o tɛn'ɛsʋg wʋsa pʋʋgin, fal kae tis Wina'am.
5O suoya wʋsa ken tuon la zug,
o mɔri nyɛɛsim ka fʋ wada lal nɛ o,
ka nɛ'ɛsid o dataas wʋsa.
6O yɛt o sʋnfʋn ye, “Si'el kae na daam mam.
Saŋa wʋsa m na mɔr sumalisim
ka yɛlsi'a kʋ maligim paae ma.”
7 Linɛ yit o nɔɔrin na anɛ nɔpɔɔr nɛ ziri nɛ vɔlisʋg.
O zilim pɛ'ɛli nɛ yɛla nɛ bɛ'ɛd ma'aa.
8O su'anɛ teŋkpɛmis la baba,
ye o kʋʋd banɛ ka' taal la,
ka su'a gu'ud banɛ dɔl anina gat la.
9O dignɛ gur wʋʋ gbigim nɛ, ye o gban'e tadimnam.
O gban'adnɛ banɛ ka' kpi'euŋ la,
ka niŋidi ba o zulis la pʋʋgin mɔri ken.
10O mugusidnɛ tadimnam ka ba lit teŋin,
o mɔr paŋi nyaŋidi ba.
11O yɛt o sʋnfʋn ye, “Wina'am tam ya,
o ligil o nindaa ka pʋ lɛn nyɛt si'ela.”
12Zugsɔba, duom zi'en!
Wina'am, ʋkimi fʋ nu'ug!
Da tam tadimnam la yɛlaa.
13Bɔɔ kɛ ka nimbɛ'ɛd la ziemid Wina'am?
Bɔɔ kɛ ka o yɛt o sʋnfʋn ye,
“O kʋ gi'el man tʋm si'el la yɛllɛ.”
14Amaa sida fʋ nyɛt yɛla nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ kan ka maan, O Wina'am:
fʋ gɔsidi li yɛla sʋ'ʋŋa.
Onɛ ka ba namisid la nɔk o mɛŋi niŋi fʋ ma'asimin,
ka fʋ sʋŋid banɛ an kpiibis la wʋsa.
15Kɔ'ɔgim bugusim sɔb nɛ nimbɛ'ɛd kpʋkpauŋ,
kɛl ka ba paam namisʋgʋ ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd zug
la'an nɛ ban yɛl ye sɔ' kʋ nyɛ li la.
16Zugsɔb la anɛ na'ab saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ,
teŋ zʋŋ nidib kʋ lɛm bɛɛ o teŋinɛ.
17O Zugsɔba, fʋ wʋm banɛ namisid la bɔɔd si'el;
fʋ wʋmmi ba kukuma ka kpɛmisidi ba;
18ka sʋŋid kpiibis nɛ banɛ bɛ namisʋgʋn;
linɛ na kɛ ka ninsaal na bɛ dunia ni
ka kʋ lɛn zɔ dabiem ya'asɛ.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
Trusting the Lord
1The Lord is my fortress!
Don't say to me,
“Escape like a bird
to the mountains!”
2You tell me, “Watch out!
Those evil people have put
their arrows on their bows,
and they are standing
in the shadows,
aiming at good people.
3What can an honest person do
when everything crumbles?”
4The Lord is sitting
in his sacred temple
on his throne in heaven.
He knows everything we do
because he sees us all.
5The Lord tests honest people,
but despises those
who are cruel
and love violence.
6He will send fiery coals
and flaming sulfur
down on the wicked,
and they will drink nothing
but a scorching wind.
7The Lord always does right
and wants justice done.
Everyone who does right
will see his face.
translation_text:
Zugsɔb la aan m suak zin'ig
1Zugsɔb la aan m suak zin'ig,
dinzug bɔ ka ya yɛtim ye
m iankim wʋʋ niiŋe
zɔɔ keŋ zuoya ni?
2Gɔsim nimbɛ'ɛdnam la gʋdi ba tiraad si'em!
Ba nɔk piema la niŋi ba tiraadin
ye ba su'a zibisimin tɔn
banɛ sʋnya an nyain nɛ Wina'am la.
3Ɛɛnbir la ya'a luu widig
pʋpielim dim la ye ba niŋ wala?
4Zugsɔb la bɛ nɛ o Pʋ'ʋsim Yir linɛ an kasi la ni,
Zugsɔb la bɛ nɛ o na'am gbauŋ zug arezana ni.
O kpansid ninsaalib,
ka o nini la gɔsid ban tʋm si'em.
5Zugsɔb la kpansid pʋpielim dim,
amaa bugusim dim nɛ banɛ bɔɔd zaba la,
o kisi ba ka o ya'am pʋ bɔɔdi ba baa bi'elaa.
6O na kpa'ae bugumsaana nɛ kidibiri
niŋ bugusim dim zug,
pɛbistʋʋlʋg na da'ae gɛɛli ba.
7Bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb la anɛ pʋpielim sɔb ka nɔŋ pʋpielim tʋʋma;
sida dim nɛ banɛ tʋm sʋm na nyɛɛ o nindaa.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.
)
A Prayer for Help
1Please help me, Lord!
All who were faithful
and all who were loyal
have disappeared.
2Everyone tells lies,
and no one is sincere.
3Won't you chop off
all flattering tongues
that brag so loudly?
4They say to themselves,
“We are great speakers.
No one else has a chance.”
5But you, Lord, tell them,
“I will do something!
The poor are mistreated
and helpless people moan.
I'll rescue all who suffer.”
6Our Lord, you are true
to your promises,
and your word is like silver
heated seven times
in a fiery furnace.
7You will protect us
and always keep us safe
from those people.
8But all who are wicked
will keep on strutting,
while everyone praises
their shameless deeds.
translation_text:
Winsɔsʋg linɛ bɔɔd sʋŋir
1Zugsɔba, sʋŋimim, ka banɛ dɔllif lɛn kae,
pʋpielnam lɛn ka' nidib sʋʋginɛ.
2Sɔ' wʋsa ma'adnɛ tisid o kpi'a,
ba nɔŋgban pian'ad anɛ ziri ma'aa.
3Zugsɔb, kɛl ka nɔŋgban malisiŋ wʋsa lɛbi fɔn'
ka banɛ nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔg la zilima niŋ baanlimm.
4Ba yɛt ye, “Ti na nyaŋ nɛ ti zilima la:
tinamɛ sʋ'oe ti nɔŋgbana, anɔ'ɔnɛ aan ti sʋ'ʋda?”
5Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “Ban namisid tadimnam
nɛ banɛ ka' si'el la fabʋlʋg zug,
m yʋ'ʋn na duoe zi'en,”
m na faaɛn ba yis banɛ namisidi ba la nu'usin.
6Zugsɔb la yɛlʋg anɛ nyain wʋʋ anzurifa nɛ;
ka nwɛnɛ anzurifa ka ba nyɛligi silig nɔɔr ayɔpɔi.
7Zugsɔba, gu'umi ba sʋ'ʋŋa
guri ba ka yisi ti nimbama nu'usin, saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.
8Nimbɛ'ɛdnam la bɛ nɛ zin'ig wʋsa
ka linɛ pʋ nar la lieb girima bʋn nidib la sʋʋgin.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
A Prayer for the Lord's Help
1How much longer, Lord,
will you forget about me?
Will it be forever?
How long will you hide?
2How long must I be confused
and miserable all day?
How long will my enemies
keep beating me down?
3Please listen, Lord God,
and answer my prayers.
Make my eyes sparkle again,
or else I will fall
into the sleep of death.
4My enemies will say,
“Now we've won!”
They will be greatly pleased
when I am defeated.
5I trust your love,
and I feel like celebrating
because you rescued me.
6You have been good to me, Lord,
and I will sing about you.
translation_text:
Sʋŋir winsɔsʋg
1O Zugsɔba, saŋa wala ka fʋ na tam man yɛla?
Fʋ na tam man yɛla fassinɛ?
Saŋa wala ka fʋ na fɛndigi fʋ nindaa ka basi ma?
2Saŋa wala ka man pʋtɛn'ɛr na kpɛn an yɔɔd-yɔɔdi,
ka mɔr sʋnsa'aŋ daar wʋsa?
Saŋa wala ka m dataas na nyaŋi ma?
3Wina'am onɛ aan m Zugsɔba, sʋŋim!
Kɛlisim ka gandigim.
Tisim paŋ ya'as; ya'a ka' ala m na kpi.
4Da kɛ ka m dataa yɛl ye, “M nyaŋ oo.”
Banɛ kisim la ya'a nyɛ ka m lu, ba na maal sumalisim.
5Amaa mam mɔr yadda nɛ fʋ nɔŋilim linɛ pʋ naad la.
M sʋnf malis nɛ fʋ faangir linɛ ka' bɛn la.
6M na yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma tis Zugsɔb la
bɔzugɔ o tʋm tʋʋm sʋma tisim.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
No One Can Ignore the Lord
1 Only a fool would say,
“There is no God!”
People like that are worthless;
they are heartless and cruel
and never do right.
2From heaven the Lord
looks down to see
if anyone is wise enough
to search for him.
3But all of them are corrupt;
no one does right.
4Won't you evil people learn?
You refuse to pray,
and you gobble up
the Lord's people.
5But you will be frightened,
because God is on the side
of every good person.
6You may spoil the plans
of the poor,
but the Lord protects them.
7I long for someone from Zion
to come and save Israel!
Our Lord, when you bless
your people again,
Jacob's family will be glad,
and Israel will celebrate.
translation_text:
Saalib bugusim yɛla
(Yʋm 53)
1Zɔlʋg yɛt o pʋtɛn'ɛrin ye,
“Wina'am kae!”
Ba san'amnɛ, ka ba suoya wʋsa an bɛ'ɛd;
sɔ' kae tʋm sʋm.
2Zugsɔb la naan arezana gɔsid saalib
ye o na nyɛ ya'am daani ba sʋʋgin
nɛ onɛ ieed on Wina'am.
3 Ayei! Sɔ' wʋsa fɛndignɛ,
ba wʋsa yʋ'ʋn kilimnɛ zam dim;
sɔ' kae tʋm sʋm,
hali baa nid yinne mɛnɛ.
4Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim la kʋ zamis ya'am?
Ba vɔnnɛ m nidib la wʋʋ saalibi vɔn sa'ab si'em la;
ka mɛ pʋn pʋ sɔsid Zugsɔb la.
5Banɛ bɛɛ anina ka dabietita'ar gban'e ba la,
Wina'am mɛ bɛ nɛ o nimbanɛ an pʋpielim dim la san'an.
6Yanam bugusim dim la san'amid tadimnam yɛla
amaa Wina'am aan ba suak zin'ig.
7M bɔɔd ye Israel faangir naan Zion teŋin na!
Zugsɔb la ya'a ti lɛbis o nidibi ba zin'igin,
Jakob nɛ Israel dim na mɔr sumalisim!

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
Who May Worship the Lord?
1Who may stay in God's temple
or live on the holy mountain
of the Lord?
2Only those who obey God
and do as they should.
They speak the truth
3and don't spread gossip;
they treat others fairly
and don't say cruel things.
4They hate worthless people,
but show respect for all
who worship the Lord.
And they keep their promises,
no matter what the cost.
5They lend their money
without charging interest,
and they don't take bribes
to hurt the innocent.
Those who do these things
will always stand firm.
translation_text:
Zugsɔb la bɔɔdnɛ banɛ tʋm linɛ nar
1Zugsɔba anɔ'ɔn na nyaŋi kpɛn' fʋ yin la?
Anɔ'ɔn na nyaŋi bɛɛ fʋ zuokanɛ an kasi la zugɔ?
2Li anɛ onɛ ken ka gba'ar kae, ka tʋm linɛ an pʋpielim la,
o anɛ onɛ pian'ad sida ka li yit o sʋnfʋn na.
3O zilim pʋ pian'ad bɛ'ɛdɛ,
bɛɛ maannɛ o kpi'a linɛ pʋ nara,
ka pʋ kɛɛnd o ninsaal taabaa.
4O kis nimbɛ'ɛdnam,
ka nɔŋ banɛ zɔt Zugsɔb la.
O zi'e o kaanbʋg zug
hali baa li ya'a tɔi si'em tis oo.
5O pɛ'ɛŋid o ligidi tisid
ka pʋ paasid nyɔɔdɛ,
ka pʋ kɛt ka ba da'ad o
ye o kʋʋs bʋʋd sɔb bɛ'ɛdɛ.
Onɛ tʋm nɛ'ɛŋa wʋsa, si'el kae na daam o.

english_text:
(A special psalm by David.)
The Best Choice
1Protect me, Lord God!
I run to you for safety,
2and I have said,
“Only you are my Lord!
Every good thing I have
is a gift from you.”
3Your people are wonderful,
and they make me happy,
4but worshipers of other gods
will have much sorrow.
I refuse to offer sacrifices
of blood to those gods
or worship in their name.
5You, Lord, are all I want!
You are my choice,
and you keep me safe.
6You make my life pleasant,
and my future is bright.
7I praise you, Lord,
for being my guide.
Even in the darkest night,
your teachings fill my mind.
8 I will always look to you,
as you stand beside me
and protect me from fear.
9With all my heart,
I will celebrate,
and I can safely rest.
10 I am your chosen one.
You won't leave me in the grave
or let my body decay.
11You have shown me
the path to life,
and you make me glad
by being near to me.
Sitting at your right side,
I will always be joyful.
translation_text:
Winsɔsʋg linɛ mɔr ti'ir
1O, m Wina'am, gurim sʋ'ʋŋa
bɔzugɔ fʋ san'an ka m su'adi m mɛŋ.
2M yɛl Zugsɔb la ye, “Fʋ anɛ m Zugsɔb;
ya'a ka' fʋnɛ, m pʋ lɛm mɔr bʋnsʋŋsi'aa.”
3Zugsɔb nimbanɛ bɛ teŋ la ni la
anɛ girima dim ka m sʋnf malis nɛ ba.
4Banɛ zɔti dɔl winsieba la, na maligim paasi ba mɛŋ sʋnsa'aŋ.
M kʋ bu'oe ba maan ku'om linɛ an ziim la
bɛɛ ya'am m nɔɔri buoli ba yʋdaa.
5Zugsɔba, fʋ tisim linɛ aan m bʋn nɛ linɛ narim,
fʋnɛ kɛ ka m zin' ka dabiem kae.
6M di'e zin'ibanɛ vɛnli tisim;
sida-sida m mɔr faar linɛ ma'adi m sʋnf.
7M na zun'e Zugsɔb onɛ sa'annim la,
la'an nɛ yʋ'ʋŋ m sʋnf pa'annim mam na maal si'em.
8Zugsɔb la ka man zaŋi galisi m tuon daar wʋsa;
on bɛɛ m datiuŋ la zug, dabiem pʋ mɔri ma.
9Dinzug, man sʋnf ma'anɛ
ka m pian'ad nɛ sumalisim,
ka m niŋgbina mɛ mɔr laafi ka si'el kʋ daami ma.
10Bɔzugɔ fʋ kʋ basim yaʋgʋnɛ,
bɛɛ kɛ ka Onɛ an Kasi tisif la pun'oe.
11Fʋnɛ kɛ ka m baŋ vʋm suor,
fʋ na tisim sumalisim fʋ san'an,
ka kɛ ka m mɔr ya'amlɛog linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ fʋ datiuŋ la.

english_text:
(A prayer by David.)
The Prayer of an Innocent Person
1I am innocent, Lord!
Won't you listen as I pray
and beg for help?
I am honest!
Please hear my prayer.
2Only you can say
that I am innocent,
because only your eyes
can see the truth.
3You know my heart,
and even during the night
you have tested me
and found me innocent.
I have made up my mind
never to tell a lie.
4I don't do like others.
I obey your teachings
and am not cruel.
5I have followed you,
without ever stumbling.
6I pray to you, God,
because you will help me.
Listen and answer my prayer!
7Show your wonderful love.
Your mighty arm protects those
who run to you for safety
from their enemies.
8Protect me as you would
your very own eyes;
hide me in the shadow
of your wings.
9Don't let my brutal enemies
attack from all sides
and kill me.
10They refuse to show mercy,
and they keep bragging.
11They have caught up with me!
My enemies are everywhere,
eagerly hoping to smear me
in the dirt.
12They are like hungry lions
hunting for food,
or like young lions
hiding in ambush.
13Do something, Lord!
Attack and defeat them.
Take your sword and save me
from those evil people.
14Use your powerful arm
and rescue me
from the hands of mere humans
whose world won't last.
You provide food
for those you love.
Their children have plenty,
and their grandchildren
will have more than enough.
15I am innocent, Lord,
and I will see your face!
When I awake, all I want
is to see you as you are.
translation_text:
Pʋpiel winsɔsʋg
1O Zugsɔba, kɛlisimi m pʋpielim winsɔsʋg,
wʋmmi m kukuma.
Kɛlisimi m sɔsʋg,
li pʋ yit ziri sɔb nɔɔrin naa.
2Kɛl ka li anɛ fʋnɛ na tisim bʋʋd.
Fʋ nini na nyɛ linɛ an sida.
3La'an nɛ fʋn mi' m sʋnf ka kpansidim yʋ'ʋŋ la,
la'an nɛ fʋn makidimɛ gɔsid la,
fʋ kʋ nyɛ gba'arɛ;
m gban'e ye m nɔɔr kʋ pian' bɛ'ɛdɛ.
4Ya'a kpɛlim ninsaalib tʋʋma,
fʋ nɔɔr pian'ad zug man gban'e m mɛŋ
ka pʋ dɔl zaba dim suoya.
5M nɔba zi'enɛ fʋ suorin la,
m pʋ bie yii li nii.
6O Wina'am, fʋn ka m buon,
bɔzugɔ m mi' ye fʋ na wʋm tisim.
Kɛlisim ka wʋmi m sɔsʋg.
7Pa'alimi fʋ nɔŋilim la tʋm nyalima si'em,
fʋnɛ nɔki fʋ paŋi faaɛn nidib wʋsa
banɛ zɔti kennɛ su'adi fʋ san'an ba dataas yɛla la.
8Mɔrim sʋŋa wʋʋ fʋ nif bielif nɛ,
nɔkimi su'a fʋ kpʋkpama lɛuŋʋn
9yi nimbɛ'ɛdnam banɛ mɔɔd ye ba duoe
tʋ'ʋsim nɛ zaba la ni,
nɛ m dataas banɛ giligim ye ba kʋ la san'an.
10Ba yɔɔ ba sʋnya linɛ digilim la,
ka pian'adnɛ tita'alim.
11Ba gban'e man nɛ zi'el ka giligim;
ba ieednɛ suoya ye ba lugim teŋin.
12Ba nwɛnɛ gbigim ka kɔ'ɔm mɔr o ka o gu'ud ye o gban'e si'el,
ka nwɛnɛ gbigim kanɛ su'a mɔɔdin mɔɔd ye o gban'e si'eli ɔnb.
13O Zugsɔba, duom zi'en,
tʋ'ʋsimi ba ka sigisi ba teŋin,
nɔkimi fʋ zaba sʋ'ʋg la faanmi yis nimbɛ'ɛdnam nu'ugin.
14O Zugsɔba, nɔkimi fʋ paŋi
faanmi yis nimbama nu'usin;
ban banɛ di'edi ba yɔɔd dunia kaŋa ni ma'aa la.
Fʋn nɔŋ sieba la kɔ'ɔm ya'a zabid fʋ tisidi banɛ ka ba tigid
ka ba biis mɛ mɔr bɛdegʋ,
ba su'a arezak bɛdegʋ digili ba biis.
15Ka mam an pʋpiel la zug m na nyɛɛf.
M ya'a ti duoe ka nyɛɛ fʋ nindaa, lin ma'aa siakim.

english_text:
(For the music leader. A psalm by David, the Lord's servant. David sang this to the Lord after the Lord had rescued him from his enemies, but especially from Saul.)
David's Song of Thanks
1I love you, Lord God,
and you make me strong.
2You are my mighty rock,
my fortress, my protector,
the rock where I am safe,
my shield, my powerful weapon,
and my place of shelter.
3I praise you, Lord!
I prayed, and you rescued me
from my enemies.
4Death had wrapped
its ropes around me,
and I was almost swallowed
by its flooding waters.
5Ropes from the world
of the dead
had coiled around me,
and death had set a trap
in my path.
6I was in terrible trouble
when I called out to you,
but from your temple
you heard me
and answered my prayer.
7The earth shook and shivered,
and the mountains trembled
down to their roots.
You were angry
8and breathed out smoke.
Scorching heat and fiery flames
spewed from your mouth.
9You opened the heavens
like curtains,
and you came down
with storm clouds
under your feet.
10You rode on the backs
of flying creatures
and swooped down
with the wind as wings.
11Darkness was your robe;
thunderclouds filled the sky,
hiding you from sight.
12Hailstones and fiery coals
lit up the sky
in front of you.
13 Lord Most High, your voice
thundered from the heavens,
as hailstones and fiery coals
poured down like rain.
14You scattered your enemies
with arrows of lightning.
15You roared at the sea,
and its deepest channels
could be seen.
You snorted,
and the earth shook
to its foundations.
16You reached down from heaven,
and you lifted me
from deep in the ocean.
17You rescued me from enemies,
who were hateful
and too powerful for me.
18On the day disaster struck,
they came and attacked,
but you defended me.
19When I was fenced in,
you freed and rescued me
because you love me.
20You are good to me, Lord,
because I do right,
and you reward me
because I am innocent.
21I do what you want
and never turn to do evil.
22I keep your laws in mind
and never look away
from your teachings.
23I obey you completely
and guard against sin.
24You have been good to me
because I do right;
you have rewarded me
for being innocent
by your standards.
25You are always loyal
to your loyal people,
and you are faithful
to the faithful.
26With all who are sincere,
you are sincere,
but you treat the unfaithful
as their deeds deserve.
27You rescue the humble,
but you put down all
who are proud.
28You, the Lord God,
keep my lamp burning
and turn darkness to light.
29You help me defeat armies
and capture cities.
30Your way is perfect, Lord,
and your word is correct.
You are a shield for those
who run to you for help.
31You alone are God!
Only you are a mighty rock.
32You give me strength
and guide me right.
33 You make my feet run as fast
as those of a deer,
and you help me stand
on the mountains.
34You teach my hands to fight
and my arms to use
a bow of bronze.
35You alone are my shield.
Your right hand supports me,
and by coming to help me,
you have made me famous.
36You clear the way for me,
and now I won't stumble.
37I kept chasing my enemies,
until I caught them
and destroyed them.
38I stuck my sword
through my enemies,
and they were crushed
under my feet.
39You helped me win victories,
and you forced my attackers
to fall victim to me.
40You made my enemies run,
and I killed them.
41They cried out for help,
but no one saved them;
they called out to you,
but there was no answer.
42I ground them to dust
blown by the wind,
and I poured them out
like mud in the streets.
43You rescued me
from stubborn people,
and you made me the leader
of foreign nations,
who are now my slaves.
44They obey and come crawling.
45They have lost all courage,
and from their fortresses,
they come trembling.
46You are the living Lord!
I will praise you.
You are a mighty rock.
I will honor you
for keeping me safe.
47You took revenge for me,
and you put nations
in my power.
48You protected me
from violent enemies
and made me much greater
than all of them.
49 I will praise you, Lord,
and I will honor you
among the nations.
50You give glorious victories
to your chosen king.
Your faithful love for David
and for his descendants
will never end.
translation_text:
Na'ab David nyaŋir yʋʋm
(2Sa 22:1-51)
1Man nɔŋ fʋn Zugsɔb onɛ aan m paŋ daan la.
2M Zugsɔba, fʋnɛ aan m tampiing,
m suak zin'ikpi'euŋ nɛ m faangid.
M Wina'am la anɛ m gbanti'edʋg, o san'an ka m su'ad.
Onɛ lusidim ka aan m vʋm la paŋ, nɛ m kpi'euŋ zin'ig.
3M buol Zugsɔb onɛ nar nɛ zʋn'or la,
ka paam yɔlisim yii m dataas nu'usin.
4Kum lɔbi giligim nwɛnɛ nwiis nɛ,
ka kum ku'onwiis libigim yɔɔg-yɔɔg.
5Ayaʋg lɔb nwiisi giligim,
ka Akum bɛndim nɛ baans.
6M mugusʋg pʋʋgin m daa buolnɛ Zugsɔb la,
m daa kaasi tisim Wina'am la bɔɔd sʋŋir,
ka o naanɛ o Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la ka wʋm tisim,
m kukuma la paae o san'an ka kpɛn' o tʋba ni.
7Teŋgbauŋ la damnɛ ka mi'im zika-zika,
hali ka zuoya la gbina dammid;
ba mi'imnɛ o sʋnfʋ duoe la zug.
8Nyɔ'ɔs daa naanɛ o nyɔnya nii yina;
ka bugum linɛ kanbid yii o nɔɔrin na,
ka bugumsaana linɛ dit yii li pʋʋgin na.
9O da buak agɔla ka sig na,
ka saŋgbansabilig bɛɛ o nɔba teŋir.
10O da ban' Kerub la iank.
Ka sisi'em da'ad o ken tɔ'ɔtɔ wʋʋ niiŋ nɛ.
11O da nɔk liki su'a o mɛŋ,
ka kɛ ka saa saŋgbansabilig gilig o.
12Saŋgbana nɛ sakuga nɛ sa-ian'asʋg
naan nɛɛsim linɛ bɛɛ o san'an la yina.
13Zugsɔb la tans wʋʋ saa nɛ arezana ni;
Onɛ Gaad Si'el wʋsa la lɛn vu ya'as.
14O da tɔɔn o piema la widig o bi'emnam,
ka kadi ba nɛ sa-ian'astita'ar.
15Zugsɔba, fʋ tansʋg
nɛ pɛbistita'ar kanɛ yii fʋ nyɔnya ni na la
kɛ ka Atɛuk ku'osuoya nɛ
teŋgbauŋ ɛɛnbir nie paalʋ.
16O naan agɔlli su'uni gban'e m nu'ugʋ
yaami yis ku'ozuluŋ pʋʋgin.
17O faanmi yisi m dataas banɛ mɔr paŋ hali la ni,
banɛ kisim ka mɔr paŋi gatim la.
18Ba daa kena ludimi m dabisbɛ'og daar,
amaa ka Zugsɔb la sʋŋim.
19O daa mɔrimi yii keŋ paae zin'ikanɛ an yaliŋa.
O daa faanm, on nɔŋim la zug.
20Zugsɔb la tʋmnɛ tisim
wʋʋ man an pʋpiel si'em la.
M nu'usi an nyain la zug ka fʋ tisim piini.
21Man dɔlis Zugsɔb suoya la wʋsa;
m pʋ tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi
fɛndig ka basi m Wina'am.
22M dɔlisid o wada la wʋsa,
m pʋ fɛndig ka bas o zi'ela la.
23O pʋ nyɛ gba'asi'a m san'anɛ,
m mɔɔ gban'e m mɛŋ ka pʋ tʋm bɛ'ɛdɛ.
24M pʋpielim la zug ka Zugsɔb la niŋi m zug bareka.
M nu'usi an nyain la zug ka o tisim piini.
25Banɛ an sida dim la, fʋ pa'annɛ ba nɛ ye fʋ anɛ sida sɔb,
banɛ ka' gba'ar la, fʋ pa'annɛ ba ye fʋ mɛ ka' gba'arɛ.
26Banɛ an nyain la, fʋ pa'annɛ ba ye fʋ anɛ nyain.
Amaa banɛ bɛllim pʋ dɔl suor la,
fʋ mɛ pa'annɛ ba ye fʋ mi' ba gbin.
27Fʋ faand banɛ siedi ba mɛŋ la,
ka sigisid nyɛɛsim dim wʋsa.
28Zugsɔba, fʋnɛ kɛt ka m fitir la kpɛn dit,
Wina'am la kɛ ka lik lieb nɛɛsim tisim.
29Fʋ sʋŋir la zug, m na nyaŋi zab nɛ m dataas.
Wina'am paŋ zug, m na ianki gaŋ zaŋguom tita'ar.
30Ya'a an sida, Wina'am suoya la an sʋ'ʋŋa.
Zugsɔb la pian'ad pʋ mɔr zirii;
onɛ lusid banɛ wʋsa su'a o san'an la.
31Anɔ'ɔnɛ an Wina'am ka ya'a ka' Zugsɔb la?
Ka anɔ'ɔnɛ an Tampiing kanɛ kpi'em
ka li ya'a ka' ti Wina'am la?
32Li anɛ Wina'am la tisidim paŋ,
ka maannɛ m suor sʋ'ʋŋa.
33 O maali m nɔba wʋʋ walig nɔba nɛ,
ka dʋ'ʋsimi zi'el zuor zug.
34O pa'alim mam na zab si'em,
m nu'us tun'e pɔnd kʋntzɛn'ug tiraug.
35Fʋ zaŋ nɛ zaba gbanti'edʋgʋ lusim ka m nyaŋi m dataas,
ka fʋ datiuŋ nu'ug gurim.
Fʋ sʋŋir kɛ ka m an nintita'ar.
36Fʋ yalig suokanɛ bɛɛ m tuon la,
ka m nɔba kʋ sadigɛ.
37M kadi m dataas la paae ba,
ka pʋ fɛndig nya'aŋa, hali nɛ mam ti san'ami ba wʋsa.
38M nwɛ' ba digil teŋinɛ m nɔba ni
ka ba mak duori gʋ'ʋŋ.
39Fʋ tisim paŋ kanɛ na zab,
ka kɛ ka m dataas igini m tuon.
40Fʋnɛ kɛ ka m dataas fɛndigi zɔ ka basim,
ka m kʋ banɛ kisim la wʋsa.
41Ka ba kaasi bɔɔd sʋŋir,
amaa sɔ' kae na faaɛn ba.
Ba kaasi tis Zugsɔb la ka o pʋ gi'e gɔsi ba.
42M bʋ' ba hali
ka ba ti nwɛnɛ uusʋg ka pɛbisim ziidi kennɛ;
m kpa'ae ba bas pal zug wʋʋ bian'ar nɛ.
43Fʋ faanmi yis nimbanɛ kisim la nu'usin,
ka kɛ ka m lieb tɛɛns la zugdaan;
ka sʋ'oe nimbanɛ ka m zi' ba.
44Teŋ zʋŋ dim kenna iginidi m tuon
m ya'a yɛl si'el ba siakid nɛ tisidim tɔ'ɔtɔ.
45Ba wʋsa giinla kɛns nɛ,
ka ba kiridi yiti ba kpi'euŋ zin'isin kenna.
46Zugsɔb la sid bɛ! Zun'or anɛ m Tampiing la din!
Wina'am onɛ aan m faangid la nar nɛ zʋn'or!
47O anɛ Wina'am onɛ yɔɔd banɛ tʋmmim bɛ'ɛd la sam,
ka nyaŋid tɛɛns banɛ ka m sʋ'oe ba la,
48o faanmi yisi m dataas nu'usin.
Fʋ dʋ'ʋsimi gaadi m dataas,
ka faanmi yis banɛ bɔɔd zaba la ni.
49 Alazug, Zugsɔba, m na na'asif buudi wʋsa sʋʋgin,
m na yʋʋm wɔ'ɔgi fʋ yʋ'ʋr la.
50O kɛt ka o na'ab nyaŋid o dataas,
ka pa'an o nɔŋir kanɛ pʋ naadi
tis onɛ ka o bu'oe malʋŋ kpaam niŋ o zugin la.
Ɛɛn! O sʋŋid man David,
ka na sʋŋi m biis nɛ m yaas wʋsa
hali nɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
The Wonders of God and the Goodness of His Law
1The heavens keep telling
the wonders of God,
and the skies declare
what he has done.
2Each day informs
the following day;
each night announces
to the next.
3They don't speak a word,
and there is never
the sound of a voice.
4 Yet their message reaches
all the earth,
and it travels
around the world.
In the heavens a tent
is set up for the sun.
5It rises like a bridegroom
and gets ready like a hero
eager to run a race.
6It travels all the way
across the sky.
Nothing hides from its heat.
7 The Law of the Lord is perfect;
it gives us new life.
His teachings last forever,
and they give wisdom
to ordinary people.
8The Lord's instruction is right;
it makes our hearts glad.
His commands shine brightly,
and they give us light.
9Worshiping the Lord is sacred;
he will always be worshiped.
All his decisions
are correct and fair.
10They are worth more
than the finest gold
and are sweeter than honey
from a honeycomb.
11By your teachings, Lord,
I am warned;
by obeying them,
I am greatly rewarded.
12None of us know our faults.
Forgive me when I sin
without knowing it.
13Don't let me do wrong
on purpose, Lord,
or let sin have control
over my life.
Then I will be innocent,
and not guilty
of some terrible fault.
14Let my words and my thoughts
be pleasing to you, Lord,
because you are my mighty rock
and my protector.
translation_text:
Agɔla pa'annɛ Wina'am girima an si'em
1Agɔla pa'annɛ Wina'am girima an si'em;
saŋgbana la mɛ mɔɔnnɛ o nu'ug tʋʋma yɛla.
2Dabisir wʋsa ba pian'adnɛ,
yʋ'ʋŋ wʋsa ba pa'annɛ o baŋiri an si'em.
3Fʋ kʋ wʋm ka ba pian'ad bɛɛ yɛt si'ela
amaa la'an nɛ wala,
teŋgbauŋ la wʋsa mi' ba yɛla.
4 Ba tiig teŋ wʋsa,
ka ba labaar paae dunia bɛn la.
Wina'am maal zin'ig agɔlli tis winnig la
5ka li nwɛnɛ pu'apaal sidi naanɛ o dɔɔgin yit na,
bɛɛ zɔzɔti zɔɔ nyaŋ
ka maan sumalisim ye o lɛn zɔ.
6Winnig la yitnɛ nya'aŋi gaadi keŋ lu tuon,
si'el kae na su'a ka o tʋʋlʋg kʋ paae lii.
7Zugsɔb wada la an sʋm hali,
ka tɛndigid ninsaal sʋnf.
Zugsɔb la pa'alʋg anɛ sida,
ka kɛt ka banɛ zi' si'el la paam baŋir.
8Zugsɔb la sa'alʋg dɔl suor,
ka tisid sumalisim.
Zugsɔb la zi'ela mɔr nɛɛsim
linɛ nied ninsaal nini.
9Zugsɔb la zɔtim anɛ nyain
ka na bɛ saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.
Zugsɔb la zi'el si'el la zi'enɛ kiŋ-kiŋ
ka pʋpielim bɛɛ li pʋʋgin hali.
10Li an sʋm gat sanlimsʋŋ,
li gat sanlimmɛŋir bɛdegʋ.
Li malisi gat siind,
li gat siind linɛ siligi yi singbana ni na.
11Li ni ka m paamid nimmua sa'alʋg;
man kanɛ aan fʋ sankpan'as la,
m ya'a dɔlli li, li mɔri nyɔɔd bɛdegʋ.
12Anɔ'ɔnɛ na nyaŋi baŋ o gbɛlima?
Kɛlli m tʋʋmbɛ'ɛsu'ada la taali bas.
13M anɛ fʋ sankpan'as,
gurim ka m da tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd pɔn'ɔsim-pɔn'ɔsim;
da kɛ ka li sʋ'ʋgi ma.
Ala ka m kʋ mɔr gba'ar linɛ zu'oe halii.
14Kɛl ka m nɔɔr pian'ad nɛ m sʋnf tɛn'ɛsa paae fʋ ya'am,
Zugsɔba, fʋ anɛ m Tampiing nɛ m Faangid.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
A Prayer for Victory
1I pray that the Lord
will listen when you
are in trouble,
and that the God of Jacob
will keep you safe.
2May the Lord send help
from his temple
and come to your rescue
from Mount Zion.
3May he remember your gifts
and be pleased
with what you bring.
4May God do what you want most
and let all go well for you.
5Then you will win victories,
and we will celebrate,
while raising our banners
in the name of our God.
May the Lord answer
all your prayers!
6I am certain, Lord,
that you will help
your chosen king.
