and now we have seen it
in the city of our God,
the Lord All-Powerful.
This is the city that God
will let stand forever.
9Our God, here in your temple
we think about your love.
10You are famous and praised
everywhere on earth,
as you win victories
with your powerful arm.
11Mount Zion will celebrate,
and all Judah will be glad,
because you bring justice.
12Let's walk around Zion
and count its towers.
13We will see its strong walls
and visit each fortress.
Then you can say
to future generations,
14“Our God is like this forever
and will always guide us.”
translation_text:
Zion linɛ an Wina'am Tempʋtita'ar la
1Zugsɔb la galis ya, ka nar nɛ zʋn'or hali
ti Wina'am la tempʋʋgin la, o zuokanɛ an kasi la ni.
2Zuor la wa'am nɛ ka vɛnl hali,
ka dunia dim wʋsa mɔr sumalisim li yɛla.
Li nwɛnɛ Zafon zuor, zin'ikanɛ wa'am hali la,
Na'atita'ar la tempʋʋg linɛ an Zion Zuor la.
3Wina'am mɛŋ bɛɛ li kpi'euŋ zin'isin la;
o pa'al o mɛŋ ye o anɛ ba suak zin'ig.
4Na'anam la la'as taaba,
ba la'asi ken tuon,
5ba nyɛɛ o ka li paki ba;
ka dabiem mɔri ba ka ba zɔt.
6Dabiem daa kpɛn' ba pamm anina ka ba kirid,
ka li zabidi ba nwɛnɛ pu'a na sa'ae ka li zabid o si'em la.
7Fʋ san'ami ba wʋʋ Tarsis anrintitada
ka sisi'em yi ya-nya'aŋ na widigi ba.
8Nwɛnɛ tinamɛ wʋm si'em la,
ala ka ti nyɛ
Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb tempʋʋgin la,
ti Wina'am tempʋʋgin la:
Wina'am kɛ ka li an baanlimm saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.
9O Wina'am, fʋ Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la pʋʋgin
ka ti tɛn'ɛsidi fʋ nɔŋilim linɛ pʋ mɔr bɛn la yɛla.
10Fʋ yʋ'ʋri an si'em la,
ala ka fʋ zʋn'or paae dunia la zin'ig wʋsa;
fʋ datiuŋ nu'ug la pɛ'ɛl nɛ pʋpielim.
11Zion Zuor nidib maan sumalisim,
ka Juda teŋkpɛmis la dim sʋnf ma'ae
fʋn tu'ad sida la zug.
12Kemi Zion Zuorin la, giligimi li,
kaalimi li mɛɛb banɛ wa'am la,
13gɔsimi li zaŋguom kpi'ema la,
ka gɔsi ba ya' linɛ mɔr paŋ la,
ka ti yɛl zʋmaʋŋ kanɛ na ti duoe na la.
14Bɔzugɔ Wina'am kaŋa anɛ ti Wina'am saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ;
onɛ na guri ti hali ti paae li bɛn.

english_text:
(A psalm by the clan of Korah and for the music leader.)
Don't Depend on Wealth
1Everyone on this earth,
now listen to what I say!
2Listen, no matter who you are,
rich or poor.
3I speak words of wisdom,
and my thoughts make sense.
4I have in mind a mystery
that I will explain
while playing my harp.
5Why should I be afraid
in times of trouble,
when I am surrounded
by vicious enemies?
6They trust in their riches
and brag about
all their wealth.
7You cannot buy back your life
or pay off God!
8It costs far too much
to buy back your life.
You can never pay God enough
9to stay alive forever
and safe from death.
10 We see that wise people die,
and so do stupid fools.
Then their money is left
for someone else.
11The grave will be their home
forever and ever,
although they once had land
of their own.
12Our human glory disappears,
and, like animals, we die.
13Here is what happens to fools
and to those who trust
the words of fools:
14They are like sheep
with death as their shepherd,
leading them to the grave.
In the morning God's people
will walk all over them,
as their bodies lie rotting
in their home, the grave.
15But God will rescue me
from the power of death.
16Don't let it bother you
when others get rich
and live in luxury.
17Soon they will die
and all their wealth
will be left behind.
18We humans are praised
when we do well,
and all of us are glad
to be alive.
19But we each will go down
to our ancestors,
never again to see
the light of day.
20Our human glory disappears,
and, like animals, we die.
translation_text:
Fʋ ya'a ti'e kpan'am, li anɛ gɛtim
1Ya wʋsa wʋmmi;
kɛlisimi nɛ', yanam banɛ bɛ dunia nwa' ni la,
2banɛ an talis nɛ kpi'emnam wʋsa,
kpan'am dim nɛ nɔŋ dim zan':
3M nɔɔr na pian' ya'am pian'ad;
pian'ad linɛ yiti m pʋtɛn'ɛrin na la mɔr gbin.
4M na fɛndigi m tʋbiri kɛlis siilima;
m na nwɛ' kɔn ka yɛli m bʋgʋlʋm-bʋgʋlʋm la gbin.
5Bɔ ka m na zɔt dabiem nɛ dabisbɛ'og kenna yɛla?
Nimbɛ'ɛdnam giligim,
6banɛ niŋi ba kpan'am yadda
ka dʋ'ʋsidi ba mɛŋ nɛ ba areza'as yɛla la.
7Sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi faaɛn o tiraan nyɔvʋrɛ
bɛɛ o yɔ Wina'am o mɛŋ yɛla.
8Nyɔvʋr yɔɔdi kpi'em si'em la,
sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi yɔɔ li yɛla,
9ye o vʋe saŋa wʋsa
ka da kpii.
10Ti ya'a gɔs, ya'am dim kpiid;
ka zɔn nɛ ya'ampɔɔdim dim mɛ kpiid
ka basidi ba kpan'am tisid sieba.
11Ba yaad na kpɛn aan ba ya',
ba na bɛɛ li ni saŋa linɛ pʋ mɔr bɛnnɛ,
la'an nɛ ban nɔki ba mɛŋ yʋda pʋd tɛɛns la.
12Amaa ninsaal nɛ o mɔrim wʋsa, li kʋ nyaŋi faaɛn o
o mɛ na kpi wʋʋ bʋnkɔnbidi kpiid si'em la.
13Banɛ tisi ba mɛŋ sida la na ba'as si'em nwa',
nɛ banɛ dɔlli ba nya'aŋ ka siak ban yɛl si'el la.
14Ba na kpi nwɛnɛ pɛ'ɛs nɛ,
ka kum dii ba.
Pʋpielim dim na sʋ'ʋgʋ ba;
ba niŋgbina na pun'oe yaʋgʋn,
ka ba na lal nɛ ba ya-vɛnla banɛ ka ba mɛ' la.
15Amaa Wina'am na faaɛn man nyɔvʋr yaʋgʋn;
sida o na nɔk mam keŋ o san'an.
16Sɔ' ya'a nyɛ kpan'am, fʋn da kɛ ka li paki fɔ,
hali baa o yir ya'a ti nɔbigidi ken tuonnɛ;
17bɔzugɔ o ya'a ti kpiid o kʋ mɔr si'eli keŋɛ,
o kpan'am la kʋ dɔl o keŋɛ.
18La'an nɛ on daa vʋe ka tɛn'ɛs ye o mɔri bareka
hali ka nidib dʋ'ʋsidif fʋn daa ken tuon zug la,
19o na keŋ la'as nɛ o yaanam zʋmaʋŋ la,
ka kʋ lɛn nyɛ nɛɛsim linɛ bɛ vʋm pʋʋgin la.
20Amaa ninsaal nɛ o mɔrim wʋsa, li kʋ nyaŋi faaɛn o,
o mɛ na kpi wʋʋ bʋnkɔnbidi kpiid si'em la.

english_text:
(A psalm by Asaph.)
What Pleases God
1From east to west,
the powerful Lord God
has been calling together
everyone on earth.
2God shines brightly from Zion,
the most beautiful city.
3Our God approaches,
but not silently;
a flaming fire comes first,
and a storm surrounds him.
4God comes to judge his people.
He shouts to the heavens
and to the earth,
5“Call my followers together!
They offered me a sacrifice,
and we made an agreement.”
6The heavens announce,
“God is the judge,
and he is always honest.”
7My people, I am God!
Israel, I am your God.
Listen to my charges
against you.
8Although you offer sacrifices
and always bring gifts,
9I won't accept your offerings
of bulls and goats.
10Every animal in the forest
belongs to me,
and so do the cattle
on a thousand hills.
11I know all the birds
in the mountains,
and every wild creature
is in my care.
12If I were hungry,
I wouldn't tell you,
because I own the world
and everything in it.
13I don't eat the meat of bulls
or drink the blood of goats.
14I am God Most High!
The only sacrifice I want
is for you to be thankful
and to keep your word.
15Pray to me in time of trouble.
I will rescue you,
and you will honor me.
16But to the wicked I say:
“You don't have the right
to mention my laws or claim
to keep our agreement!
17You refused correction
and rejected my commands.
18You made friends
with every crook you met,
and you liked people who break
their wedding vows.
19You talked only about violence
and told nothing but lies;
20you sat around gossiping,
ruining the reputation
of your own relatives.”
21When you did all this,
I didn't say a word,
and you thought,
“God is just like us!”
But now I will accuse you.
22You have ignored me!
So pay close attention
or I will tear you apart,
and no one can help you.
23The sacrifice that honors me
is a thankful heart.
Obey me, and I, your God,
will show my power to save.
translation_text:
Wina'am pʋ'ʋsim linɛ an yɛlmɛŋir
1Wina'am Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la, o anɛ Zugsɔb Wina'am,
o pian'ad ka buon dunia wʋsa
lin yi winnigi tansid zin'isi'a paae on lit zin'isi'a.
2Wina'am pipilim nyɛɛnnɛ yit Zion
linɛ an teŋ vɛnliŋ amɛŋa la na.
3Ti Wina'am la kenna amaa o pʋ an baanlimm nɛ;
bugum gaad o tuonnɛ diti ken
ka sisi'etita'ar gilig o.
4O buol agɔl nɛ teŋ ye ba wʋm,
ye o na kad o nidib saria, ka ye,
5“La'asimini m mɛŋ nidib la mɔri kɛɛn m san'an na;
nimbanɛ daa maal maana maal nɔnaar nɛ man la.”
6Saŋgbana na mɔɔl o pʋpielim la yɛla,
bɔzugɔ Wina'am mɛŋ anɛ sariakat.
7“M nidiba, wʋmmi ka m bɔɔd ye m pian'anɛ.
Yanam Israel dima, m na di kasɛti pɔ'ɔgi ya;
manɛ an Wina'am, onɛ aan ya Wina'am la.
8M pʋ tansi ya maana la yɛla
bɛɛ ya nyu'or maana linɛ ka ya maannɛ m tuon daar wʋsa la.
9M pʋ bɔɔd na'araugʋ ya gariki ni
bɛɛ bʋʋsi ya bʋlʋʋdinɛ.
10Bʋnkɔnbid banɛ bɛ mɔɔgin la wʋsa anɛ man din,
nɛ niigi banɛ bɛ zuoya tusa ni la.
11M mi' niis banɛ bɛ zuoya ni la wʋsa,
bʋnvʋya banɛ bɛ sian'arin la anɛ m din.
12Man kɔ'ɔm ya'a pʋn zabid, m kʋ yɛli yaa,
bɔzugɔ dunia la nɛ linɛ bɛɛ li pʋʋgin wʋsa anɛ man din.
13Man ɔnbidnɛ na'araad ni'imɛɛ?
Bɛɛ m nuudnɛ bʋʋs ziim?
14Maalim bareka pʋ'ʋsim maannɛ tis Wina'am,
ka kɛ ka fʋn pʋ'ʋlʋm zi'el Onɛ Gaad Si'el wʋsa la niŋ amɛŋa.
15Buoliminimɛ ya yɛla saŋa;
ka m na yisi ya, ka ya na'asim.”
16Amaa nimbɛ'ɛdnam la, Wina'am yɛli ba ye,
“Suobɔ ka fʋ mɔr ka na pian'adi m wada la yɛla?
Bɛɛ bɔ ka fʋ nɔki m nɔnaar la ka li bɛɛ fʋ nɔɔrinɛ?
17Fʋ kisi m pa'alʋg
ka lɔbigi m pian'ad la bas nya'aŋ.
18Fʋ ya'a nyɛ na'ayiig, fʋ ɛɛnti naal nɛ o nɛ;
fʋ zaŋi fʋ mɛŋi la'as nɛ banɛ bɔɔd nidib pu'ab
nɛ banɛ bɔɔd nidib sidib.
19Fʋ mɔri fʋ nɔɔri pian'ad bɛ'ɛd
ka pʋ gban'adi fʋ zilim nɛ faadɛ.
20Fʋ pian'adi pɔ'ɔgidi fʋ ba'abiig ka pʋ basida
ka kɛɛndi fʋ mɛŋ mabiis.
21Fʋn maal nɛ'ɛnam wʋsa ka m sin baanlimm la;
fʋ tɛn'ɛs ye mam anɛ wʋʋ fʋ nɛ.
Amaa m na zɛrigif sʋ'ʋŋa
ka bu'osi fʋ, fʋ nini ni.
22Kɛlisim yɛl lina nwa', fʋn kanɛ tam Wina'am yɛla la,
ya'a ka' ala m na aansif bɛna-bɛna
ka sɔ' kae na faaɛn fɔ.
23Onɛ maal bareka pʋ'ʋsim maan wʋsa na'asidi mam,
ka maan suori digin
ye m ti pa'al o Wina'am faangir.”

english_text:
(For the music leader. A psalm by David when the prophet Nathan came to him after David had been with Bathsheba.)
A Prayer for Forgiveness
1 You are kind, God!
Please have pity on me.
You are always merciful!
Please wipe away my sins.
2Wash me clean from all
of my sin and guilt.
3I know about my sins,
and I cannot forget
the burden of my guilt.
4 You are really the one
I have sinned against;
I have disobeyed you
and have done wrong.
So it is right and fair for you
to correct and punish me.
5I have sinned and done wrong
since the day I was born.
6But you want complete honesty,
so teach me true wisdom.
7Wash me with hyssop
until I am clean
and whiter than snow.
8Let me be happy and joyful!
You crushed my bones,
now let them celebrate.
9Turn your eyes from my sin
and cover my guilt.
10Create pure thoughts in me
and make me faithful again.
11Don't chase me away from you
or take your Holy Spirit
away from me.
12Make me as happy as you did
when you saved me;
make me want to obey!
13I will teach sinners your Law,
and they will return to you.
14Keep me from any deadly sin.
Only you can save me!
Then I will shout and sing
about your power to save.
15Help me to speak,
and I will praise you, Lord.
16Offerings and sacrifices
are not what you want.
17The way to please you
is to be truly sorry
deep in our hearts.
This is the kind of sacrifice
you won't refuse.
18Please be willing, Lord,
to help the city of Zion
and to rebuild its walls.
19Then you will be pleased
with the proper sacrifices,
and we will offer bulls
on your altar once again.
translation_text:
Suguru sɔsib winsɔsʋg
1Zɔmim nimbaanlig, O Wina'am,
fʋ nɔŋilim kanɛ pʋ naad la zug;
fʋ nimbaanlzɔɔri zu'oe si'em la zug,
kɛɛsimi m tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la bas.
2Linɛ wʋsa ka m gɛsig la piemi li wʋsa
ka pie m tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi bas ka m lieb nyain.
3M baŋi m pɔ'ɔgiri an si'em,
saŋa wʋsa m mi' m taal la yɛla.
4 M tʋm bugusim tʋʋma pɔ'ɔgif,
ka tʋm linɛ an bɛ'ɛdi fʋ tuon,
alazugɔ, fʋ din dɔl suor
ka fʋ pian'ad mɔr sida fʋ sariakadib pʋʋgin.
5Sida m anɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb m biilimin sa,
m maa tʋki m pʋʋg saŋsi'a la sa ka m tʋm taal.
6Sida, fʋ bɔɔdi linɛ an sida ninsaal bɛllim pʋʋgin;
pa'alimim ya'am linɛ na bɛɛ m sʋnfʋn!
7Piemim nɛ sappʋ, ka kɛ ka m an nyain;
sʋʋmim ka m pɛligi gaad sakuga.
8Kɛl ka m wʋm sumalisim labaar;
fʋn daa tisim sʋnsa'aŋ hali la,
kɛl ka sumalisim lɛb na.
9Da gɔsidi m tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la
ka yis linɛ wʋsa ka m tʋm ka li an bɛ'ɛd.
10Maalimi m sʋnf la bʋmpaal, O Wina'am,
ka tɛndigim ka m na bɛ sʋ'ʋŋa tisif.
11Da kadimi yisi fʋ san'anɛ
bɛɛ yisi fʋ Siig Kasi la ka kɛɛ ma.
12Lɛbisim sumalisim linɛ yiti fʋ faangirin la na tisim
ka tisim siig kanɛ wʋmmi fʋ nɔɔr la
ka ala na sʋŋidim saŋa wʋsa.
13Ala ka m na pa'ali fʋ suoya tis banɛ pɔ'ɔgidif la,
ka tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim na fɛndigi lɛbi fʋ san'an na.
14Faanmim yis ninkʋʋr pʋʋgin, O Wina'am,
fʋn Wina'am onɛ faandim la,
m zilim na yʋ'ʋmmi fʋ pʋpielim la yɛla.
15O Zugsɔba, yɔ'ɔgimi m nɔɔr,
ka m na zʋn'ʋf.
16Fʋ pʋ mɔr ya'amlɛog nɛ maanaa, ka man naan mɔrin na;
fʋ ba'a kae nɛ nyu'or maanaa.
17Maana linɛ ka Wina'am bɔɔd anɛ fʋn na tiaki fʋ sʋnf ka sie fʋ mɛŋ.
Fʋ mɛ pʋ zan'asid ninkanɛ sik o mɛŋ
ka tiak ka bas o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ.
18Fʋ ya'am bɔɔdim pʋʋgin kɛl ka Zion zi'esim an sʋ'ʋŋa,
mɛɛm Jerusalem zaŋguoma la.
19Ala ka ba na maal pʋpielim maana,
nɛ nyu'or maana linɛ na ma'aa fʋ sʋʋnri tisif.
Ala ka na'araad maana na maali fʋ bimbim la zug.

english_text:
(A special psalm by David for the music leader. He wrote this when Doeg from Edom went to Saul and said, “David has gone to Ahimelech's house.”)
God Is in Control
1 You people may be strong
and brag about your sins,
but God can be trusted
day after day.
2You plan brutal crimes,
and your lying words cut
like a sharp razor.
3You would rather do evil
than good, and tell lies
than speak the truth.
4You love to say cruel things,
and your words are a trap.
5God will destroy you forever!
He will grab you and drag you
from your homes.
You will be uprooted
and left to die.
6When good people see
this fearsome sight,
they will laugh and say,
7“Just look at them now!
Instead of trusting God,
they trusted their wealth
and their cruelty.”
8But I am like an olive tree
growing in God's house,
and I can count on his love
forever and ever.
9I will always thank God
for what he has done;
I will praise his good name
when his people meet.
translation_text:
Wina'am pʋpielim nɛ o nɔŋilim la yɛla
1Bɔ ka fʋ mɔr tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdi nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔgɔ,
kpi'euŋ tita'ar sɔba?
Bɔ ka fʋ dʋ'ʋsidi fʋ mɛŋ bɛogʋn sa?
La'an nɛ wala Wina'am nɔŋilim sid bɛnɛ saŋa wʋsa!
2Fʋ zilim pian'ad anɛ gban'abɛ'ɛd;
li nwɛnɛ sʋ'ʋg kanɛ dit hali nɛ,
fʋ gban'e faad nu'us ayi'.
3Fʋ nɔŋ bɛ'ɛdi gat sʋm,
ka mɛ nɔŋ faadi gat sida.
4Fʋ nɔŋ pian'ad linɛ na san'am nid sʋʋnr,
Fʋn kanɛ an faad sɔba!
5Sida Wina'am na mɔr san'auŋ linɛ kʋ mɔr naari kɛɛn fʋ san'an na:
O na sianki fʋ yisi fʋ sʋgʋrin la bas;
o na yisif teŋ kanɛ ka vʋm dim bɛ la ni.
6Pʋpielim dim na nyɛɛ li, ka dabiem gban'e ba;
ba na la'ad o ka yɛt ye,
7“Dau la nwa' yʋ'ʋs
onɛ pʋ nɔk Wina'am ka o aan o kpi'euŋ zin'iga,
amaa ka ti'e o kpan'am
ka mɔɔd hali san'amid o taaba la!”
8Amaa man nwɛnɛ olif tiig nɛ
busid Wina'am Pʋ'ʋsim Yin;
M niŋnɛ Wina'am nɔŋilim linɛ pʋ mɔr bɛn la yadda
saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.
9M na dʋ'ʋsi fʋ yʋ'ʋr saŋa wʋsa fʋn maal si'el la zug;
fʋ yʋ'ʋrin ka m mɔr ti'ir, fʋ yʋ'ʋri an sʋm la zug.
M na dʋ'ʋsi fʋ yʋ'ʋr fʋ nidib la tuon.

english_text:
(A special psalm by David for the music leader. To the tune “Mahalath.”
)
No One Can Ignore God
1 Only a fool would say,
“There is no God!”
People like that are worthless!
They are heartless and cruel
and never do right.
2From heaven God
looks down to see
if anyone is wise enough
to search for him.
3But all of them
are crooked and corrupt.
Not one of them does right.
4Won't you lawbreakers learn?
You refuse to pray,
and you gobble up
the people of God.
5But you will be terrified
worse than ever before.
God will scatter the bones
of his enemies,
and you will be ashamed
when God rejects you.
6I long for someone from Zion
to come and save Israel!
Our God, when you bless
your people again,
Jacob's family will be glad,
and Israel will celebrate.
translation_text:
Wina'am nidib sɔsid Zugsɔb ye o guri ba
(Yʋm 14)
1Zɔlʋg yɛt o pʋtɛn'ɛrin ye,
“Wina'am kae!”
Ba san'amnɛ, ka ba suoya wʋsa an bɛ'ɛd;
sɔ' kae tʋm sʋm.
2Wina'am naan arezana gɔsid saalib
ye o na nyɛ ya'am daani ba sʋʋgin
nɛ onɛ ieed on Wina'am.
3 Ayei! Sɔ' wʋsa fɛndignɛ,
ba wʋsa yʋ'ʋn san'amnɛ;
sɔ' kae tʋm sʋm,
hali baa nid yinne mɛnɛ.
4Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim la kʋ zamis ya'am?
Ba vɔnnɛ m nidib la wʋʋ saalibi vɔn sa'ab si'em la;
ka mɛ pʋn pʋ sɔsid Wina'am.
5Amaa dabietita'ar linɛ nan zi' gban'e ba
yʋ'ʋn na paae ba hali pamm.
Wina'am na widig banɛ zabid nɛ ya la;
ya diisi ba nyan, bɔzugɔ Wina'am nɛ'ɛsi banɛ.
6M bɔɔd ye Israel faangir naan Zion teŋin na!
Wina'am ya'a ti lɛbis o nidibi ba zin'igin,
Jakob nɛ Israel dim na mɔr sumalisim!

english_text:
(For the music leader. Use with stringed instruments. A special psalm that David wrote when the people of Ziph went to Saul and said, “David is hiding here with us.”)
Trusting God in Times of Trouble
1 Save me, God, by your power
and prove that I am right.
2Listen to my prayer
and hear what I say.
3Cruel strangers have attacked
and want me dead.
Not one of them cares
about you.
4You will help me, Lord God,
and keep me from falling;
5you will punish my enemies
for their evil deeds.
Be my faithful friend
and destroy them.
6I will bring a gift
and offer a sacrifice
to you, Lord.
I will praise your name
because you are good.
7You have rescued me
from all my troubles,
and my own eyes have seen
my enemies fall.

(A special psalm by David for the music leader. Use with stringed instruments.)
Betrayed by a Friend
1Listen, God, to my prayer!
Don't reject my request.
2Please listen and help me.
My thoughts are troubled,
and I keep groaning
3because my enemies attack
with loud shouts.
They treat me terribly
and hold angry grudges.
4My heart is racing fast,
and I am afraid of dying.
5I am trembling with fear,
completely terrified.
6I wish I had wings
like a dove,
so I could fly far away
and be at peace.
7I would go and live
in some distant desert.
8I would quickly find shelter
from howling winds
and raging storms.
9Confuse my enemies, Lord!
Upset their plans.
Cruelty and violence
are all I see in the city,
10and they are like guards
on patrol day and night.
The city is full of trouble,
evil, 11and corruption.
Troublemakers and liars
freely roam the streets.
12My enemies are not the ones
who sneer and make fun.
I could put up with that
or even hide from them.
13But it was my closest friend,
the one I trusted most.
14We enjoyed being together,
when we went with others
to your house, our God.
15All who hate me are controlled
by the power of evil.
Sentence them to death
and send them down alive
to the world of the dead.
16I ask for your help, Lord God,
and you will keep me safe.
17Morning, noon, and night
you hear my concerns
and my complaints.
18I am attacked from all sides,
but you will rescue me
unharmed by the battle.
19You have always ruled,
and you will hear me.
You will defeat my enemies
because they won't turn
and worship you.
20My friend turned against me
and broke his promise.
21His words were smoother
than butter, and softer
than olive oil.
But hatred filled his heart,
and he was ready to attack
with a sword.
22Our Lord, we belong to you.
We tell you what worries us,
and you won't let us fall.
23But what about those people
who are cruel and brutal?
You will throw them down
into the deepest pit
long before their time.
I trust you, Lord!
translation_text:
Zua gbi'id zua
1Kɛlisimi m sɔsʋg, O Wina'am,
da zan'asi m sɔsʋgɔ.
2Kɛlisim ka sʋŋim.
M tɛn'ɛsa la daa daamim nɛ ka m fabili gɛn.
3M dataas la tansid agɔla kpɛn'ɛsidim dabiem;
ba kɛ ka m nyɛt namisʋg
ka katim nɛ sʋnpɛɛn.
4M sʋnf san'amnɛ hali;
ka kum dabiem mɔrim.
5Dabiem kpɛn'ɛm nɛ ka m kirid;
dabiem nyaŋim nɛ hali.
6Ka m yɛl ye, “M ya'a mɔrin dawan kpʋkpama!
M naan ianki lalig ka vʋ'ʋsin.
7M naan ianki laligi
bɛɛn pipirisin.
8M naan zɔɔ laligi ieen su'asig zin'ig,
ka lal nɛ sisi'em linɛ vuud hali la.”
9Fɛndigim nimbɛ'ɛdnam la ya'am, O Zugsɔbaa,
kɛl ka ban gban'e si'el wʋsa lieb zaalim,
bɔzugɔ m nyɛ zaba nɛ bugusim
ka li pɛ'ɛl tempʋʋg la wʋsa.
10Nintaŋ nɛ yʋ'ʋŋ wʋsa ba giligid zaŋguoma la ni wʋʋ ba guri teŋ la;
kisidim nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ma'aa zu'oe teŋ la pʋʋgin.
11Tʋʋmsa'aŋ dim ma'aa pɛ'ɛl teŋ la pʋʋgin;
banɛ kpɛn'ɛsid nidib dabiem nɛ ziri dimi bɛ suoraadin la.
12Li ya'a aannɛ m dataa tʋ'ʋdim,
m naan mɔdigin;
li ya'a aannɛ m bi'em duoe zabid nɛ m,
m naan su'an ka bas o.
13Amaa li anɛ fʋn, ninkanɛ nwɛnɛ mam nɛ,
m zɔɔng, ka aan m zua.
14Fʋn onɛ ka fʋ dɔllim daa malisim
ka ti dɔl taaba la'am ken Wina'am pʋ'ʋsim yin.
15Kɛl ka kum libigi m dataas la;
kɛl ka ba sig kpi'im teŋ vʋt,
bɔzugɔ bɛ'ɛd bɛɛ ba san'anɛ giilim.
16Amaa m buol Wina'am,
ka Zugsɔb la faanm.
17Zaam nɛ bɛogʋn nɛ nintaŋ wʋsa
m kaasid nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ,
ka o wʋmmi tisidim.
18Zaba giligi m zin'ig wʋsa
ka o faanm ka ba pʋ pu'alimi ma,
hali baa nɛ nidib bɛdegʋ duoe zabid nɛ m la.
19Wina'am onɛ zin' o na'am gbauŋ zug saŋa wʋsa la,
na wʋmi ba yɛla ka namisi ba.
Ba anɛ nimbanɛ pʋ tiakidi ba suorɛ,
ka mɛ pʋ zɔt Wina'am baa bi'elaa.
20M dɔllim taa la zabid nɛ o zuanam;
o san'am o nɔnaar la.
21O pian'ad anɛ saaliga wʋʋ kpaam nɛ,
la'an nɛ wala zaba bɛɛ o sʋnfʋn;
o pian'ad bʋgʋsnɛ nwɛnɛ kpaam nɛ,
la'an nɛ wala li anɛ linɛ yisid zaba sʋ'ʋs na.
22Nɔkimi fʋ ziid wʋsa tis Zugsɔb la
ka onɛ na sʋ'ʋŋif;
o kʋ kɛ ka pʋpielim sɔb lii.
23O Wina'am, fʋ lɛɛ na kɛ ka nimbɛ'ɛdnam la li
ba na li bʋmbɔk linɛ an san'auŋ la ni;
ninkʋʋdib nɛ ziri dim la
na dɛŋ kum ka kʋ paae ba yʋma bɛnnɛ.
Amaa ya'a kpɛlim nɛ mam, fʋn ka man ti'e.

english_text:
(For the music leader. To the tune “A Silent Dove in the Distance.”
A special psalm by David when the Philistines captured him in Gath.)
A Prayer of Trust in God
1 Have pity, God Most High!
My enemies chase me all day.
2Many of them are pursuing
and attacking me,
3but even when I am afraid,
I keep on trusting you.
4I praise your promises!
I trust you and am not afraid.
No one can harm me.
5Enemies spend the whole day
finding fault with me;
all they think about
is how to do me harm.
6They attack from ambush,
watching my every step
and hoping to kill me.
7They won't get away
with these crimes, God,
because when you get angry,
you destroy people.
8You have kept record
of my days of wandering.
You have stored my tears
in your bottle
and counted each of them.
9When I pray, Lord God,
my enemies will retreat,
because I know for certain
that you are with me.
10I praise your promises!
11I trust you and am not afraid.
No one can harm me.
12I will keep my promises
to you, my God,
and bring you gifts.
13You protected me from death
and kept me from stumbling,
so that I would please you
and follow the light
that leads to life.
translation_text:
Wina'am ka m tis sida, ka kʋ zɔt dabiem
1Zɔmim nimbaanlig, O Wina'am, ka nidibi katim,
dabisir la wʋsa ba zabid nɛ mam.
2Banɛ ma'ad ziri tisidim la katimnɛ saŋa wʋsa,
a-pa'alim-mɛŋ dim zabid nɛ man.
3Dabiem ya'a ti mɔrim saŋa si'a wʋsa,
mam na ti'enɛ fʋn.
4Wina'am la yʋ'ʋr ka m dʋ'ʋsid,
Wina'am la ka m tis sida, ka kʋ zɔt dabiem.
Ninsaal na maalim bɔ?
5Saŋa wʋsa ba tia'asidi m pian'ad
ka gban'adi m yɛla bɛ'ɛd.
6Ba su'anɛ gban'adi m yɛla,
ka gɔsidi m nɔba yakir,
ka mɔɔd ye ba kʋʋm.
7Ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la zug da kɛ ka ba pɔnsɛ;
O Wina'am kɛl ka fʋ sʋnf duoe nɛ tɛɛns nwa' ka ba wʋsa li.
8Sɔmmi m fabʋlʋg la;
nɔkimi m ninta'am niŋi fʋ waa la pʋʋgin;
li yɛla pʋ sɔbi fʋ gbana la nii?
9Ala ka m ya'a ti buonnɛ fʋ bɔɔd sʋŋir
m dataas la na lɛb nya'aŋ.
Ala ka m na baŋ ye Wina'am la bɔɔdi m yɛla.
10Wina'am la yʋ'ʋr ka m dʋ'ʋsid,
nɛ Zugsɔb kanɛ ka m dʋ'ʋsid o pian'ʋk la.
11Wina'am la ka m tis sida, ka kʋ zɔt dabiem;
ninsaal na maalim bɔ?
12M na maal man daa kaanbi zi'el si'el la, O Wina'am,
m na tisi fʋ m bareka pʋ'ʋsim piini la.
13Bɔzugɔ fʋnɛ yisim kumin
ka pʋ kɛ ka m nɔba tu'ugɛ,
ye m ken Wina'am tuon
vʋm linɛ an nɛɛsim dunia kaŋa ni la.

english_text:
(For the music leader. To the tune “Don't Destroy.”
A special psalm by David when he was in the cave while running from Saul.)
Praise and Trust in Times of Trouble
1 God Most High, have pity on me!
Have mercy. I run to you
for safety.
In the shadow of your wings,
I seek protection
till danger dies down.
2I pray to you, my protector.
3You will send help from heaven
and save me,
but you will bring trouble
on my attackers.
You are faithful,
and you can be trusted.
4My enemies are fierce,
much worse than lions!
They have spears and arrows
instead of teeth,
and they have sharp swords
instead of tongues.
5May you, my God, be honored
above the heavens;
may your glory be seen
everywhere on earth.
6 Enemies set traps for my feet
and struck me down.
They dug a pit in my path,
but fell in it themselves.
7I am faithful to you,
and you can trust me.
I will sing and play music
for you, my God.
8I feel wide awake!
I will wake up my harp
and wake up the sun.
9I will praise you, Lord,
for everyone to hear,
and I will sing hymns to you
in every nation.
10Your love reaches higher
than the heavens;
your loyalty extends
beyond the clouds.
11May you, my God, be honored
above the heavens;
may your glory be seen
everywhere on earth.
translation_text:
Wina'am, zɔmim nimbaanlig
1Zɔmim nimbaanlig, O Wina'am, zɔmim nimbaanlig,
bɔzugɔ fʋ ni ka m su'adi m mɛŋ.
M na su'a m mɛŋi fʋ kpʋkpama lɛuŋʋn
ka yɛlpakir ti gaad.
2M kaasi tis Wina'am Onɛ Gaad Si'el wʋsa,
m na sɔs Wina'am
onɛ maan linɛ ka o gban'e ye o maali tisim la.
3O na naan arezana ni tʋm sʋŋiri faanm,
ka nyaŋ banɛ kati dɔllim la tisim.
Kɛl ka Wina'am pa'al o nɔŋilim nɛ yɛlsida tisim.
4M bɛ nɛ gbigima buugin,
m dignɛ nɛ bʋnyuos;
nimbanɛ ka ba nyina an wʋʋ kpana nɛ piema nɛ,
ka ba zilima nwɛnɛ zaba sʋ'ʋg kanɛ dit hali.
5O Wina'am, kɛl ka fʋ yʋ'ʋr la dʋʋ paae saŋgbana;
kɛl ka fʋ na'am pipilim la pɛ'ɛl teŋgbauŋ la wʋsa.
6Ba yadig asau ye ba gban'e m nɔba;
ka m sʋnf san'am hali.
Ba tunɛ bʋmbɔki m suorin;
amaa ba mɛŋ lɛbi lii ani.
7M sʋnf lɔnɛ viki fʋ yɛla, O Wina'am,
m sʋnf sid lɔnɛ yim,
m na yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma zʋn'ʋf.
8M siiga, duom!
Duomi, yanam banɛ nwɛ'ɛd kɔna nɛ duundis la!
M na duoe bɛkɛung asuba yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma.
9Zugsɔba, m na dʋ'ʋsi fʋ yʋ'ʋr tɛɛns la sʋʋgin,
ka yʋ'ʋmmi fʋ yɛla nidib buudi wʋsa sʋʋgin.
10Fʋ nɔŋilim la zu'onɛ, li wa'ami gaad saŋgbana la;
ka fʋ sida la dʋʋ paae agɔla.
11O Wina'am, kɛl ka fʋ yʋ'ʋr la dʋʋ paae saŋgbana;
ka fʋ na'am pipilim la pɛ'ɛl teŋgbauŋ la wʋsa.

english_text:
(A special psalm by David for the music leader. To the tune “Don't Destroy.”
)
A Prayer When All Goes Wrong
1Do you mighty people talk
only to oppose justice?
Don't you ever judge fairly?
2You are always planning evil,
and you are brutal.
3You have done wrong and lied
from the day you were born.
4Your words spread poison
like the bite of a cobra
5that refuses to listen
to the snake charmer.
6My enemies are fierce
as lions, Lord God!
Shatter their teeth.
Snatch out their fangs.
7Make them disappear
like leaking water,
and make their arrows miss.
8Let them dry up like snails
or be like a child that dies
before seeing the sun.
9Wipe them out quicker
than a pot can be heated
by setting thorns on fire.
10Good people will be glad
when they see the wicked
getting what they deserve,
and they will wash their feet
in their enemies' blood.
11Everyone will say, “It's true!
Good people are rewarded.
God does indeed rule the earth
with justice.”
translation_text:
Wina'am na tɛɛg bugusnam tʋba
1Yanam banɛ an na'anama, ya sid pian'adnɛ sidaa?
Ya kad nidib saria ka li dɔl suorɛɛ?
2Ayei, ya pʋtɛnda ni ya gban'ar wʋsa pʋ dɔl suorɛ,
ya nu'us ieed zaba teŋgbauŋ la zug.
3Hali bugusim dim la pʋn bɔdig nɛ ba du'am saŋa;
ba du'am saŋa sa ka ba pʋn anɛ ninyaalis nɛ ziri dim.
4Ba nɔɔr tɔi nɛ wʋʋ yabid nɛ,
ka nwɛnɛ dunduug kanɛ li' o tʋba ka pʋ wʋmma,
5hali tiim sɔb ya'a bɛlisidi ba si'em,
ba pʋ wʋm o kʋkɔrɛ.
6Kɔɔmi ba nyina la ba nɔya ni, O Wina'am;
vɔɔm gbigima la nyina, O Zugsɔba!
7Kɛl ka ba mɛlim wʋʋ ku'om na pʋbigi gaad si'em la;
ba ya'a tɛɛg tiraug, fʋn kɛl ka ba piema la gbi'ilim.
8Kɛl ka ba nwɛnɛ wilisʋŋ ka bian'ar mɔri gaad
ka nwɛnɛ bikpiilʋŋ ka ba du'a ka o pʋ nyɛ winniga.
9Wina'am na uusi ba kpɛɛmnam nɛ ba biis la tɔ'ɔtɔ
wʋʋ ban na dʋgʋl dʋk ka walim yit si'em la.
10Ba sam yɔɔb la ya'a ti paae, pʋpielim dim na mɔr sumalisim,
daakan ka ba na sig bugusim dim ziimin buugi gaad.
11Ani ka nidib na yɛl ye, “Sida, pʋpielim dim la di'e ba yɔɔd;
Wina'am onɛ kad teŋgbauŋ saria nɛ sida la sid bɛ.”

english_text:
(For the music leader. To the tune “Don't Destroy.”
A special psalm by David when Saul had David's house watched so that he could kill him.)
A Prayer for Protection
1 Save me, God! Protect me
from enemy attacks!
2Keep me safe from brutal people
who want to kill me.
3Merciless enemies, Lord,
are hiding and plotting,
hoping to kill me.
I have not hurt them
in any way at all.
4But they are ready to attack.
Do something! Help me!
Look at what's happening.
5 Lord God All-Powerful,
you are the God of Israel.
Punish the other nations
and don't pity those terrible
and rebellious people.
6My enemies return at evening,
growling like dogs
roaming the city.
7They curse, and their words
cut like swords,
as they say to themselves,
“No one can hear us!”
8You, Lord, laugh at them
and sneer at the nations.
9You are my mighty fortress,
and I depend on you.
10You love me and will let me
see my enemies defeated.
11Don't kill them,
or everyone may forget!
Just use your mighty power
to make them tremble
and fall.
You are a shield
for your people.
12My enemies are liars!
So let them be trapped
by their boastful lies.
13Get angry and destroy them.
Leave them in ruin.
Then all the nations will know
that you rule in Israel.
14Those liars return at evening,
growling like dogs
roaming the city.
15They search for scraps of food,
and they snarl
until they are stuffed.
16But I will sing about
your strength, my God,
and I will celebrate
because of your love.
You are my fortress,
my place of protection
in times of trouble.
17I will sing your praises!
You are my mighty fortress,
and you love me.
translation_text:
Winsɔsʋg linɛ bɔɔd sʋŋir Wina'am san'an
1O Wina'am, faanmim m dataas la nu'ugin;
gurim ka banɛ duoe zi'e m yɛla la da nyɛɛ ma.
2Yisimim tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim la nu'usin
ka faanm ninkʋʋdib la nu'usin.
3Gɔsim ban dig si'em gurim!
Nimbɛ'ɛdnamɛ gu'udim
ka m mɛ pʋ maali ba bɛ'ɛdɛ.
4M pʋ maali ba bugusim,
la'an nɛ wala, ba mɔɔd ye ba zab nɛ m.
Duom sʋŋim,
ka gɔsi maali m yɛl la tisim!
5O Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb, ka an Israel Wina'am,
duom zi'enɛ fʋ mɛŋ ka namis tɛɛns la;
da zɔ bugusnam la nimbaanliga.
6Zaam ma'aya, ka ba lɛb na
ka nyiigid nyina wʋʋ baas,
ka su'adi giligid tempʋʋg la.
7Gɔsim yɛlbɛ'ɛd linɛ yiti ba nɔɔrin na,
ba nɔɔr pian'ad nwɛnɛ sʋ'ʋsi nwaad nidib,
ka ba yɛt ye, “Anɔ'ɔn na wʋmi ti pian'ad la?”
8O Zugsɔba, fʋ la'adi ba nɛ;
fʋ nɛ'ɛs tɛɛns la wʋsa.
9Fʋnɛ aan m paŋ, fʋn ka m gɔsid;
O Wina'am, fʋnɛ aan m suak zin'ig,
10nɛ m Wina'am onɛ an nɔŋilim sɔb.
Wina'am na gaadi m tuon
ka kɛ ka m nyaŋi m dataas.
11Amaa da kʋʋ ba, O Zugsɔb onɛ lusidi ti,
ya'a ka' ala m nidib la na tam.
Fʋ paŋ tita'ar la na kɛ ka ba yirid yɔri-yɔri,
ka kɛ ka ba yʋ'ʋn sig teŋin.
12Tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd linɛ yiti ba nɔya ni la zug,
nɛ ba nɔŋgbana pian'ad si'el la zug,
kɛl ka ba nyɛɛsim la gban'e ba.
Ban pɔɔd nɔya ka ma'ad ziri si'em la zug,
13fʋ sʋnpɛɛn na kanbi ba wʋʋ bugum nɛ,
li na dii ba ti naae nyain.
Ala ka dunia wʋsa na baŋ ye
Wina'am sʋ'oe Jakob yaas la.
14Zaam ma'aya, ka ba lɛb na
nyiigid nyina wʋʋ baas nɛ,
ka su'adi giligid tempʋʋgin la.
15Ba zɔti giligidi ieed diib,
ka ba ya'a pʋ tigɛ ban wuunnɛ wʋʋ baas nɛ.
16Amaa mam na yʋ'ʋmmi fʋ paŋ la yɛla,
bɛog ya'a nie m na yʋ'ʋmmi fʋ nɔŋilim la yɛla;
bɔzugɔ fʋnɛ aan m suak zin'ig,
fʋ san'an ka m su'ad mugusʋg saŋa.
17Fʋn onɛ aan m paŋa, m yʋ'ʋmmi zun'odi fʋ yʋ'ʋr;
O Wina'am, fʋnɛ aan m suak zin'ig,
nɛ Wina'am kanɛ nɔŋim saŋa wʋsa.

english_text:
(For the music leader. To the tune “Lily of the Promise.” A special psalm by David for teaching. He wrote it during his wars with the Arameans of northern Syria,
when Joab came back and killed twelve thousand Edomites
in Salt Valley.)
You Can Depend on God
1 You, God, are angry with us!
We are rejected and crushed.
Make us strong again!
2You made the earth shake
and split wide open;
now heal its wounds
and stop its trembling.
3You brought hard times
on your people,
and you gave us wine
that made us stagger.
4You gave a signal to those
who worship you,
so they could escape
from enemy arrows.
5Answer our prayers, God!
Use your powerful arm
and give us victory.
Then the people you love
will be safe.
6Our God, you solemnly promised,
“I would gladly divide up
the city of Shechem
and give away Succoth Valley
piece by piece.
7The lands of Gilead
and Manasseh are mine.
Ephraim is my war helmet,
and Judah is the symbol
of my royal power.
8Moab is merely my washbasin.
Edom belongs to me,
and I shout in triumph
over the Philistines.”
9Our God, who will bring me
to the fortress,
or lead me to Edom?
10Have you rejected us
and deserted our armies?
11Help us defeat our enemies!
No one else can rescue us.
12You will give us victory
and crush our enemies.
translation_text:
Winsɔsʋg kanɛ bɔɔd nyaŋir
1Wina'am, fʋ zan'asi ti ka san'ami ti;
fʋ sʋnf pɛlig nɛ ti.
Kɛl ka ti lɛm paae fʋ ya'am ya'as!
2Fʋ dam teŋ la yɔ'ɔgi li;
maalimi li lɛbis, ka li da san'am naae.
3Fʋ kɛya ka fʋ nidib nyɛ mugusʋg,
ka kɛ ka ti gɛrid nwɛnɛ daam ka ti nunɛ.
4Amaa banɛ zɔtif la, fʋ nɔk tuuta sɛɛ tisi ba
ye ba zɔɔ la'as anina zaba saŋa.
5Faanmi ti ka sʋŋi ti nɛ fʋ paŋ la,
ka ala ka banɛ ka fʋ nɔŋ la na paam yɔlisim.
6Wina'am naan o zin'ikanɛ an kasi la nii pian' ye,
“M na pʋdig Sekɛm teŋ la nɛ paŋ
ka mak Sukot Bɔn'ɔg la.
7Gilead teŋgbauŋ la anɛ m din,
ka Manase sʋ'ʋlim mɛ aan m din:
Efiram anɛ m tanp zupibig,
ka Juda aan m na'am dansaar.
8Moab anɛ lakanɛ ka m mɔri piesid,
ka Edom aan m ta'ada digilʋg zin'ig;
Filistia ka m tansid,
man nyaŋi ba la yɛla.”
9Anɔ'ɔnɛ na mɔrimi kpɛn' tempʋkanɛ kpi'em la ni?
Anɔ'ɔnɛ na ta'asim Edom teŋinɛ?
10Li ka' fʋnɛɛ, O Wina'am? Ka' fʋnɛ zan'asi ti
ka pʋ lɛn dɔlli ti soogianamɛ yit tanp laa?
11Sʋŋimi tii zab nɛ ti dataas la,
ka ninsaal sʋŋir ka' gbinnɛ.
12Nɛ Wina'am paŋa ti na nyaŋ,
bɔzugɔ, o na nɔɔ ti dataas la digil teŋin.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader. Use with stringed instruments.)
Under the Protection of God
1Please listen, God,
and answer my prayer!
2I feel hopeless,
and I cry out to you
from a faraway land.
Lead me to the mighty rock
high above me.
3You are a strong tower,
where I am safe
from my enemies.
4Let me live with you forever
and find protection
under your wings, my God.
5You heard my promises,
and you have blessed me,
just as you bless everyone
who worships you.
6Let the king have a long
and healthy life.
7May he always rule
with you, God, at his side;
may your love and loyalty
watch over him.
8I will sing your praises
forever, God, and will always
keep my promises.
translation_text:
Wina'am nidib sɔsid o ye o guri ba
1Wʋmmi m kaasig, O Wina'am;
kɛlisimi m winsɔsʋg.
2Dunia bɛn wʋsa ni ka m buolif,
m buolnɛ hali ka m susʋnya ligid;
mɔrimi keŋ tampiing kanɛ wa'ami gat mam la ni.
3Fʋnɛ aan m suak zin'ig,
zin'ikanɛ kpi'em ka gu'udi m dataasi lɛbisid.
4M ya'am bɔɔd ye m bɛɛ fʋ sʋgʋrin la saŋa wʋsa
ka su'a m mɛŋi fʋ kpʋkpama lɛuŋʋn.
5O Wina'am, fʋn wʋm mam pɔ nɔsi'a zi'el la,
ka tisim faar linɛ ka fʋ digil
ye fʋ tis banɛ zɔti fʋ yʋ'ʋr la.
6Paasim na'ab la yʋma,
ka o saŋa na zu'oe zʋmaana bɛdegʋ ni.
7O na zin'in Wina'am na'am gbauŋ zug saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ;
nɔkimi fʋ nɔŋilim nɛ fʋ sida la gur o.
8Ala ka m na yʋ'ʋm zun'e fʋ yʋ'ʋr la
ka maal linɛ ka m pɔɔ zi'el la dabisir wʋsa.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for Jeduthun, the music leader.)
God Is Powerful and Kind
1Only God can save me,
and I calmly wait for him.
2God alone is the mighty rock
that keeps me safe
and the fortress
where I am secure.
3I feel like a shaky fence
or a sagging wall.
How long will all of you
attack and assault me?
4You want to bring me down
from my place of honor.
You love to tell lies,
and when your words are kind,
hatred hides in your heart.
5Only God gives inward peace,
and I depend on him.
6God alone is the mighty rock
that keeps me safe,
and he is the fortress
where I feel secure.
7God saves me and honors me.
He is that mighty rock
where I find safety.
8Trust God, my friends,
and always tell him
each of your concerns.
God is our place of safety.
9We humans are only a breath;
none of us are truly great.
All of us together weigh less
than a puff of air.
10Don't trust in violence
or depend on dishonesty
or rely on great wealth.
11I heard God say two things:
“I am powerful,
12 and I am very kind.”
The Lord rewards each of us
according to what we do.
translation_text:
M faangir yit nɛ Zugsɔb san'an na
1Mam anɛ baanlimm ka gu'usid Wina'am la;
m faangir yit nɛ o san'an na.
2On ma'aa aan m tampiing nɛ m faangid;
onɛ aan m suak zin'ig, m kʋ zɔt dabiem.
3Bɔ ka ya la'asi gilig nid yinnɛ?
Ya wʋsa na la'asi lug o
wʋʋ zaŋguom kanɛ dɛlli bɔɔd liig,
bɛɛ dɔkpin kanɛ pʋ mɔr paŋa?
4Ba mɔɔd ye ba sigis o zin'isʋŋ kanɛ ka o bɛ la ni;
ba ya'amlɛog anɛ faad ma'aa.
Ba kaanbidnɛ kaanb sʋŋʋ ba nɔya ni,
ka lɛɛ kaanbid kaanbbɛ'ɛdi ba sʋʋnrin.
5Zugsɔb la ma'aa ka m gu'usid;
m ti'ir yit nɛ o san'an na.
6On ma'aa aan m tampiing nɛ m faangid;
onɛ aan m suak zin'ig, m kʋ zɔt dabiem.
7M faangir nɛ m na'asi bɛ nɛ Wina'am nu'usin;
o anɛ m tampintita'ar,
ka aan m suak zin'ig.
8Nidibaa, tisimin o sida saŋa wʋsa,
pɛligimi ya pʋʋg nyain tis o,
ka Wina'am la aan ti suak zin'ig.
9Ninsaalib wʋsa nwɛnɛ nidi na vʋ'ʋsi yis na,
kpi'emnam nɛ tadimnam wʋsa pʋ mɔr sidaa;
ba ya'a la'asi ba maki ba tɛbisim
ba anɛ zaalim wʋʋ sɔ' na vʋ'ʋsi yis na.
10Da nɔk la'abanɛ ka fʋ fan' ka li an sida bʋn
bɛɛ nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔg nɛ na'ayiigim la'adɛ,
hali baa fʋ arezak ya'a bɔɔd lin paasim si'em,
amaa da kɛ ka fʋ ya'am kpɛn' li.
11Bʋn yinne ka Wina'am pian' li yɛla,
bʋnama ayi' ka m wʋm;
ye fʋn, Wina'am, fʋ anɛ kpi'euŋ sɔb,
12ka fʋn, O Zugsɔba, fʋ anɛ nɔŋilim sɔb.
Sida fʋ na yɔ sɔ' wʋsa
wʋʋ on tʋm si'em.

english_text:
(A psalm by David when he was in the desert of Judah.)
God's Love Means More than Life
1 You are my God. I worship you.
In my heart, I long for you,
as I would long for a stream
in a scorching desert.
2I have seen your power
and your glory
in the place of worship.
3Your love means more
than life to me,
and I praise you.
4As long as I live,
I will pray to you.
5I will sing joyful praises
and be filled with excitement
like a guest at a banquet.
6I think about you, God,
before I go to sleep,
and my thoughts turn to you
during the night.
7You have helped me,
and I sing happy songs
in the shadow of your wings.
8I stay close to you,
and your powerful arm
supports me.
9All who want to kill me
will end up in the ground.
10Swords will run them through,
and wild dogs will eat them.
11Because of you, our God,
the king will celebrate
with your faithful followers,
but liars will be silent.
translation_text:
Ieem Wina'am nɛ nimmua
1O Wina'am, fʋ anɛ m Wina'am,
m ieedif nɛ nimmua;
fʋ yɛla kɛ ka ku'onuud mɔri m siig
ka m niŋgbina bɔɔdif hali
zin'ikanɛ ka ku'om kae
ka teŋ la kʋdig bar-bar nwa' ni.
2M nyɛɛf fʋ, fʋ pʋ'ʋsim Yin la
ka nyɛɛ fʋ paŋ nɛ fʋ na'am pipilim an si'em.
3Fʋ nɔŋilim la zu'oe gaad vʋm la zug,
m nɔɔr na wɔ'ɔgif.
4M vʋm saŋa wʋsa m na zun'e fʋ yʋ'ʋr,
ka fʋ yʋ'ʋrin la ka m na ʋkidi m nu'us.
5M tigi gaad mam na di disʋŋ;
m nɔɔr na yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma zʋn'ʋf.
6M dig zin'igin m tɛnri fʋ yɛla;
M tɛn'ɛsidi fʋ yɛla yʋ'ʋŋ wʋsa.
7Fʋn aan m sʋŋid la zug,
ka m su'a m mɛŋi fʋ kpʋkpama lɛuŋʋn.
8Fʋn ka m gban'e mɔr kiŋ-kiŋ
ka fʋ datiuŋ nu'ugʋ gurim.
9Banɛ bɔɔd ye ba yisi m nyɔvʋr la na paam san'auŋ;
ba na sig kpi'im teŋ.
10Ba na kpi zaba ni
ka lieb diibi tis sian'anr bʋnkɔnbid.
11Amaa na'ab la na mɔr sumalisim Wina'am san'an;
banɛ wʋsa pɔɔd nɛ Wina'am yʋ'ʋr la na wɔ'ɔg o,
amaa banɛ an ziri dim la, nɔya na an baanlimm.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
Celebrate because of the Lord
1Listen to my concerns, God,
and protect me
from my enemies' threats.
2Keep me safe from secret plots
of corrupt and evil gangs.
3Their words cut like swords,
and their cruel remarks
sting like sharp arrows.
4They fearlessly ambush
and shoot innocent people.
5They are determined to do evil,
and they tell themselves,
“Let's set traps!
No one can see us.”
6They make evil plans and say,
“We'll commit a perfect crime.
No one knows our thoughts.”
7But God will shoot his arrows
and quickly wound them.
8They will be destroyed
by their own words,
and everyone who sees them
will tremble with fear.
9They will be afraid and say,
“Look at what God has done
and keep it all in mind.”
10May the Lord bless his people
with peace and happiness
and let them celebrate.
translation_text:
Wina'am nidib sɔsid Zugsɔb ye o guri ba
1Wʋmmi m fabʋlʋgʋ tisim, O Wina'am;
gu'umi m nyɔvʋr ka bi'em daan la da nyaŋi ma.
2Su'amim ka bugusnam la gban'abɛ'ɛd la da paae ma,
nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd dim banɛ zu'oe mɔr tʋkpiidʋg la.
3Ba saasi ba zilima nɛ wʋʋ sʋ'ʋs nɛ
ka pian'adim pian'abɛ'ɛd wʋʋ piema ka ba ɔɔnni tɔɔndim.
4Ba bɛ nɛ ba suakin ka tɔɔnd banɛ pʋ maali ba si'ela;
ba ɛɛnti gbirig nɛ tɔɔnd ka dabiem kae.
5Ba kpɛmisidi taaba gban'ad gban'abɛ'ɛd,
ka pian'ad ban na su'adi bɛnt baans si'em;
ka yɛt ye, “Anɔ'ɔn na nyɛ ti baans nwa'?”
6Ba gban'ad linɛ pʋ dɔl suorɛ ka yɛt ye,
“Ti gban'e gban'asʋŋ!”
Sida ninsaal pʋtɛn'ɛr nɛ o sʋnf mɔri ya'ambɛ'ɛd.
7Amaa Wina'am na tɔɔn ba nɛ piema;
o na tɔɔn ba vuguri digil teŋin.
8O na kɛ ka ba mɛŋ pian'ad tuligi dii ba
ka kɛ ka san'auŋ paae ba;
ka banɛ wʋsa nyɛɛ ba na lɔbid zug ka nɛ'ɛsidi ba.
9Nidib wʋsa na zɔt dabiem;
ba na mɔɔl Wina'am tʋʋma la yɛla
ka tɛn'ɛsid on maal si'el la.
10Kɛl ka pʋpielim dim la mɔr sumalisim
Zugsɔb la ni ka su'a o san'an;
kɛl ka banɛ pʋ mɔr gba'are ba sʋnya ni la zun'e o.

english_text:
(A psalm by David and a song for the music leader.)
God Answers Prayer
1Our God, you deserve praise
in Zion, where we keep
our promises to you.
2Everyone will come to you
because you answer prayer.
3When our sins get us down,
you forgive us.
4You bless your chosen ones,
and you invite them
to live near you
in your temple.
We will enjoy your house,
the sacred temple.
5Our God, you save us,
and your fearsome deeds answer
our prayers for justice!
You give hope to people
everywhere on earth,
even those across the sea.
6You are strong,
and your mighty power
put the mountains in place.
7You silence the roaring waves
and the noisy shouts
of the nations.
8People far away marvel
at your fearsome deeds,
and all who live under the sun
celebrate and sing
because of you.
9You take care of the earth
and send rain to help the soil
grow all kinds of crops.
Your rivers never run dry,
and you prepare the earth
to produce abundant grain.
10You water all its fields
and level the lumpy ground.
You send showers of rain
to soften the soil
and help the plants sprout.
11Wherever your footsteps
touch the earth,
a rich harvest is gathered.
12Desert pastures blossom,
and mountains celebrate.
13Meadows are filled
with sheep and goats;
valleys overflow with grain
and echo with joyful songs.
translation_text:
Zun'or nɛ bareka pʋ'ʋsʋg yʋʋm
1O Wina'am li nar ye ti zun'odif Zion teŋin;
ti na maal tinamɛ pɔɔ zi'el ye ti maal si'el la tisif.
2Fʋn kanɛ wʋm winsɔsʋg la,
nidib wʋsa na kɛɛn fʋ san'an na.
3Tinamɛ daa bɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdin
ka li zu'oe nyaŋi ti la,
fʋ di suguru ka kɛɛ ti taali bas.
4Banɛ ka fʋ gaŋ la mɔr Wina'am bareka;
ban ka fʋ mɔri ba na ye ba bɛɛ fʋ zakin la!
Ti nyɛ la'asʋma banɛ bɛɛ fʋ yin la,
fʋ pʋ'ʋsim zin'ikanɛ an kasi la.
5Fʋ di'e ti winsɔsʋg nɛ fʋ pʋpielim
linɛ an tʋʋmnyalima la,
O Wina'am onɛ an ti Faangida.
Fʋnɛ an sɔ' wʋsa ti'ir dunia nwa' ni
nɛ banɛ bɛɛ atɛukʋn lallisa la.
6Fʋnɛ maal zuoya la nɛ fʋ mɛŋ paŋ,
ka li pa'annɛ fʋ kpi'euŋ linɛ galis la,
7ka kɛ ka atɛuk la ma'ae baanlimm,
ka li ku'onwiis mɛ ma'ae baanlimm,
ka kɛ ka tʋkpiidʋg linɛ yit tɛɛnsin la na lɛbi fɔn.
8Banɛ bɛ teŋ-magbinnin la sa zɔti fʋ tʋʋmnyalima la;
winnigi yit si'el hali ti paae on lut si'el la,
fʋ kɛya ka nidib nyɛt sumalisim.
9Fʋ gɔsid teŋ la ka dɔn'ɔsidi li;
ka kɛ ka li mɔr kʋ'ʋlʋm.
Wina'am kɔldaad la pɛ'ɛl nɛ ku'om
ye li kɛ ka nidib nyɛ zʋʋd,
bɔzugɔ fʋnɛ maali li ala.
10Fʋ kɛya ka saa ni ka ku'om pɛ'ɛl vugus
hali birigi li wʋsa;
fʋ kɛya ka saa nii bʋgʋli li
ka kɛ ka li zʋʋd la mɔr bareka.
11Yʋʋm la pʋʋgin fʋ kɛya ka nidib bun zʋʋd bɛdegʋ,
ka diib pɛ'ɛli ba niigi tɛrekonam hali badigidi lut suoya ni.
12Mɔma'asa bɛ pipirisin la ka kɔnbid ɔnbid;
ka kʋkʋna la mɔr sumalisim.
13Bʋnkɔnbid galis nɛ zin'ikanɛ ka yaama bɛ la,
ka bɔn'ɔd la mɛ pɛ'ɛl nɛ zʋʋd;
ka ba yʋ'ʋm ka tansid nɛ sumalisim.

english_text:
(A song and a psalm for the music leader.)
Shout Praises to God
1Tell everyone on this earth
to shout praises to God!
2Sing about his glorious name.
Honor him with praises.
3Say to God, “Everything you do
is fearsome,
and your mighty power makes
your enemies come crawling.
4You are worshiped by everyone!
We all sing praises to you.”
5Come and see the fearsome things
our God has done!
6 When God made the sea dry up,
our people walked across,
and because of him,
we celebrated there.
7His mighty power rules forever,
and nothing the nations do
can be hidden from him.
So don't turn against God.
8All of you people,
come praise our God!
Let his praises be heard.
9God protects us from death
and keeps us steady.
10Our God, you tested us,
just as silver is tested.
11You trapped us in a net
and gave us heavy burdens.
12You sent war chariots
to crush our skulls.
We traveled through fire
and through floods,
but you brought us
to a land of plenty.
13I will bring sacrifices
into your house, my God,
and I will do what I promised
14when I was in trouble.
15I will sacrifice my best sheep
and offer bulls and goats
on your altar.
16All who worship God,
come here and listen;
I will tell you everything
God has done for me.
17I prayed to the Lord,
and I praised him.
18If my thoughts had been sinful,
he would have refused
to hear me.
19But God did listen
and answered my prayer.
20Let's praise God!
He listened when I prayed,
and he is always kind.
translation_text:
Yʋʋm kanɛ zun'od ka pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am bareka
1Teŋgbauŋ wʋsa, tansim nɛ sumalisim tis Wina'am!
2Yʋ'ʋmmi yʋʋma yɛl o yʋ'ʋr la mɔr vɛnlim si'em;
kɛl ka o zʋn'or la dʋʋ agɔla!
3Yɛlim Wina'am ye, “Fʋ tʋʋma la mɔr nyalima!
Fʋ paŋ la zu'oya
ka fʋ dataas la kiridi kennɛ fʋ tuon na.
4Dunia la wʋsa iginidi fʋ tuon;
ba yʋ'ʋmnɛ zun'odif,
ba yʋ'ʋmnɛ zun'odi fʋ yʋ'ʋr.”
5Kemi na gɔsi Wina'am la tʋm si'el,
o tʋm tʋʋmnyalima tis o nidib.
6O kɛ ka atɛuk lieb teŋ kpi'emis,
ka ba dɔl teŋ kpi'emis la gaadi dʋ.
Alazugɔ, kemi na ka ti maal sumalisim o san'an!
7O paŋ la zug ka o na'am la ka' naarɛ,
ka o nini gɔsid tɛɛns la wʋsa
ka sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi zan'as o nɔɔrɛ.
8Zun'omi ti Wina'am la, yanam nidiba,
kɛlli ka ba wʋm yanamɛ zun'od o la;
9o guri ti nyɔvʋya
ka kʋ maligin kɛ ka ti sadigɛ.
10O Wina'am, fʋ maki ti gɔs;
ka siligi ti wʋʋ anzurifa ka ba nyɛlig nɛ.
11Fʋ kpɛn'ɛsi ti sanrega ni
ka ziili ti ziid.
12Fʋ bas suor ka nidib nɔɔdi ti;
ka kɛ ka ti dɔl bugum nɛ ku'om pʋʋginɛ gaad;
amaa fʋ mɔri ti kɛn zin'ikanɛ ka diib bɛ bɛdegʋ na.
13M na mɔr nyu'or maana kɛɛn fʋ pʋ'ʋsim yin la na,
ka maal mam pɔ nɔɔri zi'el ye m na maal si'el la wʋsa.
14Man da bɛ yɛla ni ka pɔ nɔɔri zi'el la,
m na maal wʋʋ man da yɛl si'em la.
15M na nɔk bʋnkɔnbid banɛ nɔbi tisif
ka maal maan nɛ pɛraad;
M na nɔk na'araad nɛ bʋʋsi maal maan.
16Yanam banɛ zɔt Wina'am la wʋsa, kemi na kɛlisi;
kɛl ka m mɔɔli on tʋm si'em tisim la wʋsa.
17Man kaas nɛ tis o;
ka yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma zun'e o yʋ'ʋr.
18M sʋnf ya'a nɔŋin tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd,
Zugsɔb la naan kʋ kɛlisini m pian'adɛ;
19amaa Wina'am sid kɛlisya
ka wʋmi m winsɔsʋg.
20Wina'am yʋ'ʋr na paam zʋn'or,
on pʋ zan'asi m winsɔsʋg
bɛɛ mɔŋim o nɔŋilim la!

english_text:
(A psalm and a song for the music leader. Use with stringed instruments.)
Tell the Nations To Praise God
1Our God, be kind and bless us!
Be pleased and smile.
2Then everyone on earth
will learn to follow you,
and all nations will see
your power to save us.
3Make everyone praise you
and shout your praises.
4Let the nations celebrate
with joyful songs,
because you judge fairly
and guide all nations.
5Make everyone praise you, God,
and shout your praises.
6Our God has blessed the earth
with a wonderful harvest!
7Pray for his blessings
to continue
and for everyone on earth
to worship our God.
translation_text:
Bareka pʋ'ʋsim yʋʋm
1Wina'am na zɔɔ ti nimbaanlig ka niŋi ti bareka
ka kɛ ka o nindaa nie ti san'an na.
2Ka li kɛ ka nidib baŋ o suoya la,
ka tɛɛns wʋsa na wʋm o faangir la yɛla.
3Wina'am, kɛl ka nidib dʋ'ʋsi fʋ yʋ'ʋr,
kɛl ka tɛɛns wʋsa nidib zʋn'ʋf.
4Kɛl ka tɛɛns la na mɔr sumalisim ka yʋ'ʋm nɛ sumpielim,
bɔzugɔ fʋ gur nidib la lin nar si'em
ka pa'an tɛɛns banɛ bɛ dunia ni la suosʋma.
5Wina'am, kɛl ka nidib dʋ'ʋsi fʋ yʋ'ʋr,
kɛl ka nidib wʋsa zʋn'ʋf.
6Ala ka teŋgbauŋ la na du'a zʋʋd bɛdegʋ,
ka Wina'am onɛ aan ti Wina'am la na niŋi ti bareka.
7Wina'am na niŋi ti bareka,
ka dunia nwa' wʋsa nidib na zɔɔ o.

english_text:
(A psalm and a song by David for the music leader.)
God Will Win the Battle
1Do something, God!
Scatter your hateful enemies.
Make them turn and run.
2Scatter them like smoke!
When you come near,
make them melt
like wax in a fire.
3But let your people be happy
and celebrate because of you.
4Our God, you are the one
who rides on the clouds,
and we praise you.
Your name is the Lord,
and we celebrate
as we worship you.
5Our God, from your sacred home
you take care of orphans
and protect widows.
6You find families
for those who are lonely.
You set prisoners free
and let them prosper,
but all who rebel will live
in a scorching desert.
7You set your people free,
and you led them
through the desert.
8 God of Israel,
the earth trembled,
and rain poured down.
You alone are the God
who rules from Mount Sinai.
9When your land was thirsty,
you sent showers
to refresh it.
10Your people settled there,
and you were generous
to everyone in need.
11You gave the command, Lord,
and a chorus of women told
what had happened:
12“Kings and their armies
retreated and ran,
and everything they left
is now being divided.
13And for those who stayed back
to guard the sheep,
there are metal doves
with silver-coated wings
and shiny gold feathers.”
14God All-Powerful, you scattered
the kings like snow falling
on Mount Zalmon.
15Our Lord and our God,
Bashan is a mighty mountain
covered with peaks.
16Why is it jealous of Zion,
the mountain you chose
as your home forever?
17When you, Lord God, appeared
to your people at Sinai,
you came with thousands
of mighty chariots.
18 When you climbed
the high mountain,
you took prisoners with you
and were given gifts.
Your enemies didn't want you
to live there,
but they gave you gifts.
19We praise you, Lord God!
You treat us with kindness
day after day,
and you rescue us.
20You always protect us
and save us from death.
21Our Lord and our God,
your terrible enemies
are ready for war,
but you will crush
their skulls.
22You promised to bring them
from Bashan
and from the deepest sea.
23Then we could wash our feet
in their blood,
and our dogs could chew
on their bones.
24We have seen crowds marching
to your place of worship,
our God and King.
25Singers come first,
and then the musicians,
surrounded by young women
playing tambourines.
26They come shouting,
“People of Israel,
praise the Lord God!”
27The small tribe of Benjamin
leads the way,
followed by the leaders
from Judah.
Then come the leaders
from Zebulun and Naphtali.
28Our God, show your strength!
Show us once again.
29Then kings will bring gifts
to your temple
in Jerusalem.
30Punish that animal
that lives in the swamp!
Punish that nation
whose leaders and people
are like wild bulls.
Make them come crawling
with gifts of silver.
Scatter those nations
that enjoy making war.
31Force the Egyptians to bring
gifts of bronze;
make the Ethiopians hurry
to offer presents.
32Now sing praises to God!
Every kingdom on earth,
sing to the Lord!
33Praise the one who rides
across the ancient skies;
listen as he speaks
with a mighty voice.
34Tell about God's power!
He is honored in Israel,
and he rules the skies.
35The God of Israel is fearsome
in his temple,
and he makes us strong.
Let's praise our God!
translation_text:
Nyaŋir yʋʋm
1Wina'am, duom zi'en ka fʋ dataas la widig;
fʋ bi'emnam la na zɔɔ widigi fʋ tuon.
2Nwɛnɛ sisi'em da'ad nyɔ'ɔsi ken si'em la
fʋ na da'ae ba ka ba gaad;
nwɛnɛ bugum nyɛligid singbana si'em la,
ala ka ba na bɔdig Wina'am tuon.
3Amaa pʋpielim dim la na mɔr sumalisim
ka maal sumalisim Wina'am tuon;
ba sʋnya sid na malis hali.
4Yʋ'ʋm tis Wina'am, yʋ'ʋm zʋn'or yʋʋma tis o,
dʋ'ʋsim Onɛ Ban'ad Saŋgbana la yʋ'ʋr;
o yʋ'ʋri buon Zugsɔb,
maalimi sumalisim o tuon!
5O anɛ kpiibis ba', ka an onɛ sʋŋid pʋkɔnya,
onɛ an Wina'am kanɛ bɛɛ o Zin'ig Kanɛ An Kasi la ni.
6Wina'am tisid banɛ pʋ mɔr si'el-si'el la ya' ka ba kpɛn'ɛd,
onɛ yisid banɛ bɛ sanrega ni la ka ba yʋ'ʋm nɛ sumalisim;
amaa banɛ zan'as o la na bɛ teŋ kanɛ mɔr nintantʋʋlʋg
7O Wina'am, fʋn da gaad nidib la tuonnɛ
mɔri ba dɔl sian'arin la,
8teŋ la da dam ya,
ka saa naan agɔlli ni
Sinai Zuor zug fʋn Wina'am,
onɛ sid an Israel dim Wina'am la tuon.
9Wina'am, fʋ tis saa bɛdegʋ
ye fʋ bʋgʋli fʋ teŋ kanɛ kʋdig la.
10Ani ka fʋ nidib la da kena zin'in,
ka fʋ kɛ ka zʋʋd maal bɛdegʋ, O Wina'am,
ka tis banɛ an nɔŋ dim la ban bɔɔd si'el wʋsa.
11Zugsɔb la da tis o labaar la,
ka pu'ab pamm giligi mɔɔli li yɛla yɛt ye,
12“Na'anam nɛ ba soogianam zɔt tɔ'ɔtɔ
ka basi ba la'asʋg la zin'ig,
ka nidib pʋdig la'abanɛ ka ba faaɛn la.
13Hali yanam banɛ da gbɛɛnd bʋnkɔnbid dɔɔdin la,
ya nyɛt la'ad linɛ nwɛnɛ dawana kɔnbid nɛ
ka ba buligi li nɛ anzurifa,
ka li kɔnbid nyɛɛnnɛ nwɛnɛ sanlim nɛ.”
14Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la da widig na'anam teŋin saŋsi'a la,
li da nwɛnɛ sakuga lit Zalmon Zuor zug nɛ.
15Basan zuoya la anɛ zuotitada;
Basan zuoya la dʋnɛ hali.
16Yanam zuotitada, bɔ ka ya gɔsid
zuokanɛ ka Zugsɔb la gaŋ ye o sʋ'oe
ka na bɛɛ ani saŋa wʋsa la nɛ fufummɛ?
17Wina'am zaba tɛrekonam la zu'onɛ,
ba anɛ tusa-tusa ka pʋ mɔr kallɛ;
Zugsɔb la yi Sinai kɛɛn o pʋ'ʋsim yin la na.
18 Fʋn da dʋʋ agɔla la,
fʋ da mɔri banɛ an yammis bɛdegʋ keŋ,
ka di'e piini nidib san'an,
hali la'an nɛ banɛ zan'asif la:
Zugsɔb Wina'am, fʋ na bɛɛ ani.
19Dʋ'ʋsim Zugsɔb la yʋ'ʋr,
Wina'am onɛ aan ti Faangid,
ka ziidi ti zitɛbisa tisidi ti daar wʋsa la.
20Ti Wina'am la anɛ faangid Wina'am,
Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yisidi ti kumin.
21Sida, Wina'am na nwa'ae o dataas la zut,
o na nwa'ae banɛ ken nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ma'aa la zut.
22Zugsɔb la yɛl ye, “M na mɔri ba yi Basan teŋin na,
nɛ atɛuk zulʋŋ la pʋʋgin,
23ka ya na piesi ya nɔba ya bi'emnam la ziimin,
hali ka ya baas mɛ na nyɛɛ ba din.”
24O Wina'am, sɔ' mɛkama nyɛ fʋn ken si'em,
Wina'am onɛ an Na'ab la ken si'em
kpɛn'ɛd o pʋ'ʋsim yin la.
25Banɛ yʋ'ʋm la bɛ tuon ka bʋnnwɛ'ɛda la bɛɛ ba nya'aŋ,
ka pu'asada la bɛɛ ba teŋsʋkʋ nwɛ'ɛd siyaaris.
26Zun'om Zugsɔb la nidib la'asʋg zin'igin;
zun'om Zugsɔb la Israel dim wʋsa bɛ si'el la.
27Benjamin dɔɔg kanɛ an fiin la gaadi ba tuon,
ani ka Juda na'ayikpɛm la bɛ,
nɛ Zebulun nɛ Naftali kpi'emnam wʋsa.
28Wina'am, kɛl ka fʋ paŋ la nie paalʋ,
pa'alimi li tisi ti wʋʋ fʋn ɛɛnti niŋid si'em la.
29Fʋ pʋ'ʋsim Yiri bɛ Jerusalem la zug
na'anam na mɔr piini na tisif.
30Kadim Egipt dim banɛ nwɛnɛ bʋnkɔnbidi bɛ mɔɔgin la,
ka tans tɛɛns la nimbanɛ an wʋʋ wɛniigi la.
Widigim tɛɛns banɛ bɔɔd zaba la,
ka kɛ ka ba sie ba mɛŋ ka mɔr anzurifa na tisif.
31Ba na tʋm nidib ka ba yi Egipt teŋin kena,
Kus dim mɛ na nɔki ba mɛŋi tis Wina'am.
32Dunia na'anama, yʋ'ʋm tisi Wina'am,
yʋ'ʋm zun'oni ti Zugsɔb la.
33Yʋ'ʋm tisi on, Onɛ Ban'ad Saŋgbana la,
saŋgbana banɛ da pʋn dɛŋi bɛ agɔla kʋdimin sa
tansid nɛ kʋkɔtita'ar la.
34Mɔɔlim Wina'am paŋ la yɛla
onɛ ka o kpi'euŋ gur Israel,
ka o paŋ bɛ saŋgbana ni la.
35O Wina'am, fʋn bɛ fʋ Pʋ'ʋsim Yin si'em la,
fʋ tʋʋmnyalima kpɛn'ɛsid nidib dabiem.
Israel Wina'am la tisid o nidib kpi'euŋ nɛ paŋ.
Na'asi anɛ Wina'am din!

english_text:
(By David for the music leader. To the tune “Lilies.”)
God Can Be Trusted
1Save me, God!
I am about to drown.
2I am sinking deep in the mud,
and my feet are slipping.
I am about to be swept under
by a mighty flood.
3I am worn out from crying,
and my throat is dry.
I have waited for you
till my eyes are blurred.
4 There are more people
who hate me for no reason
than there are hairs
on my head.
Many terrible enemies
want to destroy me, God.
Am I supposed to give back
something I didn't steal?
5You know my foolish sins.
Not one is hidden from you.
6 Lord God All-Powerful,
ruler of Israel,
don't let me embarrass anyone
who trusts and worships you.
7It is for your sake alone
that I am insulted
and blush with shame.
8I am like a stranger
to my relatives
and like a foreigner
to my own family.
9 My love for your house
burns in me like a fire,
and when others insult you,
they insulted me as well.
10I cried and went without food,
but they still insulted me.
11They sneered at me
for wearing sackcloth
to show my sorrow.
12Rulers and judges gossip
about me,
and drunkards make up songs
to mock me.
13But I pray to you, Lord.
So when the time is right,
answer me and help me
with your wonderful love.
14Don't let me sink in the mud,
but save me from my enemies
and from the deep water.
15Don't let me be
swept away by a flood
or drowned in the ocean
or swallowed by death.
16Answer me, Lord!
You are kind and good.
Pay attention to me!
You are truly merciful.
17Don't turn away from me.
I am your servant,
and I am in trouble.
Please hurry and help!
18Come and save me
from my enemies.
19You know how I am insulted,
mocked, and disgraced;
you know every one
of my enemies.
20I am crushed by insults,
and I feel sick.
I had hoped for mercy and pity,
but there was none.
21 Enemies poisoned my food,
and when I was thirsty,
they gave me vinegar.
22 Make their table a trap
for them and their friends.
23Blind them with darkness
and make them tremble.
24Show them how angry you are!
Be furious and catch them.
25 Destroy their camp
and don't let anyone live
in their tents.
26They cause trouble for people
you have already punished;
their gossip hurts those
you have wounded.
27Make them guiltier than ever
and don't forgive them.
28 Wipe their names from the book
of the living;
remove them from the list
of the innocent.
29I am mistreated and in pain.
Protect me, God,
and keep me safe!
30I will praise the Lord God
with a song
and a thankful heart.
31This will please the Lord
better than offering an ox
or a full-grown bull.
32When those in need see this,
they will be happy,
and the Lord's worshipers
will be encouraged.
33The Lord will listen
when the homeless cry out,
and he will never forget
his people in prison.
34Heaven and earth
will praise our God,
and so will the oceans
and everything in them.
35God will rescue Jerusalem,
and he will rebuild
the towns of Judah.
His people will live there
on their own land,
36and when the time comes,
their children will inherit
the land.
Then everyone who loves God
will also settle there.
translation_text:
Winsɔsʋg kanɛ kaasidi bɔɔd faangir
1Faanmim, O Wina'am,
ka ku'om la paae m kʋkɔya.
2M simnɛ bian'ar la pʋʋgin sa,
zin'ikanɛ ka nɔbir zi'elʋg zin'ig kae.
M paanɛ ku'ozuluŋin la,
ka ku'om la nyaŋim.
3M gɛnnɛ ka bɔɔd sʋŋir;
m kʋdig nɛ.
M nini sɔbid nɛ,
ka m ieedi m Wina'am.
4Banɛ kis man ka li ka' gbin la
gaad mam mɛŋ zuobid kal;
dataas banɛ yaam zaalim-zaalim la zu'oya,
ba anɛ banɛ mɔɔd ye ba san'amim.
Li anɛ mugusʋgʋ tisim ban yɛtim ye
m yɔɔm linɛ ka m pʋ zu la.
5O Wina'am, fʋ mi' m zɔlim yɛla,
m tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd pʋ su'a fʋ san'anɛ.
6Da kɛ ka banɛ mɔr ti'iri fʋ san'an la
di nyan man zugɔ,
O Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔba;
da kɛ ka banɛ ieedif la
di nyan man yɛlaa,
O Israel Wina'am.
7Fʋn yɛla ka ba tʋ'ʋdim saŋa wʋsa,
ka diisidim nyan daar woo.
8Man liebnɛ saanne m ba'abiisin,
ka nwɛnɛ teŋ zʋŋ nidi m mɛŋ mabiis la ni;
9 M nini mu'oe nɛ Wina'am Yir yɛla si'em la
li nwɛnɛ bugum dit man nɛ
nimbanɛ tʋ'ʋdif la tʋ'ʋdnɛ mam.
10M ya'a lɔ nɔɔri sɔsid Wina'am nɛ kukuma,
ba la'adim nɛ;
11M ya'a yɛ bɔto fuug sʋnsa'aŋ zugɔ,
ba mɔrim nɛ siilim.
12Banɛ zin' za'anɔɔrin la la'adim nɛ,
ka danuudib mɔrimi yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma.
13Amaa m Zugsɔba, fʋn ka man sɔsid.
Wina'am, gandigimim fʋ sʋŋir saŋa
nɛ fʋ nɔŋilim tita'ar la,
di'emi m sɔsʋg nɛ fʋ yɛlsida faangir la.
14Yisimim bian'arin la,
da kɛ ka m firi li nii;
faanmim banɛ kisim la nu'usin.
Yisimim ku'ozulima la ni.
15Da kɛ ka ku'om linɛ pʋbid la nyaŋim,
bɛɛ linɛ zulim la limi ma,
bɛɛ yaʋg linɛ an bʋmbɔk la vɔli ma.
16Di'emi m sɔsʋg, O Zugsɔba, fʋ nɔŋilim linɛ an sʋm la zug;
fʋ nimbaanlzɔɔr la zugɔ, fɛndigimi m san'an na.
17M anɛ fʋ tʋmtʋm, da su'a fʋ nindaa nɛ ma;
di'emi m sɔsʋg tɔ'ɔtɔ, ka m bɛ nɛ yɛla ni.
18Li'elim na faanm;
faanmim yisi m bi'emnam la nu'usin.
19Fʋ mi' ban tʋ'ʋdim ka nɛ'ɛsidim ka kpɛn'ɛsidim nyan si'em;
m bi'emnam la wʋsa bɛ nɛ fʋ tuon ka fʋ nyɛti ba.
20Tʋ'ʋd la san'ami m sʋʋnr pamm
ka kɛ ka m kʋ lɛn nyaŋi maal si'ela;
M ieed onɛ na bʋgʋli m sʋnf, ka sɔ' kae;
ka bɔɔd onɛ na zɔtim nimbaanligi gʋ'ʋŋ.
21Ba daa nɔk yabidi niŋi m diibin
ka nɔk bʋmmi'isʋgʋ gɛndigi m bʋnnuuda ni.
22 Kɛl ka dikanɛ ka ba dit la lieb bɛndigʋ tisi ba;
ka ba nɔnaar nɛ taaba la lieb baŋi gban'e ba.
23Kɛl ka ba nini zu'om ka ba kʋ nyɛta,
ka kɛ ka ba tadigi ku'usid teŋin saŋa wʋsa.
24Kpa'ami fʋ sumpɛɛn la yɛɛli ba;
ka kɛ ka fʋ sumpɛɛn linɛ dit wʋʋ bugum la kanbi ba.
25Kɛl ka ba yir na yɔ danzuunr,
ka nidib kʋ lɛm bɛɛ aninaa.
26Ba namisidi banɛ ka fʋ pu'alimi ba la
ka pian'ad banɛ ka fʋ kɛ ka tɔɔg paae ba la yɛla bɛ'ɛd.
27Sɔmmi ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la wʋsa digil;
da kɛ ka ba nyɛ fʋ faangir laa.
28Yisimi ba yʋda nyɔvʋr gbauŋʋn la
ka da kɛ ka ba yʋda la'as nɛ pʋpielim dim la.
29M sʋʋnri san'am ka m niŋgbina zabid;
O Wina'am, kɛl ka fʋ faangir paŋ la gurim.
30M na yʋ'ʋm zun'e Wina'am yʋ'ʋr
ka na'as o nɛ bareka pʋ'ʋsim.
31Nɛ'ɛŋa na ma'ae Zugsɔb la sʋʋnri gaad naaf maan,
o bɔɔdi li gaad na'araug kanɛ mɔr iila nɛ tafɛɛd.
32Nɔŋ dim na nyɛ ka ba sʋnya ma'ae;
yanam banɛ ieed Wina'am la sʋnya sid na malis!
33Zugsɔb la wʋm fara dim la kaasig,
ka pʋ nɛ'ɛsid o nimbanɛ bɛ mugusʋg pʋʋgin la yɛla.
34Kɛl ka agɔl nɛ teŋgbauŋ zun'e o,
la'an nɛ atɛuk nɛ linɛ bɛ li pʋʋgin wʋsa.
35Wina'am na faaɛn Zion
ka lɛbis Juda tempʋʋs la mɛ'.
Ka nidib na zin'in ani ka sʋ'ʋgi li;
36o tʋmtʋmnib la biis na dii li faar,
ka banɛ nɔŋ o yʋ'ʋr la na bɛɛ ani.

english_text:
(By David for the music leader. To be used when an offering is made.)
God Is Wonderful
1Save me, Lord God!
Hurry and help.
2Disappoint and confuse
all who want to kill me.
Turn away and disgrace
all who want to hurt me.
3Embarrass and shame those
who say, “We told you so!”
4Let your worshipers celebrate
and be glad because of you.
They love your saving power,
so let them always say,
“God is wonderful!”
5I am poor and needy,
but you, the Lord God,
care about me.
You are the one who saves me.
Please hurry and help!
translation_text:
Winsɔsʋg kanɛ bɔɔd sʋŋir
1M Wina'am, kem tɔ' na faanm!
O m Zugsɔba, kem tɔ'ɔtɔ na sʋŋim!
2Banɛ ieedim ye ba kʋʋm la,
kɛl ka ba ya'am fɛndig, ka ba di nyan;
Banɛ wʋsa bɔɔdi m san'auŋ la
na fɛndigi lɛb nɛ nyan.
3Kɛl ka nyan di banɛ la'ad mam
ye, “Hahaa, hahaa la!”
4Amaa banɛ wʋsa ieedif la sʋnf na malis
ka ba na mɔr sumalisim nɛf;
kɛl ka banɛ nɔŋi fʋ faangir la yɛt saŋa wʋsa ye,
“Wina'am la yʋ'ʋr na nyɛ zʋn'or!”
5La'an nɛ wala, m anɛ nɔŋdaan ka an fara sɔb
kem tɔ'ɔtɔ na, O Wina'am.
Fʋnɛ aan m sʋŋid nɛ m faangid;
O Zugsɔba, da yuugɛ.

english_text:
A Prayer for God's Protection
1I run to you, Lord,
for protection.
Don't disappoint me.
2You do what is right,
so come to my rescue.
Listen to my prayer
and keep me safe.
3Be my mighty rock, the place
where I can always run
for protection.
Save me by your command!
You are my mighty rock
and my fortress.
4Come and save me, Lord God,
from vicious and cruel
and brutal enemies!
5I depend on you,
and I have trusted you
since I was young.
6I have relied on you
from the day I was born.
You brought me safely
through birth,
and I always praise you.
7Many people think of me
as something evil.
But you are my mighty protector,
8and I praise and honor you
all day long.
9Don't throw me aside
when I am old;
don't desert me
when my strength is gone.
10My enemies are plotting
because they want me dead.
11They say, “Now we'll catch you!
God has deserted you,
and no one can save you.”
12Come closer, God!
Please hurry and help.
13Embarrass and destroy
all who want me dead;
disgrace and confuse
all who want to hurt me.
14I will never give up hope
or stop praising you.
15All day long I will tell
the wonderful things you do
to save your people.
But you have done much more
than I could possibly know.
16I will praise you, Lord God,
for your mighty deeds
and your power to save.
17You have taught me
since I was a child,
and I never stop telling about
your marvelous deeds.
18Don't leave me when I am old
and my hair turns gray.
Let me tell future generations
about your mighty power.
19Your deeds of kindness
are known in the heavens.
No one is like you!
20You made me suffer a lot,
but you will bring me
back from this deep pit
and give me new life.
21You will make me truly great
and take my sorrow away.
22I will praise you, God,
the Holy One of Israel.
You are faithful.
I will play the harp
and sing your praises.
23You have rescued me!
I will celebrate and shout,
singing praises to you
with all my heart.
24All day long I will announce
your power to save.
I will tell how you disgraced
and disappointed those
who wanted to hurt me.
translation_text:
Wina'am onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔba la aan m ti'ir
1O Zugsɔba, fʋ san'an ka m su'adi m mɛŋ;
da kɛ ka m di nyannɛ.
2Faanmim ka yisim nɛ fʋ pʋpielim la;
Wʋmmi m sɔsʋg ka faanm.
3Aan m tampinkanɛ ka m su'adi fʋ ni,
ani ka m na ken saŋa wʋsa;
tisim nɔɔr ka m nyɛ faangir,
bɔzugɔ fʋnɛ aan m tampiing nɛ m kpi'euŋ zin'ig.
4M Wina'am, faanmim nimbɛ'ɛdnam la nu'usin,
banɛ an bugusnam ka tʋm bɛ'ɛd la.
5Bɔzugɔ fʋnɛ an m ti'ir, O Paŋtita'ar Sɔba,
lin yii m biilimin sa hali ti paae nannanna.
6Lin yii m du'am saŋa sa fʋn ma'aa ka m ti'e;
fʋnɛ yisimi m ma pʋʋgin na.
Fʋn ma'aa ka m na zun'od.
7M bɛllim la anɛ zanbinnɛ tis nidib bɛdegʋ,
bɔzugɔ fʋnɛ aan m kpi'euŋ nɛ m suak zin'ig.
8Fʋ zʋn'or ma'aa bɛɛ m nɔɔrin,
m pa'annɛ fʋ pipilim la an si'em daar wʋsa.
9M ya'a kʋdig, fʋn da kadimi basɛ;
m paŋ ya'a ti naae, fʋn da tami m yɛllɛ.
10M dataas pian'adi m yɛla bɛ'ɛd
banɛ mɔɔd ye ba kʋʋm la la'asi gban'e, yɛt ye,
11“Wina'am tam o yɛla,
kʋdim gban'aminɛ o,
ka sɔ' kʋ faaɛn o.”
12Wina'am, da lal nɛ ma;
lɛm tɔ'ɔtɔ na sʋŋim, O m Wina'am.
13Banɛ duoe zi'e m yɛla la na bɔdig ka di nyan;
banɛ bɔɔd ye san'auŋ paam la na di nyan.
14Amaa ya'a kpɛlim nɛ mam, m na mɔr ti'ir saŋa wʋsa;
m na dʋ'ʋsif ka maligim dʋ'ʋsif.
15M nɔɔr na yɛli fʋ pʋpielim
nɛ fʋ faangir la yɛla daar wʋsa,
la'an nɛ mam kʋ nyaŋi maki baŋ lin zem si'em la.
16M na kena mɔɔli fʋ tʋʋm kpi'ema la yɛla,
O Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔba;
m na mɔɔl pʋpielim
linɛ an fʋn ma'aa din la yɛla.
17O Wina'am, m biilim saŋa ka fʋ pa'alim,
hali ti paae zina ka m kpɛn mɔɔnnɛ
fʋ nyalima tʋʋma la yɛla.
18Hali m ya'a kʋdig ka m zug pɛlig,
fʋn da tami m yɛllɛ, O Wina'am,
hali ti paae mam na mɔɔli fʋ paŋ la yɛla tis zʋmaʋŋ kanɛ kenna la,
ka lɛm mɔɔli fʋ kpi'euŋ la yɛla tis banɛ na ti kena la.
19O Wina'am, fʋ pʋpielim la paae saŋgbana ni,
fʋn kanɛ tʋm tʋʋm bɛda la,
O Wina'am, anɔ'ɔn nwɛnɛ fɔ?
20La'an nɛ fʋn kɛ ka m nyɛ yɛla bɛdegʋ nɛ tɔɔg la,
fʋ na lɛbisi m paŋ la na;
hali m ya'a sigi bɛ teŋ teŋir
fʋ na mɔrimi dʋ'ʋs na ya'as.
21Fʋ paasim na'asi
ka bʋgʋli m sʋʋnr ya'as.
22M Wina'am, fʋ sida la zug,
m na nwɛ' kɔnne zʋn'ʋf.
M na yʋ'ʋm dʋ'ʋsi fʋ yʋ'ʋr,
O Israel Wina'am onɛ an Kasi.
23Mam kanɛ ka fʋ faaɛn la,
na baamid nɛ sumalisim
zun'odi fʋ yʋ'ʋr.
24M zilim na yɛli fʋ pʋpielim tʋʋma la yɛla daar wʋsa,
banɛ bɔɔd ye ba san'amim la,
ba ya'am fɛndig ya ka ba di nyan.

english_text:
(By Solomon.)
A Prayer for God To Guide and Help the King
1Please help the king
to be honest and fair
just like you, our God.
2Let him be honest and fair
with all your people,
especially the poor.
3Let peace and justice rule
every mountain and hill.
4Let the king defend the poor,
rescue the homeless, and crush
everyone who hurts them.
5Let the king live forever
like the sun and the moon.
6Let him be as helpful as rain
that refreshes the meadows
and the ground.
7Let the king be fair
with everyone,
and let there be peace
until the moon
falls from the sky.
8 Let his kingdom reach
from sea to sea,
from the Euphrates River
across all the earth.
9Force the desert tribes
to accept his rule,
and make his enemies
crawl in the dirt.
10Force the rulers of Tarshish
and of the islands
to pay taxes to him.
Make the kings of Sheba
and of Seba bring gifts.
11Make other rulers bow down
and all nations serve him.
12Do this because the king
rescues the homeless
when they cry out,
and he helps everyone
who is poor and in need.
13The king has pity
on the weak and the helpless
and protects those in need.
14He cares when they hurt,
and he saves them from cruel
and violent deaths.
15Long live the king!
Give him gold from Sheba.
Always pray for the king
and praise him each day.
16Let cities overflow with food
and hills be covered with grain,
just like Mount Lebanon.
Let the people in the cities
prosper like wild flowers.
17May the glory of the king
shine brightly forever
like the sun in the sky.
Let him make nations prosper
and learn to praise him.
18 Lord God of Israel,
we praise you.
Only you can work miracles.
19We will always praise
your glorious name.
Let your glory be seen
everywhere on earth.
Amen and amen.
20This ends the prayers
of David, the son of Jesse.
translation_text:
Ban sɔs Wina'am tis na'ab la yɛla
1Pa'alim Na'ab la fʋ yɛlsida, O Wina'am,
pa'alim na'abiig la fʋ pʋpielim.
2O na kadi fʋ nidib la saria nɛ pʋpielim,
nɛ fʋ nimbanɛ namisid la nɛ yɛlsida.
3Kɛl ka zuoya la mɔr bɛllim linɛ an sʋm na tis nidib la,
ka kʋkʋna mɔr pʋpielim na.
4O na zab o nimbanɛ namisid la yɛla
ka tis biis banɛ an fara dim la yɔlisim;
o na san'am onɛ namisidi ba la paŋ.
5O na bɛ saŋa wʋsa nwɛnɛ winnig
nɛ nwadigi bɛ si'em la,
hali nɛ zʋmaana wʋsa.
6O na nwɛnɛ saa niid mɔma'asa zug,
ka nwɛnɛ samilimmiugʋ niidi bʋgʋn teŋ la.
7O bɛllim saŋa la pʋpielim na bɛ;
si'el wʋsa na an sʋ'ʋŋa paae nwadig la bɛn.
8O na sʋ'oe atɛuk nɔɔrin keŋ paae atɛuk nɔɔrin
nɛ Efiritis kɔldaug la nɔɔrin paae teŋ la bɛn.
9Buudbanɛ bɛ pipirisin la na igin o tuon
ka o dataas lii o tuon tintannin.
10Tarsis na'ab nɛ banɛ bɛ lalli la
na mɔr piini na tis o;
Seeba teŋ nɛ Seba teŋ na'anam mɛ
na yɔɔd lampɔɔ tisid o.
11Na'anam wʋsa na igin o tuon
ka sʋ'ʋlim wʋsa na tʋmmi tisid o.
12Bɔzugɔ onɛ na faaɛn fara dim banɛ kaasidi buon o la,
nɛ banɛ namisid ka pʋ mɔr sʋŋid la.
13O na zɔ tadimnam nɛ nɔŋ dim la nimbaanlig
ka faaɛn ba kum pʋʋgin.
14O na faaɛn ba zaba nɛ mugusʋg pʋʋgin,
ba vʋm yɛla pak o la zug.
15O na vʋe yuug!
Ba na tis o sanlima linɛ yit Seeba teŋin na.
Nidib na sɔsid Wina'am tisid o
ka kaanb sʋm tis o saŋa wʋsa.
16Kɛl ka zʋʋd bɛ teŋ la wʋsa ni;
hali nɛ kʋkʋna la wʋsa zug.
Ka wal wala wʋʋ Lebanon zʋʋdi maan si'em la;
ka bul nwɛnɛ mɔɔd banɛ bɛ mɔɔgin la bʋn si'em la.
17Kɛl ka na'ab la yʋ'ʋr bɛ saŋa wʋsa;
kɛl ka o yʋ'ʋr na yuug wʋʋ winnigi yuugid si'em la.
On zug ka sʋ'ʋlim bɛdegʋ na nyɛ bareka,
ka ba na buon o ye Wina'am bareka sɔb.
18Zun'or anɛ Zugsɔb onɛ an Israel Wina'am la din,
on ma'aa tʋm nyalima.
19Zun'omin o yʋ'ʋr linɛ an sʋm hali la saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ;
teŋgbauŋ la wʋsa pɛ'ɛl nɛ o na'am pipilim.
Ami! Ami!
20Jese biig David winsɔsʋg la bɛnnɛ nwa'.

english_text:
BOOK III
(Psalms 73–89)
(A psalm by Asaph.)
God Is Good
1God is truly good to Israel,
especially to everyone
with a pure heart.
2But I almost stumbled and fell,
3because it made me jealous
to see proud and evil people
and to watch them prosper.
4They never have to suffer,
they stay healthy,
5and they don't have troubles
like everyone else.
6Their pride is like a necklace,
and they commit sin more often
than they dress themselves.
7Their eyes bulge with fat,
and their minds are flooded
with foolish thoughts.
8They sneer and say cruel things,
and because of their pride,
they make violent threats.
9They dare to speak against God
and to order others around.
10God will bring his people back,
and they will drink the water
he so freely gives.
11Only evil people would say,
“God Most High cannot
know everything!”
12Yet all goes well for them,
and they live in peace.
13What good did it do me
to keep my thoughts pure
and refuse to do wrong?
14I am sick all day,
and I am punished
each morning.
15If I had said evil things,
I would not have been loyal
to your people.
16It was hard for me
to understand all this!
17Then I went to your temple,
and there I understood
what will happen
to my enemies.
18You will make them stumble,
never to get up again.
19They will be terrified,
suddenly swept away
and no longer there.
20They will disappear, Lord,
despised like a bad dream
the morning after.
21Once I was bitter
and brokenhearted.
22I was stupid and ignorant,
and I treated you
as a wild animal would.
23But I never really left you,
and you hold my right hand.
24Your advice has been my guide,
and later you will welcome me
in glory.
25In heaven I have only you,
and on this earth
you are all I want.
26My body and mind may fail,
but you are my strength
and my choice forever.
27All-Powerful Lord God,
those who stay far from you
will be lost,
and you will destroy those
who are unfaithful.
28It is good for me
to be near you.
I choose you as my protector,
and I will tell about
your wonderful deeds.
translation_text:
GBAUŊ KANƐ PAAS ATAN'
(Yʋm 73–89)
Wina'am tʋmnɛ linɛ nar
1Sida, Zugsɔb la an sʋm tis Israel,
nɛ banɛ pʋʋgʋ an nyain la.
2Amaa li ya'a anɛ mam, li kpɛlimin bi'ela ka m sadigin;
li kpɛlimin fiin ka m ti'ir wʋsa gaadin.
3Bɔzugɔ, m daa mɔr fufum nɛ nyɛɛsim dim la,
man daa nyɛ ka bugusim dim ken tuon la zug.
4Si'el-si'el pʋ daamidi baa;
ka ba niŋgbina mɔr laafi nɛ paŋ.
5Namisʋg linɛ paad nidib la pʋ paad banɛ;
ban'as mɛ pʋ gban'adi ba wʋʋ sieba bɛn'ɛd si'em la.
6Dinzugɔ, nyɛɛsim aan ba niŋgɔnkɔris
ka ba nɔk zaba yɛ wʋʋ fuug nɛ.
7Ba sʋnya an bɛ'ɛd la zug ka ba tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd;
bɛ'ɛd linɛ ka ba tɛn'ɛsidi ba pʋtɛn'ɛrin la pʋ mɔr bɛnnɛ.
8Ba pʋ nan nidiba, ka pian'ad nɛ kisidim
ba nyɛɛsim la zug ka ba bɔɔd ye ba namisi ba taaba.
9Ba pian'adi nwɛnɛ banɛ sʋ'oe arezana,
ka pa'an nyɛɛsim dunia nwa' pʋʋgin.
10Alazugɔ, ba nidib yʋ'ʋn fɛndigi lɛbidi ba san'an
ka siakid ban yɛt si'el wʋsa wʋʋ ku'om ka ba nuud nɛ.
11Ba yɛt ye, “Wina'am na niŋ wala baŋɛ?
Onɛ Gaad Si'el wʋsa la mɔr baŋirɛɛ?”
12Bugusim dimi an si'em la,
ba ba'a kae, ba mɔɔdi ban na nyɛ kpan'am paas.
13Sida, man pɛligi m pʋʋgʋ bɛ si'em la anɛ zaalim;
ka san'ami m ya'a gban'e m mɛŋ nɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd.
14Dabisa la wʋsa m bɛ nɛ namisʋgʋn;
bɛkɛung wʋsa m nyɛti namisʋg.
15M ya'a yɛlin ye m na pian' li yɛla
m naan yiinɛ fʋ biis la nya'aŋ.
16Mam daa mak ye m gban'e li gbin la,
li daa anɛ linɛ mugusidim pamm,
17hali ti paae saŋkanɛ ka m kpɛn' Wina'am pʋ'ʋsim Yin la;
ani ka m baŋi ba naarɛ na an si'em.
18Sida, fʋ nɔki ba niŋ sisalig zin'igin;
fʋ da'ae ba bas teŋin ye ba san'am.
19Gɔsim ban gbirigi san'am si'em!
Dabiem mɔri ba gaad sa nyain!
20Li nwɛnɛ nidi na zaansim ka duoe gbɛɛmin,
Oo Zugsɔba, fʋ ya'a ti duoe,
fʋ na nɛ'ɛsi ba ban ka' gbin la zug.
21M sʋnfʋ daa san'am saŋa si'a
ka ɛndʋg mɔrim hali la,
22m daa anɛ zɔlʋg ka zi' si'el si'ela
ka nwɛnɛ bʋnkɔnbbɛ'ogʋ fʋ tuon.
23La'an nɛ wala, m bɛ fʋ san'an saŋa wʋsa
ka fʋ gban'e m datiuŋ nu'ug.
24Fʋ gurim nɛ fʋ sa'alʋg
ka li naar wʋsa fʋ na mɔrimi keŋ na'asi zin'igin.
25M mɔr anɔ'ɔn arezana ni, ka li ya'a ka'anɛ fʋn ma'aanɛ?
Si'el kae teŋgbauŋ la zug ka m bɔɔdi lɛm paas fʋn zugɔ.
26M niŋgbina nɛ m sʋnf tun'e tadig,
amaa Wina'am an onɛ kpɛmisidi m sʋnf;
on ma'aa ka m bɔɔd saŋa wʋsa.
27Banɛ basif la na bɔdig;
fʋ na san'am banɛ wʋsa pʋ dɔllif nɛ sida la.
28Amaa li ya'a kpɛlim nɛ mam,
li an sʋm nɛ mam pʋ lal nɛ Wina'am la.
M na kɛ ka Zugsɔb la aan m suak zin'ig,
ka lɛm mɔɔn o tʋʋm sʋma yɛla saŋa wʋsa.

english_text:
(A special psalm by Asaph.)
A Prayer for the Nation in Times of Trouble
1Our God, why have you
completely rejected us?
Why are you so angry
with the ones you care for?
2Remember the people
you rescued long ago,
the tribe you chose
for your very own.
Think of Mount Zion,
your home;
3walk over to the temple
left in ruins forever
by those who hate us.
4Your enemies roared like lions
in your holy temple,
and they have placed
their banners there.
5It looks like a forest
chopped to pieces.
6They used axes and hatchets
to smash the carvings.
7They burned down your temple
and badly disgraced it.
8They said to themselves,
“We'll crush them!”
Then they burned every one
of your meeting places
all over the country.
9There are no more miracles
and no more prophets.
Who knows how long
it will be like this?
10Our God, how much longer
will our enemies sneer?
Won't they ever stop
insulting you?
11Why don't you punish them?
Why are you holding back?
12Our God and King,
you have ruled
since ancient times;
you have won victories
everywhere on this earth.
13 By your power you made a path
through the sea,
and you smashed the heads
of sea monsters.
14 You crushed the heads
of the monster Leviathan,
then fed him to wild creatures
in the desert.
15You opened the ground
for streams and springs
and dried up mighty rivers.
16You rule the day and the night,
and you put the moon
and the sun in place.
17You made summer and winter
and gave them to the earth.
18Remember your enemies, Lord!
They foolishly sneer
and won't respect you.
19You treat us like pet doves,
but they mistreat us.
Don't keep forgetting us
and letting us be fed
to those wild animals.
20Remember the agreement
you made with us.
Violent enemies are hiding
in every dark corner
of the earth.
21Don't disappoint those in need
or make them turn from you,
but help the poor and homeless
to shout your praises.
22Do something, God!
Defend yourself.
Remember how those fools
sneer at you all day long.
23Don't forget the loud shouts
of your enemies.
translation_text:
Winsɔsʋg linɛ bɔɔd ye Wina'am faaɛn ba teŋ dataas nu'usin
1Wina'am, bɔ ka fʋ zan'asi ti nyainnɛ?
Bɔ ka fʋ sʋnf pɛlig nɛ fʋ nimbanɛ nwɛnɛ fʋ pɛ'ɛs la?
2Tɛnri fʋ nimbanɛ ka fʋ gaŋ ka li yʋma zulim la,
buudkanɛ aan fʋ faar ka fʋ faaɛn ba la.
Tɛnr Zion Zuokanɛ aan fʋ bɛllim zin'ig la.
3Fɛndigimi fʋ nindaa kpa' gɔsi
fʋ Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la san'am si'em,
dataas la san'ami li ka li pʋ lɛm mɔr maalʋgɔ.
4Fʋ dataas bɛ zin'ikanɛ ka tinam nɛ fʋ la'asid la
ka nwa'ami tansid nyaŋir tansʋg;
ba sɛɛ ba tuutanamɛ zi'el
ka li an zanbinnɛ pa'an ye ba nyaŋ ya.
5Ba niŋidi nwɛnɛ nimbanɛ zanl zɛnna ba nu'usin
ye ba nwa' tiis bɛdegʋ lug.
6Ka zaŋ liemis nɛ zɛnna
san'am dabanɛ ka ba kpi'a la.
7Ba nyu'oe fʋ pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg la ka li dii paae teŋin;
ba kɛ ka fʋ yʋ'ʋri bɛ zin'isi'a la lieb dian'ad.
8Ka yɛli ba pʋtɛn'ɛrin ye, “Ti na san'ami ba wʋsa nyain!”
Teŋin la wʋsa ba nɔk bugum nyu'oe
ka li di zin'ibanɛ wʋsa ka ba daa pʋ'ʋsid Wina'am la.
9Ti pʋ lɛn nyɛt zanbina ka li an nyalimaa;
nɔdi'esidib la baa yinne pʋ kpɛlim,
ka ti sɔ' mɛ zi' nɛ'ɛŋa na yuugi paae si'em bɛnnɛ.
10O Wina'am, bʋndaar ka fʋ dataas la na basi fʋ la'abɔ?
Bi'emnam la na kpɛn san'amidi fʋ yʋ'ʋr ala saŋa wʋsaa?
11Bɔɔ kɛ ka fʋ fuoe fʋ nu'ugʋ ti san'anɛ? Hali fʋ datiuŋ nu'ug la ka basi ti?
Yisimi fʋ nu'ug la fʋ fuugin na san'ami ba!
12O Wina'am, fʋnɛ da aan m na'ab pin'ilʋgʋn sa;
fʋnɛ mɔr faangiri kɛn teŋgbauŋ la zug na.
13Li anɛ fʋnɛ da buak atɛuk la nɛ fʋ paŋ;
fʋnɛ da nwa'ae ku'omin bʋnyua la zut.
14Li anɛ fʋnɛ da mɛdig bʋmbɛ'og kanɛ ka ba buon Lɛviatan la zug
ka nɔk o niŋgbina tis pipirisin bʋnkɔnbid ka li liebi ba diib.
15Li anɛ fʋnɛ da yɔ'ɔg ku'osuoya
nɛ zin'ibanɛ ka ku'om tansidi yit na la;
ka mɛ kɛ ka kɔldaad banɛ pʋbid saŋa wʋsa la kʋdig.
16Fʋnɛ sʋ'oe nintaŋ ka lɛn sʋ'oe yʋ'ʋŋ;
fʋnɛ da maal winnig nɛ nwadig.
17Fʋnɛ da mak teŋgbauŋ la wʋsa titɔndis;
fʋnɛ maal ʋʋn nɛ sɛɛung wʋsa.
18O Zugsɔbaa, tɛn'ɛsim dataas la la'adif si'em,
gɔsim nimbanɛ an zɔn la san'amidi fʋ yʋ'ʋr si'em.
19Ti nwɛnɛ fʋ dawana nɛ,
da nɔki ti tis sian'arin bʋnkɔnbidɛ,
da tami fʋ nimbanɛ namisid la yɛla nyainnɛ.
20Tɛnri fʋ nɔnaar la yɛla,
bɔzugɔ teŋ la zin'ibanɛ an lik la wʋsa pɛ'ɛl nɛ zaba.
21Da kɛ ka banɛ ka ba mugusidi ba la lɛb nɛ nyannɛ;
kɛl ka nɔŋ dim nɛ fara dim la dʋ'ʋsi fʋ yʋ'ʋr.
22O Wina'am, duom zabi sʋŋi fʋ nidib la;
tɛn'ɛsim zɔn la san'amidi fʋ yʋ'ʋr la saŋa wʋsa si'em.
23Da tam fʋ bi'emnam la sʋnya duoe si'em la,
bɛɛ fʋ dataas la maan tʋkpiidʋg saŋa wʋsa si'em laa.

english_text:
(A psalm and a song by Asaph for the music leader. To the tune “Don't Destroy.”
)
Praise God for All He Has Done
1Our God, we thank you
for being so near to us!
Everyone celebrates
your wonderful deeds.
2You have set a time
to judge with fairness.
3The earth trembles,
and its people shake;
you alone keep
its foundations firm.
4You tell every bragger,
“Stop bragging!”
And to the wicked you say,
“Don't boast of your power!
5Stop bragging! Quit telling me
how great you are.”
6Our Lord and our God,
victory doesn't come
from the east or the west
or from the desert.
