18O Jerusalem, kɛlli ka ya zaŋguoma la kaas
ka li wʋsa nwɛ' kuŋi tis Zugsɔb la.
Kɛlli ka ya ninta'am yit wʋʋ ku'om bun nɛ
ka pʋbid yʋ'ʋŋ nɛ nintaŋ.
Kaasimi ka kɛ ka ya sʋnya san'am.
Da vʋ'ʋs bɛɛ bas kaasig baa bi'elaa.
19Yʋ'ʋŋ wʋsa duom ka kaasi tis Zugsɔb la,
kaasim zaamnɔɔr hali ti paae yʋ'ʋŋ tisʋʋs.
Nɔkimi ya sʋnya kpa'ae wʋʋ ku'om nɛ sɔsid Zugsɔb la.
Ʋkimini ya nu'us agɔl ka sɔs o
ka o zɔɔ ya biis la nimbaanlig;
bibanɛ ka kɔ'ɔm kʋʋd suoya wʋsa ni la.
20Wala ka fʋ namisidi ba ala, Zugsɔba?
Sɔ' kae nam mi' nyɛ namisʋg ka li nwɛnɛ nɛ'ɛɛ.
Gɔsima! Li nar ye pu'ab ɔnbi ba biisɛ?
Bibanɛ ka ba mɛŋ du'a ka gɔsi ba la?
Ka li nar ye ba kʋʋdi fʋ maanmaannib nɛ nɔdi'esidib
banɛ tʋmmi fʋ Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la?
21Ba biis nɛ ba kpɛɛmnam
la'am kpii dig teŋin suoya la ni.
Dataas la kʋʋ ba dasam nɛ pu'asada la;
ba kʋʋ ba wʋsa tanpin.
Fʋ sʋʋnri duoe la zug ka fʋ kɛ ka ba kpi
ka pʋ zɔɔ ba nimbaanliga.
22Zugsɔba, fʋn la'asid nidib ye ba di ka maal sumalisim si'em la,
ala ka fʋ kɛ ka dataas kpɛn'ɛsidim dabiem zin'ig wʋsa.
Zugsɔb la sʋnpɛɛn daar la
sɔ' kae na nyaŋi zɔɔ pɔns bɛɛ tiligɛ.
Bi'emnam la kena kʋʋ m biis
banɛ ka m gʋ'ʋl ka nɔŋ la.

english_text:
There Is Still Hope
The Prophet Speaks:
1I have suffered much
because God was angry.
2He chased me into a dark place,
where no light could enter.
3I am the only one he punishes
over and over again,
without ever stopping.
4God caused my skin and flesh
to waste away,
and he crushed my bones.
5He attacked and surrounded me
with hardships and trouble;
6he forced me to sit in the dark
like someone long dead.
7God built a fence around me
that I cannot climb over,
and he chained me down.
8Even when I shouted
and prayed for help,
he refused to listen.
9God put big rocks in my way
and made me follow
a crooked path.
10God was like a bear or a lion
waiting in ambush for me;
11he dragged me from the road,
then tore me to shreds.
12God took careful aim
and shot his arrows
13straight through my heart.
14I am a joke to everyone—
no one ever stops
making fun of me.
15God has turned my life sour.
16He made me eat gravel
and rubbed me in the dirt.
17I cannot find peace
or remember happiness.
18I tell myself, “I am finished!
I can't count on the Lord
to do anything for me.”
19Just thinking of my troubles
and my lonely wandering
makes me miserable.
20That's all I ever think about,
and I am depressed.
21Then I remember something
that fills me with hope.
22The Lord's kindness never fails!
If he had not been merciful,
we would have been destroyed.
23The Lord can always be trusted
to show mercy each morning.
24Deep in my heart I say,
“The Lord is all I need;
I can depend on him!”
25The Lord is kind to everyone
who trusts and obeys him.
26It is good to wait patiently
for the Lord to save us.
27When we are young,
it is good to struggle hard
28and to sit silently alone,
if this is what
the Lord intends.
29Being rubbed in the dirt
can teach us a lesson;
30we can also learn from insults
and hard knocks.
31The Lord won't always reject us!
32He causes a lot of suffering,
but he also has pity
because of his great love.
33The Lord doesn't enjoy
sending grief or pain.
34Don't trample prisoners
under your feet
35or cheat anyone out of
what is rightfully theirs.
God Most High sees everything,
36and he knows when you refuse
to give someone a fair trial.
37No one can do anything
without the Lord's approval.
38Good and bad each happen
at the command
of God Most High.
39We're still alive!
We shouldn't complain
when we are being punished
for our sins.
40Instead, we should think
about the way we are living,
and turn back to the Lord.
41When we lift our hands
in prayer to God in heaven,
we should offer him our hearts
and say, 42“We've sinned!
We've rebelled against you,
and you haven't forgiven us!
43Anger is written all over you,
as you pursue and slaughter us
without showing pity.
44You are behind a wall of clouds
that blocks out our prayers.
45You allowed nations
to treat us like garbage;
46our enemies curse us.
47We are terrified and trapped,
caught and crushed.”
48My people are destroyed!
Tears flood my eyes,
49and they won't stop
50until the Lord looks down
from heaven and helps.
51I am horrified when I see
what enemies have done
to the young women of our city.
52No one had reason to hate me,
but I was hunted down
like a bird.
53Then they tried to kill me
by tossing me into a pit
and throwing stones at me.
54Water covered my head—
I thought I was gone.
55From the bottom of the pit,
I prayed to you, Lord.
56I begged you to listen.
“Help!” I shouted. “Save me!”
You answered my prayer
57and came when I was in need.
You told me, “Don't worry!”
58You rescued me
and saved my life.
59You saw them abuse me, Lord,
so make things right.
60You know every plot
they have made against me.
61Yes, you know their insults
and their evil plans.
62All day long they attack
with words and whispers.
63No matter what they are doing,
they keep on mocking me.
64Pay them back for everything
they have done, Lord!
65Put your curse on them
and make them suffer.
66Get angry and go after them
until not a trace is left
under the heavens.
translation_text:
Tʋbtɛɛgir nɛ ti'ir yɛla
1Manɛ an onɛ baŋ namisʋgʋ an si'em
ka li anɛ Wina'am sʋnfʋ duoe ka o bʋ'ʋm nɛ balaar.
2O mɔrimi keŋ kpɛn'ɛs zin'ikanɛ an lik
ka nɛɛsim kae.
3Ka bʋ'ʋm hali sʋ'ʋŋa
pɛndigi pɛndig ka pʋ basida.
4O basi m niŋgbiŋ la ka li kʋdig,
ka kɔɔ m kɔnba.
5O da yɔɔm nɛ sanrega ni
ka kɛ ka namisʋg nɛ tɔɔg giligim.
6O kɛ ka m bɛ likin
ka nwɛnɛ banɛ kpii dig yaʋgʋn nɛ.
7O lɔɔm nu'us nɛ baans
ka m ka' yiib ti'irɛ.
8M kaas kuŋ ka tansi bɔɔd sʋŋir,
ka Wina'am zan'as ye o kʋ wʋmi m sɔsʋgɔ.
9M ya'a ye m keŋ wʋsa
o mɛɛd kuga guoma gu'udim.
10O nwɛnɛ wɛbaa su'a gu'udim
ka nwɛnɛ gbigim kanɛ su'a digi pigidim.
11O vuugimi yi suor la zug na tɔɔnsi tɔɔnsim
ka basim, ka sʋŋir kae.
12O gʋd tiraugʋ tɛk ye o tɔn
ka li anɛ mam ka o tɛɛg piim la kpa' ye o tɔn.
13O fuoe piema o lɔkin, tɔn
ka piema la kʋnsi m susʋnf.
14Nidib la'adim daar wʋsa, ka mɔrimi di'em,
ka yʋ'ʋm yʋʋma nɛ'ɛsidim.
15Namisʋgʋ liebi m diib nɛ m ku'om
li tɔɔg nwɛnɛ yabid nɛ.
16O nɔk zigi nɛ kuga kɔɔ m nyina;
ka nɔɔmi digil titanin.
17M kɔ'ɔŋ laafi nɛ sumbʋgʋsʋm
li yuugi galis ka m tam linɛ wʋsa an sʋm yɛla.
18Ala ka m yɛl ye, “Man vɛnlim naae ya,
ka m ti'ir linɛ ka m mɔr Zugsɔb san'an la gaad.”
19M ya'a tɛn'ɛsi m namisʋg nɛ man giilim si'em la yɛla
li anɛ tɔɔg wʋʋ yabid nɛ tisim.
20M tɛn'ɛsidi li yɛla hali
ka m sʋʋnr san'ami li zug.
21Amaa m tɛn'ɛs yɛl yinne
ka linzug ka m mɔr ti'ir ya'as:
22ye, Zugsɔb nɔŋilim nɛ o nimbaanlzɔɔr linɛ ka' bɛn la,
kɛ ka ti nan kpɛm bɛ.
23Bɛogʋn wʋsa o nɔŋilim la anɛ bʋmpaal;
ka o yɛlsida zu'oe hali.
24M yɛli m sʋʋnrin ye, “Zugsɔb la aan m mɔrim nɛ m faar,
ka m nɔki m ti'ir wʋsa niŋ o ni.”
25Zugsɔb la an sʋ'ʋm tis banɛ ti'iri bɛɛ o ni
nɛ banɛ ieed o nɛ ba sʋʋnr wʋsa la.
26Li an sʋ'ʋm nɛ nidi na ma'ae o mɛŋ baanlimm
gur Zugsɔb la faangir la.
27Li nar ye o mɔr suguru kaŋa mɔdig tʋʋm kpi'ema ni
saŋkan ka o nam bɛɛ o dasannimin la.
28O ya'a namisid, on zin'inim baanlimm nɛ suguru
ka li anɛ Zugsɔb la kɛ ka li paae o.
29O siem o mɛŋi digin teŋin
ka daasi'erɛ ti'ir na bɛɛ tis o.
30Baa li ya'a anɛ tʋ'ʋd nɛ bʋ'ʋd wʋsa
on siakimi li ka bɛ baanlimm.
31Zugsɔb la zɔt nimbaanlig
ka kʋ bas ninsaal nyainnɛ.
32O na mɔr sʋnsa'aŋ na amaa o na pa'al o nimbaanlzɔɔr
o nɔŋilim linɛ ka' naar la zug.
33Li ka' o bɔɔdim ka o namisid nidiba;
ba sʋʋnr ya'a san'am li pʋ malis oo.
34Ba mugus banɛ bɛ sanrega ni
ka namisi ba hali.
35Ba mɔŋ nidib bʋʋd
Zugsɔb Onɛ Gaad Si'el Wʋsa la tuon,
36ka kɛ ka sida kae sariakadib zin'iginɛ;
Zugsɔb la nyɛt ka mi' linɛ tʋm wʋsa.
37Anɔ'ɔnɛ na tun'e tis nɔɔr ka ba sid niŋi li
ka li ya'a ka'anɛ Zugsɔb la pʋn gban'e li?
38Li ka'anɛ Zugsɔb Onɛ Gaad Si'el wʋsa la san'an
ka bʋnsʋŋ nɛ bʋmbɛ'ɛd wʋsa yitnaa?
39Bɔɔ maal ka ninsaal ya'a tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka tɔɔg paae o
ka o fabin ka nyɔnnɛ li yɛla?
40Kɛl ka ti vɛɛnsi ti suoya gɔs
ka fɛndigi lɛb Zugsɔb san'an.
41Kɛl ka ti yɔ'ɔgi ti sʋnya tis Wina'am onɛ bɛ Arezana la
ka ʋki ti nu'usi pʋ'ʋs o, ka yɛl o ye,
42“Ti tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka zan'asi fʋ nɔɔr,
ka fʋn Zugsɔb la nam pʋ kɛɛ ti taali basɛ.
43Fʋ pili fʋ mɛŋ nɛ sʋnpɛɛn wʋʋ fuugnɛ kati ti
ka kʋʋdi ti ka pʋ zɔt nimbaanliga.
44Fʋ pili fʋ mɛŋ nɛ saŋgbana
ka li kɛ ka ti sɔsʋg pʋ paadi fɔ.
45Fʋ kɛya ka ti nwɛnɛ tampʋʋr
ka nwɛnɛ sa'adi tis dunia nidib wʋsa.
46Ti dataas wʋsa la'adi ti nɛ,
ba kɛɛndi ti ka tʋ'ʋdi ti.
47Ti nyɛt tɔɔg nɛ dabiem nɛ vɔlisʋg
ka dit namisʋg nɛ fara bɛdegʋ.”
48M nini wʋsa anɛ ninta'am
ka li anɛ m nidib la paam san'auŋ la zug.
49M ninta'am yit nɛ ka pʋ gu'oda,
li zan'as ye li kʋ gu'oe.
50Asɛɛ ka Zugsɔb naam arezana ni
sʋ'ʋnnɛ gɔs na ka nyɛɛti.
51M ya'a nyɛ ban maan pu'abi m tempʋʋgin la si'em la
kɛnɛ ka m sʋʋnr san'amid.
52M dataas gban'am nɛ baŋ wʋʋ niiŋ nɛ
ka m pʋ maali ba si'el si'ela.
53Ba nɔkim nɛ bas bʋmbɔk zulʋŋin
ka nɔk kuga lɔbid ye ba kʋʋm.
54Ku'om la limi m zug
ka m tɛn'ɛs ye m kum paae.
55M Zugsɔba, m daa bɛnɛ bʋmbɔk la pʋʋgin
ka nwɛ' kuŋi buoli fʋ yʋ'ʋr.
56Fʋ wʋmmi m sɔsʋg,
“Da li' fʋ tʋba nɛ man fabinnɛ tisidif ye fʋ tisim yɔlisim la!”
57Man buolif la fʋ li'eli m san'an na
ka yɛlim ye, “Da zɔt dabiem!”
58Zugsɔba, fʋnɛ kena sʋŋim ka faanm
ka kɛ ka m nan vʋe.
59Fʋ nyɛ ban kisim ka mɔŋi m bʋʋd si'em.
Kadim saria ka tisim bʋʋd.
60Fʋ nyɛ ban yɛt ye ba na yɔ sam ka namisim si'em;
ba gban'ad gban'abɛ'ɛd m yɛla.
61Zugsɔba, fʋ wʋm ban tʋ'ʋdim si'em
ka gban'ad bɛ'ɛd ye ba mugusim.
62Daar wʋsa ba pian'ad nɛ mam yɛla
ka su'adi gban'ad pʋtɛn'ɛbɛ'ɛdi m yɛla.
63Lin yi bɛogʋn keŋ paae zaam man ka ba la'ad,
hali ba yʋ'ʋmmi ziemid man.
64Zugsɔba, yɔɔmi ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la sam,
kɛl ka tɔɔg paae ba, ka li zemis nɛ ban tʋm si'el la.
65Kɛl ka ba tʋba ziank,
ka kɛ ka fʋ nɔpɔɔr dɔlli ba.
66Kadimi ba yis nɛ sʋnpɛɛn
yisimi ba dunia kanɛ ka Zugsɔb maal la ni.

english_text:
The Punishment of Jerusalem
The Prophet Speaks:
1The purest gold is ruined
and has lost its shine;
jewels from the temple
lie scattered in the streets.
2These are Zion's people,
worth more than purest gold;
yet they are counted worthless
like dishes of clay.
3Even jackals nurse their young,
but my people are like ostriches
that abandon their own.
4Babies are so thirsty
that their tongues are stuck
to the roof of the mouth.
Children go begging for food,
but no one gives them any.
5All who ate expensive foods
lie starving in the streets;
those who grew up in luxury
now sit on trash heaps.
6 My nation was punished worse
than the people of Sodom,
whose city was destroyed
in a flash without the help
of human hands.
7The leaders of Jerusalem
were purer than snow
and whiter than milk;
their bodies were healthy
and glowed like jewels.
8Now they are blacker than tar,
and no one recognizes them;
their skin clings to their bones
and is drier than firewood.
9Being killed with a sword
is better than slowly
starving to death.
10 Life in the city is so bad
that loving mothers have boiled
and eaten their own children.
11The Lord was so fiercely angry
that he burned the city of Zion
to the ground.
12Not a king on this earth
or the people of any nation
believed enemies could break
through her gates.
13Jerusalem was punished because
her prophets and her priests
had sinned and caused the death
of innocent victims.
14Yes, her prophets and priests
were covered with blood;
no one would come near them,
as they wandered
from street to street.
15Instead, everyone shouted,
“Go away! Don't touch us!
You're filthy and unfit
to belong to God's people!”
So they had to leave
and become refugees.
But foreign nations told them,
“You can't stay here!”
16The Lord is the one
who sent them scattering,
and he has forgotten them.
No respect or kindness
will be shown
to the priests or leaders.
17Our eyes became weary,
hopelessly looking
for help from a nation
that could not save us.
18Enemies hunted us down
on every public street.
Our time was up;
our doom was near.
19They swooped down faster
than eagles from the sky.
They hunted for us in the hills
and set traps to catch us
out in the desert.
20The Lord's chosen leader
was our hope for survival!
We thought he would keep us safe
somewhere among the nations,
but even he was caught
in one of their traps.
21You people of Edom
can celebrate now!
But your time will come
to suffer and stagger
around naked.
22The people of Zion
have paid for their sins,
and the Lord will soon
let them return home.
But, people of Edom,
you will be punished,
and your sins exposed.
translation_text:
Tɔɔg linɛ paae Jerusalem la
1Gɔsima, ti sanlim banɛ daa nyɛɛn la
vɛnlim san'am ya!
Ba nɔk Pʋ'ʋsim Yir kugvɛnla la wʋsa
widigi bas suoya ni.
2Zion dasam banɛ da nwɛnɛ sanlima ligidkpi'ema la,
nannanna ba maannɛ ba
wʋʋ tan dʋgid ka banɛ ya'abid maal.
3Hali wɛbaas mu'asidi ba biis bin'isim
amaa mam nidib la anɛ nimbɛ'ɛdnam hali,
ba nwɛnɛ sian'arin niiŋ titada banɛ pʋ kɛlisidi ba biis kaasiga.
4Ku'onuudi mɔr bilies la zug
ka ba zilima tabinɛ ba nɔnya ni;
biis la sɔsid diib,
amaa sɔ' pʋ tisi ba diibɔ.
5Nimbanɛ daa dit disʋma la
yʋ'ʋn gɔɔnd pala ni ka kpiid kɔ'ɔm.
Banɛ daa dit na'am ka yɛɛd fuvɛnla la
yʋ'ʋn bɛ nɛ tampʋya ni pi'isid diib.
6 M nidib la nyɛ mugusʋg si'em la
gaad Sodom dimi da namis si'em la,
la'an nɛ Wina'am da gbirigi san'ami ba la
sɔ' da pʋ siak ye o sʋŋi ba.
7Ti na'abiis la daa pɛligi gaad sakuga
ka pɛligi gaad bin'isim,
ba niŋgbina anɛ nyain
ka vɛnli nwɛnɛ kugbanɛ yʋ'ʋri buon Safira la.
8Amaa nannanna ba sɔbigi gaad vugulim
ka sɔ' kʋ lɛm baŋi ba nindaa.
Ba waŋim nɛ kpɛlim kɔnba ma'aa,
ka kʋdigi nwɛnɛ dakpi'emis nɛ.
9Banɛ da kpi zabbɔn'ɔgin la
sɔn'oe banɛ ka kɔ'ɔm kʋʋ ba la;
ba namis nɛ kɔ'ɔm hali
diibi kae pɔɔdin la zug.
10 Saŋa kanɛ ka man nidib la daa bɛ mugusʋgin la,
pu'a banɛ zɔt nimbaanlig
daa dʋgidi ba mɛŋ-mɛŋ biis
ka li liebi ba diib.
11Zugsɔb la sʋnfʋ pɛlig la
o pʋ gu'us baa bi'elaa,
ka nyu'oe Zion tempʋʋg nɛ bugum
ka li di nɛ li ɛɛnbir la wʋsa.
12Teŋgbauŋ la na'anam pʋ niŋ labaar la yadda.
Hali dunia nidib la wʋsa sɔ' pʋ niŋ yadda
ye bi'emnam nɛ dataas
na nyaŋi kpɛn' Jerusalem teŋ za'anɔya la nii.
13Amaa li tʋm ya ka li anɛ ba nɔdi'esidib la tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd zug
nɛ ba maanmaannib la maal taal.
Ban kʋʋd nidib tempʋʋgin la zug,
hali banɛ pʋ tʋm taal la kpii ba nu'usin.
14Ba tuongatib la yiridnɛ suorin
wʋʋ zʋnzɔɔs nɛ.
Ba liebnɛ tuk dim ziim kanɛ ka ba yis la zug
ka sɔ' kʋ nyaŋi si'isi ba ya'asɛ.
15Ka nidib la yɛti ba ye, “Zɔmi!
Ka ya anɛ tuk dim, da si'isi tii! Kemi sa!”
Ka ba tɔɔm giligid tɛɛns wʋsa
ka teŋ ban dim la yɛti ba ye,
“Da di'e ba ka ba kʋ lɛm kpɛlim kpɛla ya'asɛ!”
16Zugsɔb la mɛŋi widigi ba
o pʋ lɛn guri ba ya'asɛ.
Maanmaannib pʋ lɛn nyɛt na'asii
ka kpɛɛmnam kɔ'ɔŋ girima.
17Ti da tɛn'ɛsid ye sʋŋir na kena
ka li pʋ kenaa, ka ti ti'ir naae.
Ti da dʋ dɔwa'ama zugʋ gu'usid
teŋ kanɛ kʋ nyaŋi sʋŋi tii.
18Ti dataas la pigidi dɔlli ti wʋʋ tɔn'ɔsnam nɛ
ka ti pʋ lɛn nyaŋidi ken suoya la nii.
Ti ba'asʋg dabisir li'el ya
ka ti naar saŋa paae.
19Banɛ da kati ti bugir la ken tɔ'ɔtɔ
gaad silʋgʋ ian'ad agɔlli ken si'em la;
banɛ dɔlli ti ye ba gban'e la gaadi ti tuon zuoya la ni
ka su'a pipirigin ye ba libigi ti.
20Ba da bɛnd baansi gban'e ti Na'ab
onɛ ka ti Zugsɔb gaŋ la,
ka li nwɛnɛ ba di'e ti nyɔvʋr wʋsa nɛ.
On ka ti niŋ yadda ye ti na su'a o ma'asimin,
ka o na gu' ka yisi ti, ti dataas nu'usin.
21Yanam Edom dim banɛ bɛ Uz teŋ la,
kɛlli ka ya sʋnya ma'ae ka ya maal sumalisim!
Amaa yanam namisʋg mɛ kenna, ya na paami li.
Ya na nuu li bug ka ken biel nɛ nyan.
22Yanam Zion dima, ya tʋbtɛɛgir naae ya,
Zugsɔb kʋ lɛn kɛ ka ya an yammis teŋ zʋŋʋ yuugɛ.
Amaa yanam Edom dima, Zugsɔb na tɛɛgi ya tʋba.
O na nie ya bugusim la paalʋ ka nidib nyɛ.

english_text:
A Prayer for Mercy
The People of Jerusalem Pray:
1Our Lord, don't forget
how we have suffered
and been disgraced.
2Foreigners and strangers
have taken our land
and our homes.
3We are like children
whose mothers are widows.
4The water we drink
and the wood we burn
cost far too much.
5We are terribly mistreated;
we are worn out
and can find no rest.
6We had to surrender
to Egypt and Assyria
because we were hungry.
7Our ancestors sinned,
but they are dead,
and we are left to pay
for their sins.
8Slaves are now our rulers,
and there is no one
to set us free.
9We are in danger
from brutal desert tribes;
we must risk our lives
just to bring in our crops.
10Our skin is scorched
from fever and hunger.
11On Zion and everywhere in Judah
our wives and daughters
are being raped.
12Our rulers are strung up
by their arms,
and our nation's advisors
are treated shamefully.
13Young men are forced
to do the work of slaves;
boys must carry
heavy loads of wood.
14Our leaders are not allowed
to decide cases in court,
and young people
no longer play music.
15Our hearts are sad;
instead of dancing,
we mourn.
16Zion's glory has disappeared!
And we are doomed
because of our sins.
17We feel sick all over
and can't even see straight;
18our city is in ruins,
overrun by wild dogs.
19You will rule forever, Lord!
You are King for all time.
20Why have you forgotten us
for so long?
21Bring us back to you!
Give us a fresh start.
22Or do you despise us so much
that you don't want us?
translation_text:
Ba sɔs Wina'am ye o zɔɔ ba nimbaanlig
1Zugsɔba, tɛn'ɛsim dinɛ maali ti la;
gɔsim tinamɛ di nyan si'em.
2Ti areza'as wʋsa lieb nɛ saam din
ka teŋ zʋŋ dim kpɛn'ɛdi ti yaan.
3Ti dataas la kʋʋ ti saamnam
ka kɛ ka ti manam an pʋkɔnya,
ka tinam mɛ an kpiibis.
4Asɛɛ ka ti da' ku'om ka naan nu;
ti mɛŋ daad ka ba kuosidi tisidi ti.
5Banɛ kati ti la bɛ nɛ ti nya'aŋ yammin
ka ti gɛn ka ba mɛ kʋ basi ti ka ti vʋ'ʋsɛ.
6Dikanɛ ka ti dit ka vʋe kae
asɛɛ ti keŋ Egipt bɛɛ Asiria sɔs diib.
7Ti yaanamɛ da tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la ka kpi
linzug ka tinam yʋ'ʋn bɛ namisʋg pʋʋgin.
8Nimbanɛ sʋ'oe ti la anɛ yammis
ka sɔ' mɛ kae na faaɛn ti yisi ba nu'usinɛ.
9Ti ɛɛn kuosnɛ ti nyɔɔr ka naan nyɛ diibi di
bɔzugɔ banɛ ye ba kʋʋ ti bɛ sian'arin la.
10Kɔ'ɔm kɛ ka ti niŋgbina tʋlig
wʋʋ bugum nɛ.
11Ba bibi ti pu'ab Zion zuorin
ka dig nɛ ti pu'asada Juda teŋkpɛmisin wʋsa.
12Ba mɔri ti tuongatib la keŋ yuli ba nɛ nwiis
ka pʋ tisidi ti bʋnkʋd la na'asii.
13Ba mugusidi ti na'akim la
ka kɛ ka ba nɛ'ɛm ki wʋʋ yammis nɛ,
ka ti biribis la zi daadi gɛn.
14Kpɛɛmnam la pʋ lɛn zin' teŋ la za'anɔya nii,
ka dasam la mɛ pʋ lɛn nwɛ'ɛd yʋʋma ya'asɛ.
15Malisim gaad ya, ka sʋnsa'aŋ di'e zin'ig wʋsa.
Ti wa'a tiaknɛ lieb fabʋlʋg nɛ kaasig.
16Tinamɛ daa nwɛ'ɛd nyɔ'ɔg nɛ si'el la wʋsa lɛn kae.
Gɔsima! Ti tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka bɛ yɛla ni.
17Nɛ'ɛŋa zug ka ti sʋnya san'am
ka ti nini pʋ lɛn nyɛt sʋ'ʋŋa.
18Bɔzugɔ Zion zuor la kpɛlim nɛ zaalim
ka Akɔranam giligid teŋ la wʋsa.
19Amaa Zugsɔba, fʋnɛ an Na'ab saŋa wʋsa
ka na'am la bɛ nɛ zʋmaana wʋsa saŋa linɛ ka' bɛnnɛ.
20Bɔ ka fʋ tammidi ti yɛla saŋa wʋsa?
Bɔ ka fʋ basi ti ka li yuugɛ?
21Mɔri ti lɛb na, Zugsɔba, mɔri ti lɛbi fʋ san'an na!
Tɛndigimi ti ka ti lɛbi an wʋʋ tinamɛ da an si'em la.
22Bɛɛ fʋ zan'asi ti nɛ nyainnɛ?
Fʋ sʋnpɛɛn la ka' bɛnnɛ?

english_text:
Ezekiel Sees the Lord's Glory
1-3 I am Ezekiel—a priest and the son of Buzi.
Five years after King Jehoiachin of Judah had been led away as a prisoner to Babylonia, I was living near the Chebar River among those who had been taken there with him. Then on the fifth day of the fourth month of the thirtieth year, the heavens suddenly opened. The Lord placed his hand upon me and showed me some visions.
4I saw a windstorm blowing in from the north. Lightning flashed from a huge cloud and lit up the whole sky with a dazzling brightness. The fiery center of the cloud was as shiny as polished metal, 5 and in that center I saw what looked like four living creatures. They were somewhat like humans, 6except that each one had four faces and four wings. 7Their legs were straight, but their feet looked like the hoofs of calves and sparkled like bronze. 8Under each of their wings, these creatures had a human hand. 9The four creatures were standing back to back with the tips of their wings touching. They moved together in every direction, without turning their bodies.
10 Each creature had the face of a human in front, the face of a lion on the right side, the face of a bull on the left, and the face of an eagle in back. 11Two wings of each creature were spread out and touched the wings of the creatures on either side. The other two wings of each creature were folded against its body.
12The four living creatures went wherever the Spirit led them, and they moved together without turning their bodies, because each creature faced straight ahead. 13 The creatures were glowing like hot coals, and I saw something like a flaming torch moving back and forth among them. Lightning flashed from the torch every time its flame blazed up. 14The creatures themselves moved as quickly as sparks jumping from a fire.
15 I then noticed that on the ground beside each of the four living creatures was a wheel, 16shining like chrysolite. Each wheel was exactly the same and had a second wheel that cut through the middle of it, 17so that they could move in any direction without turning. 18 The rims of the wheels were large and frightening, and they had eyes all the way around them. 19-21The creatures controlled when and where the wheels moved—the wheels went wherever the four creatures went and stopped whenever they stopped. Even when the creatures flew in the air, the wheels were beside them.
22-23 Above the living creatures, I saw something that was sparkling like ice, and it reminded me of a dome. Each creature had two of its wings stretched out toward the creatures on either side, with the other two wings folded against its body. 24 Whenever the creatures flew, their wings roared like an ocean or a large army or even the voice of God All-Powerful. And whenever the creatures stopped, they folded their wings against their bodies.
25When the creatures stopped flapping their wings, I heard a sound coming from above the dome. 26 I then saw what looked like a throne made of sapphire, and sitting on the throne was a figure in the shape of a human. 27 From the waist up, it was glowing like metal in a hot furnace, and from the waist down it looked like the flames of a fire. The figure was surrounded by a bright light, 28as colorful as a rainbow that appears after a storm.
I realized I was seeing the brightness of the Lord's glory! So I bowed with my face to the ground, and just then I heard a voice speaking to me.
translation_text:
Bʋnvʋya nɛ Zugsɔb girima yɛla
1Israel nidibi da an yammisi bɛ teŋ zʋŋ yʋma pistan' la, li nwadis anaasi la daba anu daar, ka mam Ezikil, da bɛ nɛ ba sieba banɛ bɛ Keba Kɔldaugin la, ka agɔl yɔ'ɔg ka Wina'am yɛla nie pa'alim.
2 Li anɛ ban da gban'e Na'ab Jehoyakin n keŋ teŋ zʋŋ la yʋma anu la di nwadis anu la ni, 3 ka Zugsɔb pian' tis Ezikil onɛ an maanmaan ka o saam yʋ'ʋr buon Buzi, ka o bɛ Keba Kɔldaug la baba Babilon sʋ'ʋlimin la. Ani ka Zugsɔb la paŋ kɛɛn o san'an na. 4Ka m gɔsi nyɛ ka sisi'etita'ar yi ya-datiuŋ baba kenna nɛ saŋgbantita'ar, ka saa ian'adi tansid panr-panr ka bugum nie nyain giligi li nyɛɛn. Ka si'el bɛ bugum la teŋsʋkʋ nyɛɛn pil-pil, 5 ka si'elnam bɛ bugum la pʋʋgin nwɛnɛ bʋnvʋya anaasi. Ba da nwɛnɛ ninsaal nɛ, 6amaa ba yinne wʋsa da mɔri nindaas nɛ kpʋkpama anaas naas. 7Ba nɔba da tiɛnnɛ sappi, ka ba nɔbpansimpana nwɛnɛ na'abil tafɛɛd nɛ, ka nyɛɛn wʋʋ kʋntzɛn'ug ka ba maali duus nɛ. 8Ba da mɔri ninsaal nu'usi anaasi ka li bɛɛ ba kpʋkpama linɛ tabi ba lʋga anaasi la lɛuŋʋn. Baba anaasi la wʋsa da mɔri nindaas nɛ kpʋkpama. 9Bʋnvʋya la wʋsa kpʋkpama da si'isidnɛ taaba, ka ba yinne wʋsa ya'a ye o keŋ ba la'asidnɛ ken vuguri ka pʋ fɛndigidi ba niŋgbinaa.
10Ba nindaas la da nwɛn si'em nwa': bʋnvʋr wʋsa da mɔri nindaas anaasi; ninsaal nindaa linɛ bɛ tuon, nɛ gbigim nindaa linɛ bɛ datiuŋ, nɛ na'araug nindaa linɛ bɛ dagɔbʋg nɛ abaar nindaa linɛ bɛ nya'aŋ; 11ba nindaasi da an si'em la. Ba da yadignɛ ba kpʋkpama dʋ'ʋs agɔla; ka bʋnvʋr wʋsa mɔr kpʋkpama ayi', ka kpʋkpauŋ wʋsa tiɛn si'isid bʋnvʋr kanɛ kpi'e nɛ o la kpʋkpauŋ, ka kpʋkpama ayi' banɛ kpɛlim la lusidi ba niŋgbina. 12Yinne wʋsa da kpɛn kpa'ad o tuonnɛ ken. Siig la ken zin'isi'a wʋsa ba na keŋ ka pʋ fɛndigi ba mɛŋa. 13Bʋnvʋya la da nwɛnɛ bugumsaana bɛɛ kʋtir bugum nɛ, ka li nyɛɛn hali giligid saŋa wʋsa. Bugum la da nienɛ ka tɔɔndi ian'ad bʋnvʋya la teŋsʋk wʋʋ saa nɛ. 14Bʋnvʋya la da zɔti tɔ'ɔtɔ ken tuon ka lɛbid nya'aŋ wʋʋ saa ian'ad si'em la.
15Man da gɔt bʋnvʋya anaasi la, m da nyɛ fiilnama anaasi ka li si'isid teŋi kpi'e ba yinne wʋsa. 16Fiilnam la da an si'em nwa': anaasi la wʋsa da zemnɛ taaba, ka nyɛɛn nwɛnɛ gɔtiŋ nɛ. Fiilnam la da maal si'em la da nwɛnɛ ba nɔknɛ yinne nyaae li tiraan pʋʋgin nɛ, 17ka li kɛ ka fiilnam la tun'e kpa' keŋ dunia lʋga anaasi la wʋsa, bʋnvʋya la ya'a ken zin'isi'a wʋsa, ba pʋ fɛndigidi ba mɛŋa. 18Li fiilnam la da wa'am nɛ mɔr dabiem, ka li wʋsa mɔr nini. 19Bʋnvʋya la ya'a ti ye ba keŋ, fiilnam la da dɛn'ɛnidi ba nɛ; ba ya'a lɛn ian'adnɛ agɔla li kpɛn dɛn'ɛnidi ba nɛ. 20Siig la da ken si'el wʋsa ba na keŋ, ka fiilnam la mɛ dɛn'ɛnidi ba, bɔzugɔ bʋnvʋya la siig da bɛ nɛ fiilnam la ni. 21Alazug saŋa kanɛ wʋsa ka bʋnvʋya la ken bɛɛ zi'e bɛɛ ian'ad, fiilnam la mɛ maannɛ ala nɔɔ, bɔzugɔ bʋnvʋya la siig bɛnɛ fiilnamin la.
22Si'eli da yadig lammiri bɛɛ ba zutin n nyɛɛn hali nwɛnɛ gɔtiŋ nɛ, ka fʋ ya'a nyɛ ka li mɔr dabiem. 23Bʋnlammir la lɛuŋʋn ba da yadignɛ ba kpʋkpama kpa' taaba, ka bas kpʋkpama ayi' lusi ba niŋgbina. 24Bʋnvʋya la da ian'ad la, m da wʋm ka ba kpʋkpama la dammid wʋʋ atɛuk ku'om, bɛɛ Wina'am Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar sɔb la tansʋg vuud, ka lɛn nwɛnɛ zabzabidib bɛdegʋ na kenna. Ba ya'a da zi'en baanlimm ba sigisidnɛ ba kpʋkpama la teŋin. 25Saŋkanɛ ka ba da zi'en ka sigisi ba kpʋkpama la m da wʋm kʋkɔri yi bʋnlammir linɛ bɛɛ ba zugin la.
26 Bʋnlammir linɛ bɛɛ ba zugin la, si'el da bɛɛ ani nwɛnɛ na'am kʋk linɛ ka ba nɔk gɔtiŋi maal, ka si'el zin' na'am kʋk la zugʋ nwɛnɛ ninsaal nɛ. 27M da nyɛ lin naanɛ o siaa baba dʋt la ka li nyɛɛn nwɛnɛ ba zugudnɛ kʋnt bugumin. Ka lin yii ani sigid la nwɛnɛ bugum ka nɛɛsim tita'ar giligi li. 28Li da nwɛnɛ saa na kʋ ka dindɛog buoɛn saŋgbana ni si'em la. Vɛnlim kaŋa da gilig o.
Ala ka li da nie nwɛnɛ Zugsɔb na'am pipilim girima nɛ. Man da nyɛ nɛ'ɛŋa la ka luu avanba, ka wʋm ka li pian'ad.

english_text:
The Lord Chooses Ezekiel
1The Lord said, “Ezekiel, son of man, I want you to stand up and listen.” 2After he said this, his Spirit took control of me and lifted me to my feet. Then the Lord said:
3Ezekiel, I am sending you to the people of Israel. They are just like their ancestors who rebelled against me and refused to stop. 4They are stubborn and hardheaded. But I, the Lord God, have chosen you to tell them what I say. 5Those rebels may not even listen, but at least they will know that a prophet has come to them.
6Don't be afraid of them or of anything they say. You may think you're in the middle of a thorn patch or a bunch of scorpions. But be brave 7and preach my message to them, whether they choose to listen or not. 8Ezekiel, don't rebel against me, as they have done. Instead, listen to everything I tell you.
And now, Ezekiel, open your mouth and eat what I am going to give you.
9 Just then, I saw a hand stretched out toward me. And in it was a scroll. 10The hand opened the scroll, and both sides of it were filled with words of sadness, mourning, and grief.
translation_text:
Wina'am buol Ezikil
1Ka o yɛlim ye, “Ninsaal biiga, duom zi'en ka m pian' tisif.” 2On pian' naae la, ka Siig la kpɛn'ɛm ka duomi zi'el, ka m wʋm ka o pian'adi tisidim. 3O yɛlim ye, “Ninsaal biiga, m tʋmif nɛ Israel dim san'an. Ba anɛ banɛ pʋ siakida ka ki'isidi m nɔɔr. Ban nɛ ba yaanam ki'isi m nɔɔr hali ti paae zina. 4Nimbanɛ ka m tʋmmi fʋ ba san'an la anɛ banɛ zuti kpi'em ka ba pʋ tiakid na'anaa. Yɛlimi ba ye Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa'. 5Ba ya'a siak bɛɛ pʋ siakɛ, fʋn yɛlimi ba, ka ba pʋn anɛ nimbanɛ ki'isid. La'an nɛ ala, ba na baŋ ye Wina'am nɔdi'es sid mi' naanɛ ba sʋʋgin. 6 Amaa fʋn, Ninsaal biiga, da zɔti ba dabiem bɛɛ fʋ zɔɔ ba pian'ad. Da zɔti ba dabiem la'an nɛ ban nwɛnɛ gɔn'ɔs nɛ gɛnda giligif ka fʋ bɛ namis sʋʋgin la. La'an nɛ ban an nimbanɛ ki'isid la, da zɔt dabiem ban na yɛl si'el bɛɛ kɛ ka fʋ ya'am ian'adi ba yɛlaa, la'an nɛ ban an nimbanɛ pʋ siakid la. 7Asɛɛ fʋ yɛli ba man yɛlif si'el la, ba ya'a kɛlis bɛɛ zan'asɛɛ, ba pʋn anɛ banɛ ki'isid. 8Amaa fʋn, Ninsaal biiga, kɛlisim man yɛlif si'el la. Da ki'isim wʋʋ nimbama. Ya'ami fʋ nɔɔr ka di'e man tisidif si'el la ɔnb.” 9Ani ka m gɔsi nyɛ nu'ugʋ tieli m san'an na ka gbauŋ kpilim bɛ nu'ug la pʋʋg. 10Ka o idigi li m tuon, ka li tuon nɛ li nya'aŋ wʋsa sɔb fabʋlʋg nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ nɛ tɔɔg yɛla.

english_text:
1 The Lord said, “Ezekiel, son of man, after you eat this scroll, go speak to the people of Israel.”
2-3He handed me the scroll and said, “Eat this and fill up on it.” So I ate the scroll, and it tasted sweet as honey.
4The Lord said:
Ezekiel, I am sending you to your own people. 5-6They are Israelites, not some strangers who speak a foreign language you can't understand. If I were to send you to foreign nations, they would listen to you. 7But the people of Israel will refuse to listen, because they have refused to listen to me. All of them are stubborn and hardheaded, 8so I will make you as stubborn as they are. 9You will be so determined to speak my message that nothing will stop you. I will make you hard like a diamond, and you'll have no reason to be afraid of those arrogant rebels.
10Listen carefully to everything I say and then think about it. 11Then go to the people who were brought here to Babylonia with you and tell them you have a message from me, the Lord God. Do this, whether they listen to you or not.
12The Spirit lifted me up, and as the glory of the Lord started to leave, I heard a loud, thundering noise behind me. 13It was the sound made by the creatures' wings as they brushed against each other, and by the rumble of the wheels beside them. 14Then the Spirit carried me away.
The Lord's power had taken complete control of me, and I was both annoyed and angry.
15When I was back with the others living at Abib Hill near the Chebar River, I sat among them for seven days, shocked at what had happened to me.
The Lord Appoints Ezekiel To Stand Watch
(Ezekiel 33.1-9)
16Seven days after I had seen the brightness of the Lord's glory, the Lord said:
17Ezekiel, son of man, I have appointed you to stand watch for the people of Israel. So listen to what I say, then warn them for me. 18When I tell wicked people they will die because of their sins, you must warn them to turn from their sinful ways so they won't be punished. If you refuse, you are responsible for their death. 19However, if you do warn them, and they keep on sinning, they will die because of their sins, and you will be innocent.
20Now suppose faithful people start sinning, and I decide to put stumbling blocks in their paths to make them fall. They deserve to die because of their sins. So if you refuse to warn them, I will forget about the times they were faithful, and I will hold you responsible for their death. 21But if you do warn them, and they listen to you and stop sinning, I will let them live. And you will be innocent.
Ezekiel Cannot Talk
22The Lord took control of me and said, “Stand up! Go into the valley, and I will talk with you there.”
23I immediately went to the valley, where I saw the brightness of the Lord's glory, just as I had seen it near the Chebar River, and I bowed with my face to the ground. 24His Spirit took control of me and lifted me to my feet. Then the Lord said:
Go back and lock yourself in your house! 25You will be tied up to keep you inside, 26and I will make you unable to talk or to warn those who have rebelled against me. 27But the time will come, when I will tell you what to say, and you will again be able to speak my message. Some of them will listen; others will be stubborn and refuse to listen.
translation_text:
1 Ka Wina'am yɛlim ye, “Ninsaal biiga, ɔm gbauŋ linɛ bɛɛ fʋ tuon la, ka keŋ pian' tis Israel nidib la.” 2Ka m ya'ae m nɔɔr ka o tisim gbauŋ la ka m ɔnb. 3Ka o yɛlim ye, “Ninsaal biiga, ɔm gbauŋ kanɛ ka m tisidif la pɛ'ɛli fʋ pʋʋr.” Ka m ɔnbi li ka li malis hali wʋʋ siind nɛ m nɔɔrin. 4Ka o yɛlim ye, “Ninsaal biiga, kem Israel nidibin la nannanna tu'asi m yɛla tisi ba. 5M pʋ tʋmif nimbanɛ pian'ad pian'azʋŋ dinɛ baŋiri na tɔi tisi fɔ, amaa Israel nidibin ka m tʋmif. 6M pʋ tʋmif nɛ nimbanɛ zu'oe ka ba pian'ad tɔi ka ba buudi kpi'em ka ba pian'ad ka fʋ kʋ gban'e li gbin la san'anɛ. Sida, hali baa m ya'a tʋmi nɛf nimban buudi san'an ba naan wʋm tisi nɛf. 7Amaa Israel dim la kʋ wʋm tisi fɔ, bɔzugɔ ba pʋ bɔɔd ye ba kɛlis mam mɛŋa. Ba wʋsa anɛ zukpi'euŋ dim ka pʋ nanna. 8Amaa m na kɛ ka fʋ mɛ an onɛ pʋ siakid na'anaa ka an zukpi'euŋ sɔb nwɛnɛ ban an si'em la. 9M na kɛ ka fʋ zug kpi'em gaad kutiŋgbinnig. Da zɔti ba dabiem bɛɛ fʋ ya'am ianki ba yɛlaa, ba pʋn anɛ ki'isʋg dim.”
10Ka o lɛn yɛlim ye, “Ninsaal biiga, kɛlisim sʋ'ʋŋa ka tɛnr man yɛlif si'el la wʋsa ka zaŋi niŋi fʋ pʋtɛn'ɛrin. 11Kemi fʋ teŋ nimbanɛ ka ba gban'e ba keŋ teŋ zʋŋ la ni, tu'asi tisi ba. Yɛlimi ba ye, ‘Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛlim ye m yɛli ya si'eli nwa',’ ba ya'a siak bɛɛ ba ya'a pʋ siakɛ fʋn yɛlimi ba.”
12Ka Siig la ʋkim agɔla, ka m wʋm ka kʋkɔtita'ar vuudi m nya'aŋi yɛt ye, “Zugsɔb onɛ bɛ arezana la na paam wɔ'ɔgir o bɛllim zin'igin la!” 13Ka m wʋm ka bʋnvʋya kpʋkpama nwɛ'ɛd agɔla si'isid taaba ka tɛreko fiilnam dammid nwa'am-nwa'am nwɛnɛ teŋi mi'im nɛ. 14Ka Siig la ʋkim agɔla mɔri keŋ sa. Ka m keŋ nɛ ɛndʋg hali nɛ sʋnsa'aŋ ka Zugsɔb la paŋ bɛɛ m san'an. 15M da paae m taab banɛ da bɛ Tel Abib teŋin linɛ kpi'e nɛ Keba kɔldaug la ka li pakim hali ka m zin'in ani daba ayɔpɔi.
Israel dim sa'alʋg
(Ezi 33:1-9)
16Daba ayɔpɔi la naar daar la, ka Wina'am pian' tisim ye, 17Ninsaal biiga, mam maalif nɛ yigur ka fʋ na gur Israel nidib la. Wʋm man yɛtif si'el la nɛ nimmua ka tu'asi kpa'asi ba tisim. 18M ya'a yɛl tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb ye o na kpi, ka fʋ pʋ yɛl o ka o bas o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la ka nyɛ faangirɛ, ninkan sɔb na kpii o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdin, amaa o ziim na bɛɛ fʋ zugin. 19Amaa fʋ ya'a yɛl tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd sɔb ye o basim tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la ka o pʋ siakɛ, o na kpii o tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdin la, amaa fʋn na faaɛn fʋ mɛŋ.
20“Pʋpielim sɔb ya'a bas tʋʋm sʋma ka pin'ili tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd ka fʋ pʋ yɛl o, m na kɛ ka yɛlbɛ'og gban'e o ka o tu'ugi lii kpi. Li ya'a niŋ ala, m kʋ tɛnr tʋʋm sʋma banɛ ka o tʋm la, ka o ziim mɛ na bɛɛ fʋ zug. 21Amaa fʋ ya'a yɛl pʋpielim sɔb ye o da tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛdɛ ka o siak, o na vʋe on wʋm nɛ nimmua tisif la zug, ka fʋn mɛ na faaɛn fʋ mɛŋ.”
22Zugsɔb la paŋ da bɛɛ m san'an zin'ikan la, ka o yɛlim ye, “Duom keŋ paalʋ kanɛ an sassi la ni, ka m na pian' tisif.” 23Ka man paae zin'ikan la, m nyɛ ka Zugsɔb la girima nie nyain wʋʋ man da nyɛɛ li si'em Keba kɔldaug baba la. Ka m luu avanba.
24Ka Siig la kɛɛn m san'an na ʋkim agɔla zi'el ka pian' tisim ye, “Kem yɔɔ fʋ mɛŋi fʋ yin. 25Ka fʋn Ninsaal biiga, ba na lɔɔf nɛ nwiis ka bɔbigif ka fʋ kʋ nyaŋi yii fʋ nidibin la naa. 26M na kɛ ka fʋ zilim tabin ka fʋ kʋ nyaŋi pian' tis nimbanɛ zugʋ kpi'em la. 27Amaa m ya'a lɛm pian' tisif, m na kɛ ka fʋ zilim lak ka fʋ yɛli ba mam Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛlif si'el. Banɛ na siak ban siak, banɛ zan'as ban on zan'as, ka m pʋn mi' ba zukpi'euŋ la yɛla.”

english_text:
Ezekiel Acts Out an Attack on Jerusalem
The Lord said:
1Ezekiel, son of man, find a brick and sketch a picture of Jerusalem on it. 2Then prepare to attack the brick as if it were a real city. Build a dirt mound and a ramp up to the top and surround the brick with enemy camps. On every side put large wooden poles as though you were going to break down the gate to the city. 3Set up an iron pan like a wall between you and the brick. All this will be a warning for the people of Israel.
4-5After that, lie down on your left side and stay there for 390 days as a sign of Israel's punishment—one day for each year of its suffering. 6Then turn over and lie on your right side 40 more days. That will be a sign of Judah's punishment—one day for each year of its suffering.
7The brick stands for Jerusalem, so attack it! Stare at it and shout angry warnings. 8I will tie you up, so you can't leave until your attack has ended.
9Get a large bowl. Then mix together wheat, barley, beans, lentils, and millet, and make some bread. This is what you will eat for the 390 days you are lying down. 10Eat only a small loaf of bread each day 11and drink only two large cups of water. 12Use dried human waste to start a fire, then bake the bread on the coals where everyone can watch you. 13When I scatter the people of Israel among the nations, they will also have to eat food that is unclean, just as you must do.
14I said, “Lord God, please don't make me do that! Never in my life have I eaten food that would make me unacceptable to you. I've never eaten anything that died a natural death or was killed by a wild animal or that you said was unclean.”
15The Lord replied, “Instead of human waste, I will let you bake your bread on a fire made from cow manure. 16Ezekiel, the people of Jerusalem will starve. They will have so little food and water that they will be afraid and hopeless. 17Everyone will be shocked at what is happening, and, because of their sins, they will die a slow death.”
translation_text:
Ezikil pa'al dataasi na lɔbi gilig Jerusalem teŋ la si'em
1 Ka Wina'am da lɛn yɛl mam Ezikil ye, Ninsaal biiga, nɔkim birikiisi digili fʋ tuon ka buoɛn li zugini pa'al Jerusalem tempʋʋgʋ an si'em. 2Mɛɛm dʋʋsa gilig tempʋʋg la ka nɔk gulungun'udi digili gilig ka niŋ wʋʋ dataasi ɛɛn lɔbi gilig teŋ si'em ye ba zab la. 3Ka nɔk kʋnt gammi zi'el nwɛnɛ zaŋguom nɛ fʋn nɛ birikiisi la teŋsʋk, ka fɛndigi fʋ nindaa kpa' li ka li na bɛ sʋʋgin wʋʋ zabzabidibi lɔbi gilig nɛ ka fʋn na nwɛnɛ banɛ lɔbi giligi li la. Nɛ'ɛŋa na an zanbinnɛ tis Israel dim la.
4Ka yʋ'ʋn diginɛ fʋ dagɔbʋg nu'ug zug, ka nɔk Israel dim tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la wʋsa ziili fʋ mɛŋ. Fʋ na zii li hali ti paae dabisa banɛ ka fʋ dig la bɛn. 5M na nɔk yʋʋm banɛ ka ba nɔki tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la wʋsa tiaki li ka li lieb dabisa. Alazug dabisa kɔbistan' nɛ piswai (390) ka fʋ ye fʋ zi Israel dim tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la.
6Fʋ ya'a naae lin, fʋn on lɛn diginɛ fʋ datiuŋ nu'ug la zugʋ zi Juda dim tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd. M nɔknɛ dabisa pisnaasi (40) tisif. Dabisir wʋsa pa'an ye li anɛ yʋʋm yinne. 7Fɛndigimi fʋ nindaa kpa' Jerusalem kanɛ ka fʋ buoɛn digil la, ka zian'am nu'ugʋ di'e m nɔɔr pian'ad linɛ ka m zɛrigi li la tisi li. 8Man na lɔɔf nɛ nwiis ka fʋ kʋ nyaŋi biki lɛb zin'isi'aa, hali nɛ dabisa la bɛnnɛ na ti naae.
9“Nɔkim mui nɛ bɛŋa nɛ ki niŋ dʋkʋn ka nɔki li maal diib ka dii li dabisa kɔbistan' nɛ piswai (390) saŋa kanɛ ka fʋ dig la. 10Makim diibi dit daar wʋsa si'em nɛ saŋa kanɛ ka fʋ gban'e ye fʋ dit. 11Ka mɛ mak ku'om bʋtiis ayi' nuud saŋa kan nɔɔ. 12Dim diib la wʋʋ ma'asa ka fʋ ɔnbid nɛ; li anɛ tilas ye fʋ maal ma'asa la zin'ikanɛ ka nidib na nyɛt, ka nɔk ninsaal binkpi'emisi nyu'oe bugum maali li.” 13Zugsɔb la da ye, “Nɛ'ɛŋa na pa'al Israel dimi na di dian'ad si'em, teŋ kanɛ wʋsa ka m ye m mɔri ba keŋ la.”
14Ka m yɛl ye, “Ayei, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔba! Man nan zi' di linɛ kis ka an dian'adɛ. M biilimin sa man nan zi' di bʋnkpiilʋŋ bɛɛ linɛ ka wɛog bʋn gban'e. Bʋnkpiilʋŋ ni'im nan zi' kpɛn' man nɔɔrinɛ.”
15Ka o lɛbis ye, “Tɔ', li ka' yɛllɛ, m na kɛ ka fʋ nɔk na'ambinnɛ nyu'oe maal ka ka' ninsaal binnɛ.”
16Ka o yʋ'ʋn yɛlim ye, “Ninsaal biiga, m na gu'oe ka kʋ lɛn tis Jerusalem dim diibɔ. Nidib la na di diib linɛ an fiin nɛ nyɛlʋg, ka nu ku'okanɛ an fiin nɛ dabiem, 17bɔzugɔ diib nɛ ku'om na kar. Ba na lidigi gɔsid taaba ka waŋim kpii ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la zug.”

english_text:
Jerusalem's Coming Destruction
The Lord said:
1Ezekiel, son of man, get a sharp sword and use it to cut off your hair and beard. Weigh the hair and divide it into three equal piles. 2After you attack the brick that stands for Jerusalem, burn one pile of your hair on the brick. Chop up the second pile and let the small pieces of hair fall around the brick. Throw the third pile into the wind, and I will strike it with my own sword.
3Keep a few of the hairs and wrap them in the hem of your clothes. 4Then pull out a few of those hairs and throw them in the fire, so they will also burn. This fire will spread, destroying everyone in Israel.
5I am the Lord God, and I have made Jerusalem the most important place in the world, and all other nations admire it. 6But the people of Jerusalem rebelled and refuse to obey me. They ignored my laws and have become even more sinful than the nations around them.
7So tell the people of Jerusalem:
I am the Lord God! You have refused to obey my laws and teachings, and instead you have obeyed the laws of the surrounding nations. You have become more rebellious than any of them! 8Now all those nations will watch as I turn against you and punish you 9for your sins. Your punishment will be more horrible than anything I've ever done or will ever do again. 10 Parents will be so desperate for food that they will eat their own children, and children will eat their parents. Those who survive this horror will be scattered in every direction.
11Your sins have disgusted me and made my temple unfit as a place to worship me. So I swear by my own life that I will cut you down and show you no pity. 12A third of you will die here in Jerusalem from disease or starvation. Another third will be killed in war. And I will scatter the last third of you in every direction, then track you down and kill you.
13You will feel my fierce anger until I have finished taking revenge. Then you will know that I, the Lord, was furious because of your disobedience. 14Every passerby will laugh at your destruction. Foreign nations 15will insult you and make fun of you, but they will also be shocked and terrified at what I did in my anger. 16I will destroy your crops until you starve to death, and disasters will strike you like arrows. 17 Starvation and wild animals will kill your children. I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and your enemies will strike you down with their swords. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_text:
1Wina'am da lɛn yɛl mam Ezikil ye, Ninsaal biiga, nannanna nɔkim sʋ'ʋkanɛ dit nwɛnɛ barigi pʋni fʋ zuobid nɛ fʋ tieŋ. Ka nɔk linɛ makid tɛbisim mak, ka pʋdig zuobid la zin'is atan'. 2Dabisa banɛ ka fʋ dig la bɛn ya'a paae, fʋn nɔk zuobid la pʋdigir yinne nyu'oe tempʋʋg la pʋʋgin, ka nɔk yinne fuoe sʋ'ʋgʋ fi'idi li giligid teŋ la. Ka nɔk yinne la yɛlig pɛbisʋgin. Ka m na fuoe m sʋ'ʋgʋ kati ba. 3Amaa nɔkim zuobid la fiin lɔɔ fʋ fuug nɔɔr, 4ka yisi li bi'ela nɔki lɔs bugumin ka li kanb. Bugum na naan ani tiigi paae Israel dim wʋsa.
5Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa' ye, Jerusalem kaŋa ka man ye m nɔki zi'el dunia teŋsʋk ka tɛɛns bɛdegʋ gilig o. 6O bugusim la zug ka o zan'asi m wada nɛ m zi'ela la gaad tembanɛ gilig o la. O zan'asnɛ ka pʋ dɔlli m wada nɛ m zi'ela la.
7Alazug Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa': Ya tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd gat tembanɛ giligi ya la ka ya pʋ dɔlli m zi'ela bɛɛ m wada la. Hali ya dɔlnɛ tembanɛ giligi ya la zi'ela.
8Dinzug Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'eli nwa': Mam mɛŋ kis yanam Jerusalem dim nɛ, ka na kɛ ka namisʋg paae ya ka dunia wʋsa nyɛ. 9Ya bada banɛ ka m kis ka ya sin ka maan la zug, m na maali ya bʋn linɛ ka m nan zi' maalɛ ka mɛ kʋ lɛm maali li buudii. 10Alazug ya tempʋʋgin la, saamnam na ɔnbi ba biis, ka biis ɔnbi ba saamnam. M na kɛ ka tɔɔg paae ya, ka banɛ pʋ kpi la m na widigi ba gilig dunia wʋsa. 11Alazug man Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pɔya ye yanamɛ dian'a mam Pʋ'ʋsim Yir, nɛ ya bada banɛ ka ya ya'ab ka m kis la, m kʋ lɛn sʋŋi ya. M mɛ kʋ lɛn zɔɔ ya nimbaanlig bɛɛ bas ka ya pɔnsɛ. 12Ya nidib la pʋdigir zin'is atan' yinne na kpi nɛ tɔɔg bɛɛ kɔ'ɔm. Ba mɛ na kʋ pʋdigir yinne nɛ sʋ'ʋg teŋ la yiŋ, ka m fuoe m sʋ'ʋgʋ kad banɛ kpɛlim la ka ba widigi keŋ dunia wʋsa.
13Linɛ na kɛ ka ɛndʋg nɛ sʋnpɛɛn linɛ ka m gban'e ba yɛla la niŋ lamm. Ala ka ba na baŋ ye man Zugsɔb sid pian'anɛ nɛ sʋntɔɔg.
14M na kɛ ka ya san'am ka lieb bʋnla'adir nimbanɛ giligi ya la teŋsʋk, ka banɛ wʋsa gat na gɔsidi ya zaalim. 15Ba na pɔ'ɔgi ya ka maali ya siaa. M ya'a kɛ ka tɔɔg nɛ mugusʋg paae ya, li na an nimmua sa'alʋgʋ tis tembanɛ giligi ya la. Man onɛ an Zugsɔb la yɛl ala. 16M ya'a ti tɔɔn ya nɛ kɔ'ɔm wʋʋ piim kanɛ mɔr yabid nɛ, li na kʋʋ ya. M na kɛ ka kɔ'ɔm tɔllʋ kena ka ya kʋ nyɛ diibɔ. 17M na kɛ ka kɔ'ɔm nɛ wɛog bʋnkɔnbid tʋ'ʋsi ya naae ya biis wʋsa. Tɔɔg nɛ zaba na gɛɛli ya, ka m kɛ ka ba zab nɛ ya. Man onɛ an Zugsɔb la yɛl ala.

english_text:
Israel Is Doomed
1The Lord God said:
2Ezekiel, son of man, face the hills of Israel and tell them:
3Listen, you mountains and hills, and every valley and gorge! I, the Lord, am about to turn against you and crush all the places where foreign gods are worshiped. 4Every altar will be smashed, and in front of the idols I will put to death the people who worship them. 5Dead bodies and bones will be lying around the idols and the altars. 6Every town in Israel will be destroyed to make sure that each shrine, idol, and altar is smashed—everything the Israelites made will be a pile of ruins. 7All over the country, your people will die. And those who survive will know that I, the Lord, did these things. 8I will let some of the people live through this punishment, but I will scatter them among the nations, 9where they will be prisoners. And when they think of me, they will realize that they disgraced me by rebelling and by worshiping idols. They will hate themselves for the evil things they did, 10and they will know that I am the Lord and that my warnings must be taken seriously.
11The Lord God then said:
Ezekiel, beat your fists together and stomp your feet in despair! Moan in sorrow, because the people of Israel have done disgusting things and now will be killed by enemy troops, or they will die from starvation and disease. 12Those who live far away will be struck with deadly diseases. Those who live nearby will be killed in war. And the ones who are left will starve to death. I will let loose my anger on them! 13These people used to offer incense to idols at altars built on hills and mountaintops and in the shade of large oak trees. But when they see dead bodies lying around those altars, they will know that I am the Lord. 14I will make their country a barren wasteland, from the Southern Desert to the town of Diblah in the north. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_text:
Zugsɔb la zɛrig Israel dim la yɛla
1Zugsɔb la da yɛlim ye; 2Ninsaal biiga, ʋkimi fʋ nindaa kpa' Israel zuoya la; ka zɛrigi ba tisim. 3Yɛlimi ba ye, Israel zuoya, wʋmmi Zugsɔb Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la labaar. Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa' tisid zuoya nɛ kʋkʋna la nɛ bɔn'ɔd la wʋsa: M bɔɔd ye m zab nɛ ya, ka san'am san'ami ya teŋgbana la wʋsa. 4Bimbim banɛ ka ya maan maana ka nyɔ'ɔd bʋnnyubisa la wʋsa m na nwa'a ba, ka kʋʋ ya nidib la ya bada la tuon. 5M na dɛlig Israel nidib la niŋgbina ba bada la tuon, ka widigi ya kɔnba la giligi ya bimbima la. 6Yanamɛ bɛ zin'isi'a wʋsa tɛɛns la na lieb zaalim ka ya teŋgbana la san'am, ka ya bimbima la san'am lieb zaalim, ka ba na nwa'a ya bada la bas, la'an nɛ ya bʋnnyubisa bimbima la; ka yanamɛ maal si'el wʋsa na bɔdig. 7Ba na kʋʋ ya nidib la ya teŋsʋk, ka li kɛ ka ya baŋ ye manɛ sid an Zugsɔb la.
8“Amaa m na tiligi ya sieba, bɔzugɔ ya sieba na nyaŋi zɔɔ pɔns, ka widigi keŋ buudi nɛ tɛɛns bɛdegʋ ni. 9Tɛɛns banɛ ka ba gban'e ba maal yammis la, banɛ pɔns la na tiɛn man yɛla ka baŋ man sʋnfʋ san'ami ba yɛla si'em. Ka li anɛ ba pʋtɛn'ɛr linɛ ka sida kae la, kɛ ka ba fɛndig ka bas mam, wʋʋ sɔ' na bas o pu'a ka bɔɔd pu'a sɔ', ba nini nyɛti ba bada la kɛ ka kʋkɔma'asim kpɛn' ba. Ba na kisigi ba mɛŋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nɛ tʋʋmkisa banɛ ka ba tʋm la yɛla. 10Ka ba na baŋ ye manɛ an Zugsɔb la, ka man da ye yɛla na kena la, m da pʋ vɔlisidnɛ nɛ nɔɔr pian'ad ma'aanɛ.”
11Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa', ye, “La'asimi fʋ nu'us ayi' bibig zug ka kimis nɔba ka ki'e kuŋ, tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd nɛ tʋʋmkisa banɛ ka Israel dim tʋm la zug. Linɛ na kʋʋ ba anɛ zaba nɛ kɔ'ɔm nɛ tɔɔg. 12Onɛ lal la, tɔɔg la na kʋʋ o; ka onɛ bɛ yammin, zaba la na kʋʋ o; ka onɛ pɔns ka pʋ kpii, kɔ'ɔm la na kʋʋ o. Ala ka m sʋnpɛɛn la na luu ba zug. 13Ka ba na baŋ ye manɛ an Wina'am, ba ya'a nyɛ ka ba kʋʋ ba nidib la ka ba digi tɛri giligi ba maan bimbima nɛ ba bada zin'isin la nɛ teŋgban wʋsa ni nɛ zuor wʋsa zug nɛ titita'ar wʋsa gbinnin, zin'ibanɛ ka ba nyɔ'ɔd maana nɛ bʋnnyubisa tisidi ba bada la. 14M na kɛ ka ba teŋ la lieb zaalim, lin pin'il pipirigin la ti paae Dibila teŋin nɛ ban bɛ zin'isi'a wʋsa. Ka ba baŋ ye manɛ sid an Zugsɔb la.”

english_text:
Disaster Is Near
1The Lord God said:
2Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Israel that I am saying:
Israel will soon come to an end! Your whole country is about to be destroyed 3as punishment for your disgusting sins. I, the Lord, am so angry 4that I will show no pity. I will punish you for the evil you've done, and you will know that I am the Lord.
5There's never been anything like the coming disaster. 6And when it comes, your life will be over. 7You people of Israel are doomed! Soon there will be panic on the mountaintops instead of celebration. 8I will let loose my anger and punish you for the evil things you've done. You'll get what you deserve. 9Your sins are so terrible, that you'll get no mercy from me. Then you will know that I, the Lord, have punished you.
10Disaster is near! Injustice and arrogance are everywhere, 11and violent criminals run free. None of you will survive the disaster, and everything you own and value will be shattered. 12The time is coming when everyone will be ruined. Buying and selling will stop, 13and people who sell property will never get it back, because all of you must be punished for your sins. And I won't change my mind!
14A signal has been blown on the trumpet, and weapons are prepared for battle. But no one goes to war, because in my anger I will strike down everyone in Israel.
Israel Is Surrounded
The Lord said to the people of Israel:
15War, disease, and starvation are everywhere! People who live in the countryside will be killed in battle, and those who live in towns will die from starvation or deadly diseases. 16Anyone who survives will escape into the hills, like doves who leave the valleys to find safety.
All of you will moan because of your sins. 17Your hands will tremble, and your knees go limp. 18You will put on sackcloth to show your sorrow, but terror will overpower you. Shame will be written all over your faces, and you will shave your heads in despair. 19Your silver and gold will be thrown into the streets like garbage, because those are the two things that led you into sin, and now they cannot save you from my anger. They are not even worth enough to buy food. 20You took great pride in using your beautiful jewelry to make disgusting idols of foreign gods. So I will make your jewelry worthless.
21Wicked foreigners will rob and disgrace you. 22They will break into my temple and leave it unfit as a place to worship me, but I will look away and let it happen.
23Your whole country is in confusion! Murder and violence are everywhere in Israel, 24so I will tell the most wicked nations to come and take over your homes. They will put an end to the pride you have in your strong army, and they will make your places of worship unfit to use. 25You will be terrified and will desperately look for peace—but there will be no peace. 26One tragedy will follow another, and you'll hear only bad news. People will beg prophets to give them a message from me. Priests will stop teaching my Law, and wise leaders won't be able to give advice. 27Even your king and his officials will lose hope and cry in despair. Your hands will tremble with fear.
I will punish you for your sins and treat you the same way you have treated others. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_text:
Li bɛn paae ya
1Zugsɔb la yɛlim ye, 2“Ninsaal biiga, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛt si'eli nwa' tisid Israel teŋ la ye, ‘Li bɛn paae ya! Li bɛn paae tis teŋgbauŋ la lʋga anaasi la wʋsa. 3Li bɛnnɛ yʋ'ʋn paae la zug, m na kpa'ae m sʋnpɛɛn la niŋif. M na kadif saria ka li dɔlli fʋ tʋʋma. Tʋʋmkisa banɛ ka fʋ tʋm la wʋsa m na yɔɔ fʋ li yɛla. 4M kʋ zɔɔf nimbaanlig bɛɛ basi fɔ; m sid na yɔɔ fʋ zʋgbɛ'ɛd nɛ tʋʋmkisa banɛ ka fʋ tʋm la lɛbis. Ala ka fʋ na baŋ ye manɛ sid an Zugsɔb la.’”
5Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye san'auŋ linɛ ka ya nan zi' nyɛ na paae ya. 6Li bɛn paae ya! Li bɛn sid paae ya! Li duoe li mɛŋi gɛɛli ya. Li kena! 7San'auŋ kɛɛn ya zugin na, yanam banɛ bɛ teŋin la. Saŋa la paae ya, dabisir la li'el ya, dabiem na bɛ zuoya la zug, ka li kʋ lɛn an sumalisim. 8Li kʋ yuugɛ, m na kpa'ae m sʋnpɛɛn la niŋi ya zugin; m na kadi ya saria ka li dɔlli ya tʋʋma an si'em, ka lɛbisi yɔɔ ya tʋʋmkisa banɛ ka ya tʋmmi ya sʋʋgin la. 9M kʋ zɔɔ ya nimbaanlig bɛɛ basi yaa. M na lɛbisi yɔɔ ya, ka li dɔlnɛ ya bɛllim nɛ tʋʋmkisa banɛ ka ya tʋm la. Ala ka ya na baŋ ye man onɛ an Zugsɔb la tʋmi li.
10Dabisir la nwa'! Li paae na! San'auŋ tansi yi paalʋ na, ka zabbɔɔdib la busid wʋʋ tutuud nɛ, ka tita'alim nɔbigid wʋʋ mɔɔd puum! 11Nɔŋgbannwa'ar yʋ'ʋn nɔbignɛ kilim balaar ye li bʋ' bugusnamɛ namisi ba; nidib la baa yinne kʋ pɔnsɛ; banɛ la'asi maan tʋkpiidʋg la nɛ ba areza'as nɛ ba la'asʋma wʋsa kʋ pɔnsɛ. 12Saŋa la paae ya, dabisir la paae ya. Onɛ da'ad la da mɔr sumalisim, ka onɛ mɛ kuosid la da mɔr sʋnsa'aŋa, bɔzugɔ san'auŋ la na paae sɔ' wʋsa. 13Onɛ kuosid la kʋ lɛm paam paalʋ kanɛ ka o kuos la ba wʋsa vʋm saŋaa, bɔzugɔ nier linɛ pa'an nidib yɛla la kʋ tiakɛ. Ba tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd la zug, ba nid baa yinne kʋ tiligɛ. 14La'an nɛ ban pieb na'atan ka ba ti'eb la, sɔ' kʋ yi zabirɛ, bɔzugɔ m sʋnpɛɛn paae nidib la wʋsa.
15Zaba la bɛ nɛ yiŋ, ka wiim nɛ kɔ'ɔm bɛ teŋ la pʋʋgin; banɛ bɛ teŋ la yiŋ la na kpi zaba ni, ka kɔ'ɔm nɛ wiim mɛ kʋ banɛ bɛ teŋ la pʋʋgin. 16Banɛ nyaŋi zɔɔ pɔns la na bɛ zuoya la ni kaasid wʋʋ sian'anr dawana, ba wʋsa na kaasidi ba mɛŋ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd zug. 17Nu'us wʋsa na kpi zɛba, ka duma wʋsa nyɔsid ka bʋk wʋʋ gungum nɛ. 18Ba na yɛ bɔto fuud sʋnsa'aŋ zug ka dabiem gban'e ba. Nyan na kpɛn' ba ka ba pʋni ba zut. 19 Ba na nɔki ba anzurifa lɔbi bas suoraadin, ka sanlima lieb wʋʋ sa'ad nɛ. Daakanɛ ka Zugsɔb sʋnpɛɛn na luna la, ba anzurifa nɛ ba sanlima la kʋ nyaŋi faaɛn ba. Li kʋ tun'e ma'ae ba kɔ'ɔm bɛɛ pɛ'ɛli ba pʋʋrɛ, bɔzugɔ li anɛ linɛ kɛ ka ba tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd. 20Ba da dʋ'ʋsidi ba mɛŋ nɛ ba niŋgɔnkɔris nɛ ba bʋnvɛnla la wʋsa zug, ka nɔki li kud bada nɛ wina banɛ ka man kis. Alazug mam na tiaki li ka li lieb dian'ad bunnɛ tisi ba. 21M na kɛ ka teŋ zʋŋ dim di'e li wʋsa zaba ni, ka dunia nimbɛ'ɛdnam na faaɛn ba la'ad la wʋsa, ka kɛ ka di lieb dian'ad. 22M na fɛndigi m nindaa ka kʋ lɛn gɔsi baa, ka kɛ ka ba nɔk man zin'ig linɛ an kasi la maal yalis yalisi. Na'ayiis na kpɛn' ani maal linɛ ka' suorɛ.
23“Ieemi baans, bɔzugɔ teŋ la pɛ'ɛli nɛ ninkʋʋr ka tempʋʋg la pɛ'ɛl nɛ taawai. 24M na kɛ ka teŋ kanɛ mɔr bugusim gat sɔ' wʋsa la kena sʋ'ʋgi ba ya'. Ya nimbɛda la nyɛɛsim na naae, ka ba na san'ami ba pʋ'ʋsim dɔɔd la. 25Mugusʋg ya'a ti kena kpɛn'ɛsi ba dabiem, ba na bɔɔd sumbʋgʋsʋm amaa ka kʋ nyɛɛ. 26Yɛla nɛ lababɛ'ɛd na ta'a-ta'a taaba kena. Ba na bɔɔd ye nɔdi'esidib la yɛli ba linɛ na maal bɛog sa, amaa ba na mɔɔ gɛn; Zugsɔb wada linɛ ka maanmaannib la pa'an la kʋ lɛm bɛɛ, ka kpɛɛmnam sa'alʋg la mɛ kʋ lɛm bɛɛ. 27Na'ab la na kaas kʋʋr, ka na'abiis la sʋnf san'am, ka teŋ la nidib wʋsa nu'us na kirid. Man na tɛɛgi ba tʋbir ka li dɔlli ba tʋʋma an si'em. Ba mɛŋ zi'esim an si'em la, ala ka m ye m dɔlisi kadi ba saria. Ala ka ba na baŋ ye manɛ sid an Zugsɔb la.”

english_text:
Ezekiel Sees the Terrible Sins of Jerusalem
1Six years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the leaders of Judah were meeting with me in my house. On the fifth day of the sixth month, the Lord God suddenly took control of me, 2 and I saw something in the shape of a human. This figure was like fire from the waist down, and it was bright as polished metal from the waist up. 3It reached out what seemed to be a hand and grabbed my hair. Then in my vision the Lord's Spirit lifted me into the sky and carried me to Jerusalem.
The Spirit took me to the north gate of the temple's inner courtyard, where there was an idol that disgusted the Lord and made him furious. 4 Then I saw the brightness of the glory of the God of Israel, just as I had seen it near the Chebar River.
5God said to me, “Ezekiel, son of man, look north.” And when I did, I saw that repulsive idol by the altar near the gate.
6God then said, “Do you see the terrible sins of the people of Israel? Their sins are making my holy temple unfit as a place to worship me. Yet you will see even worse things than this.”
7Next, I was taken to the entrance of the courtyard, where I saw a hole in the wall.
8God said, “Make this hole bigger.” And when I did, I realized it was a doorway. 9“Go in,” God said, “and see what horrible and evil things the people are doing.”
10Inside, I saw that the walls were covered with pictures of reptiles and disgusting, unclean animals, as well as with idols that the Israelites were worshiping. 11Seventy Israelite leaders were standing there, including Jaazaniah son of Shaphan. Each of these leaders was holding an incense burner, and the smell of incense filled the room.
12God said, “Ezekiel, do you see what horrible things Israel's leaders are doing in secret? They have filled their rooms with idols. And they say I can't see them, because they think I have already deserted Israel. 13But I will show you something even worse than this.”
14He took me to the north gate of the temple, where I saw women mourning for the god Tammuz. 15God asked me, “Can you believe what these women are doing? But now I want to show you something even worse.”
16I was then led into the temple's inner courtyard, where I saw about 25 men standing near the entrance, between the porch and the altar. Their backs were to the Lord's temple, and they were bowing down to the rising sun.
17God said, “Ezekiel, it's bad enough that the people of Judah are doing these disgusting things. But they have also spread violence and injustice everywhere in Israel and have made me very angry. They have disgraced and insulted me in the worst possible way. 18So in my fierce anger, I will punish them without mercy and refuse to help them when they cry out to me.”
translation_text:
Ba'ar linɛ bɛ Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la yɛla
1Saŋa kanɛ ka ti da an yammisi bɛ teŋ zʋŋ la, yʋma ayuobʋ la ni, li nwadis ayuobʋ la dabisa anu daar la, ka man nɛ Israel kpɛɛmnam zin' m yin, ka Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la paŋ kɛɛn m san'an na. 2M da nyɛ si'el ka li zi'e nwɛnɛ nid. Ka lin yii o siaa baba sig la nwɛnɛ bugum nɛ, ka o siaa la baba dʋt la nyɛɛn wʋʋ kʋnt nɛ. 3O da tiɛn si'el ka li nwɛnɛ nu'ug nɛ gban'e m zuobid. Ka Siig la ʋkim agɔla mɔrimi keŋ Jerusalem zak linɛ bɛ pʋʋgin la za'anɔɔr linɛ lɛbid ya-dagɔbʋg baba la. Ani ka ba'ar linɛ duod Wina'am sʋʋnr la da zi'e.
4Ani ka m nyɛ Israel Wina'am girima la, wʋʋ man da nyɛɛ li si'em Keba kɔldaug paalʋ ni la.
5Ka o yɛlim ye, “Ninsaal biiga, gɔsim kpa' ya-dagɔbʋg baba!” Ka m gɔsi nyɛ maan daka linɛ bɛ ya-dagɔbʋg za'anɔɔrin la, ka ba'ar linɛ duod Zugsɔb sʋnf la zi'e ani.
6Ka o yɛlim ye, “Ninsaal biiga, fʋ nyɛ ban maan si'elaa? Li anɛ tʋʋmkisa banɛ ka Israel dim tʋm kpɛla, bʋmbanɛ na kɛ ka man lal nɛ m Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la. Hali fʋ na nyɛ yɛlkisa linɛ gaad ala.”
7Ka o yʋ'ʋn mɔrimi kɛn Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la za'ambɛŋ za'anɔɔrin na, ka m gɔs ka zaŋguom la mɔr vɔɔnr. 8Ka o yɛlim ye, “Ninsaal biiga, nannanna tuum vɔɔnr zaŋguom la ni.” Ka m sid tu ka nyɛ za'anɔɔr ka li bɛɛ ani.
9Ka o yɛlim ye, “Kpɛn'ɛm gɔs bugusim nɛ tʋʋmkisa linɛ ka ba tʋm kpɛla.” 10Ka m sid kpɛn' nyɛ ka ba gʋli gʋl bʋnkɔnbid banɛ vuud nɛ bʋnkɔnbkisa nɛ Israel dim bada la wʋsa tabil zaŋguom la. 11Israel kpɛɛmnam pisyɔpɔi da zi'e ani, ka Jaazanaya onɛ an Safan biig la mɛ la'am zi'e nɛ ba. Sɔ' wʋsa da zanli linɛ ka ba nyu'od bʋnnyubisa ani la ba nu'usin, ka nyɔ'ɔs zɔɔnd. 12Wina'am da bu'osim ye, “Ninsaal biiga, fʋ nyɛ Israel kpɛɛmnam la tʋm si'el likinɛɛ? Sɔ' wʋsa zi'enɛ o ba'ar tuon. Bɔzugɔ ba gban'e ba pʋtɛn'ɛrin ye, ‘Zugsɔb la pʋ nyɛti tii; o tam teŋ la yɛla nɛ.’” 13Ka o lɛn yɛlim ye, “Fʋ na nyɛ ka ba tʋm si'elnam ka li an bɛ'ɛdi gat nɛ'ɛnam.”
14O da mɔrimi keŋ za'anɔɔr kanɛ bɛ ya-datiuŋ baba Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yin la, ka m nyɛ pu'ab ka ba zi'e ani kaasid Tamuz onɛ an ba'ar la kʋʋr. 15Ka o bu'osim ye, “Fʋ nyɛ nɛ'ɛŋaa? M na pa'alif tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd linɛ gaad fʋn nyɛt si'el la.”
16O da mɔrimi kpɛn' Pʋ'ʋsim Yin zak linɛ bɛ pʋʋgin la. Ka dap wʋʋ ban pisi nɛ anu zi'e Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg za'ambɛŋ nɛ maan daka la teŋsʋkʋ bid kudugʋ tis Dɔɔg la. Ba da kpa'anɛ ya-nya'aŋi wɔ'ɔgid winnig saŋkanɛ ka o tansid na la.
17O da bu'osim ye, “Ninsaal biiga, fʋ nyɛ nɛ'ɛŋa wʋsaa? Li pʋ pak Juda dim nɛ ban tʋm tʋʋmfɛn'ɛsa laa? Hali ba lɛn ieed zaba ken nidib la sʋʋgin na ka li kɛ ka m sʋnf duoe nɛ ba. Gɔsim ban tʋ'ʋdim nɛ tʋ'ʋtita'ar si'em! 18Alazug mam na pa'ali ba ye m sʋnf duonɛ; m kʋ zɔɔ ba nimbaanlig bɛɛ basi baa. La'an nɛ ban kpiidi m tʋba nii bɛllim la, m kʋ wʋm tisi baa.”

english_text:
The Lord Gives the Command To Punish Jerusalem
1After that, I heard the Lord shout, “Come to Jerusalem, you men chosen to destroy the city. And bring your weapons!”
2I saw six men come through the north gate of the temple, each one holding a deadly weapon. A seventh man dressed in a linen robe was with them, and he was carrying things to write with. The men went into the temple and stood by the bronze altar.
3The brightness of God's glory then left its place above the statues of the winged creatures inside the temple and moved to the entrance. The Lord said to the man in the linen robe, 4 “Walk through the city of Jerusalem and mark the forehead of anyone who is truly upset and sad about the terrible things that are being done here.”
5-6He turned to the other six men and said, “Follow him and put to death everyone who doesn't have a mark on their forehead. Show no mercy or pity! Kill men and women, parents and children. Begin here at my temple, but be sure not to harm those who are marked.”
The men immediately killed the leaders who were standing there.
7Then the Lord said, “Pollute the temple by piling the dead bodies in the courtyards. Now get busy!” They left and started killing the people of Jerusalem.
8I was then alone, so I bowed down and cried out to the Lord, “Why are you doing this? Are you so angry with the people of Jerusalem that everyone must die?”
9The Lord answered, “The people of Israel and Judah have done horrible things. Their country is filled with murderers, and Jerusalem itself is filled with violence. They think that I have deserted them, and that I can't see what they are doing. 10And so I will not have pity on them or forgive them. They will be punished for what they have done.”
11Just then, the man in the linen robe returned and said, “I have done what you commanded.”
translation_text:
Ban kʋ ba'amaannib la yɛla
1M da wʋm ka Wina'am tans nɛ kʋkɔtita'ari yɛl ye, “La'asimi banɛ gur tempʋʋg la kpɛla na, ka kɛ ka sɔ' wʋsa mɔr o zaba la'ad o nu'ugin!” 2 Ka m nyɛ dapa ayuobʋ ka ba yi ya-datiuŋ baba za'anɔɔr kanɛ bɛ zugin la kenna, ka mɔr zaba la'abɛda ba nu'usin. Sɔ' da paasi dɔlli ba yɛ fupiel ka zanl si'el linɛ ka o na nyaŋi sɔbi li zug ka li lab o sakpidir. Ba da kpɛn' na zi'enɛ kpi'en nɛ kʋntzɛn'ug maan daka la. 3Ka Israel Wina'am la na'am pipilim da naan Kerubnam la zugin, lin da pʋn dɛŋi bɛ zin'isi'a la, dʋʋ agɔla ka keŋ ban dɔl zin'isi'a kpɛn'ɛd Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔgin la. Ka Zugsɔb buol onɛ yɛ fupiel ka zanl linɛ sɔbid ka li lab o sakpidirin la 4ka yɛl o ye, “Kem kaae gilig Jerusalem tempʋʋg la wʋsa ka zanbil banɛ wʋsa sid kum ka fabin tʋʋmkisa banɛ wʋsa tʋm teŋ la pʋʋgin la gbɛ'ɛlaas.”
5Man da kɛlisid la, ka wʋm ka o yɛl bama la ye, “Dɔlli nɛ o gilig teŋ la wʋsa kʋ nidib la. Da zɔɔe sɔ' nimbaanlig bɛɛ mɔr nyɔɔg nɛ sɔ'. 6Kʋʋmi bʋnkʋd nɛ dasam nɛ pu'asada nɛ pu'ab nɛ biis, amaa da si'isi onɛ wʋsa mɔr zanbinnɛ o gbɛ'ogʋnɛ. Pin'ilimi Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg la pʋʋgin.” Ba sid da pin'il nɛ kpɛɛmnam banɛ bɛ Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg la tuon la.
7Wina'am da yɛli ba ye, “Miligimi Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg la ka li da lɛn an kasii, ka kʋ nidibi pɛ'ɛl za'as la. Kemi!” Ka ba sid yi ka pin'il kʋʋb teŋ la wʋsa pʋʋgin. 8Ban da pin'ili kʋʋd la ka man kpɛlimmi m kɔn' ani, ka m luu avanba ka kaas kuŋ ye, “Aa, Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔba! Anwa ka fʋ ye fʋ mɔr tɔɔg linɛ ka fʋ lɔbi bas Jerusalem teŋ zug la san'am Israel nimbanɛ kpɛlim la wʋsaa?”
9Ka o lɛbisi yɛlim ye, “Israel nɛ Juda nidib la tʋmnɛ tʋʋmbɛ'ɛtita'ar hali. Teŋgbauŋ la pɛ'ɛli nɛ ziim ka sida lɛn kae tempʋʋgin laa. Ba yɛt ye, ‘Zugsɔb la tam teŋ la yɛla nɛ: Zugsɔb la pʋ nyɛtaa.’ 10Alazug man kʋ zɔɔ ba nimbaanlig bɛɛ kɛ ka sɔ' pɔnsɛ, amaa ban maal si'el la wʋsa, m na kɛ ka li lɛbi ba zugin na.”
11Ka dau kanɛ yɛ fupiel ka zanl linɛ sɔbid o sakpidirin la lɛb na yɛt ye, “Man tʋm wʋʋ fʋn yɛlim si'em la naae.”

english_text:
The Lord's Glory Leaves the Temple
1 I saw the dome that was above the four winged creatures, and on it was the sapphire throne. 2 The Lord said to the man in the linen robe, “Walk among the four wheels beside the creatures and pick up as many hot coals as you can carry. Then scatter them over the city of Jerusalem.” I watched him as he followed the Lord's instructions.
3The winged creatures were standing south of the temple when the man walked among them. A cloud filled the inner courtyard, 4and the brightness of the Lord's glory moved from above the creatures and stopped at the entrance of the temple. The entire temple was filled with his glory, and the courtyard was dazzling bright. 5The sound of the creatures' wings was as loud as the voice of God All-Powerful and could even be heard in the outer courtyard.
6The man in the robe was now standing beside a wheel. 7One of the four creatures reached its hand into the fire among them and gave him some of the hot coals. The man took the coals and left.
8I noticed again that each of the four winged creatures had what looked like human hands under their wings, 9 and I saw the four wheels near the creatures. These wheels were shining like chrysolite. 10Each wheel was exactly the same and had a second wheel that cut through the middle of it, 11so that they could move in any direction without turning. The wheels moved together whenever the creatures moved. 12 I also noticed that the wheels and the creatures' bodies, including their backs, their hands, and their wings, were covered with eyes. 13And I heard a voice calling these “the wheels that spin.”
14 Each of the winged creatures had four faces: the face of a bull, the face of a human, the face of a lion, and the face of an eagle. 15-17These were the same creatures I had seen near the Chebar River. They controlled when and where the wheels moved—the wheels went wherever the creatures went and stopped whenever they stopped. Even when the creatures flew in the air, the wheels stayed beside them.
18Then I watched the brightness of the Lord's glory move from the entrance of the temple and stop above the winged creatures. 19They spread their wings and flew into the air with the wheels at their side. They stopped at the east gate of the temple, and the Lord's glory was above them.
20I knew for sure that these were the same creatures I had seen beneath the Lord's glory near the Chebar River. 21-22They had four wings with hands beneath them, and they had the same four faces as those near the River. Each creature moved straight ahead without turning.
translation_text:
Zugsɔb girima la yi ka bas Pʋ'ʋsim Yir la yɛla
1M da gɔsi nyɛ bʋnsi'a linɛ nwɛnɛ na'am kʋk ka li nyɛɛnnɛ nwɛnɛ gɔtiŋ nɛ bɛ linɛ an lammiri ka bɛ Kerubnam la zugin la. 2Zugsɔb la da yɛl onɛ yɛ fupiel la ye, “Kem kpɛn' fiil banɛ bɛ Kerubnam la lɛuŋʋn la teŋsʋk ka gbin'e bugumsaana linɛ bɛ Kerubnam la teŋsʋk la pɛ'ɛli fʋ nu'us ka widigi li kpɛn'ɛs tempʋʋgin la.” Ka man nan gɔsid la ka o keŋ kpɛn' ani.
3Saŋkanɛ ka dau la kpɛn' la, Kerubnam la da zi'enɛ Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔgin la lɛbisid ya-dagɔbʋg baba, ka Zugsɔb girima la pɛ'ɛl zak la. 4Zugsɔb girima la da yi Kerubnam la zugin keŋ paae Dɔɔg la za'ambɛŋin la, ka zin'ig la pɛ'ɛl nɛ Zugsɔb girima la vɛnlim. 5Kerubnam la kpʋkpama da vuud Pʋ'ʋsim Dɔɔg la za'ambɛŋin la ka li wʋm paalʋ wʋʋ Wina'am Onɛ an Paŋtita'ar sɔb la ɛɛn pian' ka li an si'em la.
6 Saŋkanɛ ka Zugsɔb la da tis onɛ yɛ fupiel la nɔɔr ye o gbin'e bugum fiilnam la nɛ Kerubnam la teŋsʋk la, dau la da keŋ zi'enɛ kpi'en nɛ fiil yinne. 7Ka Kerub yinne tiɛn o nu'ugʋ paae bugum kanɛ bɛɛ ba teŋsʋk la. O da gbin'e bugum la niŋ dau la nu'ugin, ka o mɔri lii yi yiŋ. 8(Bʋnsi'a da bɛ Kerubnam la kpʋkpama lɛuŋʋn nwɛnɛ ninsaal nu'us nɛ.)
9M da gɔsi nyɛ fiilnam anaasi kpi'e Kerubnam la, ka yinne wʋsa kpi'e bʋnvʋr yinne, nyɛɛn hali wʋʋ gɔtiŋ nɛ. 10Ya'a kpɛlim ban nwɛn si'em yɛla, ba wʋsa da nwɛnɛ taaba, yinne wʋsa da nwɛnɛ ba nɔknɛ yinne nyaae li tiraan pʋʋgin nɛ. 11Ka Kerubnam la ya'a ken dunia lʋga anaasi la wʋsa zin'isi'a fiilnam la dɔlnɛ ka li ka' ye ba fɛndigɛ, Kerubnam la ya'a ken zin'ikanɛ ka ba zug kpa' wʋsa, ba kennɛ ka pʋ fɛndigida. 12Ba niŋgbina la wʋsa la'an nɛ ba nya'aŋ nɛ ba nu'us nɛ kpʋkpama wʋsa da anɛ nini ma'aa, la'an nɛ fiilnam anaasi la wʋsa. 13Man da wʋm ka ba buon fiilnam la ye, “Fiilzɔta.” 14Kerubnam la wʋsa da mɔri nindaas anaas naas. Nindaa yinne da nwɛnɛ Kerub nindaa, ka linɛ paas ayi' la nwɛnɛ ninsaal nindaa, ka linɛ paas atan' la nwɛnɛ gbigim nindaa, ka linɛ paas anaasi la nwɛnɛ abaar nindaa.
15Kerubnam la da duoe dʋt agɔla. Bama da an bʋnvʋbanɛ ka m da dɛŋin nyɛ Keba kɔldaug la dɛn'ɛr la. 16Kerubnam la ya'a da ken, fiil banɛ bɛɛ ba lʋga ni la mɛ kennɛ, ka ba ya'a ti yadigi ba kpʋkpama la ye ba iank teŋin dʋʋ agɔla, fiilnam la mɛ dɔlnɛ. 17Kerubnam la ya'a ti zi'en baanlimm, li mɛ zi'enid nɛ, ka ba ya'a duoe ka li mɛ duoe, bɔzugɔ bʋnvʋya la siig da bɛ fiilnamin la.
18Zugsɔb girima la da yi za'ambɛŋin la keŋ zi'en Kerubnam la zugin. 19Man da nan gɔt la, ka Kerubnam la yadigi ba kpʋkpama ye ba iank teŋin dʋʋ agɔla, ka ban iank la ka fiilnam la mɛ ianki dɔlli ba. Ba da keŋ zi'en Pʋ'ʋsim Yir za'anɔɔr linɛ bɛ ya-nya'aŋ baba la, ka Israel Wina'am la girima bɛɛ ba zugin.
20Bʋnvʋbama ka man da nyɛ Israel Wina'am la san'an Keba kɔldaug la baba la, ka m baŋ ye ba anɛ Kerubnam. 21Ba wʋsa da mɔri nindaas anaas naas, nɛ kpʋkpama anaas naas ka si'el bɛɛ ba kpʋkpama lɛuŋʋn nwɛnɛ ninsaal nu'us nɛ. 22Ba nindaas la da nwɛnɛ banɛ ka man nyɛ Keba kɔldaug baba la. Ba wʋsa da kpɛn kennɛ kpa'adi ba nindaa kpa' si'em la ken.

english_text:
Ezekiel Condemns Jerusalem's Wicked Leaders
1The Lord's Spirit lifted me up and took me to the east gate of the temple, where I saw 25 men, including the two leaders, Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah. 2The Lord said, “Ezekiel, son of man, these men are making evil plans and giving dangerous advice to the people of Jerusalem. 3They say things like, ‘Let's build more houses. This city is like a cooking pot over a fire, and we are the meat, but at least the pot keeps us from being burned in the fire.’ 4So, Ezekiel, condemn them!”
5The Lord's Spirit took control of me and told me to tell these leaders:
I, the Lord God, know what you leaders are saying. 6You have murdered so many people that the city is filled with dead bodies! 7This city is indeed a cooking pot, but the bodies of those you killed are the meat. And so I will force you to leave Jerusalem, 8and I'll send armies to attack you, just as you fear. 9Then you will be captured and punished by foreign enemies. 10You will be killed in your own country, but not before you realize that I, the Lord, have done these things.
11You leaders claim to be meat in a cooking pot, but you won't be protected by this city. No, you will die at the border of Israel. 12You will realize that while you were following the laws of nearby nations, you were disobeying my laws and teachings. And I am the Lord!
13Before I finished speaking, Pelatiah dropped dead. I bowed down and cried out, “Please, Lord God, don't kill everyone left in Israel.”
A Promise of Hope
14The Lord replied:
15Ezekiel, son of man, the people living in Jerusalem claim that you and the other Israelites who were taken to Babylonia are too far away to worship me. They also claim that the land of Israel now belongs only to them. 16But here is what I want you to tell the Israelites in Babylonia:
It's true that I, the Lord God, have forced you out of your own country and made you live among foreign nations. But for now, I will be with you wherever you are, so that you can worship me. 17And someday, I will gather you from the nations where you are scattered and let you live in Israel again. 18When that happens, I want you to clear the land of all those idols I hate so much. 19 Then I will take away your stubbornness and make you eager to be completely faithful to me. You will want to obey me 20and all my laws and teachings. You will be my people, and I will be your God. 21But those who worship idols will be punished and get what they deserve. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
The Lord's Glory Leaves Jerusalem
22 After the Lord had finished speaking, the winged creatures spread their wings and flew into the air, and the wheels were beside them. The brightness of the Lord's glory above them 23left Jerusalem and stopped at a hill east of the city.
24Then in my vision, the Lord's Spirit lifted me up and carried me back to the other exiles in Babylonia. The vision faded away, 25and I told them everything the Lord had shown me.
translation_text:
Israel tuongatib tʋbtɛkir yɛla
1Wina'am Siig la da ʋkimi keŋ Zugsɔb Pʋ'ʋsim Yir za'anɔɔr linɛ kpa' ya-tuona baba la. Za'anɔɔrin la dap pisi nɛ anu da zin' ani, ka m nyɛ Jaazanaya onɛ an Azur biig la nɛ Pelataya onɛ an Benaya biig la ka ba bɛɛ ba teŋsʋk, banɛ an nidib la tuongatib. 2Zugsɔb la da yɛlim ye, Ninsaal biiga, nimbama gban'adnɛ gban'abɛ'ɛd, ka sa'an nidib la bugusim sa'alʋg tempʋʋg kaŋa ni. 3Ba ye, Li pʋ kpɛlim bi'ela ka ti pin'il ya' mɛɛbɔ? Tempʋkaŋa anɛ dʋk kanɛ ka ba mɔri dʋgid, ka tinam an ni'im la.
4Alazug di'em m nɔɔr pian'ad linɛ ka m zɛrigi ba la tisi ba; pian'am, Ninsaal biiga.
5Ka Zugsɔb Siig la kɛɛn m san'an na, ka Zugsɔb la ye m yɛlim ye, Zugsɔb la yɛl si'em nwa' ye, Yanamɛ yɛt si'em nwa', Israel nidiba, amaa man mi' linɛ bɛɛ ya pʋtɛn'ɛrin. 6Ya kʋ nidib bɛdegʋ tempʋkaŋa ni, ka suoraad la pɛ'ɛl nɛ kum.
7“Alazug Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa' ye, ‘Kum banɛ ka ya kʋʋ lɔbi digil la an ni'im la, ka tempʋʋg la an dʋk la, amaa m na kadi ya yisi li ni.’ 8Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl ye, Ya zɔtnɛ sʋ'ʋg la, ka sʋ'ʋg la mɛn ka m ye m nɔki kʋʋ ya. 9M na kadi ya yis teŋ la ni, ka nɔki ya tis teŋ zʋŋ nidib ka ba namisi ya. 10Sʋ'ʋg la ye li kʋʋ ya, ka m kadi ya saria ka kɛ ka tɔɔg paae ya Israel teŋ titɔndigin; ka ya baŋ ye manɛ sid an Zugsɔb la. 11Tempʋkaŋa kʋ an dʋkʋ tisi ya bɛɛ yanam an ni'imi li nii. Man na kadi ya saria ka namisi ya, Israel teŋ la titɔndis baba. 12Ka ya baŋ ye manɛ sid an Zugsɔb la, bɔzugɔ ya pʋ siaki m zi'ela bɛɛ m wada la, amaa ya lɛɛ niŋidi wʋʋ sʋ'ʋlim banɛ giligi ya la niŋid si'em la nɔɔ.”
13Tɔ', ka man da nan yɛt on ye m yɛlim si'el la, Pelataya onɛ an Benaya biig la da kpiya. Ka m luu avanba ka kaas kuŋ ye, “Aa! Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔba! Fʋ na kʋ Israel nimbanɛ kpɛlim la wʋsaa?”
Israel lɛbig la yɛla
14Zugsɔb la pian'ad da kɛɛn m san'an na ye, 15“Ninsaal biiga, fʋ ba'abiis la, ɛɛn fʋ ba'abibanɛ ka fʋn nɛ ban an ziim yinne la, nɛ Israel dim la wʋsa anɛ banɛ ka Jerusalem dim la yɛt ye ya lalli nɛ Zugsɔb la. Ka ye, ‘Tinam ka ba tis teŋ kaŋa ye ti sʋ'oe li.’”
16Ka Zugsɔb da lɛn yɛlim ye, Alazugɔ yɛlimi ba ye Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa' ye, La'an nɛ man mɔri ba keŋ lalli widigi ba kpɛn'ɛs sʋ'ʋlimnamin nɛ tɛɛnsin la, m bɛ nɛ ba zin'ikanɛ wʋsa ka ba keŋ.
17 Alazugɔ yɛlimi ba ye Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la yɛl si'em nwa' ye, Man na la'asi ya sʋ'ʋlimnamin la ka zii ya yi tɛɛns banɛ ka ya widig la ni mɔri ya lɛb na, ka lɛn lɛbis Israel teŋ la tisi ya ya'as.
18Ba na lɛbi li ni ka vɔn' bada nɛ wina banɛ ka man kis la. 19M na tisi ba pʋtɛn'ɛr yinne linɛ ka ba kʋ bi'es mam, ka nɔk sipaaligi kpɛn'ɛsi ba pʋʋgin. M na yisi ba sʋnya linɛ kpi'em wʋʋ kugir la, ka tisi ba sʋnya linɛ bʋgʋs. 20Ala ka ba na nyaŋi dɔlli m gban'ar ka gu'us ka dɔlli m wada la. Ba na aan m nidib, ka mam na aan ba Wina'am. 21Amaa banɛ nɔki ba sʋnya pɛsigi tisi ba wina nɛ bada banɛ ka man kis la, ban tʋm si'el wʋsa m na kɛ ka li lɛbi ba zugin na. Zugsɔb onɛ an Paŋtita'ar Sɔb la pian'ʋkʋ la.
22Ka Kerubnam banɛ mɔr fiilnam la yadigi ba kpʋkpama, ka Israel Wina'am la girima bɛɛ ba zugin. 23Zugsɔb girima la da yi teŋ la zugʋ keŋ zi'en zuor linɛ zi'e tempʋʋg ya-nya'aŋ baba la zug. 24Siig la da ʋkimi mɔri keŋ yammis banɛ bɛ Babilon teŋin la, ka li anɛ Wina'am Siigi nie pa'alim si'em la.
Ka man nyɛ bʋnsi'a la yii m san'an. 25Ka m yɛl yammis la Zugsɔb la pa'alim si'el la wʋsa.

english_text:
Ezekiel Acts Out Israel's Captivity
1The Lord said:
2 Ezekiel, son of man, you are living among rebellious people. They have eyes, but refuse to see; they have ears, but refuse to listen. 3So before it gets dark, here is what I want you to do. Pack a few things as though you were going to be taken away as a prisoner. Then go outside where everyone can see you and walk around from place to place. Maybe as they watch, they will realize what rebels they are. 4After you have done this, return to your house.
Later that evening leave your house as if you were going into exile. 5Dig through the wall of your house and crawl out, carrying the bag with you. Make sure everyone is watching. 6Lift the bag to your shoulders, and with your face covered, take it into the darkness, so that you cannot see the land you are leaving. All this will be a warning for the people of Israel.
7I did everything the Lord had said. I packed a few things. Then as the sun was going down, and while everyone was watching, I dug a hole through one of the walls of my house. I pulled out my bag, then lifted it to my shoulders and left in the darkness.
8The next morning, the Lord 9reminded me that those rebellious people didn't even ask what I was doing. 10So he sent me back to tell them:
The Lord God has a message for the leader of Jerusalem and everyone living there!
11I have done these things to show them what will happen when they are taken away as prisoners.
12The leader of Jerusalem will lift his own bag to his shoulders at sunset and leave through a hole that the others have dug in the wall of his house. He will cover his face, so he can't see the land he is leaving. 13 The Lord will spread out a net and trap him as he leaves Jerusalem. He will then be led away to the city of Babylon, but will never see that place, even though he will die there. 14His own officials and troops will scatter in every direction, and the Lord will track them down and put them to death.
15The Lord will force the rest of the people in Jerusalem to live in foreign nations, where they will realize that he has done all these things. 16Some of them will survive the war, the starvation, and the deadly diseases. That way, they will be able to tell foreigners how disgusting their sins were, and that it was the Lord who punished them in this way.
A Sign of Fear
17The Lord said:
18Ezekiel, son of man, shake with fear when you eat, and tremble when you drink. 19Tell the people of Israel that I, the Lord, say that someday everyone in Jerusalem will shake when they eat and tremble when they drink. Their country will be destroyed and left empty, because they have been cruel and violent. 20Every town will lie in ruins, and the land will be a barren desert. Then they will know that I am the Lord.
The Words of the Lord Will Come True
21The Lord said:
22Ezekiel, son of man, you've heard people in Israel use the saying, “Time passes, and prophets are proved wrong.” 23Now tell the people that I, the Lord, am going to prove that saying wrong. No one will ever be able to use it again in Israel, because very soon everything I have said will come true! 24The people will hear no more useless warnings and false messages. 25I will give them my message, and what I say will certainly happen. Warn those rebels that the time has come for them to be punished. I, the Lord, make this promise.
